/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Claws/TennoCl.zhDescription: （英文：VENKA）运用一种全新的战斗姿势，这把 Tenno 武器可以把拳头变为利爪，把敌人变成散乱的肉块及废铁。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/BrassKnuckles.name: Kogake
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/BrassKnuckles.description: These coverings for the hands and feet allow devastating high flying hand-to-hand combat attacks without risking harm to the user.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/BrassKnuckles.zhDescription: （英文：KOGAKE）这些覆盖物装在使用者的手脚上，能让他们进行激烈又危险的肉搏战而不受到伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/WolfFrame.name: Sarofang
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/WolfFrame.description: Mete out the sharp pain of justice. Heavy Slam attacks create a vortex that pulls in lifted enemies when the Sarofang’s Combo Multiplier builds to 8x. In Voruna’s hands, the Sarofang only requires a 5x Combo Multiplier to summon the vortex.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/WolfFrame.zhDescription: （英文：SAROFANG）给予维持正义所带来的剧痛。当沙罗之牙的连击倍率达到 8 倍时，重型震地攻击会产生一个漩涡，将被举起的敌人卷入。在 Voruna 的手中，沙罗之牙只需要 5 倍的连击倍率就能召唤漩涡。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/PrimeVoru.name: Sarofang Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/PrimeVoru.description: Voruna Prime's signature axe is adorned with Orokin gold. She personally ensured that the former owners would have no further use for it.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/PrimeVoru.zhDescription: （英文：SAROFANG PRIME）Voruna Prime 的标志性战斧装饰着奥罗金黄金。她亲自确保了这把战斧的前任主人不会再使用它。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/DualInfes.name: Dual Ichor
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/DualInfes.description: The fast and brutal Dual Ichor axes will quickly tear through enemies with a high probability of inflicting Critical Damage.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/DualInfes.zhDescription: （英文：DUAL ICHOR）迅捷凶残的恶脓双斧能借由高几率的强力暴击快速撕裂敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/DualAxeWe.name: Dual Zoren
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/DualAxeWe.description: Short axes held in each hand. High attack speed and can hit multiple targets. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/DualAxeWe.zhDescription: （英文：DUAL ZOREN）双手各为轴心挥砍。高攻速且能同时攻击多目标。高暴击几率。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/AxeWeapon.name: Scindo
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/AxeWeapon.description: The Scindo is a heavy war axe crafted by the Tenno. Reduced speed and agility is balanced by heavy, devastating strikes capable of connecting with multiple targets at once.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/AxeWeapon.zhDescription: （英文：SCINDO）分裂斩斧是由 Tenno 精心设计的重型战斧。减少速度和灵活性加强重量，破坏性的攻击能够一次杀伤多个目标。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/PrimeZore.name: Dual Zoren Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/PrimeZore.description: Axes worthy of an executioner, refined to Orokin perfection.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/PrimeZore.zhDescription: （英文：DUAL ZOREN PRIME）这是两把配得上行刑者的斧头，是奥罗金工艺登峰造极的体现。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/PrimeScin.name: Scindo Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/PrimeScin.description: An ancient executioners weapon, the honor of decapitation by the Scindo Prime was reserved for the Orokin's most respected enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Axe/PrimeScin.zhDescription: （英文：SCINDO PRIME）一把古老的刑具，只有那些最受奥罗金尊重的敌人才能享有被分裂斩斧 Prime 斩首的荣耀。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/WraithLatr.name: Latron Wraith
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/WraithLatr.description: The Latron Wraith is a powerful variation of the standard, semi-automatic rifle that features unique styling.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/WraithLatr.zhDescription: （英文：LATRON WRAITH）拉特昂·亡魂是把变异版本的半自动步枪，拥有强大火力以及自己的独特外观。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnoPrmryXb.name: Attica
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnoPrmryXb.description: Quickly fire off a volley of deadly bolts with the Attica repeating crossbow.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnoPrmryXb.zhDescription: （英文：ATTICA）阿提卡连弩能够快速发射一片致命的弩矢弹幕。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnoLotusPo.name: Steflos
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnoLotusPo.description: An energy projectile bursts forth from the Steflos and grows as it rushes toward enemies. The projectile's duration increases when it hits an enemy. When Citrine fires the Steflos, its projectile speed increases.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnoLotusPo.zhDescription: （英文：STEFLOS）石晶之花发射的能量弹会在飞向敌人时变大。当投射物击中敌人时，其飞行持续时间会增加。当 Citrine 使用石晶之花时，它的投射物速度会增加。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnoLeverAc.name: Sybaris
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnoLeverAc.description: This Tenno crafted, lever action rifle, is equal parts elegance and executioner.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnoLeverAc.zhDescription: （英文：SYBARIS）这支 Tenno 定制的扳杆式步枪是优雅的刽子手。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnWispRifl.name: Fulmin
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnWispRifl.description: Strike with silent lightning or the pummeling drum of thunder. Alternate between stealthy short-range electrical discharge, and automatic lightning gun. Faster mode-switch when used by Wisp.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnWispRifl.zhDescription: （英文：FULMIN）用寂静或雷鸣般的闪电来攻击。可在隐秘的短距离放电和自动闪电枪两种模式中切换。在被 Wisp 使用时，武器的模式切换速度会更快。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnSMG/TnSM.name: Baza
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnSMG/TnSM.description: Make easy prey of enemies with this quiet, agile, and pinpoint accurate Tenno submachine gun.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnSMG/TnSM.zhDescription: （英文：BAZA）凭借着安静、灵敏及精准的特性，这把 Tenno 冲锋枪能轻易地猎杀敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnRifleErs.name: Aeolak
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnRifleErs.description: This unusual automatic rifle feels strangely familiar and has two fire modes. Primary fire packs radiation damage. Alternate fire charges up to launch an explosive projectile.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnRifleErs.zhDescription: （英文：AEOLAK）这把非同寻常的自动步枪给人一种奇异的熟悉感，并且拥有两种开火模式。主要射击附带辐射伤害，次要射击充能后可发射一枚爆炸投射物。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnRevolver.name: Veldt
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnRevolver.description: Precise calibration, rapid trigger-pull and a steady hand all combine to bring down the hardiest prey on two legs or four.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnRevolver.zhDescription: （英文：VELDT）结合精确校准、快速击发式扳机以及稳定持枪三项特点，打倒各种顽强的猎物。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnRailjack.name: Quellor
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnRailjack.description: The Quellor was standard-issue to Dax Railjack crews of the Old War, dating back to the earliest, pre-Sigma craft. A rapid-fire assault rifle with a hefty magazine-size, the Quellor is an all-round workhorse. Also capable of large, short-range cryo-blasts.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnRailjack.zhDescription: （英文：QUELLOR）压制者是远古之战时禁卫航道星舰舰员的标准配置武器，其最早的铸造可追溯到西格玛系列之前。这是一种速射突击步枪，拥有较大的弹匣容量，是全能型的主战武器。而且也有着巨大的、短距离的冰冻冲击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnQuadSnip.name: Perigale
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnQuadSnip.description: Like a breath of wind, shots fired by this multi-barrel sniper are felt but never seen by its targets. Headshots in quick succession grant the Perigale Infinite Ammo. When the Perigale is wielded by Voruna, its ammo pool increases.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnQuadSnip.zhDescription: （英文：PERIGALE）就像一阵风，这把多管狙击枪发射的子弹能被它的目标感觉到，却从未被看到。快速连续爆头可提高月面狂风的弹药效率。当 Voruna 手持月面狂风时，它的弹药库会因此增加。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnPriestSp.name: Scourge
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnPriestSp.description: Blast targets with corrosive plasma projectiles, or toss the scepter to inflict an energy field upon nearby enemies that amplifies their brain waves to attract bullets.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnPriestSp.zhDescription: （英文：SCOURGE）用腐蚀性的等离子体轰炸目标，或是投出手杖用能量场增幅附近敌人的脑波，使其吸引子弹。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnModQuest.name: Thornbak
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnModQuest.description: A sturdy burst-rifle of considerable age and unknown origin collected by Teshin during his many years wandering the Origin System.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnModQuest.zhDescription: （英文：THORNBAK）这是 Teshin 在始源星系流浪多年期间收集的一把坚固的点射步枪，年代久远且来历不明。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnInkRifle.name: Enkaus
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnInkRifle.description: Turn the enemy's worst nightmare into reality with Follie's signature rifle. The Enkaus will instantly kill and dissolve inked enemies that are damaged at low health. Shooting inked enemies siphons ink back into the Enkaus, allowing for a constant flow of creative destruction.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnInkRifle.zhDescription: （英文：ENKAUS）使用 Follie 的标志性步枪将敌人的噩梦化为现实。当被墨汁侵染的敌人生命值较低时，绘墨会瞬间将其击杀并溶解。射击被墨汁侵染的敌人可将墨水回流至绘墨，实现持续不断的创造性破坏。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnHopliteS.name: Afentis
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnHopliteS.description: Styanax's speargun matches his might. Throw Afentis to pin an enemy and nearby enemies will also be stunned. Throw Afentis onto the ground to buff nearby allies with Ballistarii Might. The buff increases reload speed, fire rate, and ammo pools and reduces recoil. Allies who kill enemies with Ballistarii Might maintain the buff temporarily when they move away from Afentis.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnHopliteS.zhDescription: （英文：AFENTIS）Styanax 的标枪与他的力量相匹配。投掷圣英来压制敌人，其附近的敌人也会被击晕。将圣英投掷到地上，可创造一个为友军带来增益的炮兵威能力场，可增加装填速度，射速，弹药最大值，并降低后坐力。当获得炮兵威能的友军击杀敌人后，炮兵威能效果则会在他们离开圣英力场后继续维持一小段时间。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnHeavySho.name: Corinth
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnHeavySho.description: Deliver a massive punch with each blast of this shotgun, or launch a round that explodes mid-air knocking down nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnHeavySho.zhDescription: （英文：CORINTH）用这把霰弹枪打出沉重的一击，或者射出一发在空中爆炸的子弹来击倒附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnGlassSho.name: Astilla
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnGlassSho.description: Blast enemies with glass slugs that devastate on impact. In Gara's hands, this signature weapon has a larger Ammo Pool.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnGlassSho.zhDescription: （英文：ASTILLA）用玻璃弹头轰炸敌人，碰撞时将炸裂。当 Gara 手持这把的标志性武器时，其弹药上限会得到提升。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnBeltFedR.name: Reconifex
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnBeltFedR.description: Cyte-09's signature rifle is an ideal match for forceful gunners. A precisely timed reload increases reload speed and infuses the new magazine with Heat Damage.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnBeltFedR.zhDescription: （英文：RECONIFEX）Cyte-09 的标志性步枪是强力枪手的理想搭档。精确的装填可提高装填速度，并为下一个弹匣注入火焰伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnBardRifl.name: Tenora
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnBardRifl.description: Unload percussive machine gun fire, or strike a heavy chord with a single charge shot. When Octavia wields her signature rifle alt-fire Headshot Kills have a chance to instantly refill the magazine.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnBardRifl.zhDescription: （英文：TENORA）释放出强大冲击力的机枪炮火，或者用单发充能射击进行重和弦攻击。当 Octavia 使用她的标志性步枪时，由次要射击所造成的爆头击杀有几率立即装填弹匣。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnAlchemis.name: Cedo
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnAlchemis.description: Launch a glaive that ricochets off surfaces in bursts of elemental damage, then perforate enemies with primary fire's precision buck-shot. Damage increases with each Status Effect afflicting a target. Lavos will transmute a small portion of any ammo pickup to Primary Ammo when wielding his signature Cedo.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnAlchemis.zhDescription: （英文：CEDO）发射能在表面弹跳并爆发出元素伤害的战刃，然后通过主要射击的精准鹿弹来击穿敌人。伤害会随着目标所受到的每个异常状态而增加。当 Lavos 持有他标志性的塞多时，他会将一小部分拾取到的任意弹药转化为主要武器弹药。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TennoTommy.name: Stradavar
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TennoTommy.description: A high-capacity, high-damage enforcer, this weapon can switch between the high crit semi-automatic and full automatic firing modes.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TennoTommy.zhDescription: （英文：STRADAVAR）一把兼具大容量弹匣和高伤害的杀器，这把武器可以在半自动和全自动开火模式间切换。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/SapientPri.name: Acceltra
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/SapientPri.description: Using a barrage of rapid-fire plasma rockets, Gauss’ signature weapon lays down a path of destruction. Reloads are faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. For safety, rockets arm after traveling a safe distance.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/SapientPri.zhDescription: （英文：ACCELTRA）通过使用速射电浆火箭弹，Gauss 的标志性武器铺设了一条毁灭之路。冲刺时可以更快地装填弹匣，在 Gauss 手里效果更加显著。为了安全起见，火箭会在离开安全距离后爆炸。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/RubicoPrim.name: Rubico Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/RubicoPrim.description: For the hunter, the apex of the sniper's art. For the hunted, a gateway to the next life.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/RubicoPrim.zhDescription: （英文：RUBICO PRIME）对猎人而言，这是狙击艺术的巅峰。对于猎物而言，这是通向来生的大门。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/RevenantSh.name: Phantasma
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/RevenantSh.description: Irradiate enemies with a continuous stream of deadly plasma. Charging secondary fire releases a glob of plasma that erupts with homing bomblets on impact. Increased Magazine Capacity when wielded by Revenant.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/RevenantSh.zhDescription: （英文：PHANTASMA）用连续的致命等离子束照射敌人；次要攻击充能后可以释放出一团等离子球，球体碰撞时会产生多发制导的小型炸弹。在被 Revenant 使用时，该武器的弹匣容量会提升。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/RepeatingC.name: Zhuge
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/RepeatingC.description: This devastating automatic crossbow is the perfect marriage of ancient Earth weaponry and Tenno technology.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/RepeatingC.zhDescription: （英文：ZHUGE）这把毁灭性的自动连弩是古代地球军武与 Tenno 工艺完美结合的杰作。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeZhuge.name: Zhuge Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeZhuge.description: Tenno artistry. Ancient craft. A weapon of surgical precision and devastating effect. Each bolt fired by Zhuge Prime explodes shortly after embedding.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeZhuge.zhDescription: （英文：ZHUGE PRIME）Tenno 技艺。古老工艺。一把极为精确且富有破坏力的武器。诸葛连弩 Prime 的每支箭会在击中嵌入的瞬间爆炸。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeVecti.name: Vectis Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeVecti.description: Once thought destroyed, the newly uncovered Vectis Prime revives Tenno martial traditions.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeVecti.zhDescription: （英文：VECTIS PRIME）曾经一度认为已被消灭殆尽；这把新发现的守望者 Prime 还原了 Tenno 的武之传统。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTrumn.name: Trumna Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTrumn.description: Sleek lines and golden accents define this masterpiece of the illustrious Entrati family.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTrumn.zhDescription: （英文：TRUMNA PRIME）流畅的线条和金色的点缀定义了这件来自著名的英择谛家族的杰作。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTigri.name: Tigris Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTigri.description: An artifact of exquisite beauty. A weapon of deadly purpose.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTigri.zhDescription: （英文：TIGRIS PRIME）既是精美的工艺品，也是致命的武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTiber.name: Tiberon Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTiber.description: Art meets ingenuity with this beautifully deadly rifle.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTiber.zhDescription: （英文：TIBERON PRIME）在这柄美丽而又致命的步枪里，艺术与精巧的设计不期而遇。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTenor.name: Tenora Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTenor.description: Add lethal staccato percussion to Octavia's melodies with this masterpiece assault rifle.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeTenor.zhDescription: （英文：TENORA PRIME）通过这件突击步枪大师之作来为 Octavia 的旋律添加致命的顿挫击打。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeSybar.name: Sybaris Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeSybar.description: Sleek and slender, a golden symbol of Tenno perfection.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeSybar.zhDescription: （英文：SYBARIS PRIME）纤细而又熠熠生辉，象征着 Tenno 的至善至美。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeStrun.name: Strun Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeStrun.description: A classic shotgun design, embellished for the elite as only the Orokin could.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeStrun.zhDescription: （英文：STRUN PRIME）只有奥罗金能为精英们打造出如此经典的霰弹枪设计。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeStrad.name: Stradavar Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeStrad.description: Between measured staccato and staggering crescendo, Stradavar Prime never fails to call down a devastating finale.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeStrad.zhDescription: （英文：STRADAVAR PRIME）可在整齐的断奏和摇摆的渐强音之间自由切换，让斯特拉迪瓦 Prime 绝不错失任何一个给予毁灭终章的机会。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeStefl.name: Steflos Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeStefl.description: This rose has gilded thorns. Deal death from even further afar with Citrine Prime's signature shotgun.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeStefl.zhDescription: （英文：STEFLOS PRIME）带有镀金棘刺的玫瑰。通过这把 Citrine Prime 的标志性霰弹枪，从更远的地方施展致命一击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeSoma/.name: Soma Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeSoma/.description: Known for taking down whole squads with its single massive magazine, few weapons were as feared as the Prime Soma.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeSoma/.zhDescription: （英文：SOMA PRIME）以威猛的火力成功掠倒整支队伍而闻名，仅有少数武器能像月神 Prime 一样令人闻之丧胆。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeScour.name: Scourge Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeScour.description: Smite the unrighteous with Harrow Prime's signature speargun.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeScour.zhDescription: （英文：SCOURGE PRIME）用 Harrow Prime 的标志性标枪打击不义之徒。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimePhant.name: Phantasma Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimePhant.description: Phantasma Prime is burnished with deadly force. In Revenant’s hands, it has increased magazine capacity. The might of its irradiated plasma is reminiscent of the fearsome Eidolon.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimePhant.zhDescription: （英文：PHANTASMA PRIME）幻离子 Prime 由死亡之力打磨而成。它在 Revenant 的手中，会拥有更多的弹匣容量。它的等离子照射光束所发出的威力，会让人不禁想起那令人生畏的夜灵。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimePerig.name: Perigale Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimePerig.description: The one who exalted Voruna to her Prime form imbued her signature sniper rifle with increased magazine size and ammo capacity, as if to arm her for a long hunt.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimePerig.zhDescription: （英文：PERIGAL PRIME）将 Voruna 提升到 Prime 状态的人，也提升了她的标志性狙击步枪，增加了弹匣容量和弹药容量，仿佛是要让她做好长时间狩猎的准备。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimePanth.name: Panthera Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimePanth.description: The max-velocity saw-launcher perfected. Features a larger magazine, faster fire rate, and a radial, slashing ricochet.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimePanth.zhDescription: （英文：PANTHERA PRIME）完美打造的极速锯片发射器。具有更大的弹匣、更快的射速，以及可在一定范围内弹跳的锋利锯片。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeNagan.name: Nagantaka Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeNagan.description: A golden version of Garuda's versatile crossbow, as fashioned by the Orokin's finest weaponsmiths. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status, and Headshot kills have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda the Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeNagan.zhDescription: （英文：NAGANTAKA PRIME）Garuda 的标志性十字弓的镀金版本，由奥罗金最优秀的工匠所锻造。次要射击能发射出弩矢弹幕；每支弩矢都有可能造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态，爆头击杀则可加快装填速度。在被 Garuda 使用时，噬蛇弩会获得少量的穿透效果。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeLight.name: Vadarya Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeLight.description: Caliban Prime's signature sniper rifle is no mere ceremonial weapon. A sign, perhaps, that peace between Orokin and Sentient was destined to be fleeting. Struck enemies become lightning rods, with a chance to attract bolts of chain lightning that can jump to nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeLight.zhDescription: （英文：VADARYA PRIME）Caliban Prime 的标志性狙击步枪并非仅仅是仪式武器。它或许预示着奥罗金与 Sentient 之间的和平注定转瞬即逝。被击中的敌人会变成避雷针，有几率吸引连锁闪电，这些闪电会跳跃到附近的敌人身上。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeFulmi.name: Fulmin Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeFulmi.description: Wield a storm. Fulmin Prime's electric rounds switch between lightning beams and short-range bursts. Wisp quickly swaps between each mode with her elemental prowess.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeFulmi.zhDescription: （英文：FULMIN PRIME）唤起风暴。雷霆 Prime 的电击弹可在闪电光束和短距离点射之间切换。Wisp 凭借她的元素之力获得更快的模式切换速度。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeCorin.name: Corinth Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeCorin.description: Heavy in the hand with a bone-crunching kickback. This Prime version of this shotgun adds remote detonation of the weapon's airburst round.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeCorin.zhDescription: （英文：CORINTH PRIME）份量不轻且具有相当的后坐力。这种霰弹枪的 Prime 版本可以将武器射出的空爆弹远程引爆。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeCedo/.name: Cedo Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeCedo/.description: A golden shotgun, forged for those who deliver judgment.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeCedo/.zhDescription: （英文：CEDO PRIME）一把金色的霰弹枪，为那些执裁者而打造。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeBurst.name: Burston Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeBurst.description: Once thought lost to the ages, attempts to reengineer the Burston Prime never fully replicated this weapon's power and agility.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeBurst.zhDescription: （英文：BURSTON PRIME）一度以为随着岁月流逝而失去踪迹，尝试研发伯斯顿 Prime 但从没能够复制出往日的威力以及操控性。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeBolto.name: Boltor Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeBolto.description: Fires Orokin designed bolts that are faster and sharper.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeBolto.zhDescription: （英文：BOLTOR PRIME）射出由奥罗金设计、更快更尖锐的螺钉。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeBaza/.name: Baza Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeBaza/.description: This rapid-fire classic is the Orokin-engineered definition of silent, pinpoint lethality.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeBaza/.zhDescription: （英文：BAZA PRIME）这把经典的高射速冲锋枪体现了奥罗金工艺对于无声和精确杀伤的定义。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeAstil.name: Astilla Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeAstil.description: Loose explosive glass slugs that tear through enemies with Gara’s signature shotgun, presented here in its spectacular Prime form.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeAstil.zhDescription: （英文：ASTILLA PRIME）Gara 标志性的霰弹枪以惊人的 Prime 形态呈现，可以射出爆炸性的玻璃弹头来击穿敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeAlter.name: Alternox Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeAlter.description: Orokin gold enhances the conductivity of Gyre Prime's signature rifle, enabling it to fire massive electrifying orbs.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeAlter.zhDescription: （英文：ALTERNOX PRIME）奥罗金黄金增强了 Gyre Prime 标志性步枪的导电性，使其能够发射巨大的带电球体。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeAfent.name: Afentis Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeAfent.description: The gilded speargun of Styanax Prime shines like a beacon across the battlefield, invigorating allies and stunning enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeAfent.zhDescription: （英文：AFENTIS PRIME）Styanax Prime 的镀金标枪如同战场上的灯塔般闪耀，鼓舞盟友，震慑敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeAccel.name: Acceltra Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeAccel.description: Engage your enemies with deadly speed. This weapon reloads even faster when its wielder sprints, faster still with Gauss.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeAccel.zhDescription: （英文：ACCELTRA PRIME）以致命的速度与敌人交战。当使用者冲刺时，会有更快的装填速度，搭配 Gauss 使用时，速度还会更快。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PaxDuviric.name: Rauta
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PaxDuviric.description: Kullervo's signature weapon boasts melee synergy. Every shot that lands increases the wielder's Melee Combo count. When Kullervo wields Rauta, it also increases his Melee Combo duration.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PaxDuviric.zhDescription: （英文：RAUTA）Kullervo 的标志性武器具有近战协同的优势。每次命中都会增加持枪者的近战连击数。当 Kullervo 使用锐铁时，它也会增加他的近战连击持续时间。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/Miter/TnoM.name: Panthera
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/Miter/TnoM.description: Firing high-velocity blades, this weapon can also be used as a battle-saw, shredding anything unfortunate enough to get within range.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/Miter/TnoM.zhDescription: （英文：PANTHERA）发射高速刀刃，这把武器同时也能作为战斗用电锯，切碎任何进入攻击范围的倒霉鬼。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/LoginPrima.name: Zenith
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/LoginPrima.description: Deploy the radar disc to reveal hidden enemies and then strike with precision shots that punch through all obstacles in the way.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/LoginPrima.zhDescription: （英文：ZENITH）部署雷达盘揭示隐藏的敌人，紧接着用足以穿透障碍的精确射击打击敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/GyreRifle/.name: Alternox
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/GyreRifle/.description: Gyre's signature weapon has two fire modes. Primary fire shocks enemies with electrical orbs. Alternate fire is a large ball of electricity that sticks to any surface and pulses <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity before it explodes. In Gyre's hands, the weapon has a small amount of multishot.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/GyreRifle/.zhDescription: （英文：ALTERNOX）Gyre 的标志性武器有两种射击模式。主要射击可通过带电球体攻击敌人。次要射击可产生一个大型带电球体，该球体可附着在任何表面并在爆炸之前产生 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>带电脉冲。被 Gyre 使用时，该武器可产生少量的多重射击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/Gunbrella/.name: Higasa
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/Gunbrella/.description: Depend on Higasa when it rains bullets. Aiming creates a shield that blocks weapon fire. Kills and blocked shots charge a beam released by Alternate Fire.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/Gunbrella/.zhDescription: （英文：HIGASA）依靠晴日伞抵御如雨倾泻的子弹。瞄准可形成一面盾牌，阻挡敌方武器的射击。击杀和阻挡射击将为次要射击充能，以释放光束。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/GarudaCros.name: Nagantaka
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/GarudaCros.description: Slash targets with a single precise bolt from Garuda's signature crossbow. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status, and Headshots have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/GarudaCros.zhDescription: （英文：NAGANTAKA）Garuda 的标志性十字弓能以一支精准的弩矢斩断目标，而次要射击则能发射出弩矢弹幕；每支弩矢都有可能造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态，爆头射击则可加快装填速度。在被 Garuda 使用时，噬蛇弩会获得少量的穿透效果。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/FiveShotSn.name: Rubico
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/FiveShotSn.description: Scope out the enemy with this long-range revolver style rifle.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/FiveShotSn.zhDescription: （英文：RUBICO）以这把长距离转轮式步枪彻底探清敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/DrakeRifle.name: Tiberon
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/DrakeRifle.description: Forged by a master gunsmith, this Tenno burst rifle will strike down targets with swift precision.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/DrakeRifle.zhDescription: （英文：TIBERON）由大师级枪械制造工匠打造的这把 Tenno 三连发步枪可以迅速精确地击倒目标。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/DoubleBarr.name: Tigris
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/DoubleBarr.description: The double-barreled Tigris shotgun fires two bursts in rapid succession, easily taking down the toughest prey.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/DoubleBarr.zhDescription: （英文：TIGRIS）猛虎双管霰弹枪能快速连续的双弹齐发，轻松地拿下棘手的猎物。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/DexTheThir.name: Dex Sybaris
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/DexTheThir.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the third anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/DexTheThir.zhDescription: （英文：DEX SYBARIS）这是 Lotus 为第一位从低温催眠中醒来的 Tenno 所准备的一份 3 周年纪念礼物。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Grimoire/TnGrimoire.name: Grimoire
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Grimoire/TnGrimoire.description: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Grimoire/TnGrimoire.zhDescription: （英文：GRIMOIRE）获取阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的全知之力。使用典籍 Mod 增强战甲技能并获得战术优势。次要射击发射一颗必定造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态的电弧球。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Grimoire/TnDoppelga.name: Grimoire
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Grimoire/TnDoppelga.description: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Grimoire/TnDoppelga.zhDescription: （英文：GRIMOIRE）获取阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的全知之力。使用典籍 Mod 增强战甲技能并获得战术优势。次要射击发射一颗必定造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态的电弧球。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/StalkerBow.name: Dread
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/StalkerBow.description: Dread is the calling card of The Stalker. It fires arrows that can decapitate.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/StalkerBow.zhDescription: （英文：DREAD）恐惧是追猎者的标志性武器，其射出的箭矢足以取人首级。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/PrimeHuntingBo.name: Paris Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/PrimeHuntingBo.description: Discovered deep inside an ancient Orokin derelict, the Paris Prime increases the kinetic energy of any bolt it fires, dealing more damage than its more common counterpart.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/PrimeHuntingBo.zhDescription: （英文：PARIS PRIME）从遗弃的古老奥罗金船只的深处中发现的帕里斯 Prime，比原版提升了更多箭矢的动能，能造成更多的伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/HuntingBow.name: Paris
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/HuntingBow.description: Based on one of the world's oldest weapon designs, this Tenno-crafted weapon can be used both in stealth and in open combat. The Paris uses a chargeable magnetic field to launch arrows capable of impaling enemies to walls.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/HuntingBow.zhDescription: （英文：PARIS）以世界最古老的武器设计为基础，Tenno 所制作的武器不论隐匿行动和交火接战均可使用。帕里斯可利用磁场蓄力，其射出的箭矢足以将敌人钉在墙上。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/TnChoirBow/TnC.name: Evensong
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/TnChoirBow/TnC.description:
Counter the dread of battle with a song of praise. Enemies cannot hurt your allies while wounded by Evensong's arrows. Kills with Evensong empower ally weapons with Multishot.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/TnChoirBow/TnC.zhDescription:
（英文：EVENSONG）用赞美之歌来对抗战斗中的恐惧。被晚祷之箭所伤的敌人将无法伤害你的友军。使用晚祷击杀敌人将增强友军的武器的多重射击。

当晚祷、歌颂与和谐一同奏响时，体验 Jade 之合奏真正的力量。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/PrimeDerelictC.name: Proboscis Cernos
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/PrimeDerelictC.description: Each arrow spawns a swarm of sticky appendages on impact. These tongue-like probes latch onto nearby unfortunates and drag them close before bursting into a mess of diseased goo.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/PrimeDerelictC.zhDescription: （英文：PROBOSCIS CERNOS）每支箭在冲击时都会产生大量的粘稠附着物。这些像舌头一样的探针会吸附在附近的倒霉蛋身上，并把他们拖近，然后爆裂形成一团病害黏液。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/PrimeDaikyu/Pr.name: Daikyu Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/PrimeDaikyu/Pr.description: Long believed lost, the mighty Daikyu Prime was the pride of many a Tenno dojo. Designed to strike the foe where they are weakest, its powerful shots repay careful marksmanship.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/PrimeDaikyu/Pr.zhDescription: （英文：DAIKYU PRIME）长久以来，人们一直认为强大的大久和弓 Prime 早已失传，它是许多 Tenno 道场的骄傲。它旨在直击敌人的弱点，其强大的射击威力与精湛的射击技术相得益彰。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/PrimeCernos/Pr.name: Cernos Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/PrimeCernos/Pr.description: A noble bow to hunt hellish beasts.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/PrimeCernos/Pr.zhDescription: （英文：CERNOS PRIME）一把用来狩猎恶兽的高贵之弓。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/Omicrus/Omicru.name: Nataruk
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/Omicrus/Omicru.description: Hunhow’s gift, carved from the bones of his kin. Shots can be charged and held; release them just before full charge for maximum effect.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/Omicrus/Omicru.zhDescription: （英文：NATARUK）Hunhow 的礼物，由其亲属的骨头雕刻而成。射击时可以充能并维持该状态；在完全充能前一刻发射即可获得最佳效果。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/DuelistBow/Due.name: Nunchasa
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/DuelistBow/Due.description: Narin's signature bow is the north wind's icy messenger. Alt Fire unleashes a charged blizzard arrow that freezes enemies it touches and leaves behind a chilling path.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/DuelistBow/Due.zhDescription: （英文：NUNCHASA）Narin 的标志性弓箭是北风的冰霜使者。次要开火模式会释放一支充能暴雪箭，冻结接触到的敌人并留下一道寒冰的痕迹。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/DaxDuviriAsyme.name: Cinta
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/DaxDuviriAsyme.description: The versatile Cinta can fire arrows in quick succession, quickly charge a shock wave, or fully charge a powerful focused shot.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/DaxDuviriAsyme.zhDescription: （英文：CINTA）遂心的功能非常多样化，可以快速连续地射出箭矢，迅速充能释放冲击震波，或完全充能并进行威力强大的聚焦式射击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/AsymetricalBow.name: Daikyu
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/AsymetricalBow.description: Daikyu takes great strength to draw back, but provides added power and range to every shot.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/AsymetricalBow.zhDescription: （英文：DAIKYU）大久和弓需要相当程度的施力才能开弓，但每次射击同时也提供了更强的威力与更远的射程。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/AntlerBow/Antl.name: Cernos
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/AntlerBow/Antl.description: Evoking the design of ancient bows, the high impact Cernos is perfect for hunting down highly shielded enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/AntlerBow/Antl.zhDescription: （英文：CERNOS）这把冲击力强大的西诺斯长弓十分擅长猎杀高护盾的敌人，让人回想起古代长弓的设计。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bayonet/TnBayonetRi.name: Vinquibus
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bayonet/TnBayonetRi.description: Bring hell to the battlefield with Uriel's signature rifle and bayonet combination. Occupying both primary and melee slots, this unique weapon blends precision marksmanship with unrelenting melee combat.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bayonet/TnBayonetRi.zhDescription: （英文：VINQUIBUS）通过 Uriel 的标志性步枪和刺刀组合，将地狱之火带入战场。这把独特的武器既可作为主要武器也可作为近战武器，完美融合了精准的射击和毫不留情的近战攻击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Tn.name: Larkspur
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Tn.description: From death blooms the Larkspur. A unique and menacing Archgun with a wild initial attack that locks onto a target then chains other targets close to the first. It also sports an explosive projectile mode. In Hildryn's grip the Larkspur carries more reserve ammo.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Tn.zhDescription: （英文：LARKSPUR）从死亡之中生长的翠雀。一把独特且具有威胁性的曲翼枪械，初始攻击会锁定目标并将靠近第一个目标的其他敌人链在一起。它还配有爆炸性投弹模式。在 Hildryn 的握持之下，翠雀会携带更多的预备弹药。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Tn.name: Mandonel
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Tn.description: Mandonel fires <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage projectiles. Partially charged shots release a spread and fully charged shots release a beam that dissolves into a radiation field. Projectiles that pass through the field are empowered.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Tn.zhDescription: （英文：MANDONEL）辐光弩炮发射 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害投射物。未完全充能的射击会散射，而完全充能的射击则会释放出光束并生成辐射力场。穿过力场的投射物会被增强。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Th.name: Morgha
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Th.description: Blast through enemies with a double-barreled shot of energized slugs. This siphons their life essence which is then used to generate the secondary fire's massive air-burst mortar. The ancient Entrati weapon was built for Necramechs but also functions as an Archgun.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Th.zhDescription: （英文：MORGHA）通过双管射出的充能弹头来轰击敌人。这会吸取他们的生命精华，然后将其用于生成次要射击的大规模空爆迫击炮。这件古老的英择谛武器是为殁世机甲打造的，但也可以作为一把曲翼枪械来使用。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Th.name: Mausolon
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Th.description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati for use by their Necramechs. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. Punishing automatic primary fire and a secondary mode that charges up to unleash a destructive beam of energy with a large explosion at point of impact.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Th.zhDescription: （英文：MAUSOLON）英择谛为其殁世机甲所设计的古老武器。主要射击可从目标身上吸取生命精华，以助燃次要射击带来的毁灭性攻击。拥有惩戒性的全自动主要射击。次要模式可在充能后释放一道破坏性能量束，并在作用点造成大范围爆炸。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Th.name: Cortege
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Th.description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati for use by their Necramechs. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. A heavy flamethrower with surprising range. Secondary fire launches three projectiles in a fan pattern that explode, leaving a damaging area of effect for a short duration.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Th.zhDescription: （英文：CORTEGE）英择谛为其殁世机甲所设计的古老武器。主要射击可从目标身上吸取生命精华，以助燃次要射击带来的毁灭性攻击。这把重型火焰喷射器拥有惊人的射程。次要射击可扇形投射三枚爆炸弹丸，并在短时间内留下一片破坏性区域。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ro.name: Fluctus
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ro.description: An Archwing energy weapon that sends waves of deadly plasma crashing into enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ro.zhDescription: （英文：FLUCTUS）一把能射出致命等离子波来击溃敌人的曲翼能量武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Re.name: Grattler
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Re.description: Shatter your targets with explosive shells from this devastating Archwing cannon.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Re.zhDescription: （英文：GRATTLER）这把毁灭性的曲翼火炮能发射爆裂弹来击碎你的目标。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ra.name: Velocitus
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ra.description: When fully charged, the magnetized barrel of the Velocitus accelerates a metal slug to tremendous speeds, piercing hulls and obliterating armor.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ra.zhDescription: （英文：VELOCITUS）当充能完成后，极速电磁步枪的磁化枪管能将金属子弹加速至极限，使其轻易的摧毁装甲，贯穿船身。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Pr.name: Larkspur Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Pr.description: Embrace pandemonium. Chainfire and explosive potential meet in Larkspur Prime. Hildryn packs more ammo when she wields this mighty weapon.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Pr.zhDescription: （英文：LARKSPUR PRIME）迎接混乱的到来吧。连锁攻击和爆炸潜能在翠雀 Prime 身上相遇。当 Hildryn 使用这件强大的武器时，她会携带更多的弹药。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Pr.name: Corvas Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Pr.description: Flaunting ceremonial beauty, this arch gun flak cannon is even more devastating than its standard issue counterpart.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Pr.zhDescription: （英文：CORVAS PRIME）招摇又考究的美人，这款曲翼枪械版高射炮比其标准版更具破坏性。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/No.name: Arbucep
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/No.description: Nokko’s signature archgun fires six homing missiles, each bearing a payload of one of the six combined elements which detonate in an area upon impact.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/No.zhDescription: （英文：ARBUCEP）Nokko 的标志性曲翼枪械可发射六枚追踪导弹，每枚导弹都运载着六种组合元素之一，命中时会在区域内引爆。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/La.name: Corvas
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/La.description: When fully charged, this flak cannon delivers a devastating shot. Perfect for taking down fast-moving interceptors.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/La.zhDescription: （英文：CORVAS）充能完毕后，这台高射加农炮能击发出毁灭性的炮击。完美地击落快速移动的拦截机。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Fo.name: Imperator Vandal
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Fo.description: The Imperator Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the barrel.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Fo.zhDescription: （英文：IMPERATOR VANDAL）这款为 Tenno 量身打造的凯旋将军·破坏者带有蓝绿色的金属质感，枪管上还有 Lotus 的铭刻。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Fo.name: Imperator
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Fo.description: A long range rifle capable of firing in space, the Imperator's versatility makes it an ideal weapon for space combat.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Fo.zhDescription: （英文：IMPERATOR）能在太空中开火的长射程步枪，凯旋将军的多用性使得它成为在太空作战时理想的武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ar.name: Dual Decurion
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ar.description: Delivering twin streams of highly accurate, rapid-fire ordnance, the Decurion are specifically designed for combat in the vacuum of space.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ar.zhDescription: （英文：DUAL DECURION）什长双枪是专门为了在真空的太空之下战斗，能急速发射双道高精准弹幕的武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ar.name: Prisma Dual Decurions
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ar.description: Colder than space and less forgiving, Prisma crystals bring elite efficiency to the already sleek Dual Decurion. Requiring the lightest of touches to reload, these twin archguns prove that heavy weaponry can still possess elegance.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ar.zhDescription: （英文：PRISMA DUAL DECURIONS）比太空更冷酷无情，棱晶为已经很时尚的什长双枪带来了卓越的效率。只需轻轻一碰即可装填弹药，这把双持曲翼枪械证明了重型武器也可以保持优雅。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ar.name: Phaedra
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ar.description: Devastate free-space enemies with Phaedra, the Soma's big-sister.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ar.zhDescription: （英文：PHAEDRA）借由这把菲德菈——月神最年长的姊妹——纵横太空尽情毁灭敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ar.name: Cyngas
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ar.description: Unload deadly accurate bursts of mayhem.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Ar.zhDescription: （英文：CYNGAS）释放出致命般精准的爆发性混乱。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Void.name: <ARCHWING> Prisma Veritux
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Void.description: A rare object of beauty, this Archwing sword has been sheathed in prisma crystal and baptized in the Void’s energy.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Void.zhDescription: （英文：PRISMA VERITUX）这把曲翼之剑包覆在棱晶之中且沐浴着虚空的能量，成为了稀有而美丽的存在。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Prim.name: Corufell Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Prim.description: Corufell Prime's golden vines streamline its transformation for even faster Heavy Attacks.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Prim.zhDescription: （英文：CORUFELL PRIME）闪劫 Prime 的金色藤蔓让变形更流畅，使重击更迅捷。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/GrnA.name: <ARCHWING> Knux
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/GrnA.description: Gallium-alloy gauntlets for close-range Archwing combat. Designed by the infamous Tyl Regor.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/GrnA.zhDescription: （英文：KNUX）为曲翼近距离作战所制的镓合金动力拳套。由恶名昭彰的泰尔·雷工设计。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Exal.name: Corufell
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Exal.description: Heavy attacks briefly transform the Corufell into a Gunblade. After the Gunblade fires, the Corufell returns to its Heavy Scythe state. Its transformation is fastest in Citrine's hands.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Exal.zhDescription: （英文：CORUFELL）重击会在短时间内将闪劫变形为一把枪刃。枪刃开火后，闪劫返回其重型镰刀状态。Citrine 使用时，它的变形速度最为快速。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.name: <ARCHWING> Centaur
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.description: Part sword, part shield, the Centaur excels at charging headlong into enemy fire.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.zhDescription: （英文：CENTAUR）部分为剑，部分为盾，半人马剑盾专擅于突进敌军炮火之中。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.name: <ARCHWING> Veritux
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.description: Weightless space turns this impossibly massive sword into an agile instrument of destruction.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.zhDescription: （英文：VERITUX）零重力的太空将这把大到难以想象的巨剑变成了敏捷的毁灭工具。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.name: <ARCHWING> Onorix
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.description: This laser bladed battle-axe easily hacks through a ship's defenses and the forces protecting it.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.zhDescription: （英文：ONORIX）这把激光刀刃的战斧能轻易突破船只的防御和保卫船只的武装力量。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.name: <ARCHWING> Agkuza
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.description: Tear apart incoming enemies with this massive hooked blade.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.zhDescription: （英文：AGKUZA）用这柄强大的钩状刀刃撕裂来袭的敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.name: <ARCHWING> Kaszas
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.description: Become an angel of death, with this Archwing scythe.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.zhDescription: （英文：KASZAS）拿起这把曲翼镰刀，化身为死亡天使。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.name: <ARCHWING> Rathbone
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.description: Using Archwing's jets for thrust, this massive hammer crushes anything in its path.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Melee/Arch.zhDescription: 利用了曲翼的喷射推动力，这把巨大的铁锤能击碎其挥舞路径中的任何物体。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/PrimeAkimboS.name: Akbronco Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/PrimeAkimboS.description: Used together, these Orokin pistols feed off each other, inflicting greater damage with an enhanced status chance for inducing elemental effects on targets.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/PrimeAkimboS.zhDescription: （英文：AKBRONCO PRIME）同时使用这两把相辅相成的奥罗金手枪 ，以更高的元素触发几率，来对目标造成更大的伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/DualVastos.name: Akvasto
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/DualVastos.description: Vasto revolvers equipped in each hand.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/DualVastos.zhDescription: （英文：AKVASTO）双手各持一把瓦斯托左轮手枪。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/DualMagnusPr.name: Akmagnus Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/DualMagnusPr.description: Fill your fists with golden cannons of fury. This refined design unlocks quicker handling and higher critical chance.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/DualMagnusPr.zhDescription: （英文：AKMAGNUS PRIME）给你的拳中塞上这愤怒的金色教条。这种精良的设计可加快操作速度并提高暴击几率。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/DualMagnus.name: Akmagnus
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/DualMagnus.description: Twice the ammo and twice the stopping power of a single Magnus.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/DualMagnus.zhDescription: （英文：AKMAGNUS）和一把麦格努斯相比有双倍弹药和双倍后坐力。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboViperP.name: Twin Vipers
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboViperP.description: A Viper equipped in each hand.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboViperP.zhDescription: （英文：TWIN VIPERS）每只手持一把蝰蛇。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboShotGu.name: Akbronco
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboShotGu.description: A Bronco equipped in each hand.

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboPistol.name: Aklato
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboPistol.description: A Lato equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and Fire Rate, but Reload time is doubled and Accuracy is lowered.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboPistol.zhDescription: （英文：AKLATO）每只手持一把拉托，双倍弹匣和射速，但双倍装填时间，且精度更差。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboBolto.name: Akbolto
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboBolto.description: A Bolto equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but reload time is doubled and accuracy is lowered.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboBolto.zhDescription: （英文：AKBOLTO）双手各装备一把螺钉手枪，具有两倍的弹匣容量与稍快的射速，但精准度会下降，且需两倍的换弹时间。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboAutoPi.name: Afuris
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboAutoPi.description: Furis pistols equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but Accuracy and Reload Speed are lowered.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboAutoPi.zhDescription: （英文：AFURIS）双手各装备一把盗贼手枪，具有两倍的弹匣容量与稍快的射速，但精准度会下降，且换弹的速度增长。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkLexPrimePi.name: Aklex Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkLexPrimePi.description: Savage the enemy with a Lex Prime in each hand.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkLexPrimePi.zhDescription: （英文：AKLEX PRIME）双手各持一把雷克斯 Prime 猛攻敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkLexPistols.name: Aklex
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkLexPistols.description: Dual Lex pistols double the amount of high caliber lead you can throw at the enemy, but accuracy and reload time suffer.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkLexPistols.zhDescription: （英文：AKLEX）以雷克斯双枪的两只大口径枪管朝敌人开火，但精准度和装填时间会受到负面影响。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/SteelMeridian/.name: Vaykor Marelok
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/SteelMeridian/.description: Taken from defeated Grineer commanders and rebuilt to improve combat efficiency and reliability.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/SteelMeridian/.zhDescription: （英文：VAYKOR MARELOK）取自于战败的 Grineer 指挥官，并经过重构来提升作战效率和可靠性。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/SteelMeridian/.name: Vaykor Sydon
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/SteelMeridian/.description: Justice blinds. Block hits to charge a Radial Blind, when fully charged Block+Heavy Attack to unleash it.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/SteelMeridian/.zhDescription: （英文：Vaykor Sydon）正义会让人失明。每一次被格挡的攻击会为致盲充能，当充满时用格挡+重击来释放它。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/SteelMeridian/.name: Vaykor Hek
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/SteelMeridian/.description: Forged in the fires of rebel struggle, this shotgun is a force for liberation.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/SteelMeridian/.zhDescription: （英文：VAYKOR HEK）在反抗拼搏的烈焰中铸造，造就这把成为自由解放之力的散弹枪。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Pistol.name: Rakta Ballistica
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Pistol.description: This modified ballistica is the weapon of choice used by Red Veil Assassins to take out high-priority marks.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Pistol.zhDescription: （英文：RAKTA BALLISTICA）这把经过改造的布里斯提卡是血色面纱的刺客用来解决高度优先目标的首选武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Melee/.name: Rakta Dark Dagger
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Melee/.description: Infiltrate undetected; reduced visibility when held. Then strike with confidence; hits to irradiated targets restores shields and creates overshields.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Melee/.zhDescription: （英文：RAKTA DARK DAGGER）隐蔽入侵：持取时降低自身可见度。紧接着挥出自信一击：击中被辐射的目标可以恢复护盾并产生过载护盾。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Bows/R.name: Rakta Cernos
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Bows/R.description: A finely tuned instrument of assassination.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Bows/R.zhDescription: （英文：RAKTA CERNOS）一把精巧的刺杀工具。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/PerrinSequence.name: Secura Dual Cestra
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/PerrinSequence.description: The favored side-arms of Perrin Sequence executives, these pistols have been modified to improve efficiency and killing potential.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/PerrinSequence.zhDescription: （英文：SECURA DUAL CESTRA）受佩兰数列高层人员青睐的贴身武器，这对手枪已经过改造来提升效率与击杀潜力。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/PerrinSequence.name: Secura Lecta
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/PerrinSequence.description: Whip the enemy out of their ill-gotten gains; double credit drops on kills.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/PerrinSequence.zhDescription: （英文：SECURA LECTA）把敌人的非法获益抽打出来；击杀时使现金掉落翻倍。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/PerrinSequence.name: Secura Penta
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/PerrinSequence.description: Ruthless and efficient, just like the free-market.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/PerrinSequence.zhDescription: （英文：SECURA PENTA）如同自由市场一般，重效率，不讲情面。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/NewLoka/Pistol.name: Sancti Castanas
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/NewLoka/Pistol.description: This remotely detonated electrical trap is used by devotees of New Loka to protect their temples and shrines.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/NewLoka/Pistol.zhDescription: （英文：SANCTI CASTANAS ）这种能遥控引爆的电击陷阱是新世间的信徒用来保护他们的寺庙与圣殿的武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/NewLoka/Melee/.name: Sancti Magistar
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/NewLoka/Melee/.description: Each charged attack turns the enemy’s pain into a healing pulse that washes over allies. Also, creates resistance to Status Effects when held.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/NewLoka/Melee/.zhDescription: （英文：SANCTI MAGISTAR）蓄力攻击将敌人的伤痛转化成波及战友的治愈脉冲。除此之外，持取时将产生对异常状态的抵抗力。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/NewLoka/LongGu.name: Sancti Tigris
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/NewLoka/LongGu.description: Echo nature's violent beauty with this special Tigris.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/NewLoka/LongGu.zhDescription: （英文：SANCTI TIGRIS）这把特制猛虎呼应了大自然的暴戾之美。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/P.name: Synoid Gammacor
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/P.description: Deployed by the Cephalon Suda, once a data-analyzing instrument the Gammacor main focus is defense.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/P.zhDescription: （英文：SYNOID GAMMACOR）由中枢苏达所设置，过去曾作为数据分析仪器，但现在已转为专用于自卫的武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/P.name: Gammacor
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/P.description: Designed to quickly vaporize minerals for content analysis, users discovered its powerful beam was equally efficient at dispatching hostiles.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/P.zhDescription: （英文：GAMMACOR）原为使矿物迅速蒸发以便于分析作业而设计，然而使用者却发现它强大的光束对于终结敌人也同样有效。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/M.name: Synoid Heliocor
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/M.description: This intelligent hammer takes an enemy killed by a Heavy Attack and recomposes them as an ally. Any fatal strike with this weapon also performs a Codex scan.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/M.zhDescription: （英文：SYNOID HELIOCOR）这柄智能的锤子吸收被重击击杀的敌人，并将他们改组为友军。这把武器造成的任何致死攻击也会进行一次资料库扫描。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/L.name: Synoid Simulor
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/L.description: Cephalon Suda's custom issue Simulor was built to satisfy her curiosity.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/L.zhDescription: 中枢苏达的自定义改造重力奇点拟成枪，仅只是为了满足她的好奇心所打造。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/ArbitersOfHexi.name: Telos Akbolto
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/ArbitersOfHexi.description: For the Arbiters of Hexis these pistols are more than simple weapons, they are symbols of truth and discipline.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/ArbitersOfHexi.zhDescription: （英文：TELOS AKBOLTO）对均衡仲裁者来说，这对手枪不单只是寻常的武器，它们是真相与纪律的象征。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/ArbitersOfHexi.name: Telos Boltace
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/ArbitersOfHexi.description: Spinning attacks unleash the Stormpath, a tempest of mayhem that hurls any foes in its way.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/ArbitersOfHexi.zhDescription: （英文：TELOS BOLTACE）旋转式攻击会释放「暴风之道」，如同风暴般的破坏将其路径的任何敌人猛力甩出。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/ArbitersOfHexi.name: Telos Boltor
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/ArbitersOfHexi.description: Bring down judgement, with this boltor crafted by the Arbiters of Hexis.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/ArbitersOfHexi.zhDescription: （英文：TELOS BOLTOR）用这把均衡仲裁者锻造的螺钉步枪降下审判。

/Lotus/Weapons/Sentients/Shedu/SheduHeav.name: Shedu
/Lotus/Weapons/Sentients/Shedu/SheduHeav.description: This arm-cannon, ripped from a Sentient, rapid-fires thermal pulses that explode in an electrical blast. Features an ammo-less quick charge capacitor, that emits a knock-back pulse and strips Sentient damage resistances when fully discharged.
/Lotus/Weapons/Sentients/Shedu/SheduHeav.zhDescription: （英文：SHEDU）这种从 Sentient 身上扯下来的手炮能快速射出热脉冲，并在电击中爆炸。它有一个不需要弹药的快充电容器，在完全放电时会发出回弹脉冲并解除 Sentient 的伤害抗性。

/Lotus/Weapons/Sentients/SentRifleNewWar.name: Basmu
/Lotus/Weapons/Sentients/SentRifleNewWar.description: This Sentient war instrument can either barrage targets with explosive bolts or draw on its regenerative battery to create twin plasma beams that chain through targets. When fully drained, Health is leeched from nearby foes for a short period.
/Lotus/Weapons/Sentients/SentRifleNewWar.zhDescription: （英文：BASMU）这种 Sentient 军械可以用爆炸投射物密集轰击目标，也可以利用其可再生电池制造出两股将多个目标束缚在一起的等离子光束。当电量完全耗尽时，会在短时间内吸取附近敌人的生命值。

/Lotus/Weapons/Sentients/SentOctaMiniGun.name: Haalvu
/Lotus/Weapons/Sentients/SentOctaMiniGun.description: Deliver a ruthless barrage of Sentient artillery from this instrument of death. Alt-fire splits the weapon apart into separate rifles, expanding its devastation by tracking up to 4 targets at once, while consuming more ammo per shot.
/Lotus/Weapons/Sentients/SentOctaMiniGun.zhDescription: （英文：HAALVU）通过这件死亡利器释放无情的 Sentient 炮火。次要射击可将武器拆分为多把独立的步枪，同时锁定最多 4 个目标，进一步扩展其毁灭威力，但每发射击将消耗更多弹药。

/Lotus/Weapons/Sentients/SentJointedScyt.name: Venato
/Lotus/Weapons/Sentients/SentJointedScyt.description: Caliban’s signature scythe, forged from a limb wrenched off a fallen Eidolon centuries ago. 50% increased Melee Combo Counter Chance when wielded by Caliban.
/Lotus/Weapons/Sentients/SentJointedScyt.zhDescription: （英文：VENATO）Caliban 的标志性镰刀，由几个世纪前从一个倒下的夜灵身上扯下的肢体锻造而成。被 Caliban 挥舞时，有 50% 几率获得额外近战连击数。

/Lotus/Weapons/Orokin/BallasSword/Ballas.name: Paracesis
/Lotus/Weapons/Orokin/BallasSword/Ballas.description: The Sentient slayer. An offering from Ballas.

/Lotus/Weapons/Operator/Pistols/DrifterP.name: Sirocco
/Lotus/Weapons/Operator/Pistols/DrifterP.description: A silent, pistol-style Amp for the Drifter. Generates its own ammunition from Void energy. A precisely timed reload over-charges the next shot.
/Lotus/Weapons/Operator/Pistols/DrifterP.zhDescription: （英文：SIROCCO）一款为漂泊者设计的手枪式消音增幅器。从虚空能量中汲取弹药。在精准的时机进行装填会使下一次射击获得额外充能。

/Lotus/Weapons/Operator/Melee/DrifterTaz.name: Rumblejack
/Lotus/Weapons/Operator/Melee/DrifterTaz.description: An electrified jolter for quick melee takedowns, assembled from scavenged scrap. Ideal for use on unsuspecting opponents.
/Lotus/Weapons/Operator/Melee/DrifterTaz.zhDescription: （英文：RUMBLEJACK）用废料组装而成的电击器，可用于快速近战攻坚。非常适合用来对付毫无防备的对手。

/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Strun.name: MK1-Strun
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Strun.description: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Strun.zhDescription: （英文：STRUN）斯特朗是一把标准的霰弹枪，可靠，灵活，致命。

/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Paris.name: MK1-Paris
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Paris.description: The MK1-Paris is the standard issue bow for all Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Paris.zhDescription: （英文：MK1-PARIS）MK1-帕里斯是给Tenno的标准配置弓箭。

/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Kunai.name: MK1-Kunai
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Kunai.description: The MK1-Kunai is the standard issue throwing knives for all Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Kunai.zhDescription: （英文：MK1-KUNAI）MK1-苦无是给Tenno的标准配置投掷武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Furis.name: MK1-Furis
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Furis.description: The MK1-Furis are the standard issue automatic pistol for all Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Furis.zhDescription: （英文：MK1-FURIS）MK1-盗贼是给Tenno的标准配置自动手枪。

/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Furax.name: MK1-Furax
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Furax.description: The MK1-Furax is the standard issue fist weapon for all Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Furax.zhDescription: （英文：MK1-FURAX）MK1-弗拉克斯是给Tenno的标准配置拳套。

/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Bo.name: MK1-Bo
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Bo.description: The MK1-Bo is the standard issue staff weapon for all Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/MK1Series/MK1Bo.zhDescription: （英文：MK1-BO）MK1-玻之武杖是给Tenno的标准配置棍棒武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasSilencedPistol/.name: Vesper 77
/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasSilencedPistol/.description: A true masterpiece of Höllvanian engineering, Vesper 77's advanced laser sight highlights enemy Weak Points with precision. Aim to increase its Critical Damage Multiplier.
/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasSilencedPistol/.zhDescription: （英文：VESPER 77）夜语者 77 是霍瓦尼亚工程的真正杰作，其先进的激光瞄准器可突出显示敌人的弱点。瞄准来提高其暴击伤害倍率。

/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasGrenadeLauncher.name: Purgator 1
/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasGrenadeLauncher.description: Put them down so that they stay down, with this Scaldra slug launcher.
/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasGrenadeLauncher.zhDescription: （英文：PURGATOR 1）用这把炽蛇军武器让敌人再起不能。

/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasGooSickle/LasGo.name: Dual Viciss
/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasGooSickle/LasGo.description: Reap what the Techrot have sown with this vicious pair of Scaldra hand-scythes.
/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasGooSickle/LasGo.zhDescription: （英文：DUAL VICISS）用这对凶恶的炽蛇军镰刀来收获科腐者所播种的恶果。

/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasGooPistol/LasGo.name: EFV-8 Mars
/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasGooPistol/LasGo.description: The standard issue personal Efervon projector, as sported by all ranks of Scaldra.
/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasGooPistol/LasGo.zhDescription: （英文：EFV-8 MARS）标准的单兵艾弗旺喷射器，各个军衔的炽蛇军都配有此武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasGooAK/LasGooAKP.name: EFV-5 Jupiter
/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasGooAK/LasGooAKP.description: Perforate Techrot, and anyone else who stands in your way, with this Scaldra machine gun. Alternative fire pummels targets with Efervon laced buckshot.
/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/LasGooAK/LasGooAKP.zhDescription: （英文：EFV-5 JUPITER）使用这把炽蛇军机枪扫射科腐者和任何胆敢阻挡你的人。次要射击使用涂有艾弗旺的霰弹重击目标。

/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/AK47/TC2024AK47Wea.name: AX-52
/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/AK47/TC2024AK47Wea.description: This pre-Orokin weapon earned its popularity for its reliability in tough conditions. When hip-firing, its Ammo Efficiency increases. When aiming, headshots have a high Critical Chance.
/Lotus/Weapons/Lasria/AK47/TC2024AK47Wea.zhDescription: （英文：AX-52）这款前奥罗金时代的武器因其在恶劣条件下的可靠性而广受欢迎。腰射时，弹药效率会提高。瞄准时，爆头有极高的暴击几率。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/Infested.name: Embolist
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/Infested.description: A living weapon, the infested Embolist pistol kills its victims with an acidic venomous gas.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/Infested.zhDescription: （英文：EMBOLIST）活生生的武器，被感染的安柏勒斯手枪用酸性有毒气体杀死受害者。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/Infested.name: Tysis
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/Infested.description: The Tysis pistol spits out caustic darts that corrode their victims from within.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/Infested.zhDescription: （英文：TYSIS）啐沫者手枪借由喷吐出具有腐蚀性的毒镖，将受害者由内而外地侵蚀殆尽。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/InfVomit.name: Dual Toxocyst
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/InfVomit.description: Brain-strikes excite this bioweapon, causing it to rapidly release toxic munitions.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/InfVomit.zhDescription: （英文：DUAL TOXOCYST）对敌人造成爆头射击会刺激这把生物武器，能迅速发射毒素弹药。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/InfUzi/I.name: Zymos
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/InfUzi/I.description: Infect your foes with this spore-scattering pistol. Headshots burrow in and explode, releasing spore clouds that seek out nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/InfUzi/I.zhDescription: （英文：ZYMOS）用这件散射孢子的手枪来感染你的敌人。爆头射击会钻入敌人的体内并爆炸，释放出飘向附近敌人的孢子云。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/InfProxi.name: Pox
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/InfProxi.description: These festering sacs of pus and gas burst violently on impact.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/InfProxi.zhDescription: （英文：POX）受到冲击时，这些充满脓水和气体的溃烂脓包会剧烈地爆开。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/InfBeamP.name: Catabolyst
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/InfBeamP.description: Splatter enemies with a short-range stream of corrosive bile and then toss the ammo bladder as a grenade when reloading. The emptier the pistol’s ammo bladder, the more potent its damage. A fully empty bladder packs the biggest punch.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Pistols/InfBeamP.zhDescription: （英文：CATABOLYST）可在短距离内向敌人喷射腐蚀性胆汁，此外，弹药囊腔可在装填时被用作投掷手雷。手枪的弹药囊腔越空，其造成的伤害就越强。完全射空的囊腔能发挥出最大的威力。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Whip/Infes.name: Scoliac
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Whip/Infes.description: The Scoliac Whip is a nasty parasitic growth of sinew and bone that can inflict heart stopping <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage with attacks.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Whip/Infes.zhDescription: （英文：SCOLIAC）这条脊椎节鞭是由一只令人生厌的寄生虫增生出肌腱与骨头而成形。攻击时能造成会让心脏停止跳动的 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/TipedoStaf.name: Lesion
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/TipedoStaf.description: An instrument of unrelenting harm. If Lesion tastes blood, it becomes invigorated with faster Attack Speed and increased <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/TipedoStaf.zhDescription: （英文：LESION）能造成严重伤害的一把武器。如果病变尝到了血的味道，其就会变得很有活力，攻击速度加快的同时会增加 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Swords/Mir.name: Mire
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Swords/Mir.description: A relic from the Great Plague, the Mire Infested Sword is a brutal weapon. It not only cuts into the enemy, it infects the wounds of its victim with a toxic nerve poison. Deals <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage on Ground Slam attacks.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Swords/Mir.zhDescription: （英文：MIRE）米尔感染之剑是一柄来自「大瘟疫」时期的残暴武器。不仅能切开敌人，更能在其伤口染上神经剧毒。此外，米尔在震地攻击时会造成 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Swords/Mio.name: Mios
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Swords/Mio.description: This bone-forged sword includes a tendon-whip to distract and maim the enemy.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Swords/Mio.zhDescription: （英文：MIOS）这把由骨头锻造的刀包含了肌腱皮鞭用以混淆与残害敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Staff/InfS.name: Pupacyst
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Staff/InfS.description: A two-pronged attack; the bone-grafted cocoon at the tip of this polearm rends flesh, while the viral mass living within spreads itself into the wounds of each new victim.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Staff/InfS.zhDescription: （英文：PUPACYST）双管齐下的夹击；棍尖端包覆的带骨茧状物把血肉撕裂，而其中的病毒块则会扩散到每个新受害人的伤口。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Nunchaku/I.name: Pulmonars
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Nunchaku/I.description: Pummel and infect with these two pulsating hunks of flesh connected by a ligament. Take-hold of the malignant evolution of an ancient martial weapon.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Nunchaku/I.zhDescription: （英文：PULMONARS）用这两块被韧带连接的脉动肉块进行击打和感染。掌握古代军用武器的恶毒演变。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/InfWarfan/.name: Arum Spinosa
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/InfWarfan/.description: Slash through enemies with two leaves of the exceedingly rare Arum Spinosa plant. Heavy Attack to whip a flurry of toxic spines at ranged attackers.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/InfWarfan/.zhDescription: （英文：ARUM SPINOSA）用两片极其罕见的疆南星刺植物的叶子砍杀敌人。重击对范围内的攻击者抽出一连串的毒刺。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/InfWFAccom.name: Hirudo
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/InfWFAccom.description: Rip into the enemy with fists of razor sharp cartilage. Steals health with each critical hit.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/InfWFAccom.zhDescription: （英文：HIRUDO）以拳头上如同剃刀般的锋利软骨切入敌人，每次暴击时窃取生命。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/InfTransfo.name: Keratinos
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/InfTransfo.description: Leave your mark with these infected claws with increased heavy attack range. Heavy attack at max combo to keep the extended range and slam radius for 3 minutes.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/InfTransfo.zhDescription: （英文：KERATINOS）这些感染利爪可以在更大的重击范围内留下你的印记。达到最高连击数时进行重击，可以保持持续三分钟的、更大的攻击范围和震地半径。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/InfEmbolis.name: Caustacyst
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/InfEmbolis.description: Heavy attacks from this scythe unleash a wave of acid that mutilates enemies and leaves a trail of corrosive sludge.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/InfEmbolis.zhDescription: （英文：CAUSTACYST）这把镰刀的重击会释放出一道酸液，分解敌人并留下一条腐蚀的泥泞。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/InfBoomera.name: Pathocyst
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/InfBoomera.description: Each strike of this infested glaive infects its target with viral pathogens. Occasionally, it discharges the spores of rabid, enemy-seeking maggots, either in-flight or on contact with the enemy.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/InfBoomera.zhDescription: （英文：PATHOCYST）这把感染战刃的每一次攻击都会让目标感染病原体。而在飞行或与敌人接触时，它偶尔还会释放出狂乱的孢子以及追踪敌人的蛆虫。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Glaives/Pu.name: Cerata
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Glaives/Pu.description: Twisted and tortured from exposure to the Infestation, this glaive becomes an absolute predator in the hands of the right Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Melee/Glaives/Pu.zhDescription: （英文：CERATA）由于接触到感染者变得疯狂而扭曲，这把战刃在能熟练的 Tenno 手中会成为绝对的掠食者。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/Infeste.name: Synapse
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/Infeste.description: Powered by a bio-chemical reaction, the Infested Synapse rifle fries its targets with a steady stream of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive energy.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/Infeste.zhDescription: （英文：SYNAPSE）由生化反应驱动，被感染的突触生化枪通过一束稳定的<DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀能量炙烤目标。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/Tentacl.name: Phage
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/Tentacl.description: Fires seven beams of continuous biochemical energy which depletes the life of any surface they contact.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/Tentacl.zhDescription: （英文：PHAGE）射出七道持续性的生化能量，侵蚀任何物质的表面，使其寿命枯竭。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/QuantaF.name: Paracyst
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/QuantaF.description: Completely overwhelmed by Infested biology, this former Quanta now fires organic ordnance and a harpoon like appendage.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/QuantaF.zhDescription: （英文：PARACYST）被感染生物体完全包覆，这种形态的量子切割器会射出类似器质性的附肢尖叉。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/InfWFAc.name: Hema
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/InfWFAc.description: A bloodsucker. This symbiotic burst-rifle leeches health to forge its ammo and then restores health with each headshot.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/InfWFAc.zhDescription: （英文：HEMA）一把吸血者。这把点放式的共生步枪会吸取生命来铸造弹药，并在每次爆头射击时恢复生命。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/InfSnip.name: Sporothrix
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/InfSnip.description: This long-distance rifle fires a razor-sharp, virus-soaked barb that continues to attack its host before violently erupting in a spore-laden mist. Scoped headshots increase lethality.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/InfSnip.zhDescription: （英文：SPOROTHRIX）这把长射程步枪发射锋利且浸透病毒的倒钩，在猛烈爆发出充满孢子的雾气前，它会继续攻击其宿主。开镜爆头可增加杀伤力。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/InfCrpS.name: Mutalist Quanta
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/InfCrpS.description: A bizarre union of Corpus technology and Infested biology, this automatic rifle can also deploy an irradiated airborne infested mass. Further field testing is required to fully understand the potential of this weapon.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/InfCrpS.zhDescription: （英文：MUTALIST QUANTA）这是一个 Corpus 科技与感染生物的奇特组合，这把自动步枪也能发射出一种带有辐射性的可通过空气传播的感染物质。为了全面了解这把武器的潜在能力，还需要更多的实地测试。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/InfArmC.name: Bubonico
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/InfArmC.description: Rain down a triple volley of explosive disease bladders from a distance, then move in for the kill by unloading a multi-shot barrage of toxic barbs with primary fire.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/LongGuns/InfArmC.zhDescription: （英文：BUBONICO）可远距离投下三连爆炸性病毒囊腔，随后可通过主要射击一次性释放出多重毒螫来消灭敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Pis.name: Coda Tysis
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Pis.description: The Technocyte virus has contorted this Tysis into a more lethal weapon. With increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Magazine Capacity.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Pis.zhDescription: （英文：CODA TYSIS）科技细胞病毒将啐沫者扭曲成更致命的武器。伤害、暴击几率、暴击伤害和弹匣容量均有所提升。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Pis.name: Coda Pox
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Pis.description: These festering, writhing, throwable projectiles of pus and gas have been improved with a greater Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Pis.zhDescription: （英文：CODA POX）这些溃烂、扭动、可投掷的脓气投射物已得到改进，具有更高的弹匣容量、暴击几率、暴击伤害、触发几率和伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Pis.name: Coda Catabolyst
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Pis.description: When the magazine reaches empty and is manually reloaded, the Coda Catabolyst launches not one but three powerful grenades. Also has a higher Status Chance, Damage, and Magazine Size.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Pis.zhDescription: （英文：CODA CATABOLYST）当弹匣空了并且手动重新装填时，终幕·异化者会发射三枚威力极大的手榴弹，而不是一枚。同时还具有更高的触发几率、伤害和弹匣容量。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Pis.name: Dual Coda Torxica
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Pis.description: Get the job done right with a pair of spore flinging terror tools. Inflicts a spore that spreads to nearby enemies on death causing <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect and increased vulnerability to damage from the Torxica.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Pis.zhDescription: （英文：DUAL CODA TORXICA）用这对令人胆寒的孢子发射器完成任务。孢子感染会在敌人死亡时传播到附近的敌人身上，造成 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态，并且孢蚀双枪会更容易对这些敌人造成伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Mel.name: Coda Mire
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Mel.description: The Plague Year of 1999 will never be the same. With improved Critical Multipler, Critical Chance, and Status Chance, the Technocyte virus has turned the Coda Mire into a truly horrifying blade.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Mel.zhDescription: （英文：CODA MIRE）1999 年的瘟疫年将不再一样。科技细胞病毒通过增加暴击倍率、暴击几率和触发几率，将终幕·米尔变成了一把真正可怕的利刃。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Mel.name: Coda Hirudo
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Mel.description: Rip and shred your enemies to pieces with the Coda Hirudo. With improved Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance, and Critical Damage.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Mel.zhDescription: （英文：CODA HIRUDO）使用终幕·蚂蟥将敌人撕成碎片。具有更高的伤害、触发几率、暴击几率和暴击伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Mel.name: Coda Motovore
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Mel.description: Drive home the pain with this hammer evolved from a scooter assembly. The wheel shapeshifts and gains a unique buff to match whatever type of physical damage it has been modded for.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Mel.zhDescription: （英文：CODA MOTOVORE）挥舞这把从摩托车组件变异而来的战锤，将苦痛根植在你的敌人心中。其上的车轮将随着武器所配置的主要物理伤害类型而改变形状并获得独特增益。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Mel.name: Coda Pathocyst
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Mel.description: Enhanced by Technocyte mutations, the Coda Pathocyst comes with increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Status Chance. While in-flight or on contact with the enemy, it will occasionally spawn enhanced, enemy-seeking miasmites.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Mel.zhDescription: （英文：CODA PATHOCYST）终幕·病囊飞刃通过科技细胞突变的强化，具有更高的伤害、暴击几率、暴击伤害和触发几率。在飞行中或与敌人接触时，它偶尔会生成增强的、自动搜寻敌人的自爆虫。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Mel.name: Coda Caustacyst
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Mel.description: The Coda Caustacyst scythe is a force to be reckoned with, the Technocyte virus honing it with improved Damage, Status Chance, and Critical Damage, as well as acid pools with longer duration.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Mel.zhDescription: （英文：CODA CAUSTACYST）终幕·灼蚀变体镰是一股不容小觑的力量，科技细胞病毒对其进行了改良，提高了伤害、触发几率和暴击伤害，并且具有持续时间更长的酸液池。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Lon.name: Coda Synapse
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Lon.description: Firing a nonstop stream of vile corrosive gastric juice, the Coda Synapse comes with increased Magazine size, Beam Length, Status Chance, Punch Through, and Damage.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Lon.zhDescription: （英文：CODA SYNAPSE）终幕·突触生化枪可以持续发射恶臭腐蚀性胃液。具有更高的弹匣容量、光束长度、触发几率、穿透和伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Lon.name: Coda Sporothrix
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Lon.description: Delivers a virus-laden barb to its victim that continues to damage it before exploding. With increased Damage, Reload Speed, Magazine Size, Status Chance, and explosion radius.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Lon.zhDescription: （英文：CODA SPOROTHRIX）向受害者投掷一个携带病毒的倒钩，持续造成伤害直至爆炸。具有更高的伤害、装填速度、弹匣容量、触发几率和爆炸半径。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Lon.name: Coda Hema
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Lon.description: The Technocyte virus did nothing but increase the Hema’s thirst for blood. With increased Fire Rate, Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Lon.zhDescription: （英文：CODA HEMA）科技细胞病毒没有起到什么作用，只是增加了血肢的嗜血性。具有更高的射速、弹匣容量、暴击几率、暴击伤害、触发几率和伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Lon.name: Coda Bubonico
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Lon.description: With increased magazine size, the Coda Bubonico was born of the Technocyte virus' need to spread infection. Primary Fire rate ramps up with continuous fire.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Lon.zhDescription: （英文：CODA BUBONICO）终幕·横痃重炮增加了弹匣容量，其设计源于科技细胞病毒对传播感染的渴望。持续射击时，主要射击的射速会逐渐提升。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Lon.name: Coda Bassocyst
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Lon.description: Amplify shockwaves of devastating sound with this Technocyte virus infested shotgun that hungers for blood, and desires nothing more than to feed upon its enemies. Alternative fire at enemies not vulnerable to Mercy Kills to swarm them with infested mites, while firing at vulnerable ones will perform a ranged execution.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/InfestedLich/Lon.zhDescription: （英文：CODA BASSOCYST）通过这把渴求饮血食肉的科技细胞病毒感染霰弹枪来放大毁灭性声音的冲击波。次要射击无法被怜悯之击攻击的敌人，用感染螨虫将他们包围，而射击能被怜悯之击攻击的敌人则可远程处决。

/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Bow/InfCernosBow.name: Mutalist Cernos
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Bow/InfCernosBow.description: Overcome with Infestation, this bow's arrows now spread poisonous contagion to any surface they hit.
/Lotus/Weapons/Infested/Bow/InfCernosBow.zhDescription: （英文：MUTALIST CERNOS）受到感染者的侵蚀后，这把弓的箭矢能够在击中的任何表面散播病毒。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/ThrowingWeapons/G.name: Aegrit
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/ThrowingWeapons/G.description: What the Aegrit lacks in quantity it makes up for in destructive power. Toss the Aegrit onto your enemy’s position then detonate remotely at the right moment for maximum destructive effect.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/ThrowingWeapons/G.zhDescription: （英文：AEGRIT）骇敌榴弹虽然数量稀少但威力来补。将骇敌榴弹投掷到敌人的位置，然后在适当的时机远程引爆，以获得最大的破坏效果。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/WraithTwi.name: Twin Vipers Wraith
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/WraithTwi.description: The uniquely styled Twin Vipers Wraith are a powerful variation on the standard akimbo machine-pistols.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/WraithTwi.zhDescription: （英文：WRAITH TWIN VIPERS）独特风格的双子蝰蛇·亡魂拥有比原版更强的火力。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/WraithSin.name: Viper Wraith
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/WraithSin.description: The uniquely styled Viper Wraith is a powerful variation on the standard machine-pistol.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/WraithSin.zhDescription: （英文：VIPER WRAITH）这把风格独一无二的蝰蛇·亡魂是基于制式机关手枪的强力变体。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/HeatGun/G.name: Atomos
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/HeatGun/G.description: This particle cannon generates a condensed beam of super-heated plasma designed to melt rock to ore, and enemies to molten slag.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/HeatGun/G.zhDescription: （英文：ATOMOS）这把粒子加农炮能产生由超高温等离子体凝聚而成的射线。而这种射线可以用来冶炼矿石，也可以将敌人化为熔渣。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnUzi/Gr.name: Stubba
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnUzi/Gr.description: Inflict rapid-fire bursts of pain with this Grineer submachine gun.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnUzi/Gr.zhDescription: （英文：STUBBA）用这把 Grineer 冲锋枪的爆发速射特性来产生相应的苦痛。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnTorped.name: Kulstar
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnTorped.description: Rain hell on the enemy with this handheld cluster-rocket launcher.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnTorped.zhDescription: （英文：KULSTAR）使用这把手持集束火箭发射器，对敌人投以地狱之火。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnQueenG.name: Twin Rogga
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnQueenG.description: These twin barrels of destruction are the signature pistols of the Kuva Guardians.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnQueenG.zhDescription: （英文：TWIN ROGGA）这对能够带来破坏的枪管是赤毒守卫者手枪标志性的特征。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnOrokin.name: Sagek Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnOrokin.description: The sidearm of choice for Prime Grineer warriors, Sagek Prime blends Grineer brutality with Orokin aesthetics. When Sagek Prime inflicts a critical hit, its next shot has a chance to gain significant Status Chance.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnOrokin.zhDescription: （英文：SAGEK PRIME）作为精英 Grineer 战士的首选次要武器，杀格 Prime 融合了 Grineer 的残暴和 Orokin 的美学。当杀格 Prime 造成暴击时，其下一次射击有几率大幅提升触发几率。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnKohmPi.name: Kohmak
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnKohmPi.description: Like the larger Kohm, this hand-shotgun doubles its volley with each successive shot.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnKohmPi.zhDescription: （英文：KOHMAK）像稍大的寇恩热能枪，这把手持霰弹枪连续射击时都会加倍射出能量弹。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnDWUniq.name: Twin Kohmak
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnDWUniq.description: Doubling their volley on each successive shot, the Twin Kohmaks decimate foes in seconds.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnDWUniq.zhDescription: （英文：TWIN KOHMAK）每次连续击发都有双倍的齐射子弹，双子寇恩霰机枪能够在数秒之内消灭敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnAmphis.name: Quatz
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnAmphis.description: A compact four-barreled design packing a self-charging capacitor that discharges upon every reload from empty. Features auto hip-fire and aimed fire is semi-auto, four-shot instant burst.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrnAmphis.zhDescription: （英文：QUATZ）拥有紧凑的四管设计且装有一个自充电电容器，会在空枪装填时释放电流。腰射时为自动模式，瞄准时为瞬间射出四发子弹模式。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerMi.name: Nukor
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerMi.description: Creates and focuses a high-frequency field of microwaves, literally cooking the target from within.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerMi.zhDescription: （英文：NUKOR）创造并聚焦一个高频率的微波场，从内部将目标确确实实地烤熟。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerLe.name: Marelok
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerLe.description: The Marelok combines the stopping power of a rifle with the portability of a pistol.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerLe.zhDescription: （英文：MARELOK）玛瑞火枪因为后坐力高而缺乏准度。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerHa.name: Brakk
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerHa.description: Simple but powerful. The semi-automatic Brakk hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerHa.zhDescription: （英文：BRAKK）简单但威力强大，半自动布拉克手枪小型的枪身中却拥有强大的冲击火力。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerCr.name: Stug
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerCr.description: Firing a sticky, toxic, explosive compound, the Stug Gel Gun offers multiple ejection modes, delivering maximum damage in all situations.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerCr.zhDescription: （英文：STUG）史特克凝胶枪能发射出一种粘稠、有毒的爆炸混合物。且具有多种发射模式，在各种情况下都能造成最大伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerBu.name: Prisma Twin Gremlins
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerBu.description: Fused with prisma crystals, these pristine Grineer sidearms are sure to intimidate any foe.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerBu.zhDescription: （英文：PRISMA TWIN GREMLINS）熔合了棱晶，这崭新的 Grineer 随身武器能恐吓到任何敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/Tonfa/GrnCh.name: Tonkkatt
