/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/Tonfa/GrnCh.description: Rend enemies and up the heat with these mining tools repurposed into machine-tonfa. Building the Combo Multiplier overheats the Tonkkatts, setting enemies ablaze.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/Tonfa/GrnCh.zhDescription: （英文：TONKKATT）用这对由采矿工具改装而来的拐刃撕裂并点燃你的敌人。积累连击倍率将使武器过热，让敌人熊熊燃烧。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/Scythe/GrnD.name: Galariak Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/Scythe/GrnD.description: Orokin-era Grineer plated their scythes with gold as a symbol of dedication to their Golden Lords. Gains a percentage of Critical Chance with each Status Type affecting the target.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/Scythe/GrnD.zhDescription: （英文：GALARIAK PRIME）奥罗金时代的 Grineer 战士将镰刀镀上黄金，以此象征他们对黄金之主的忠诚。每有一种异常状态影响目标，镰刀的暴击几率就会提升一定百分比。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GunBlade/Gr.name: Vastilok
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GunBlade/Gr.description: Slash and blast with this heavy Gunblade of brutal Grineer design. High slash damage paired with a heavy shotgun attack.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GunBlade/Gr.zhDescription: （英文：VASTILOK）用这把凶猛的重型 Grineer 枪刃斩杀、爆破。高切割伤害与重型霰弹攻击相得益彰。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnTrident/.name: Sydon
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnTrident/.description: Inflict maximum devastation with this massive Grineer trident.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnTrident/.zhDescription: （英文：SYDON）这柄沉重的 Grineer 三叉戟能造成极致的毁灭。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnSparring.name: Korrudo
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnSparring.description: When they go high, go low. Powerful pneumatic grips and toecaps amplify every blow. Four ways to deal twice the pain.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnSparring.zhDescription: （英文：KORRUDO）当他们出上拳的时候，你就出下拳。强大的气动握把和尖锐的部分可以强化每一次攻击。多达四种方法来施放双倍的痛苦。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnSharbola.name: Slaytra
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnSharbola.description: The Slaytra is a powerful reiteration of the traditional Grineer Machete that doubles the duration of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnSharbola.zhDescription: （英文：SLAYTRA）屠煞是对传统 Grineer 砍刀的强大重现，它可以使 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害的出血持续时间加倍。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnQueenSce.name: Broken Scepter
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnQueenSce.description: A shattered talisman of the Grineer Elder Queen. It pulls health orbs from deceased enemies and energy orbs from destroyed robots.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnQueenSce.zhDescription: （英文：BROKEN SCEPTER）Grineer 大女皇的护身物，虽已破碎但仍具有神秘力量。能从死去敌人身上取得生命球，或从被破坏的机器人中取得能量球。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnKuvaLich.name: Kuva Shildeg
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnKuvaLich.description: A crushing, killing, rocket-powered stab-hammer. Grineer, naturally.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnKuvaLich.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA SHILDEG）一款以碾碎与杀戮为卖点的火箭动力刺锤。这显然是 Grineer 的杰作。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnKusariga.name: Jat Kusar
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnKusariga.description: Overwhelm hostiles with this jet-powered sickle and razor-chain weapon. Charged strikes ignite an explosive blast at range.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnKusariga.zhDescription: （英文：JAT KUSAR）用这把喷气动力的镰刀和锋利锁链武器击垮你的敌人。蓄力攻击可以点燃一次远距离的爆破。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnGhoulSaw.name: Ghoulsaw
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnGhoulSaw.description: The cruelest of weapons built for the crudest of Grineer soldiers. Rips through metal like flesh, and through flesh like day-old pudding.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnGhoulSaw.zhDescription: （英文：GHOULSAW）为那些最粗鲁的 Grineer 士兵所打造的最残忍的武器。削铁如肉，割肉如泥。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnEgyptSwd.name: Krohkur
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnEgyptSwd.description: This hooked blade rewards critical hits to those skilled enough to strike with finesse.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnEgyptSwd.zhDescription: （英文：KROHKUR）这把钩刃能在拥有精湛技艺的人手里造成致命的打击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnEgyptSwd.name: Twin Krohkur
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnEgyptSwd.description: Battlefield butchery becomes all too easy with a Krohkur blade in each hand.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnEgyptSwd.zhDescription: （英文：DUAL KROHKUR）双手持有克鲁古尔之刃能让战场中的杀戮变得轻而易举

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnDualFire.name: Twin Basolk
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnDualFire.description: These nasty, little hatchets slice through steel as if it were flesh.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnDualFire.zhDescription: （英文：TWIN BASOLK）这对棘手凶恶的小型短斧斩铁如泥，断钢如削肉。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnBoomeran.name: Halikar Wraith
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnBoomeran.description: A different take on the throwing mace, the Halikar Wraith features unique styling.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnBoomeran.zhDescription: （英文：HALIKAR WRAITH）有别于回力飞锤，哈利卡亡魂有着独一无二的风格。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnBoomeran.name: Halikar
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnBoomeran.description: This jet powered Grineer throwing mace always comes back to its master and is even capable of disarming targets.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnBoomeran.zhDescription: （英文：HALIKAR）这个Grineer 喷射动力飞锤，其冲击足以解除被击中者的武装，且投掷后总是能回到使用者手上。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerWhip.name: Atterax
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerWhip.description: A multi-bladed whip that is adept at flaying skin from bone. In extreme cases, disobedient Grineer are sentenced to death by Atterax.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerWhip.zhDescription: （英文：ATTERAX）擅长将皮肤从骨头上剥下的多刃鞭。在极端情况下，不听话的 Grineer 可以用阿特拉克斯判处死刑。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerTylA.name: Ack & Brunt
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerTylA.description: Tyl Regor's custom axe and shield are how he likes to eliminate ‘frustrations'.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerTylA.zhDescription: 这对特制的战斧与盾牌正是泰尔·雷工用来消除'阻碍'的方式。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerMach.name: Machete Wraith
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerMach.description: A different take on a familiar combat knife, the Machete Wraith features unique styling.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerMach.zhDescription: （英文：MACHETE WRAITH）熟悉的大砍刀配上不一样的造型，马谢特砍刀·亡魂以它的独特设计风格作标榜。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerMach.name: Prisma Machete
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerMach.description: The addition of Prisma Crystal allows this otherwise barbaric weapon to elegantly hack through any foe.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerMach.zhDescription: （英文：PRISMA MACHETE）这把原本野蛮的武器在融入棱晶后能优雅的斩杀任何敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerMach.name: Prisma Dual Cleavers
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerMach.description: Blades of energized prisma crystal make these ornamental cleavers cut as sharply as they look.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerMach.zhDescription: （英文：PRISMA DUAL CLEAVERS）这双经过装饰的刀刃充满了棱晶的能量，使得这副双刀的切砍如同它的外表一般锐利。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerMach.name: Machete
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerMach.description: A ferocious Melee Weapon crafted by the Grineer and carried by their elite melee forces.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerMach.zhDescription: （英文：MACHETE）Grineer 制造的一把凶猛近战兵器，多数由精锐力量携带。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerMach.name: Dual Cleavers
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerMach.description: Butcher your foes with brutal blades in each hand.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerMach.zhDescription: （英文：DUAL CLEAVERS）双持野蛮刀刃来屠宰你的敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerJetP.name: Jat Kittag
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerJetP.description: Deliver crushing blows with this Grineer built, jet powered mace.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerJetP.zhDescription: （英文：JAT KITTAG）Grineer 所制造的喷射动力锤能造成粉碎性的打击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerHalb.name: Kesheg
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerHalb.description: Slice through mobs of unruly enemies with this fierce halberd; the signature weapon of the Kuva Guardians.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerHalb.zhDescription: （英文：KESHEG）用这柄凶猛的长戟割开群魔乱舞的敌人；这是赤毒守卫者标志性的武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerComb.name: Sheev
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerComb.description: Built for close combat, the Sheev's plasma blade slices through flesh and armor with equal ease.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerComb.zhDescription: （英文：SHEEV）专为近身战斗设计，希芙的等离子刀刃能轻而易举切开肉体与护甲。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/WraithGo.name: Gorgon Wraith
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/WraithGo.description: The Gorgon Wraith is a powerful variant of its precursor that features unique styling.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/WraithGo.zhDescription: （英文：GORGON WRAITH）蛇发女妖·亡魂是其前身的强大变体，以它独特的风格为特色。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/VoidTrad.name: Prisma Gorgon
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/VoidTrad.description: Adorned with void hardened prisma crystal, this Gorgon variant is prized for its beauty and enhanced mechanics.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/VoidTrad.zhDescription: （英文：PRISMA GORGON）装饰了虚空的硬化棱晶，使这把蛇发女妖因她的美丽与增强的机能变得更具价值。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/LaserAim.name: Argonak
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/LaserAim.description: Pick off targets by highlighting distant enemies using this Grineer rifle's advanced laser sighting system. Deadly in both single fire and automatic modes.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/LaserAim.zhDescription: （英文：ARGONAK）利用这把 Grineer 步枪的先进激光瞄准系统高亮敌人，将他们逐一射杀。单发和全自动模式都非常致命。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnSpark.name: Kohm
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnSpark.description: For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnSpark.zhDescription: （英文：KOHM ）寇恩热能枪在每一次高速连续的射击时都会额外击发出一发能量弹，使其更具杀伤力。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnOroki.name: Gotva Prime
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnOroki.description: Long before clone-rot set in, elite Grineer Commanders protected the surviving Orokin from rebelling Warframes with these formidable rifles. When Gotva Prime inflicts a Status Effect, its next shot has a chance to be a Super Critical hit.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnOroki.zhDescription: （英文：GOTVA PRIME）早在克隆基因衰变之前，精英 Grineer 指挥官就用这把强大的步枪从战甲的叛乱中保护幸存的奥罗金人。当骨葬 Prime 造成异常状态时，下一次射击有机会造成超级暴击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnKuvaL.name: Kuva Chakkhurr
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnKuvaL.description: Detonate heads with this slow-firing rifle that rewards precision.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnKuvaL.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA CHAKKHURR）用这款需要精确瞄准的低射速步枪来打爆敌人的头颅。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnHarpo.name: Harpak
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnHarpo.description: Spike enemies to the wall or reel them in with this burst harpoon gun.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnHarpo.zhDescription: （英文：HARPAK）以这把爆裂鱼叉枪卷起敌人，或将他们钉在墙上。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnGrena.name: Tonkor
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnGrena.description: Hurl mayhem and destruction with this Grineer grenade launcher.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnGrena.zhDescription: （英文：TONKOR）以这把 Grineer 榴弹发射器对敌人猛烈射出暴乱与破坏。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnGorgS.name: Buzlok
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnGorgS.description: Mark your targets and unleash a barrage of bullets, the Buzlok's homing rounds always find the enemy. Marked targets are more likely to take critical hits.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnGorgS.zhDescription: （英文：BUZLOK）标记目标，并射出密集的弹幕，巴兹火枪的制导子弹永远能够找到敌人。被标记的敌人更容易遭到暴击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnFourB.name: Quartakk
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnFourB.description: Annihilate targets with four simultaneous shots from this high-caliber Grineer rifle.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnFourB.zhDescription: （英文：QUARTAKK）用这把大口径的 Grineer 步枪的 4 发同步射击来消灭目标。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnFlame.name: Javlok
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnFlame.description: Launch super-heated slugs at individual foes, or hurl the entire weapon and ignite groups of enemies in a flash inferno.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnFlame.zhDescription: （英文：JAVLOK）对单个敌人发射极热的子弹。或者将整个武器掷出并在地狱火光中点燃成群的敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnCanno.name: Zarr
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnCanno.description: Unload a barrage of explosives or a huge shot of flak from this cannon’s enormous barrel.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrnCanno.zhDescription: （英文：ZARR）从这具火炮的巨型炮管可以倾泻出爆裂的弹幕或者一枚大型的高射炮弹。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerS.name: Vulkar Wraith
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerS.description: A blood-red variant of this devastating sniper rifle.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerS.zhDescription: （英文：VULKAR WRAITH）一把有着血红色装饰且杀伤力极大的狙击步枪。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerS.name: Vulkar
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerS.description: Built by the Grineer for their elite troopers, the Vulkar is a devastating distance weapon. In the right hands it is capable of taking down targets long before they get into attack range.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerS.zhDescription: （英文：VULKAR）Grineer 为其精锐部队制造，金工火神是一把毁灭性的远程兵器。在正确的使用者手中它能在目标进入攻击距离之前将其迅速放倒。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerS.name: Miter
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerS.description: The Miter launches high velocity saw blades, tearing apart anyone unfortunate enough to be in their path.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerS.zhDescription: （英文：MITER）米特尔发射高速锯片，撕裂任何不幸在其路径上的人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerM.name: Karak Wraith
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerM.description: A different take on the Grineer assault rifle, the Karak Wraith features unique styling.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerM.zhDescription: （英文：KARAK WRAITH）有别于 Grineer 制式的突击步枪，卡拉克·亡魂有着独一无二的风格。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerM.name: Karak
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerM.description: Solid, dependable and deadly. The Karak is a standard issue rifle in many Grineer platoons.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerM.zhDescription: （英文：KARAK）结实、可靠又致命。卡拉克是很多Grineer小队的一把标准配置步枪。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerL.name: Prisma Grinlok
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerL.description: Prisma-crystal enhancement creates here a prestige instrument; a weapon capable of taking life at astonishing range with but a single pull of its exquisitely-tooled trigger.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerL.zhDescription: （英文：PRISMA GRINLOK）棱晶的强化铸造了一个名贵的器械；一把能够在意想不到的范围内夺走生命的武器，并且只需要扣一次其精确好使的扳机。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerL.name: Grinlok
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerL.description: With pinpoint accuracy, the Grinlok lever-action repeating rifle can easily find the soft spot on any target.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerL.zhDescription: （英文：GRINLOK）凭借极高的精确度，葛恩火枪这把杠杆作用连发步枪可以轻而易举地找到任何目标的弱点。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerF.name: Drakgoon
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerF.description: The Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerF.zhDescription: （英文：DRAKGOON）龙骑兵破片炮可击发出会四处弹射的高热弹片。能以散射或压缩集中的方式进行射击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerA.name: Twin Grakatas
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerA.description: When one Grakata isn't enough, bring another for extra firepower.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerA.zhDescription: （英文：TWIN GRAKATAS）一把葛拉卡达手枪不敷需求时，不妨再带上一把享受额外的火力吧。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerA.name: Grakata
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerA.description: Equipped with a huge Magazine and impressive Fire Rate, the Grakata is the preferred weapon of Grineer Lancers.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerA.zhDescription: （英文：GRAKATA）装备了巨大弹匣，拥有非凡的射速。葛拉卡达是 Grineer 枪兵的首选。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/BurstRif.name: Hind
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/BurstRif.description: A powerful mid-range rifle used by Grineer shock troops, the Hind fires in five round bursts.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/BurstRif.zhDescription: （英文：HIND）由 Grineer 突击部队使用的强力中阶步枪，雌鹿一次射击就是五连发。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Secondar.name: Kuva Twin Stubbas
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Secondar.description: Double-fist rapid-fire bursts of pain with these dual-wield variants of the Grineer submachine gun. Higher Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Secondar.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA TWIN STUBBAS）用这把 Grineer 冲锋枪双持变体的爆发速射特性来产生双倍的苦痛。它拥有更高的射速和更大的弹匣容量。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Secondar.name: Kuva Seer
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Secondar.description: This variant pistol has higher fire rate and magazine capacity. Superior zoom capabilities plus projectiles have a small Corrosive burst.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Secondar.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA SEER）这把变体手枪拥有更高的射速、弹匣容量以及变焦倍率。此外，它射出的子弹还会产生小范围腐蚀爆炸效果。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Secondar.name: Kuva Nukor
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Secondar.description: A highly-optimized Nukor that allows for the weapon’s microwave field to hit up to two additional targets.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Secondar.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA NUKOR）一把高度优化的努寇微波枪，可以通过其微波场击中最多两个额外目标。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Secondar.name: Kuva Kraken
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Secondar.description: A custom variant that fires three quick shots with a single pull of the trigger, or can alt-fire burst the remainder of its magazine. Higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Secondar.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA KRAKEN）一种北海巨妖的改装变体，单扣扳机可迅速击出三连发射击，或者可通过次要射击来进行点射。它拥有更高的射速、更大的弹匣容量以及更快的装填速度

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Secondar.name: Kuva Brakk
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Secondar.description: This Lich-variant semi-automatic hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package. Higher fire rate, magazine capacity and reload speed.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Secondar.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA BRAKK）这把玄骸变体的半自动手枪，小型的枪身中却拥有强大的冲击力。它拥有更高的射速、更大的弹匣容量以及更快的装填速度

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Melee/Gh.name: Kuva Ghoulsaw
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Melee/Gh.description: The addition of Kuva has forged the savage Ghoulsaw into an even more brutal weapon, allowing for faster attacks.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/Melee/Gh.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA GHOULSAW）赤毒将尸鬼电锯锻造成了更野蛮的武器，可以进行更快的攻击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.name: Kuva Zarr
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.description: An even stronger Zarr cannon to meet the demands of Kuva Liches. With stronger explosive barrages, and long-range flak shots.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA ZARR）一把更强大的沙皇火炮，满足了赤毒玄骸的需求。拥有更强的爆裂弹幕和更远距离的高射炮弹。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.name: Kuva Tonkor
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.description: This Lich-variant grenade launcher hurls mayhem and destruction with an increased Reload Speed.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA TONKOR）这种榴弹发射器玄骸变体拥有更快的装填速度，可以对敌人猛烈射出暴乱与破坏。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.name: Kuva Sobek
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.description: The Kuva Sobek's exceptional Reload Speed, Critical Chance, and Status Chance make it a natural fit for the Kuva Lich's dominant spirit.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA SOBEK）赤毒·鳄神出色的装填速度、暴击几率和触发几率，与赤毒玄骸的霸道风格高度契合。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.name: Kuva Quartakk
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.description: Unlike a standard Quartakk this Kuva Lich variant fires automatically from the hip while retaining its signature feature when aimed: annihilating targets with four simultaneous shots.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA QUARTAKK）与原版夸塔克不同，这种赤毒玄骸夸塔克变体能从腰际全自动开火射击，同时保持了瞄准时的特点：用 4 发同步射击来消灭目标。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.name: Kuva Ogris
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.description: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. Unlike the basic version the Kuva Ogris fires detonite-infused casings semi-automatically, from a smaller magazine, while dealing greater damage per shot.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA OGRIS）某位可怕的赤毒玄骸所使用的改装武器。与原版不同，它拥有更小的弹匣，能以半自动的方式发射满载易爆物的炮弹，同时每一发能造成更多伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.name: Kuva Kohm
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.description: The Kuva Kohm variant has a higher fire rate than the original. For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kuva Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA KOHM ）这把赤毒寇恩热能枪变体拥有比原版更高的射速。赤毒寇恩热能枪在每一次高速连续的射击时都会额外击发出一发能量弹，使其更具杀伤力。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.name: Kuva Karak
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.description: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. It has greater reload speed, lower recoil and greater accuracy than the standard-issue Karak rifle.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA KARAK）某位可怕的赤毒玄骸所使用的改装武器。相比于原版卡拉克步枪，它拥有更快的装填速度、更低的后座力以及更高的精准度。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.name: Kuva Hind
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.description: This powerful Grineer burst rifle has been retrofitted to add semi-automatic and automatic fire modes.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA HIND）这款强大的 Grineer 连射步枪经过改装，增加了半自动和全自动开火模式。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.name: Kuva Hek
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.description: Forged at the behest of the Worm Queen herself, this already powerful shotgun now has the additional ability to fire from all four barrels simultaneously.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA HEK）蠕虫女皇亲自下令锻造这把本就十分强大的霰弹枪，拥有额外功能可以同时从全部四个枪管开火。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.name: Kuva Drakgoon
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.description: The Kuva Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room that do not slow down. Larger Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/LongGuns.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA DRAKGOON）这款改造版龙骑兵破片炮可击发出会四处弹射且不会减速的高热弹片。它拥有更大的弹匣容量和更快的装填速度。能以散射或压缩集中的方式进行射击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/HeavyWea.name: Kuva Grattler
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/HeavyWea.description: Reconfigured for maximum lethality, the Kuva Grattler still shatters targets with explosive shells, but now reaches maximum fire-rate instantaneously.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/KuvaLich/HeavyWea.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA GRATTLER）重新调配以获得最大杀伤力，赤毒葛拉特勒仍使用爆裂弹来粉碎目标，但现在可以瞬间达到最高射速。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/HeavyWeapons/GrnH.name: Kuva Ayanga
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/HeavyWeapons/GrnH.description: Sweep aside hordes of enemies with flaming fury of this powerful, automatic, grenade launching archgun.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/HeavyWeapons/GrnH.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA AYANGA）用这款全自动曲翼榴弹发射器的怒火来扫荡大群敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/GrineerPistol/Grn.name: Seer
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/GrineerPistol/Grn.description: Captain Vor's prized Orokin-Grineer hybrid pistol has an average rate of fire, but it has high damage and superior zoom capabilities.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/GrineerPistol/Grn.zhDescription: （英文：SEER）奥罗金-Grineer 复合式手枪是沃尔上尉最重要的手枪，虽只有一般射速，但具有高杀伤力和卓越的狙击能力。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/GrineerPistol/Grn.name: Kraken
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/GrineerPistol/Grn.description: The Kraken is a heavy pistol of Grineer design that fires two quick shots with a single pull of the trigger. Skilled marksmen will appreciate the value in this deadly accurate weapon.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/GrineerPistol/Grn.zhDescription: （英文：KRAKEN）北海巨妖是一把由 Grineer 设计、手感沉重的手枪，单扣扳机可迅速击出两连发射击。熟练的神枪手一定懂得这把致命精准武器的价值。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/GrineerPistol/Gri.name: Viper
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/GrineerPistol/Gri.description: A full-auto pistol known as the most compact and lightweight weapon of the Grineer arsenal. Though it has a small Magazine Capacity, the Viper has a very high Fire Rate and ultra-fast reload times thanks to a simplified magazine design.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/GrineerPistol/Gri.zhDescription: （英文：VIPER）Grineer 军械库中小巧轻便的代名词。蝰蛇是一把弹匣容量细小的全自动手枪，其精简化的弹匣为其带来高射速及惊人的重新装填速度。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/GrineerPistol/Gri.name: Twin Gremlins
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/GrineerPistol/Gri.description: Designed as a pair, these Grineer sidearms fire projectiles at a slower rate but with greater force and accuracy.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/GrineerPistol/Gri.zhDescription: （英文：TWIN GREMLINS）这把 Grineer 随身武器被设计成一对，虽然开火速度较慢，但有更强大的火力和准确性。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Bows/GrnBow/GrnBo.name: Kuva Bramma
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Bows/GrnBow/GrnBo.description: This Grineer bow delivers vengeance in the form of clusterbomb-tipped arrows that can be detonated mid-air or on impact. Low quiver capacity, arrows are recovered singly.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Bows/GrnBow/GrnBo.zhDescription: （英文：KUVA BRAMMA）这把 Grineer 弓箭能射出尖端配有集束炸弹的复仇箭矢，可以在空中或遇到冲击时引爆。低箭袋容量，箭矢逐个恢复。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/SniperPist.name: Arca Scisco
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/SniperPist.description: This scoped pistol analyzes strikes, learning how to damage its targets most effectively. Achieve maximum damage output after five successive hits.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/SniperPist.zhDescription: （英文：ARCA SCISCO）这把带有瞄准镜的手枪会分析着弹，获悉如何更有效的对目标造成伤害。在连续成功命中五次后会达到最大的伤害输出。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpSonific.name: Plinx
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpSonific.description: Cultivate a meaningful relationship with this deceptively simple battery-powered pistol. The Plinx rewards attention and investment from the wise.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpSonific.zhDescription: （英文：PLINX）与这把看似朴素的电池手枪培养出深厚的情感。漫射者最能回馈来自智者的关注与投资。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpSentExp.name: Ocucor
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpSentExp.description: A weapon that reaches for its next victim even as it kills. With each takedown, this pistol spawns an energy tendril that reaches for a nearby target.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpSentExp.zhDescription: （英文：OCUCOR）在击杀同时便已准备好对下一名受害者伸出魔爪的一种武器。每次击杀，这把手枪会生成能量卷须伸向邻近目标。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpSentAma.name: Cyanex
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpSentAma.description: Sentient tech merges with Corpus design to deliver this lethal sidearm. Fully automatic, it fires ricocheting, homing projectiles that release small clouds of <DT_GAS_COLOR>Gas on impact. Alt-fire to release the entire magazine without homing as a single burst.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpSentAma.zhDescription: （英文：CYANEX）Sentient 科技与 Corpus 设计的结合，发展出这款致命的次要武器。该武器为全自动，可射出跳飞式、自动导引的弹幕，子弹在撞击时会释放出小一股 <DT_GAS_COLOR>毒气。次要射击为可在单次射击中释放剩余的弹药。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpIgniter.name: Tenet Spirex
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpIgniter.description: Dominate rivals with this pistol’s lightning fast rail-slugs. Head-shots speed up reload.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpIgniter.zhDescription: （英文：TENET SPIREX）用这把手枪快如闪电的弹道压制对手。爆头可加快装填速度。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpHandRL/.name: Prisma Angstrum
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpHandRL/.description: Imbued with the finest Prisma crystal, this refined Angstrum features boosted charge and reload speeds.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpHandRL/.zhDescription: （英文：PRISMA ANGSTRUM）灌注了最出色的棱晶，这款经过精制后的安格斯壮的特点是具有更快的蓄力和装填速度。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpHandRL/.name: Angstrum
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpHandRL/.description: Capable of firing multiple rockets at once, the Angstrum is a handheld instrument of destruction.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpHandRL/.zhDescription: （英文：ANGSTRUM）能够同时发射若干火箭的安格斯壮是一个手持的毁灭工具。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpElectro.name: Staticor
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpElectro.description: Send a massive charge of potential energy hurling toward unfortunate targets.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpElectro.zhDescription: （英文：STATICOR）将强大的静电势能射向不幸的敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpChargeG.name: Cycron
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpChargeG.description: Forgo ammunition with the regenerating energy disc in this plasma throwing pistol.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpChargeG.zhDescription: （英文：CYCRON）用这把装有能量恢复圆盘的等离子体发射手枪摆脱弹药的限制。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpBriefca.name: Tenet Diplos
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpBriefca.description: Itemize and execute with this pair of auto-lock-on, homing-projectile pistols. Shoot from-hip for a more conventional pistol experience. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the pistols when holstered.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpBriefca.zhDescription: （英文：TENET DIPLOS）用这对自动锁定追踪目标的双枪将敌人逐个击破。腰射模式与传统手枪无异。配备了获得专利批准的格拉努公文包系统，收起时自动装填。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpAirPist.name: Sonicor
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpAirPist.description: Blasts targets with a massive wave of sonic energy. Results reported to be: 'Very Satisfying'.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpAirPist.zhDescription: （英文：SONICOR）以巨大的声波能量震飞目标。使用报告的结果是：非常爽。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusModu.name: Spectra Vandal
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusModu.description: A special-order Corpus cutting tool for master crafters only. Features distinctive azurite plating and a focusing crystal of precision clarity and cut.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusModu.zhDescription: （英文：SPECTRA VANDAL）一把特殊订制的 Corpus 切割工具，只适用于大师级工匠。具有独特的蓝铜色电镀外观和用于精准清澈化以及切割的聚焦水晶。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusMini.name: Dual Cestra
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusMini.description: Wield two Cestras to unleash a dual torrent of high energy bolts.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusMini.zhDescription: （英文：DUAL CESTRA）双手各持一把锡斯特释放出双流高能量弹幕。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusMini.name: Cestra
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusMini.description: Compact and deadly, the Cestra discharges bolts of energy at an increasingly rapid rate.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusMini.zhDescription: （英文：CESTRA）小巧而致命的锡斯特，以越来越快的射速释放能量弹。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusHand.name: Detron
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusHand.description: The sleek lines of the Detron conceal its ferocious nature. The hand cannon's semi-automatic action takes down enemies with speed and efficiency.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusHand.zhDescription: （英文：DETRON）德特昂的流线型线条掩饰其凶残本性，这把半自动手枪是快速并有效率地击倒敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Whips/CrpSho.name: Galvacord
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Whips/CrpSho.description: Shock and maim with this heavyweight retractable whip.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Whips/CrpSho.zhDescription: （英文：GALVACORD）使用这把重型伸缩鞭施以电击与残害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Whip/CorpusW.name: Lecta
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Whip/CorpusW.description: Half taser, half whip. The Corpus Lecta delivers a deadly shock to anything it touches.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Whip/CorpusW.zhDescription: （英文：LECTA）一半电击器一半鞭子。这条 Corpus 的勒克塔会对接触到的任何东西发出致命电击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/ShieldAndSwo.name: Tenet Agendus
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/ShieldAndSwo.description: Drive the agenda with this massive impact hammer. Heavy attacks launch devastating energy disks.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/ShieldAndSwo.zhDescription: （英文：TENET AGENDUS）用这把重型冲击锤推动议程。重击会发射毁灭性的能量盘。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Polearm/Corp.name: Serro
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Polearm/Corp.description: Developed as an energy saw to scrap obsolete ships, this tool was quickly banned when rebels in the Sedna region discovered it also made an excellent weapon.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Polearm/Corp.zhDescription: （英文：SERRO）能源锯的开发目的原是用以报废淘汰船只，但在赛德娜地区的反抗份子发现它也能用来作为优良的武器使用时，它很快就被禁止使用。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/KickAndPunch.name: Prisma Obex
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/KickAndPunch.description: Dazzle, distract and destroy with these sparring weapons of impossibly hard prisma crystal.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/KickAndPunch.zhDescription: （英文：PRISMA OBEX）用这件由无比坚硬的棱晶所打造的搏击武器，打出令人眼花缭乱的招式，进而摧毁敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/KickAndPunch.name: Obex
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/KickAndPunch.description: The Obex system multiplies the kinetic energy of a Tenno's kicks and punches, delivering devastating blows to any target.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/KickAndPunch.zhDescription: （英文：OBEX）奥比克斯战斗系统能强化 Tenno 的近身肉搏能力，给予目标致命伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Hammer/Corpu.name: Arca Titron
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Hammer/Corpu.description: Each successive kill from this massive electron hammer builds an electron charge that is unleashed on slam attacks.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Hammer/Corpu.zhDescription: （英文：ARCA TITRON）这柄巨型电子重锤的每一次连续击杀都会积累一重电荷，可以通过震地攻击将其释放出来。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Gunblade/Crp.name: Stropha
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Gunblade/Crp.description: A short-blade melee weapon with an ace up its sleeve. Send nearby enemies flying with a powerful short-range shockwave.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Gunblade/Crp.zhDescription: （英文：STROPHA）一件暗藏玄机的短刃近战武器。通过强大的短程冲击波来击飞附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Glaive/CrpGl.name: Falcor
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Glaive/CrpGl.description: Carve through enemies with surgical precision using this Corpus-tech glaive.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Glaive/CrpGl.zhDescription: （英文：FALCOR）用这把 Corpus 科技的战刃以手术般的精确性剖开敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Glaive/CrpGh.name: Xoris
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Glaive/CrpGh.description: An obscure glaive weapon of Corpus provenance, intrinsically linked to Specter technology. The Xoris strikes rapidly and with great devastation. It is capable of chaining combos infinitely.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/Glaive/CrpGh.zhDescription: （英文：XORIS）一件来源于 Corpus 且鲜为人知的战刃武器，与魅影技术有内在联系。「驱魔之刃」可以迅速进行打击，并拥有显著的破坏力。此外它可以无限进行连击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/CrpVenusHatc.name: Kreska
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/CrpVenusHatc.description: This unsophisticated Corpus survival tool does what it was designed for: hacking and splitting whatever it strikes.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/CrpVenusHatc.zhDescription: （英文：KRESKA）这把简易的 Corpus 生存工具履行了它的设计目标：砍杀和分裂任何攻击对象。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/CrpTonfa/Crp.name: Ohma
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/CrpTonfa/Crp.description: Bring the enemy to its knees with these twin electrified tonfas.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/CrpTonfa/Crp.zhDescription: （英文：OHMA）用这对带电的双子拐刃使你的敌人跪地求饶。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/CrpTonfa/Crp.name: Prisma Ohma
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/CrpTonfa/Crp.description: Prisma crystals glisten in these electrified tonfas.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/CrpTonfa/Crp.zhDescription: （英文：PRISMA OHMA）棱晶在这对带电的拐刃上闪闪发光。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/CrpBriefcase.name: Tenet Grigori
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/CrpBriefcase.description: On Heavy Slide Attack, this Corpus scythe launches a spinning energy disk that ricochets throughout the battlefield. Its lifetime is derived from the size of the Combo Counter. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/CrpBriefcase.zhDescription: （英文：TENET GRIGORI）滑行重击时，这把 Corpus 镰刀会发射一个旋转的能量盘在战场上弹跳。能量盘的持续时间由近战连击数决定。注意：格拉努公文包系统会在武器收起时暂停连击倒计时。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/CrpBriefcase.name: Tenet Livia
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/CrpBriefcase.description: The sleek lines of the Granum Attaché case conceal an infinitely sharp two-handed blade. Blocked attacks have a chance to increase the blocking angle. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Melee/CrpBriefcase.zhDescription: （英文：TENET LIVIA）格拉努公文包的流畅线条下隐藏着削铁如泥的双持利刃。格挡攻击有几率增加格挡角度。配备了获得专利批准的格拉努公文包系统，收起时暂停连击倒计时。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/Spears/Ra.name: Ferrox
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/Spears/Ra.description: Discharge a rail of ionized death or throw the Ferrox like a spear and create a localized field of attraction no enemy can escape from.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/Spears/Ra.zhDescription: （英文：FERROX）释放一道电离的死光，或掷出铁晶磁轨炮以产生一个敌人无法逃脱的局部吸引力场。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/Machinegu.name: Supra Vandal
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/Machinegu.description: A customized version of the powerful Supra, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/Machinegu.zhDescription: （英文：SUPRA VANDAL）强力苏普拉的定制版本，拥有着金属质感及 Lotus 的徽记。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/GrenadeLa.name: Penta
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/GrenadeLa.description: The Penta Launcher fires up to five grenades that can be remotely triggered at just the right moment.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/GrenadeLa.zhDescription: （英文：PENTA）潘塔发射器最多可发射五发榴弹，并在最适当的时候进行远距离引爆。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/GrenadeLa.name: Carmine Penta
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/GrenadeLa.description: Enveloped in deep red composite enamel, this Penta variant features a higher fire-rate and over-sized magazine.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/GrenadeLa.zhDescription: （英文：CARMINE PENTA）由深红色复合珐琅包络的潘塔变体，具有更高的射速和超大容量的弹匣。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpSplitL.name: Convectrix
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpSplitL.description: When its twin-lasers converge on a target a circuit is created, frying the subject.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpSplitL.zhDescription: （英文：CONVECTRIX）当双道激光汇聚在目标上时，便会产生回路，将敌人给炸熟。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpShotgu.name: Arca Plasmor
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpShotgu.description: Stagger targets with blasts from this Corpus engineered plasma shotgun. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpShotgu.zhDescription: （英文：ARCA PLASMOR）用这把 Corpus 设计的等离子霰弹枪来击倒你的目标。幸存下来的敌人会被辐射耗尽生命。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpShockR.name: Quanta Vandal
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpShockR.description: A customized version of the Quanta, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpShockR.zhDescription: （英文：QUANTA VANDAL）这把是定制化版本的量子切割器，拥有着金属质感及 Lotus 的徽记。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpShockR.name: Quanta
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpShockR.description: This weapon was designed to assist with the excavation of mineral deposits from large asteroids, but has been adapted for military purposes.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpShockR.zhDescription: （英文：QUANTA）这个武器原本是设计用来在大型小行星上协助挖掘矿物，但现在已更改为应用于军事用途上。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpShapeB.name: Exergis
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpShapeB.description: Feel the kick of this Corpus shotgun as it shatters a high-yield crystal into anyone and anything standing in your way.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpShapeB.zhDescription: （英文：EXERGIS）当这把 Corpus 霰弹枪将高产水晶轰入阻挡在你前方的任何人或物时，请细细品味其后坐力。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpSentEx.name: Battacor
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpSentEx.description: A weapon that builds charge the more it kills. Hit capacity then release for an obliterating discharge of power.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpSentEx.zhDescription: （英文：BATTACOR）一把借由击杀敌人来充能的武器。蓄满后可以释放出毁灭性的力量。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpSentAm.name: Komorex
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpSentAm.description: Corpus ingenuity leveraging Tau-tech to create a high-capacity bi-modal sniper weapon of terrifying capability. Zoom in to reduce recoil and add punch through. Zoom again to fire a bursting viral round, but with a lower rate of fire. Komorex features built-in ammo conversion.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpSentAm.zhDescription: （英文：KOMOREX）Corpus 独具匠心地利用 Tau 技术创造了一把可怕的大弹匣容量狙击枪。变焦可减少后坐力并增加穿透力。再次变焦可发射爆炸的病毒子弹，但射速降低。猛毒有自带的弹药转换。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpRubanR.name: Stahlta
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpRubanR.description: Nail them to the wall! The Stahlta automatic rifle propels hardened steel rods at high speed, while a charged fire mode fuses a number of volatile rods together for a large radioactive explosion.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpRubanR.zhDescription: （英文：STAHLTA）将敌人钉在墙上！这件钢刃自动步枪把硬化钢棒推进到高速状态，而蓄力射击模式会将大量不稳定的钢棒融合在一起，产生巨大的放射性爆炸。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpFreeze.name: Glaxion
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpFreeze.description: Fires a photon beam that halts molecular vibrations, causing instant and painful freezing.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpFreeze.zhDescription: （英文：GLAXION）发射出一道能暂停分子振动的光子束，造成痛苦的瞬间冻结。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpFreeze.name: Glaxion Vandal
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpFreeze.description: A cutting-edge, halogen-cooled electron accelerator capable of snap-freezing a target in moments.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpFreeze.zhDescription: （英文：GLAXION VANDAL）一把用尖端技术打造的卤素冷却电子加速器，能够瞬间将目标冷冻起来。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpBriefc.name: Tenet Envoy
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpBriefc.description: This discreet rocket launcher is equally at home in a board meeting or on a casual outing. Aimed rockets are wire-guided for greater accuracy, but travel more slowly. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the weapon when holstered.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpBriefc.zhDescription: （英文：TENET ENVOY）这款朴素的火箭发射器在董事会会议或休闲郊游时同样适用。瞄准发射的火箭是线导的，精确度更高，但飞行速度更慢。配备了获得专利批准的格拉努公文包系统，收起时自动装填。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpBFG/Cr.name: Opticor
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpBFG/Cr.description: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpBFG/Cr.zhDescription: （英文：OPTICOR ）一旦这挺 Corpus 激光炮充能完毕，便能释放出毁灭性的光能爆炸。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpBFG/Va.name: Opticor Vandal
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpBFG/Va.description: With a precision crafted lens, this customized Opticor achieves a level of performance previously thought impossible.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpBFG/Va.zhDescription: （英文：OPTICOR VANDAL）装有精密制作的透镜，这把定制化版本的奥堤克光子枪达到了以前认为不可能有的性能水平。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpArSnip.name: Ambassador
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpArSnip.description: Bring negotiations to an instant conclusion with this Corpus assault rifle. Switch effortlessly between charged explosive shots and rapid-fire electrical assault mode.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpArSnip.zhDescription: （英文：AMBASSADOR）使用这支 Corpus 突击步枪让谈判立即结束。可以在充能爆炸狙击和速射电子突击模式之间自由切换。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CorpusUMP.name: Prisma Tetra
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CorpusUMP.description: When bathed in Void energy and prisma crystal, the simple Tetra becomes a beacon of style and intimidation.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CorpusUMP.zhDescription: （英文：PRISMA TETRA）在浸泡过虚空能量与棱晶后，这把单纯的特拉能量步枪成为了威吓与风格的指标。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CorpusUMP.name: Tetra
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CorpusUMP.description: Drawing from its huge quad-chambered magazine, the Tetra is capable of unleashing a sustained barrage of lethal energy bolts.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CorpusUMP.zhDescription: （英文：TETRA）借由它巨大的四腔弹匣，特拉能持续发射由能量弹形成的致命弹幕。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/ChainLigh.name: Amprex
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/ChainLigh.description: The Amprex rifle fires a continuous beam of high voltage electricity that arcs among nearby enemies. This weapon excels at Crowd Control.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/ChainLigh.zhDescription: （英文：AMPREX）安培克斯步枪可持续发射致命电光束并在敌人中形成电弧。这件武器在群体控制方面很优秀。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Bow/Longbow/CrpBow.name: Lenz
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Bow/Longbow/CrpBow.description:
Bolts from this Corpus bow deliver a one-two punch of an icy pulse, followed by a conventional explosion. Excess ammo picked up for other weapons will be converted into charges for the Lenz. 

Warning: Safety-protocols do not exist on this prototype.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Bow/Longbow/CrpBow.zhDescription:
（英文：LENZ）从这把 Corpus 弓箭中射出的箭矢将会放出极寒脉冲，紧接产生常规爆炸。额外拾取的其他武器弹药将会转化为楞次弓的电荷。

警告：此原型机未使用安全协议。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Bow/Longbow/Prisma.name: Prisma Lenz
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Bow/Longbow/Prisma.description: The explosive potential of the Lenz, enhanced with Prisma crystals.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Bow/Longbow/Prisma.zhDescription: （英文：PRISMA LENZ）通过棱晶强化，楞次弓的爆炸潜力得以发掘。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Secondar.name: Tenet Plinx
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Secondar.description: Alternate fire on this reengineered Plinx fires a projectile that pulls enemies close and then explodes. Its cooldown increases after the explosion to accommodate battery power demands.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Secondar.zhDescription: （英文：TENET PLINX）这把重新设计的漫射者可以使用次要射击发射一枚投射物将敌人拉近然后爆炸。爆炸后冷却时间会增加以满足电池的电量需求。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Secondar.name: Tenet Detron
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Secondar.description: Parvos Granum's engineers have made this already ferocious hand cannon even more deadly with the addition of an alternate fire mode that empties an entire clip in one devastating burst.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Secondar.zhDescription: （英文：TENET DETRON）帕尔沃斯·格拉努的工程师们为这把已经十分凶猛的手炮增加了一种新的射击模式，在一次毁灭性的爆发中清空整个弹匣，使这把武器更加致命。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Secondar.name: Tenet Cycron
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Secondar.description: This reengineered Cycron features a refracting energy disc that can split off the main target, hitting up to 2 additional nearby targets.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Secondar.zhDescription: （英文：TENET CYCRON）这款重新设计的循环离子枪拥有一个折射能量盘，光束射击可以从主要目标上分离，最多击中附近的两个额外目标。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.name: Tenet Tetra
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.description: Parvosian upgrade of the classic Tetra. Slower fire rate but with a larger magazine. Can now alt-fire entire clip as a large burst radius grenade launcher.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.zhDescription: （英文：TENET TETRA）经典特拉的帕尔沃斯式升级版。射速较慢但拥有更大的弹匣。次要射击可以将整个弹匣作为高爆炸范围的榴弹发射出去。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.name: Tenet Quanta
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.description: Once a mining tool adapted for military purposes, Parvosian engineering has enhanced the Quanta's lethality even further.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.zhDescription: （英文：Tenet Quanta）曾经的采矿工具为了军事用途而改造，帕尔沃斯式的工程技术进一步增强了量子切割器的杀伤力。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.name: Tenet Glaxion
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.description: Advances in microelectronics have improved a Corpus classic. Tenet Glaxion’s photon beam strikes up to four enemies at once. It also boasts superior Damage, Critical Chance, and Status Chance.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.zhDescription: （英文：TENET GLAXION）微电子技术的进步改进了 Corpus 的经典武器。信条·冷冻光束步枪的光子束最多可以同时攻击四个敌人。它还拥有较高的伤害、暴击几率和触发几率。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.name: Tenet Flux Rifle
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.description: Sister-modified Flux Rifle with increased fire rate and range. Recharge has been replaced with ammo clips to accommodate greater power needs.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.zhDescription: （英文：TENET FLUX RIFLE）由姐妹们改装过的通量步枪提升了射速和射程。充电系统已被弹匣取代以适应更高的电量消耗。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.name: Tenet Ferrox
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.description: The expert engineers in Parvos Granum’s division have optimized the Ferrox’s lethal power.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.zhDescription: （英文：TENET FERROX）帕尔沃斯·格拉努部门的专业工程师优化了铁晶磁轨炮的杀伤力。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.name: Tenet Arca Plasmor
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.description: Custom variant of a Corpus classic. Staggering blasts now ricochet and have greater range at the cost of a slower fire and reload speed. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/BoardExec/Primary/.zhDescription: （英文：TENET ARCA PLASMOR）Corpus 经典武器的特制变体。惊人的爆炸会反弹且拥有更高的射程，但代价是更低的射速和装填速度。幸存下来的敌人会被辐射耗尽生命。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/VandalEle.name: Prova Vandal
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/VandalEle.description: A customized version of the vicious Prova, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/VandalEle.zhDescription: （英文：PROVA VANDAL）这是凶恶的普罗沃的定制化版本，拥有金属质感及莲花徽记。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/Railgun.name: Lanka
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/Railgun.description: The Lanka fires a high velocity projectile through magnetic induction.
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/Railgun.zhDescription: （英文：LANKA）兰卡使用电磁加速射出高速子弹。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/EnergyRif.name: Dera
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/EnergyRif.description: The Dera is a repeater that fires super-heated plasma.
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/EnergyRif.zhDescription: （英文：DERA）德拉是一把射出高热电浆的连发步枪。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/ElectroPr.name: Prova
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/ElectroPr.description: The Prova is a Melee Weapon that delivers a high-intensity shock to its target.
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/ElectroPr.zhDescription: （英文：PROVA）普罗沃是一把能对目标造成强大电击伤害的近战武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/DeraVanda.name: Dera Vandal
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/DeraVanda.description: A customized version of the Dera, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/DeraVanda.zhDescription: （英文：DERA VANDAL）这把是定制化版本的德拉步枪，拥有着金属质感及 Lotus 的徽记。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/CrpLaserR.name: Flux Rifle
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/CrpLaserR.description: Laser Rifle with Corpus safe-guards removed.
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/CrpLaserR.zhDescription: （英文：FLUX RIFLE）一把已卸除了 Corpus 安全装置的激光步枪。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/CrpLaserP.name: Spectra
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/CrpLaserP.description: While its intended design is for deep space construction, the concentrated laser beam of the Spectra is highly effective against organic and synthetic enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/CrpLaserP.zhDescription: （英文：SPECTRA）虽然它原本设计给太空中的工程师，光谱切割器的集中激光对有机和合成敌人也非常有效。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/CrpHeavyR.name: Supra
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/CrpHeavyR.description: The SUPRA is a heavy laser gun with a short wind up time.
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/CrpHeavyR.zhDescription: （英文：SUPRA）苏普拉是把重型激光枪，可在很短的时间内启动。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Chemical/RocketL.name: Ogris
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Chemical/RocketL.zhDescription: （英文：OGRIS）食人女魔能发射满载易爆物的炮弹。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Chemical/FlameTh.name: Ignis Wraith
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Chemical/FlameTh.description: A blood-red variant of this destructive flamethrower.
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Chemical/FlameTh.zhDescription: （英文：IGNIS WRAITH）这款破坏性火焰喷射器的血红变体。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Chemical/FlameTh.name: Ignis
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Chemical/FlameTh.description: Ignis produces a stream of intense heat.
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Chemical/FlameTh.zhDescription: （英文：IGNIS）伊格尼斯能产生一股强烈的热浪。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Bio/BioWeapon.name: Torid
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Bio/BioWeapon.zhDescription: （英文：TORID）托里德能抛射出剧毒榴弹。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Bio/AcidDartPist.name: Acrid
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Bio/AcidDartPist.description: The Acrid fires an acidic-infused needle.
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Bio/AcidDartPist.zhDescription: （英文：ACRID）阿克里德可以射出注满强酸的刺针。

/Lotus/Weapons/Cephalon/Primary/CephPrim.name: Simulor
/Lotus/Weapons/Cephalon/Primary/CephPrim.description: Creates miniature gravitational singularities that can be used for scientific study or self-defense.
/Lotus/Weapons/Cephalon/Primary/CephPrim.zhDescription: （英文：SIMULOR）能制造出微型的重力奇异点，可用于科学研究或自我防卫。

/Lotus/Weapons/Cephalon/Melee/Hammer/Cep.name: Heliocor
/Lotus/Weapons/Cephalon/Melee/Hammer/Cep.description: Obtain enlightenment with this massive hammer that performs a Codex scan on each fatal strike. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.
/Lotus/Weapons/Cephalon/Melee/Hammer/Cep.zhDescription: （英文：HELIOCOR）用这把重型战锤获得启示，它可以在每次毁灭性的攻击时进行资料库扫描。扫描需要携带一个资料库扫描器且有可用的扫描次数。

/Lotus/Weapons/Archon/Melee/Whip/ArchonW.name: Verdilac
/Lotus/Weapons/Archon/Melee/Whip/ArchonW.description: Archon Nira’s spine-shattering whip. Has a unique Tactical Combo that whips out a wide wave of energy with each stroke.
/Lotus/Weapons/Archon/Melee/Whip/ArchonW.zhDescription: （英文：VERDILAC）执刑官混沌蛇主的刺骨长鞭。其独特的战术组合每次抽击时都会掀起巨大的能量波。

/Lotus/Weapons/Archon/Melee/Trident/Arch.name: Korumm
/Lotus/Weapons/Archon/Melee/Trident/Arch.description: Archon Boreal’s signature trident. Thrust Korumm into the ground with a Tactical Combo and then rip it out in a shower of electricity.
/Lotus/Weapons/Archon/Melee/Trident/Arch.zhDescription: （英文：KORUMM）执刑官诡文枭主的标志性三叉戟。战术组合可以将雷霆暴君插入地面，并在拔出时造成电击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Archon/Melee/DualDaggers/.name: Nepheri
/Lotus/Weapons/Archon/Melee/DualDaggers/.description: The dual flaming fang-blades of the Archon Amar. Has a unique Neutral Combo that blasts out four short-range fireballs.
/Lotus/Weapons/Archon/Melee/DualDaggers/.zhDescription: （英文：NEPHERI）执刑官欺谋狼主的烈焰双刃。其独特的近战组合可以发射四个短程火球。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.name: Verglas
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.description: Designed as the perfect mate for Nautilus, this Sentinel weapon projects an icy beam at nearby targets.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.zhDescription: 作为鹦鹉螺的完美同伴，这件守护武器可向附近的目标投射冰冻光束。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.name: Verglas Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.description: The icy signature weapon of Nautilus Prime.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.zhDescription: （英文：VERGLAS PRIME）鹦鹉螺 Prime 的标志性冰冻武器。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.name: Sweeper
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.description: Standard issue weapon for Carrier Sentinel. Fires shotgun rounds.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.zhDescription: （英文：SWEEPER）搬运者守护的标准武器，使用霰弹枪子弹。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.name: Deconstructor
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.description: Causes the Helios Sentinel to attack enemy targets using pieces of itself.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.zhDescription: （英文：DECONSTRUCTOR）赫利俄斯用自己身上的部件攻击目标敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.name: Vulklok
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.description: Standard issue sniper rifle for Diriga.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.zhDescription: （英文：VULKLOK）电气浮囊的标准狙击枪。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.name: Stinger
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.description: Standard issue weapon for Djinn Sentinel. Fires <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin projectiles that embed into enemies and continuously deal damage for 3 seconds.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.zhDescription: （英文：STINGER）引灵守护的标准武器。发射 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素投射物，嵌入敌人体内并持续造成伤害，持续 3 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/P.name: Prisma Burst Laser
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/P.description: Fires a small burst of lasers.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/P.zhDescription: （英文：PRISMA BURST LASER）点射一小束激光。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/P.name: Sweeper Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/P.description: Standard issue weapon for Carrier Prime Sentinel. Fires shotgun rounds.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/P.zhDescription: （英文：SWEEPER PRIME）搬运者 PRIME的标准武器，使用霰弹枪子弹。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/P.name: Prime Laser Rifle
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/P.zhDescription: （英文：PRIME LASER RIFLE）一把激光步枪 Prime。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/P.name: Deth Machine Rifle Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/P.description: Signature default weapon of Dethcube Prime.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/P.zhDescription: （英文：DETH MACHINE RIFLE PRIME）死亡魔方 Prime 的标志性武器。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/P.name: Burst Laser Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/P.description: Shade Prime’s signature weapon fires laser bursts.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/P.zhDescription: 阴影 Prime 的标志性武器会发射激光束。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/L.name: Laser Rifle
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/L.description: A laser rifle developed by reverse-engineering Corpus technology.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/L.zhDescription: （英文：LASER RIFLE）通过 Corpus 科技逆向工程开发出来的一种激光步枪。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/G.name: Artax
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/G.description: Freeze targets in their tracks with this sentinel mounted ice-beam.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/G.zhDescription: （英文：ARTAX）使用守护装有的冰冷光束将目标在行动路线上冻结。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/D.name: Deth Machine Rifle
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/D.description: Standard issue weaponry signature to Dethcube.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/D.zhDescription: （英文：DETH MACHINE RIFLE）死亡魔方标准武器

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/B.name: Burst Laser
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/B.description: Fires a small burst of lasers.

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/D.name: Deconstructor Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/D.description: Allows the Helios Prime to violently disassemble and turn itself into a deadly projectile.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/D.zhDescription: （英文：DECONSTRUCTOR PRIME）使赫利俄斯 Prime 剧烈拆卸，并将自身变化为一颗致命的发射体。

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/MoaPets/MoaPe.name: Vulcax
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/MoaPets/MoaPe.description: Charges up a powerful blast of ultra-heated plasma.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/MoaPets/MoaPe.zhDescription: （英文：VULCAX）可蓄能发射出强力爆发的极热电浆。

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/MoaPets/MoaPe.name: Tazicor
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/MoaPets/MoaPe.description: Releases a burst of static electricity that can jump between foes, incapacitating them.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/MoaPets/MoaPe.zhDescription: （英文：TAZICOR）释放出一阵静电，该静电可以在敌人之间跳跃，使他们失去战斗能力。

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/MoaPets/MoaPe.name: Multron
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/MoaPets/MoaPe.description: Launches a volley of bomb darts that embed themselves in targets, exploding a short time later.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/MoaPets/MoaPe.zhDescription: （英文：MULTRON）发射一连串炸弹飞镖，嵌入目标中并在短时间后爆炸。

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/MoaPets/MoaPe.name: Cryotra
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/MoaPets/MoaPe.description: Fires volleys of icy grenades that inflict a lingering chill on the blast zone.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/MoaPets/MoaPe.zhDescription: （英文：CRYOTRA）发射一连串冰冷的手榴弹，在爆炸区域留下持久的寒气。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/ReaperMeleeWeap.name: Shadow Claws
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/ReaperMeleeWeap.description: These razor-sharp blades of condensed Void energy inflict deep and grievous wounds.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/ReaperMeleeWeap.zhDescription: 这些凝聚虚空能量的锋利之刃能造成了深切而痛苦的伤口。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/SevagothShadowP.name: Shadow Claws Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/SevagothShadowP.description: The claws of the shadowy helmsman have cast many foolish foes into the cold below.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/SevagothShadowP.zhDescription: 幽影舵手的利爪已将众多愚蠢的敌人投入幽寒深处。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Ranger/ExaltedBow.name: Artemis Bow
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ranger/ExaltedBow.description: Summon a mighty bow and unleash a volley of devastating arrows.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ranger/ExaltedBow.zhDescription: 召唤出一把强力长弓并发动毁灭性的集中箭矢射击。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Pagemaster/ExaltedBook.name: Noctua
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pagemaster/ExaltedBook.description: Wield the power of Dante's chronicles. Customize Noctua with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Primary attack releases pages that tear into lethal pieces on hits. Its alternate attack releases a wave with infinite Punch Through.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pagemaster/ExaltedBook.zhDescription: （英文：NOCTUA）掌握 Dante 编年史的力量。为夜枭安装典籍 Mod 以增强战甲技能并获得战术优势。主要攻击释放的书页在命中后会碎裂成致命的碎片。次要攻击会释放具有无限穿透的攻击波。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/PacifistFist.name: Desert Wind
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/PacifistFist.description: Baruuk channels the desert wind to turn his fists and feet into an exalted weapon.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/PacifistFist.zhDescription: （英文：DESERT WIND）Baruuk 把沙漠之风转移到他的双拳和脚掌，使之成为了一件显赫武器。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/PacifistFistP.name: Desert Wind Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/PacifistFistP.description: Baruuk Prime channels the Desert Wind to turn his fists and feet into an exalted prime weapon.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/PacifistFistP.zhDescription: （英文：DESERT WIND PRIME）Baruuk Prime 把沙漠之风转移到他的双拳和脚掌，使之成为了一件显赫 Prime 武器。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/NinjaStormWeapon.name: Shadow Clones
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/NinjaStormWeapon.description: Ash's fearsome Shadow Clones, as projected by his Blade Storm ability.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/NinjaStormWeapon.zhDescription: Ash 的凶恶影分身，由他的「剑刃风暴」技能创造。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/NinjaStormWeapon.name: Shadow Clones Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/NinjaStormWeapon.description: Ash Prime's fearsome Shadow Clones, as projected by his Blade Storm ability.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/NinjaStormWeapon.zhDescription: Ash Prime 的凶恶影分身，由他的「剑刃风暴」技能创造。

/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/WukongPrime.name: Iron Staff Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/WukongPrime.description: A unique staff wielded by the Wukong Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/WukongPrime.zhDescription: Wukong Prime 所持有的独特长棍。

/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/MonkeyKingS.name: Iron Staff
/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/MonkeyKingS.description: A unique staff wielded by the Wukong Warframe.
/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/MonkeyKingS.zhDescription: Wukong 所持有的独特长棍。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/KhoraWhipclawWea.name: Whipclaw Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/KhoraWhipclawWea.description: Khora Prime's deadly exalted whip, unleased by her Whipclaw ability.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/KhoraWhipclawWea.zhDescription: Khora Prime 的致命显赫长鞭，由她的「长鞭利爪」技能召唤。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/KhoraWhipclawWea.name: Whipclaw
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/KhoraWhipclawWea.description: Khora's deadly exalted whip, unleased by her Whipclaw ability.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/KhoraWhipclawWea.zhDescription: Khora 的致命显赫长鞭，由她的「长鞭利爪」技能召唤。

/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/BlastWeaponP.name: Balefire Charger Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/BlastWeaponP.description: Charge and release powerful bolts of balefire.
/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/BlastWeaponP.zhDescription: 蓄力并放出闪电般的野火。

/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/BlastWeapon.name: Balefire Charger
/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/BlastWeapon.description: Charges up and releases bolts of Balefire.
/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/BlastWeapon.zhDescription: 蓄力并放出闪电般的野火。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/GaraShankWeapon.name: Shattered Lash
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/GaraShankWeapon.description: Gara's devastating Shattered Lash, created by her Shattered lash ability.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/GaraShankWeapon.zhDescription: Gara 的琉璃碎击能造成毁灭性的打击，由她的「琉璃碎击」技能创造。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/GaraShankWeaponP.name: Shattered Lash Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/GaraShankWeaponP.description: Gara Prime's devastating Shattered Lash Prime, created by her Shattered lash ability.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/GaraShankWeaponP.zhDescription: Gara Prime 的琉璃碎击 Prime 能造成毁灭性的打击，由她的「琉璃碎击」技能创造。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/GarudaPrimeClaw.name: Garuda Prime Talons
/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/GarudaPrimeClaw.description: These nasty things come out when Garuda Prime forgoes a melee weapon.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/GarudaPrimeClaw.zhDescription: 当 Garuda Prime 舍弃近战武器时，这些凶恶的东西便会出现。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/GarudaClaws.name: Garuda Talons
/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/GarudaClaws.description: These nasty things come out when Garuda forgoes a melee weapon.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/GarudaClaws.zhDescription: 当 Garuda 舍弃近战武器时，这些讨厌的东西便会出现。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Frumentarius/ExaltedSn.name: Neutralizer
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frumentarius/ExaltedSn.description: Cyte-09's exalted Sniper Rifle. Bullets ricochet off Weak Points to seek out other nearby Weak Points. Alt fire lobs a grenade that completely freezes enemies with a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect, leaving a freezing zone that continues to apply <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status for a duration.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frumentarius/ExaltedSn.zhDescription: （英文：NEUTRALIZER）Cyte-09 的显赫狙击步枪。子弹从敌人的弱点弹射而出，寻找附近的其他敌人弱点。次要射击投掷的榴弹会以 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态完全冻结敌人，并在持续时间内留下一个持续施加 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态的冻结区域。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/PrimeFlightPisto.name: Dex Pixia Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/PrimeFlightPisto.description: Take flight with Razorwing and summon these mighty dual pistols.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/PrimeFlightPisto.zhDescription: （英文：DEX PIXIA）通过剃刀之翼翱翔天际并召唤这对强劲的手枪。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/PrimeFlightSword.name: Diwata Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/PrimeFlightSword.description: Take flight with Razorwing and summon this formidable heavy blade.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/PrimeFlightSword.zhDescription: （英文：DIWATA）通过剃刀之翼翱翔天际并召唤这把强大的巨刃。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/FlightPistols.name: Dex Pixia
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/FlightPistols.description: Take flight with Razorwing and summon these mighty dual pistols.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/FlightPistols.zhDescription: （英文：DEX PIXIA）通过剃刀之翼翱翔天际并召唤这对强劲的手枪。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/FlightSword.name: Diwata
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/FlightSword.description: Take flight with Razorwing and summon this formidable heavy blade.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/FlightSword.zhDescription: （英文：DIWATA）通过剃刀之翼翱翔天际并召唤这把强大的巨刃。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/DoomSwordUmb.name: Exalted Umbra Blade
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/DoomSwordUmb.description: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/DoomSwordUmb.zhDescription: 召唤一把充斥着纯洁光亮和无限力量的剑。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/DoomSwordPri.name: Exalted Prime Blade
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/DoomSwordPri.description: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/DoomSwordPri.zhDescription: 召唤一把由纯粹的光与力量锻造而成的刀剑。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/DoomSword.name: Exalted Blade
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/DoomSword.description: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/DoomSword.zhDescription: 召唤一把充斥着纯洁光亮和无限力量的剑。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Choir/ChoirEruptWeapon.name: Glory
/Lotus/Powersuits/Choir/ChoirEruptWeapon.description: Unleash the power of the Jade Light.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/AtlasPunchWeap.name: Landslide Fists
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/AtlasPunchWeap.description: Atlas' deadly fists, as utilized by his Landslide Ability.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/AtlasPunchWeap.zhDescription: Atlas 的致命拳头，由他的「土石坍方」技能创造。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/AtlasPunchWeap.name: Landslide Fists Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/AtlasPunchWeap.description: Atlas Prime's deadly fists, as utilized by his Landslide Ability.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/AtlasPunchWeap.zhDescription: Atlas Prime 的致命拳头，由他的「土石坍方」技能创造。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/BerserkerMel.name: Valkyr Prime Talons
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/BerserkerMel.description: These talons emerge when Valkyr Prime unleashes Hysteria.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/BerserkerMel.zhDescription: 当 Valkyr Prime 释放狂化爆发时这些爪子就会出现。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/BerserkerMel.name: Valkyr Talons
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/BerserkerMel.description: These talons emerge when Valkyr unleashes her Hysteria.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/BerserkerMel.zhDescription: 这些利爪将于 Valkyr 解放她的狂化爆发力量时显现。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.name: Arquebex
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.description: The pinnacle of Entrati weapons design: dual energy mortars that fire with such devastating power that the Necramech must first be locked into a braced, stationary turret mode.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.zhDescription: （英文：ARQUEBEX）英择谛武器设计的巅峰之作：双能追击炮的毁灭威力之大，使得殁世机甲必须将自身锁定在稳定的炮塔模式下来使用该武器。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.name: Ironbride
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.description: A titanic blade modeled after some of the very oldest swords, this weapon was designed to slice through massed enemy troops in a single stroke.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.zhDescription: （英文：IRONBRIDE）一把灵感源自最古老刀剑的巨大利刃，这把武器是为了一次性击穿大量敌人而设计的。

/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/CatbrowGene.name: Kavat Genetic Code
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/CatbrowGene.description:
Contains the genetic code sequence of a Kavat. 

Location: Obtained by using a Codex Scanner on Feral Kavats that roam the Orokin Derelict on Deimos
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/CatbrowGene.zhDescription:
包含库娃的遗传密码序列。

获取地点：通过对漫游在火卫二奥罗金遗迹中的野生库娃使用资料库扫描仪获得

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/Eggs/KubrowE.name: Kubrow Egg
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/Eggs/KubrowE.description:
This egg is used to transplant the genetic code of a Kubrow onto a Kubrow clone.

Location: Kubrow Dens found in Grineer Forests on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/Eggs/KubrowE.zhDescription:
这个蛋是用来将库狛的遗传密码转移到库狛克隆体上。

获取地点：Grineer 森林（地球）中的库狛兽穴

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/BlankTraitPr.name: Genetic Code Template
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/BlankTraitPr.description:
Copies the dominant genes of a pet onto the template. 
This can then be used to increase the chances that traits from the original pet will carry across to a newborn clone.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/BlankTraitPr.zhDescription:
把一只宠物的显性基因复制到模板上。
这块模板随后可以被用来增加原宠物将性状带给新生克隆体的几率。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/EggHatcher.name: Incubator Power Core
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/EggHatcher.description: This device facilitates the growth of a Kubrow or Kavat clone, from birth to adolescence.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/EggHatcher.zhDescription: 这个装置能让库狛克隆体或库娃克隆体从出生成长至幼年时期。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/KubrowPetCol.name: Nai-Zhen Kubrow Collar
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/KubrowPetCol.description: A common adornment used to distinguish a Kubrow that is loyal to its master.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/KubrowPetCol.zhDescription: 一个常见的装饰，用以区分库狛是忠于何人。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/KubrowPetFoo.name: DNA Stabilizers
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/KubrowPetFoo.description: Contains 6 DNA Stabilizers to maintain the health of a Kubrow or Kavat.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/KubrowPetFoo.zhDescription: 内装有 6 份 DNA 稳定剂，可用于稳定库狛与库娃的生命迹象。

/Lotus/Types/Game/SpectreArmies/BronzeSp.name: Vapor Specter Regiment
/Lotus/Types/Game/SpectreArmies/BronzeSp.description: An army composed of vapor-level Specter clones to be used in defense of the clan's Solar Rail. This Specter army will persist for one conflict.
/Lotus/Types/Game/SpectreArmies/BronzeSp.zhDescription: 一支由幻雾等级魅影复制人所组成的军团，用来防御氏族的星际轨道。这支魅影军团可以坚持一场战斗。

/Lotus/Types/Game/SpectreArmies/GoldSpec.name: Force Specter Regiment
/Lotus/Types/Game/SpectreArmies/GoldSpec.description: An army composed of force-level Specter clones to be used in defense of the clan's Solar Rail. This Specter army will persist for three conflicts.
/Lotus/Types/Game/SpectreArmies/GoldSpec.zhDescription: 一支由原力等级魅影复制人所组成的军团，用来防御氏族的星际轨道。这支魅影军团可以坚持三场战斗。

/Lotus/Types/Game/SpectreArmies/Platinum.name: Cosmic Specter Regiment
