/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/DayUncom.zhDescription: 它的鱼鳞上有着血溅的纹样，其肋骨通过空腔暴露在两侧。当捕食者接近时，它一动不动地躺在沙岸底部，伪装成尸体，寄希望于被忽视。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/GrineerB.name: Boot
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/GrineerB.description: Synthetic fibers and a molded foam insole were the basis for what was once a robust and comfortable combat boot. Now, it's a home for tiny aquatic organisms.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/GrineerB.zhDescription: 合成纤维与注塑泡沫制成了的鞋垫，曾经它是一只强韧、舒适的战斗靴。如今，它是小型水生生物体的家。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/HolidayG.name: STOCKING
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/HolidayG.description: You're catching a lot of these. Are you stocking up?
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/HolidayG.zhDescription: 你捕获了很多这玩意。你是在囤货吗？

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/NightLeg.name: Glappid
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/NightLeg.description: The Glappid is a scavenger that feasts on the remains of dead fish. It has formed a symbiotic bond with the Seram Beetle which extracts and feeds upon any toxins ingested by the Glappid.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/NightLeg.zhDescription: 盖拉佩德是一种以死鱼残骸为生的食腐动物。它与瑟拉姆甲虫形成了一种共生关系，甲虫将盖拉佩德摄入的毒素析出并以之为食。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/NightRar.name: Norg
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/NightRar.description: This fish inhabits the shallows and feeds of crabs and other small crustaceans. When threatened it forces air into its brain to give it the impression of being much bigger than it normally is.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/NightRar.zhDescription: 这种鱼栖息在浅水，以螃蟹及其他小型甲壳类为食。当受到威胁时，它会将空气挤入脑部，令其看起来比正常要大得多。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/NightRar.description: A grotesque crustacean that produces a potent, paralyzing toxin from its tentacles.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Eidolon/NightRar.zhDescription: 一种怪异的甲壳动物，能从其触须中产生强力的瘫痪毒素。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.name: Echowinder Anoscopic Sensor
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhName: 回声环绕者微孔视觉感应器
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.description:
A small camera that records visual data with extremely high definition.

Source: Dismantled from Echowinder servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Echowinder in the Orb Vallis lake during Warm weather.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhDescription:
能以极高清晰度纪录影像数据的小型摄影机。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从回声环绕者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷湖泊中捕捉回声环绕者。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.name: Scrubber Exa Brain
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.description:
A small, electronic brain capable of processing a billion giga-threads per second.

Source: Dismantled from Scrubber servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Scrubber in Orb Vallis caves during any weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhDescription:
每秒能处理十亿吉字节线程的小型电子脑。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从洗涤者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在任何天气下的奥布山谷洞穴中捕捉洗涤者。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.name: Brickie Muon Battery
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.description:
A small, atomic power source.

Source: Dismantled from Brickie servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Brickie in Orb Vallis ponds and rivers during Warm weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhDescription:
一个小型、原子能的能源。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从砖瓦匠伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷池塘和河流中捕捉砖瓦匠。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.name: Mirewinder Parallel Biode
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhName: 污泥绕环者并联生物二极体
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.description:
Controls the electrical flow throughout the circuitry within robotic organisms.

Source: Dismantled from Mirewinder servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Mirewinder in Orb Vallis caves during any weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhDescription:
控制生化机器人体内电路系统的电流。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从污泥环绕者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在任何天气下的奥布山谷洞穴中捕捉污泥环绕者。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.name: Eye-Eye Rotoblade
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.description:
A machine element used to propel robotic organisms through coolant.

Source: Dismantled from Eye-Eye servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Eye-Eye in Orb Vallis ponds during Warm weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhDescription:
一种可以让生化机器人在冷却液中推进的机器组件。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从目－目伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷池塘中捕捉目－目。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.name: Kriller Thermal Laser
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.description:
A weapon that discharges lasers over short distances.

Source: Dismantled from Kriller servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Kriller in the Orb Vallis lake during Warm weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhDescription:
一把能发射短距离激光的武器。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从磷虾杀手伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷湖泊中捕捉磷虾杀手。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.name: Sapcaddy Venedo Case
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.description:
A strong, metallic case that is resistant to fluctuations in environmental temperature.

Source: Dismantled from Sapcaddy servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Sapcaddy in the Orb Vallis lake during Cold weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhDescription:
一个坚固、金属制的箱子，能抵抗环境温度的波动。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从液集者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在寒冷的奥布山谷湖泊中捕捉液集者。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.name: Scrap
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.description:
A sample of sprockets, gyros and wires.

Source: Dismantled from all Orb Vallis servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhDescription:
链轮、陀螺仪与电线的样品。 

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从伺服鱼中拆解获取。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.name: Synathid Ecosynth Analyzer
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.description:
A processing unit that efficiently monitors environmental data.

Source: Dismantled from Synathid servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Synathid in Orb Vallis cave hotspots during any weather. Also drops from the Exploiter Orb in the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhDescription:
一个有效地监控环境数据的处理组件。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从海龙伺服鱼中拆解获取。在任何天气下的奥布山谷洞穴鱼点中捕捉海龙。此外它还会从奥布山谷剥削者圆蛛身上掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.name: Tromyzon Entroplasma
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.description:
A solvent that reconstitutes waste product from the Weeping Towers into degenerated matter.

Source: Dismantled from Tromyzon servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Tromyzon in Orb Vallis Pond Hotspots during Cold weather. Also drops from the Exploiter Orb in the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhDescription:
一种将渗流之塔的废弃物重建为简并物质的溶剂。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从多目鳗伺服鱼中拆解获取。在寒冷的奥布山谷池塘中捕捉多目鳗。此外它还会从奥布山谷剥削者圆蛛身上掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.name: Charamote Sagan Module
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.description:
A device used to reconstruct degenerated matter into Orokin bio-material.

Source: Dismantled from Charamote servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Charamote in Orb Vallis cave hotspots during any weather. Also drops from the Exploiter Orb in the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhDescription:
一个用于将简并物质重建为奥罗金生物材料的装置。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从重筑虾伺服鱼中拆解获取。在任何天气下的奥布山谷洞穴鱼点中捕捉重筑虾。此外它还会从奥布山谷剥削者圆蛛身上掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.name: Tink Dissipator Coil
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.description:
Discharges excess heat and energy through the casing.

Source: Dismantled from Tink servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Tink in Orb Vallis ponds during Cold weather.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhDescription:
经由外壳释放多余的热量和能量。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从修补机伺服鱼中拆解获取。在寒冷的奥布山谷池塘中捕捉修补机。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.name: Longwinder Lathe Coagulant
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhName: 长型环绕者车床凝聚剂
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.description:
A liquid that mixes with coolant fluid to produce a resilient gel that repairs leaks.

Source: Dismantled from Longwinder servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Longwinder in Orb Vallis lake hotspots during Warm weather.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhDescription:
混合了冷却液，产生出一种有弹性的凝胶，用于修复裂缝。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从长型环绕者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷湖泊鱼点中捕捉长型环绕者。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.name: Recaster Neural Relay
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.description:
Interprets signals from other mechanical organisms.

Source: Dismantled from Recaster servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Recaster in Orb Vallis pond hotspots during Cold weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/FishPart.zhDescription:
用于理解来自另一个机械有机体的讯号。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从续播机伺服鱼中拆解获取。在寒冷的奥布山谷池塘鱼点中捕捉续播机。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/CorpusBo.name: Crewman’s Boot
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/CorpusBo.description: While the Vallis coolant has kept this finely engineered Corpus tactical boot remarkably well preserved, it is, nonetheless, entirely worthless.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Fish/Solaris/CorpusBo.zhDescription: 虽然山谷冷却液将这精心设计的 Corpus 战靴保持得完好无缺，但它，仍没有一丝价值。

/Lotus/Types/Items/FusionTreasures/OroFu.description: Struck to commemorate the Entrati family's power and prestige, as well as safeguarding their memories of one another. Many things changed in the years that followed, and that which had once shone brightly grew dark and dim. But even a single Ayatan Star may make all the difference.
/Lotus/Types/Items/FusionTreasures/OroFu.zhDescription: 这尊雕像之所以被打造出来，不仅是为了纪念英择谛家族的实力与威望，同时也是为了保存家族成员之间的珍贵记忆。时过境迁，曾今闪耀的雕像现已变得暗淡无光。但只要插上一颗阿耶檀识星，它就会变得截然不同。

Blueprint sold by Otak in the Necralisk on Deimos.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.zhDescription:
从感染生物处精炼得到的提纯物。

火卫二上殁世幽都的奥塔出售的蓝图。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.name: Tiametrite
/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.description:
Infested neurotransmitters condensed under pressure.

Location: Cambion Drift (Deimos) from Blue Mining Lesions, Sagiant Entrati Caskets, and Bonus Vaults in Isolation Vault Bounties.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.zhDescription:
感染神经递质在压力下凝结而成。 

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）上的蓝色矿痕、智者英择谛罐、隔离库赏金任务中的额外隔离库

/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.name: Purged Dagonic
/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.description:
Crystalline symmetry, a far cry from its corrupt origin.

Blueprint sold by Otak in the Necralisk on Deimos.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.zhDescription:
与其肮脏的来源有天壤之别的对称晶体。

火卫二上殁世幽都的奥塔出售的蓝图。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.name: Dagonic
/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.description:
Rivulets of Exocrine fluid, hardened over passing centuries.

Location: Cambion Drift (Deimos) from Blue Mining Lesions, Sagiant Entrati Casket, and Bonus Vaults in Isolation Vault Bounties.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.zhDescription:
固化了几个世纪的外分泌液。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）上的蓝色矿痕。智者英择谛罐、隔离库赏金任务中的额外隔离库

/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.name: Adramal Alloy

Blueprint sold by Otak in the Necralisk on Deimos.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.zhDescription:
用途非常广泛的，清除了孢子和污染物的合金。

火卫二上殁世幽都的奥塔出售的蓝图。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.name: Adramalium
/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.description:

Location: Cambion Drift (Deimos) from Yellow Mining Lesions, Spitia Infested Cysts, and Rolizor Infested Cysts.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.zhDescription:
有韧性和金属感，具有很强的弹性。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）上的黄色矿痕、斯蒂亚感染包囊、偌利佐尔感染包囊

Blueprint sold by Otak in the Necralisk on Deimos.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.zhDescription:
与它无生命的感染卷须融合成一种耐用的合金。

火卫二上殁世幽都的奥塔出售的蓝图。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.name: Bapholite
/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Deimos/DeimosCom.description:

Location: Cambion Drift (Deimos) from Yellow Mining Lesions, Rolizor Infested Cysts, and Bonus Vaults in Isolation Vault Bounties.

/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Solaris/SolarisR.zhDescription:
经过切割打磨，已至臻完美。

Location: Orb Vallis (Venus) from Red Mining Veins and Resource Containers
/Lotus/Types/Items/Gems/Solaris/SolarisR.zhDescription:
处于零度以下时黏土强化成了极其耐用的石头。

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）里的红色矿脉、资源储藏箱

经过切割打磨，已至臻完美。

Location: Orb Vallis (Venus) from Blue Mining Veins

一种不可思议的宝石，生长在采出矿石的岩脉中。

A precious metal forged from coolant byproducts.

Location: Orb Vallis (Venus) from Red Mining Veins and Resource Containers

/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.name: Bile
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.description: Helminth is able to digest all manner of miscellaneous substances, but generates a large surplus of bile in order to do so. Fortunately, this bile can be repurposed.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.zhDescription: Helminth 可以消化各种杂物，但会因此而产生过量的消化液。幸运的是，这些消化液可以再次被利用。

/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.name: Biotics
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.description: Plant-based materials of all kinds are processed and liquidized within the Helminth's digestive tract; the surplus is excreted as an inoffensive, inert clump.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.zhDescription: 各种植物类物质会在 Helminth 的消化道内被处理、液化，剩余的残留物则会被以无害惰性块状物的形式排出体外。

/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.name: Calx
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.description: On consuming minerals, Helminth converts those it does not fully absorb into a smooth, rich paste with a faint vanilla odor.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.zhDescription: 在享用矿物质时，Helminth 会把那些未被完全吸收的矿物质转化为光滑浓郁、并带有淡淡香草味的糊状物。

/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.name: Oxides
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.description: Metallic substances, steadily corroded by the Helminth's digestive juices and exuded as a coarse powder.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.zhDescription: 金属物质，被 Helminth 的消化液不断腐蚀，并以大颗粒粉尘的形式分泌了出来。

/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.name: Pheromones
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.description: When Helminth consumes Infested matter it creates greasy intestine-like casings, bloats them with a dark, musky gas and ejects them. The reason for this is unknown and probably best left that way.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.zhDescription: 当 Helminth 享用了感染物质后，它会产生油腻的肠道状外壳，并通过黑色的麝香气体使其膨胀，然后将其喷射出来。这种现象的产生原因不明，可能最好不要去管它。

/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.name: Synthetics
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.description: Helminth eagerly consumes artificial materials and exudes these rope-like strands of filament as a useful byproduct.
/Lotus/Types/Items/InfestedFoundry/Helmi.zhDescription: Helminth 热衷于享用人造材料，并会分泌出这些绳状的细丝，可被作为一种有用的副产品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Ack & Brunt Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhName: 认知 & 冲击灵化之源
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to send forth a spectral axe during aerial and slide attacks in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下重击具有在空中和滑行攻击时发出一把光谱战斧的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Anku Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to temporarily increase Range and inflict guaranteed <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status for all attacks after a successful slide attack in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这把武器的技能，在灵化形态下成功进行滑行攻击后，暂时增加攻击范围同时其所有攻击都可造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Bo Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to increase Range and Heavy Attack Efficiency in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有增加范围和重击效率的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Ceramic Dagger Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to send forth spectral daggers during Heavy Attacks in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下重击具有发射光谱匕首的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Destreza Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to summon ghostly rapiers that fly forth upon Heavy Attacks, while Heavy Attack kills grant <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR> Puncture Damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下重击发射幽影细剑，同时重击击杀获得 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺伤害的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Dual Ichor Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to create a <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage field after a kill in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有击杀产生 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害力场的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Furax Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain Heavy Slam Efficiency and leave behind <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage fields after Heavy Slams in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有提高重型震地效率，重型震地攻击后留下 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害力场的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Hate Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to embed blades that explode with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage during Forward and Neutral Combos in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下进行向前和中立连击时具有嵌入带有 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的爆炸刀片的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Magistar Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to increase Initial Combo and Wind Up Speed in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有提升初始连击和重击准备速度的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Nami Solo Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to greatly increase its range in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有大幅提升范围的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Obex Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to perform a large radial attack for each Finisher hit in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下每次处决攻击都能发动范围攻击的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Okina Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to spawn spectral daggers on kill. Daggers seek out enemies, applying max <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status stacks.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下击杀敌人会生成光谱匕首的能力。匕首会自动寻找敌人，造成最大的 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态叠层。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Sibear Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhName: 西伯利亚冰锤灵化之源
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to create a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Blast Radius with Heavy Slams, slowing enemies and increasing Critical Damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有在重型震地攻击时制造一片 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻爆炸范围，还有减缓敌人速度和增加暴击伤害的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Skana Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to stun nearby enemies when it enters Incarnon Form and after Finisher attacks.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在进行灵化形态时和进行处决攻击后具有晕眩附近敌人的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Boar Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire three short-range beams that chain link enemies in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射三道短程光束链接敌人的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Boltor Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to prioritize <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage and gain Multishot in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有优先造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害并获得多重射击的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Braton Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain Radial <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage with each shot in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下每次射击具有范围 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Burston Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain an Auto Fire mode and deal Radial <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage with each shot in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下每次射击具有自动射击模式和造成范围 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Dera Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire high power beams and gain <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>Magnetic Damage.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射高能光束并造成 <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>磁力伤害的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Dread Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to sacrifice silence for increased projectile size and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有牺牲静音以增加投射物大小和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Gorgon Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire embedding projectiles that explode with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害爆炸的嵌入式投射物的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Latron Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage energy waves that bounce off enemies and terrain in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射遇到敌人和地形反弹的 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害能量波的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Miter Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire homing and bouncing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage explosives in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射追踪和反弹式 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害爆炸物的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Paris Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to sacrifice silence for increased projectile size and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有牺牲静音以增加投射物大小和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Soma Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain increased Status Chance and Multishot while slowing fire rate in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有降低射速、增加触发几率和多重射击的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Strun Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire staggering explosive projectiles in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射令敌人失衡的爆炸投射物的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Sybaris Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire 4-round bursts and gain <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Status.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下可发射 4 连发并造成 <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸异常状态的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Torid Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire a long-range <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin beam in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射远距离 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素光束的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Vectis Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire slowing projectiles that explode upon headshots in Incarnon Form. Transforms on Alt Fire while unscoped.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射减速投射物的能力，并在爆头击杀时爆炸。未瞄准时，通过次要射击可变形。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Angstrum Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to launch target-seeking fireballs that ricochet toward enemies in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射自动瞄准并弹向敌人的火球的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Atomos Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire high-powered grenades in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射高能榴弹的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Ballistica Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire cross-shaped projectiles high in <DT_SLASH_COLOR> Slash Damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有高 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害的十字形投射物的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Bronco Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to increase its Range and Ricochet in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有增加范围和跳弹的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Cestra Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to increase its Critical Chance the longer it is fired uninterrupted.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有连续射击时间越长暴击几率越大的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Despair Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain embedding projectiles that explode with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下获得造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害爆炸的嵌入式投射物的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Dual Toxocyst Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain an Auto Fire mode and Ricochet in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有自动射击模式和跳弹的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Furis Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to project a wide <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage beam in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射一束广范围 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害光束的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Gammacor Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire projectiles that pull enemies into a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage explosion in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射投射物将敌人拉入 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害爆炸中的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Kunai Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to seek Headshots and increase Multishot in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有追踪爆头和增加多重射击的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Lato Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain Punch Through and Ricochet in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有穿透和跳弹的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Lex Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire energy waves that deal <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation and Punch Through damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射和穿透伤害的能量波的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Sicarus Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to ricochet its bullets.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下的子弹跳弹能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Stug Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to unleash a chaotic maelstrom of bouncing corrosive blobs in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下释放出混乱的、弹跳的腐蚀性泡状物的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Vasto Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to rapidly empty its entire magazine in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有高速全弹发射的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.name: Zylok Incarnon Genesis
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to charge a large single shot that deals Radial <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/IncarnonAda.zhDescription: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有蓄力进行一次造成范围 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的大型单发射击的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LastWishIte.name: Belric Crystal Fragment
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LastWishIte.description: A small fragment of Belric's Crystal from Tyana Pass on Mars.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LastWishIte.zhDescription: 来自火星 Tyana Pass 的一小块贝里克的水晶碎片。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LastWishIte.name: Rania Crystal Fragment
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LastWishIte.description: A small fragment of Rania's Crystal from Tyana Pass on Mars.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LastWishIte.zhDescription: 来自火星 Tyana Pass 的一小块拉尼娅的水晶碎片。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/1999Conques.name: Pix Chip
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/1999Conques.description:
Kaya Velasco in the Höllvania Mall accepts these Pix Chips in exchange for Peely Paks.

Location: Elite Temporal Archimedea (Höllvania) and duplicate Peely Pix.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/1999Conques.zhDescription:
霍瓦尼亚中央商场的卡娅·维拉斯科收取这些贴纸芯片，提供易撕贴纸包。

获取地点：精英时光科研（霍瓦尼亚）和重复的易撕贴纸。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Alertium.name: Nitain Extract
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Alertium.description:
Each vial is produced by the painstaking expression of billions of rare, ocean-vent dwelling microorganisms.

Location: Nightwave Cred Offerings
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Alertium.zhDescription:
每一小瓶是由数十亿罕见的，栖息于海底喷管附近的微生物所制造的。

获取地点：午夜电波的贡品

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/AlloyPlate.name: Alloy Plate
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/AlloyPlate.description:
Carbon steel plates used to reinforce Grineer armor.

Location: Venus, Phobos, Ceres, Jupiter, Pluto, and Sedna.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/AlloyPlate.zhDescription:
用于强化 Grineer 护甲的碳钢板。

获取地点：金星，火卫一，谷神星，木星，冥王星和赛德娜。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/AlphaCorrup.name: Alpha Corruptor
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/AlphaCorrup.description: Inert on its own this corruptor is highly effective if mixed with its Beta counterpart. Properly mixed, these will destabilize Fomorian Reactors much faster than their Stable counterparts. This volatile item cannot be simultaneously equipped with Beta Corruptors. Recommended for Tenno operating as a team.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/AlphaCorrup.zhDescription: 这污染物单独时属于惰性，当与 BETA 污染物混合时会产生极高的效果，适当的混合会破坏巨人战舰反应堆的平衡，比 STABLE 污染物来的迅速，这个不稳定的物品不能同时间与 BETA 污染物一起携带，推荐给 Tenno 合作团队。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/AntiSerumIn.name: Zealot Derelict Code
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/AntiSerumIn.description: Allows access to Infested Derelicts that have been rerouted to populated areas by Zealots.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/AntiSerumIn.zhDescription: 进入感染者遗迹的权限，其已经被狂热者改道至人口稠密区域。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ApartmentPe.name: Vista Suite Key
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ApartmentPe.description: Opens the Dormizone's luxurious Vista Suite where residents can enjoy Vistagraphs and Audioscapes.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ApartmentPe.zhDescription: 开启居住舱的豪华景房来享受其中的景幕和景音。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ArchWingNav.name: Orokin Archive
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ArchWingNav.description: Archive detailing the locations of hidden Archwing technology
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ArchWingNav.zhDescription: 详细记录曲翼科技隐藏地点的档案

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ArgonCrysta.name: Argon Crystal
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ArgonCrysta.description:
A Void based radioactive resource that decays every day it is out of the Void.

Location: Missions in the Void
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ArgonCrysta.zhDescription:
一种来自虚空的放射性资源，离开虚空后将每天衰变。

获取地点：虚空中的任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Beacon.name: Proof Fragment
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Beacon.description: One part of a long lost mathematical proof.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Beacon.zhDescription: 一部分遗失多年的数学证明片段

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/BetaCorrupt.name: Beta Corruptor
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/BetaCorrupt.description: Inert on its own this corruptor is highly effective if mixed with its Alpha counterpart. Properly mixed, these will destabilize Fomorian Reactors much faster than their Stable counterparts. This volatile item cannot be simultaneously equipped with Alpha Corruptors. Recommended for Tenno operating as a team.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/BetaCorrupt.zhDescription: 这污染物单独时属于惰性，当与 ALPHA 污染物混合时会产生极高的效果，适当的混合会破坏巨人战舰反应堆的平衡，比 STABLE 污染物来的迅速，这个不稳定的物品不能同时间与 ALPHA 污染物一起携带，推荐给 Tenno 合作团队。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Circuits.name: Circuits
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Circuits.description:
Various electronic components.

Location: Venus, Ceres, and the Kuva Fortress
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Circuits.zhDescription:
各类电子元器件。

获取地点：金星，谷神星和赤毒要塞

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/CodaWeaponB.name: Live Heartcell
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/CodaWeaponB.description:
Harvested from the still beating heart of a Technocyte Coda.

Location: Earned upon Vanquishing a Technocyte Coda in Höllvania.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/CodaWeaponB.zhDescription:
从科技细胞终幕者仍在跳动的心脏中采集。

获取地点：消灭科技细胞终幕者。（霍瓦尼亚）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Concentrate.name: Hexenon
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Concentrate.description:
A reagent commonly used to produce highly combustible fuel.

Location: Jupiter
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Concentrate.zhDescription:
一种通常用于生产超高可燃性燃料的试剂。

获取地点：木星

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ControlModu.name: Control Module
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ControlModu.description:
Autonomy processor for Robotics. A Corpus design.

Location: Europa, Neptune, and the Void
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ControlModu.zhDescription:
机器人的自主处理器。Corpus 设计。

获取地点：欧罗巴，海王星和虚空

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Cryotic.name: Cryotic
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Cryotic.description:
Usually found in extreme sub-zero environments, Cryotic instantly freezes anything it contacts.

Location: Excavation Missions on Venus, Earth, Phobos, Europa, and Neptune
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Cryotic.zhDescription:
通常在零度以下的极端环境中可以找到，永冻晶矿可以立即冰冻任何与它接触的东西。

获取地点：金星，地球，火卫一，欧罗巴和海王星上的挖掘任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Customizati.name: additional appearance config slot for this item
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Customizati.zhName: 为这件物品解锁额外的外观配置槽位
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Customizati.description: Unlocks an additional appearance config slot for this item, up to a maximum of 3 extra slots.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Customizati.zhDescription: 为这个物品解锁 1 个额外的外观配置槽位，最多 3 个额外槽位。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DagathAbyss.name: Vainthorn
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DagathAbyss.description:
The rare thorn of an extinct rose, and a vital component in Orokin Defixios and other technology. Last seen near the Abyssal Zone.

Location: Abyssal Zone on Ceres (requires Abyssal Beacons to access)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DagathAbyss.zhDescription:
一种绝迹玫瑰的稀有刺，是奥罗金咒言板及其它技术中的关键组件。最后一次被看到是在深渊区域。

获取地点：谷神星深渊区域（需要深渊信标才能进入）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DangerRoomK.name: Simulacrum Access Key
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DangerRoomK.description:
Grants access to the Simulacrum.

In the Simulacrum you can face mimeographs of enemies you have fully researched with the Codex.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DangerRoomK.zhDescription:
授权使用幻影装置

在幻影装置中你可以迎战已经调查完毕并写入数据库的敌方单位复制品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DataFragmen.name: Tethra Data Fragments
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DataFragmen.description: Intercepted encrypted fragment of Grineer communications.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DataFragmen.zhDescription: 被拦截 Grineer 通信的加密碎片。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DistillPoin.name: Vosfor
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DistillPoin.description: Loid uses devices in Albrecht's Laboratory to reduce Arcanes to Vosfor, a potent powder for alchemical processes. Speak to Loid in the Sanctum Anatomica on Deimos to trade Vosfor for Arcanes he has stored in the laboratory.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DistillPoin.zhDescription: 洛德使用阿尔布雷希特实验室中的装置将赋能分解成荧尘，这是一种用于转换的强效粉末。在火卫二的解剖圣所与洛德对话，用荧尘交换他存放在实验室中的赋能。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DuviriGuidi.name: Enigma Sense
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DuviriGuidi.description: Nearby Duviri Enigmas will be marked with a waypoint.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/DuviriGuidi.zhDescription: 附近的双衍王境奥理将标注为标记点。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Eidolonium.name: Breath of the Eidolon
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Eidolonium.description:
A gas found solely on the Plains of Eidolon, refined to its purest form. 

Location: Plains of Eidolon Bounties on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Eidolonium.zhDescription:
一种只能在夜灵平野上找到的气体，已被精炼到了最纯粹的状态。

获取地点：夜灵平野赏金任务（地球）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Elitium.name: Vitus Essence
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Elitium.description:
Awarded by the Arbiters of Hexis to the few Tenno capable of surviving Arbitration.

Location: Arbitration Missions
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Elitium.zhDescription:
由均衡仲裁者授予少数能从仲裁中幸存的 Tenno。

获取地点：仲裁任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Eventium.name: Synthula
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Eventium.zhDescription: 提炼而成的刺激剂原料。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Ferrite.name: Ferrite
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Ferrite.description:
Alloy pellets used in Grineer manufacturing.

Location: Mercury, Earth, Lua, Neptune, and the Void
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Ferrite.zhDescription:
Grineer 在制造过程中使用的合金块。

获取地点：水星，地球，月球，海王星和虚空

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Fissureum.name: Diluted Thermia
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Fissureum.description:
A magma like liquid that is diluted with coolant during the extraction process. Thermia can be found fracturing the surface of the Orb Vallis during thermal flare-ups. Could this be the key to weakening the Exploiter Orb's defenses?

Location: Thermia Fractures event in the Orb Vallis on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Fissureum.zhDescription:
在萃取过程中能被冷却液稀释的液态岩浆。在热爆过程中，热美亚会出现在奥布山谷表面，并导致热美亚裂缝的产生。或许它就是瓦解剥削者圆蛛防御机制的关键？

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）上的热美亚裂缝活动

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensGr.name: Greater Focus Lens
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensGr.description: A Greater Lens that channels Affinity into Focus for one of the five Tenno Ways.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensGr.zhDescription: 一颗将经验值转换为五项 Tenno 之道专精的高级晶体。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensLu.name: Lua Lens
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensLu.description: An Eidolon Lens enhanced with resonance from Somatic Fibers.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensLu.zhDescription: 一颗通过活体纤维的共振来强化的夜灵晶体。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensOs.name: Eidolon Lens
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensOs.description: An enhanced Greater Lens that has been infused with Breath of the Eidolon.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FocusLensOs.zhDescription: 一颗注入了夜灵之息的强化高级晶体。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FoilModUnlo.name: Chromatic Atramentum
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FoilModUnlo.description:
Turns a conventional mod into a work of art. An Atragraph Mod.

Find Aspirant Zorba on a relay to create Atragraph Mods.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FoilModUnlo.zhDescription:
将传统 Mod 变成艺术品。墨染 Mod。

在一个中继站找到见习仲裁者左巴即可制作墨染 Mod。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Forma.name: Forma
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Forma.description: This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe, Companions or Weapon and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes, Companions and Weapons.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Forma.zhDescription: 这个非固定形态的零件是奥罗金时代建筑中不可或缺的。可以改变战甲、同伴或武器的极性槽，并将等级重置为无等级。只能用于满级的战甲、同伴及武器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaAura.name: Omni Forma
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaAura.description:
Modifies any slot to be compatible with any Mod Polarity.

*Umbra Polarity not included.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaAura.zhDescription:
改变任何槽位以与任何 Mod 极性兼容。

*不包括 Umbra 极性。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaOmega.name: TEST FORMA
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaOmega.description: This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe, Companions or Weapon and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes, Companions and Weapons.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaOmega.zhDescription: 这个非固定形态的零件是奥罗金时代建筑中不可或缺的。可以改变战甲、同伴或武器的极性槽，并将等级重置为无等级。只能用于满级的战甲、同伴及武器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaStance.name: Stance Forma
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaStance.description: Modifies a Stance slot on a melee weapon to be compatible with any Mod Polarity.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaStance.zhDescription: 改变近战武器上的架式槽位以与任何 Mod 的极性相容。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaUmbra.name: Umbra Forma
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaUmbra.description:
Forma that can apply the UMBRA polarity.

This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe or Melee Weapon to UMBRA polarity and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes and Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/FormaUmbra.zhDescription:
可以设置 UMBRA 极性的 Forma。

这个非固定形态的零件是奥罗金时代建筑中不可或缺的基础构件。它可以改变战甲或武器的极性槽至 UMBRA 极性，并将其等级重置为无等级。这项物品只能用于满级的战甲及近战武器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Gallium.name: Gallium
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Gallium.description:
Soft metal used in microelectronics and energy weapons.

Location: Mars and Uranus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Gallium.zhDescription:
用于微电子和能量武器的软金属。

获取地点：火星和天王星

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/GranumBucks.name: Corrupted Holokey
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/GranumBucks.description: A corrupted decryption key dating back to the founding of the city of Corposium. Millions of these Holokeys were lost to the Void when Parvos Granum's flagship was bombed. Strongly desired by Ergo Glast.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/GranumBucks.zhDescription: 一把堕落解密钥匙，起源可以追溯到 Corposium 之城建立的时期。当帕尔沃斯·格拉努的旗舰被炸毁时，数以百万计这样的全息密钥就失落在了虚空中。Ergo Glast 对这件物品情有独钟。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/GrnFlameSpe.name: Javlok Capacitor
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/GrnFlameSpe.description: Used in the construction of Javloks

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/HeavyWeapon.name: Gravimag
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/HeavyWeapon.description:
Allows archwing guns to be deployed in terrestrial zones. Install this device on archwing guns to compensate for atmospheric and gravitational forces not experienced in space.
NOTE: Deployment requires gear obtained from the Profit-Taker mission in Fortuna.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/HeavyWeapon.zhDescription:
允许曲翼枪械在陆地区域使用。陆地环境中存在着太空环境所没有的大气压力与重力，在曲翼枪械上安装这个装置就能抵消上述差异所带来的绝大部分影响。
注意：在部署时需要用到福尔图娜的利润收割者任务中取得的道具。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/HekNavCode.name: Vay Hek Nav Coordinate
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/HekNavCode.description: Coordinate used to locate Councilor Vay Hek.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/HekNavCode.zhDescription: 用来定位韦·海克的坐标

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/InfestedAla.name: Mutalist Alad V Nav Coordinate
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/InfestedAla.zhName: 异融阿拉德 V 导航坐标
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/InfestedAla.description:
These coordinates can be used to track Mutalist Alad V.

Location: Infestation Outbreaks Invasion Rewards, Hyf and Terrorem (Deimos), and Resource Caches found in Naeglar (Eris) and Formido (Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/InfestedAla.zhDescription:
这些坐标可用于追踪异融阿拉德 V。

获取地点：感染者爆发入侵奖励、Hyf 和 Terrorem（火卫二）、Naeglar（阋神星）和 Formido（火卫二）中的资源储藏箱

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/InstantSalv.name: RUSH REPAIR DRONE
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/InstantSalv.description: This single-use item instantly repairs a damaged component or armament in the Dry Dock.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/InstantSalv.zhDescription: 一次性物品，可以立即在干船坞内修复一件损坏的部件或军备。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/JuggernautP.name: Pulsating Tubercles
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/JuggernautP.description:
A grizzly trophy extracted from the corpse of a Juggernaut.

Location: Drops from Juggernauts (non-endless Infested Missions) and Deimos Juggernauts (Cambion Drift on Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/JuggernautP.zhDescription:
从巨兽尸体中取出的斑白战利品。

获取地点：巨兽（非无尽 Infested 任务）、火卫二巨兽（火卫二魔胎之境）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/JuggernautP.name: Infected Palpators
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/JuggernautP.description:
A grizzly trophy extracted from the corpse of a Juggernaut.

Location: Drops from Juggernauts (non-endless Infested Missions) and Deimos Juggernauts (Cambion Drift on Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/JuggernautP.zhDescription:
从巨兽尸体中取出的斑白战利品。

获取地点：巨兽（非无尽 Infested 任务）、火卫二巨兽（火卫二魔胎之境）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/JuggernautP.name: Chitinous Husk
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/JuggernautP.description:
A grizzly trophy extracted from the corpse of a Juggernaut.

Location: Drops from Juggernauts (non-endless Infested Missions) and Deimos Juggernauts (Cambion Drift on Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/JuggernautP.zhDescription:
从巨兽尸体中取出的斑白战利品。

获取地点：巨兽（非无尽 Infested 任务）、火卫二巨兽（火卫二魔胎之境）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/JuggernautP.name: Severed Bile Sac
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/JuggernautP.description:
A grizzly trophy extracted from the corpse of a Juggernaut.

Location: Drops from Juggernauts (non-endless Infested Missions) and Deimos Juggernauts (Cambion Drift on Deimos)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/JuggernautP.zhDescription:
从巨兽尸体中取出的斑白战利品。

获取地点：巨兽（非无尽 Infested 任务）、火卫二巨兽（火卫二魔胎之境）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/KahlCreds.name: Stock
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/KahlCreds.description: Chipper's current Stock level. Raise his Stock level by completing Kahl's Break Narmer missions.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/KahlCreds.zhDescription: 切片哥当前的存货储备量。通过完成卡尔的「击溃合一众」任务来增加他的存货储备量。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/KelaArenaTo.name: Judgement Points
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/KelaArenaTo.description:
Points earned through victories in Rathuum.

Obtained from Rathuum Arena missions on Nakki, Yam, and Vodyanoi (Sedna).
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/KelaArenaTo.zhDescription:
通过在死亡角斗场中获得胜利来赚取的点数。

通过在 Nakki、Yam、Vodyanoi（赛德娜）的死亡角斗场竞技场任务获得。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Kuva.name: Kuva
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Kuva.description:
Kuva is an exceedingly rare red fluid coveted by the Grineer Queens. It can be obtained in Kuva Missions, and is used to Cycle Rivens or build rare blueprints.

Location: Kuva Siphon Missions and Taveuni (Kuva Fortress)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Kuva.zhDescription:
赤毒是 Grineer 女皇梦寐以求的一种非常罕见的红色液体。它可以从赤毒任务中获得，用来循环裂罅 Mod 或者制造稀有蓝图。

获取地点：赤毒虹吸任务、Taveuni（赤毒要塞）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.name: Cross-Matrix Widget
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.description: Chance for each scan with the Synthesis Scanner to count as two scans.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.zhDescription: 每次以结合扫描器执行扫描时，有几率进行二次扫描。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.name: Data-Parse Widget
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.description: Synthesis Scanner will now show target enemy weaknesses and resistances.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.zhDescription: 结合扫描器将显示目标敌人的弱点和抗性。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.name: Vector-Thread Widget
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.description: Reduces the time required to scan a target with the Synthesis Scanner.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/LibraryScan.zhDescription: 降低结合扫描器扫描目标所需的时间。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MechSurviva.name: Phasic Cells
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MechSurviva.description: Harvested from the debris left by fallen Orphix Sentients, Phasic Cells seem to be key to pulse function. These components can be traded with Father in the Necralisk.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MechSurviva.zhDescription: 从战败的 Sentient 奥影母艇残骸中收集而来，相位电池似乎是脉冲功能的关键。在殁世幽都中，可以与'父亲'交易这些组件。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MemoryCrypt.name: Somatic Fibers
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MemoryCrypt.description:
Neural fibers sampled from an early Warframe prototype and preserved in a stabilized cerebral fluid.

Location: Demolishers on Apollo (Lua), and Conjunction Survival Missions (Lua)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MemoryCrypt.zhDescription:
从早期战甲原型采样并保存在一种稳定的脑液中的神经纤维。

获取地点：Apollo（月球）上的爆破型敌人、联结生存任务（月球）。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MirageCode.name: Orokin Cipher
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MirageCode.description:
This device is used to bypass Orokin encryptions.

Location: Orokin Derelict Vaults on Deimos once opened with a Dragon Key
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MirageCode.zhDescription:
这一装置可用来破解奥罗金的加密。

获取地点：通过龙钥开启过的奥罗金遗迹宝库（火卫二）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ModSlotUnlo.name: additional mod config slot for this item
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ModSlotUnlo.zhName: 为这件物品解锁额外的 MOD 配置槽位
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ModSlotUnlo.description: Unlocks an additional appearance config slot for this item, up to a maximum of 3 extra slots.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ModSlotUnlo.zhDescription: 为这个物品解锁 1 个额外的外观配置槽位，最多 3 个额外槽位。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Morphic.name: Morphics
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Morphic.description:
An amorphous solid. Possibly Orokin technology.

Location: Mercury, Mars, Phobos, Europa, and Pluto
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Morphic.zhDescription:
非晶态的固体。可能是奥罗金技术。

获取地点：水星，火星，火卫一，欧罗巴和冥王星

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MushroomFoo.name: Fergolyte
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MushroomFoo.description:
This highly reactive mineral deposit is the only substance known to make The Prince grow.

Location: The Deepmines below Fortuna, Venus.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/MushroomFoo.zhDescription:
这种高反应性的矿藏是已知唯一能让王子菇成长的物质。

获取地点：金星福尔图娜下方的深矿。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Nanospores.name: Nano Spores
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Nanospores.description:
Fibrous technocyte tumour. Handle Infested tissue with caution.

Location: Saturn, Neptune, Eris, and Deimos
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Nanospores.zhDescription:
纤维状的科技细胞肿瘤。请谨慎处理感染者组织。

获取地点：土星，海王星，阋神星和火卫二

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NarmerBount.name: Narmer Isoplast
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NarmerBount.description:
An adaptive Sentient base component responsible for communication flows. Used extensively in the Narmer invasion. A valuable commodity for both The Quills and Vox Solaris.

Location: Narmer Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon (Earth) and Orb Vallis (Venus)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NarmerBount.zhDescription:
一种用于 Sentient 通讯流的适应性基本组件。在合一众入侵时被广泛使用。对夜羽和索拉里斯之声来说都是一种很有价值的商品。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）和奥布山谷（金星）中的合一众赏金任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NavCode.name: Nav Coordinate
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NavCode.description:
Coordinate used to locate lost ships.

Location: Dropped from Storage Containers
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NavCode.zhDescription:
用来找到失踪飞船的坐标。

获取地点：可在储存容器中获得

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NeuralSenso.name: Neural Sensors
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NeuralSenso.description:
Implanted neural-link for controlling augmentations. Grineer design.

Location: Jupiter
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NeuralSenso.zhDescription:
植入式的神经连接，用于控制各类扩增强化系统，由 Grineer 设计。

获取地点：木星。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Neurode.name: Neurodes
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Neurode.description:
Biotech sensor organ harvested from Infested entities.

Location: Earth, Lua, Eris, and Deimos
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Neurode.zhDescription:
从感染者身上收集的生物感应器官。

获取地点：地球，月球，阋神星和火卫二

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NoraInfeste.description: Used to purchase Nightwave's Cred Offerings. Nightwave Creds from past Series can be kept as souvenirs or sold for <CREDITS>Credits.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/NoraInfeste.zhDescription: 用于购买午夜电波的贡品。过往的午夜电波系列兑换币可以留作纪念品或出售换取 <CREDITS>现金。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OmegaIsotop.name: Omega Isotope
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OmegaIsotop.description:
Produced by a Fomorian's power core, these particles only appear on or around planets where a Fomorian is present.

Location: When a Balor Fomorian is threatening a Planet's Relay, enemies on that Planet will drop this resource
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OmegaIsotop.zhDescription:
由巨人战舰动力核心所产生，这些粒子仅出现在巨人战舰活动当地或邻近的星球上。 

获取地点：当巴罗尔巨人战舰威胁到星球中继站时，该星球的敌人便会掉落这种资源

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinCatal.name: Orokin Catalyst
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinCatal.description: Orokin modification technology used to super-charge weaponry. Doubles the available Mod Capacity on a Weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinCatal.zhDescription: 用来大幅度强化武器的奥罗金改造科技。能使武器获得两倍的 Mod 点数容量。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinCell.name: Orokin Cell
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinCell.description:
Ancient energy cell from the Orokin era.

Location: Ceres, Saturn, and Deimos
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinCell.zhDescription:
奥罗金时代流传下来的的远古能量电池。

获取地点：谷神星，土星和火卫二

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinReact.name: Orokin Reactor
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinReact.description: Reactor used to super-charge Warframes. Doubles the available Mod Capacity on a Warframe, Archwing, and Companions.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OrokinReact.zhDescription: 反应堆用于大幅提升战甲的能力。且能将战甲、曲翼及同伴的 Mod 容量提升为两倍。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OxiumAlloy.name: Oxium
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OxiumAlloy.description:
Oxium is a rare lighter than air alloy of Orokin origin, used in certain Corpus Robotics.

Location: Venus, Jupiter, Mars, Neptune, Pluto, Eris, Europa, and Lua.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/OxiumAlloy.zhDescription:
奥席金属产于奥罗金，是一种比空气还轻的稀有合金，被用于部分 Corpus 机器人。

获取地点：金星，木星，火星，海王星，冥王星，阋神星，欧罗巴和月球。

Location: Phobos, Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, and Eris
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Plastids.zhDescription:
布满纳米机器人的恶心组织肿块。

获取地点：火卫一，土星，天王星，冥王星和阋神星

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/PolymerBund.zhDescription:
一种坚硬、 热塑性的塑料套管。由 Corpus 制造。

获取地点：水星，金星和天王星

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/PrimeBucks.name: Orokin Ducats
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/PrimeBucks.description: Currency exchanged for Prime components and used to purchase items from the Void Trader.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/PrimeBucks.zhDescription: 由Prime部件兑换的货币，可用于在虚空商人处购买商品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RazorbackCi.name: Cryptographic Alu
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RazorbackCi.description:
Excess circuitry disposed of during the Razorback manufacturing process, these components only appear in the vicinity of high level outer-orbit Corpus facilities after a Razorback Armada has been launched.

Location: Corpus Archwing units on Jupiter and Neptune when a Razorback Armada is active
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RazorbackCi.zhDescription:
制造利刃豺狼过程中的多余回路。在利刃豺狼舰队上阵后，这些组件只会出现在高等的 Corpus 外环设施之中。

获取地点：利刃豺狼舰队活动期间木星和海王星上的 Corpus 曲翼单位

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenFragme.name: Riven Sliver
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenFragme.description:
A fragment of a sundered Riven. It is known that, with enough slivers, Palladino is capable of reforging a complete Riven. Find her in the Iron Wake (Earth) after completing The Chains of Harrow quest.

Location: Eximus units and Requiem Relics
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenFragme.zhDescription:
破裂的裂罅 Mod 碎块。有了足够的碎块，Palladino 就可以重铸一张完整的裂罅 Mod。完成《Harrow 的枷锁》系列任务后可在钢铁守望（地球）中找到她。

获取地点：卓越者单位、安魂遗物

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenIdenti.name: Veiled Riven Cipher
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenIdenti.description: Use this cipher to instantly complete one Veiled Riven Challenge at the cost of consuming the cipher.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenIdenti.zhDescription: 使用并消耗破解器即可立即完成一项尚未揭开的裂罅 Mod 挑战。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenSplice.name: Riven Splicer
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenSplice.description:
Used in the Mod Workbench to splice Riven traits into a new trait from a special pool of possibilities.

Obtained by completing The Icebind on Yuvan Peak.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/RivenSplice.zhDescription: 可以在 Mod 工作台使用，将裂罅属性从特殊可能性池中拼接成新的属性。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Rubedo.name: Rubedo
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Rubedo.description:
A jagged crystalline ore. Gives off radiant energy.

Location: Earth, Lua, Phobos, Europa, Pluto, Sedna, and the Void
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Rubedo.zhDescription:
锯齿状的结晶矿。放出辐射能量。

获取地点：地球，月球，火卫一，欧罗巴，冥王星，赛德娜和虚空

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Salvage.name: Salvage
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Salvage.description:

Location: Mars, Jupiter, and Sedna
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Salvage.zhDescription:
从战后残骸中回收的高价值金属。

获取地点：火星，木星和赛德娜

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SchismKey.name: Aya
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SchismKey.description:
Raw Orokin memory plasma. Varzia's Foundry can consume Aya to create Void Relics. Find her in Maroo's Bazaar on Mars.

Location: Void Missions and Bounties
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SchismKey.zhDescription:
未加工的奥罗金记忆等离子。瓦奇娅的铸造厂可以消耗阿耶精华来制造虚空遗物。可在火星上 Maroo 的市集里找到她。

获取地点：虚空和赏金任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SentientFra.name: Anomaly Shard
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SentientFra.description:
A shard ripped from a Sentient Anomaly in the Veil Proxima. Little Duck is known to trade these for other exotic goods somewhere in Fortuna on Venus.

Location: Murex ships found in Veil Proxima nodes marked with a special flashing icon (Railjack)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SentientFra.zhDescription:
从面纱比邻星域中的 Sentient 异常事件中扯下的碎片。小鸭子会在福尔图娜的某个地方用异域货物交易这些碎片，她以这种交易被人所熟知。

获取地点：面纱比邻星域节点中标有特殊的闪烁图标（航道星舰）的骨螺战舰

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ShrineFragm.name: Fate Pearl
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ShrineFragm.description:
Retrieved from the shores of a sacred fate dream.

Location: Saya's Visions on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ShrineFragm.zhDescription:
取自神圣命运梦境的彼岸。

获取地点：萨娅的异象（地球）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SolarisMini.name: Sunpoint Plasma Drill Range Widget
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SolarisMini.zhName: 阳点等离子钻头范围改造器
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SolarisMini.zhDescription: 提升等离子光束的距离。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SolarisMini.name: Sunpoint Plasma Drill Silencer Widget
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SolarisMini.zhName: 阳点等离子钻头消音改造器
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SolarisMini.description: Mine in peace and avoid alerting nearby enemies with this drill silencing widget.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SolarisMini.zhDescription: 用这个钻头消音改造器来和平地挖矿并避免让敌人警戒。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SpecterPart.name: Spectral Debris
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SpecterPart.description:
Discharged specter particles form an inert dust that can be collected and re-energized for various robotic projects.

Location: Errant Specters in the Granum Void (Corpus Ship Tileset)
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SpecterPart.zhDescription:
释放的魅影粒子形成一种惰性粉尘，可以收集起来为各种机器人项目重新充能。

获取地点：格拉努虚空（Corpus 飞船场景）中的游荡魅影

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/StableCorru.name: Stable Corruptor
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/StableCorru.description: Injected into a Fomorian Reactor this corruptor will imbalance the fuels. Critically imbalanced reactors will eventually implode, destroy the ship. Slow but effective, recommended for Solo Tenno.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/StableCorru.zhDescription: 对巨人战舰反应堆注射这个污染物会造成燃料失调，失调的精密反应堆最后会发生聚爆，并摧毁船只，缓慢但是有效，推荐给独行 Tenno。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SteelEssenc.name: Steel Essence
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SteelEssenc.description: Tokens of Teshin's Esteem earned from Incursion Alerts or Acolytes on The Steel Path. Can be exchanged for items that prove your warrior capabilities by visiting Teshin in any Relay.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SteelEssenc.zhDescription: 从钢铁之路侵袭警报任务或是追随者那里获取的代表 Teshin 尊严的代币。可被用来在任意中继站的 Teshin 处换取证明你战士能力的物品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SteelEssenc.name: Steel Essence
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SteelEssenc.description: Tokens of Teshin's Esteem earned from Incursion Alerts or Acolytes on The Steel Path. Can be exchanged for items that prove your warrior capabilities by visiting Teshin in any Relay.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SteelEssenc.zhDescription: 从钢铁之路侵袭警报任务或是追随者那里获取的代表 Teshin 尊严的代币。可被用来在任意中继站的 Teshin 处换取证明你战士能力的物品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SyringeComp.name: Antiserum Injector Fragment
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SyringeComp.description:
A component of the Antiserum Injector.

Location: Oestrus on Eris
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/SyringeComp.zhDescription:
一只抗血清注射器的部件。

获取地点：阋神星的 Oestrus

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/TNWArchonIt.name: Archon Amar's Shard
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/TNWArchonIt.zhName: 执刑官欺谋狼主的源力石

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/TNWArchonIt.name: Archon Boreal's Shard
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/TNWArchonIt.zhName: 执刑官诡文枭主的源力石

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/TNWArchonIt.name: Archon Nira's Shard
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/TNWArchonIt.zhName: 执刑官混沌蛇主的源力石

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Tellurium.name: Tellurium
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Tellurium.description:
This rare metal is foreign to the Origin System and can only be found in asteroids that have made the long journey from other stars.

Location: Archwing Missions on Uranus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/Tellurium.zhDescription:
这种罕见的金属来自始源星系之外，只能从来自其他恒星的小行星上获得。

获取地点：天王星上的曲翼任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/UmbraEchoes.name: Echoes Of Umbra
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/UmbraEchoes.description: Injecting this fluid into a Warframe will imbue it with the ability to fight autonomously alongside the Operator. Injection requires the use of the Helminth Infirmary, and the ability wears off after 24 hours.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/UmbraEchoes.zhDescription: 将这种液体注入战甲内，使其具有与指挥官并肩作战的能力。注射需要使用 Helminth 医务间，并且该能力会在 24 小时后消失。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/UtilityUnlo.name: Exilus Warframe Adapter
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/UtilityUnlo.zhName: 战甲特殊功能槽连接器
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/UtilityUnlo.description: Fuses with a Warframe to unlock the Exilus Mod Slot.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/UtilityUnlo.zhDescription: 融入一架战甲来解锁特殊功能槽。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ValenceAdap.name: Elemental Vice
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ValenceAdap.description: Use the Elemental Vice to change the Elemental Damage Type of an Adversary Weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/ValenceAdap.zhDescription: 使用元素恶癖来改变对手武器的元素伤害类型。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/VayHekCoord.name: Delta Beacon
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/VayHekCoord.description: Locator beacon broadcasting on the delta frequency
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/VayHekCoord.zhDescription: 持续发送出 Delta 频率的信标定位装置。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/VayHekCoord.name: Gamma Beacon
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/VayHekCoord.description: Locator beacon broadcasting on the gamma frequency

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/VayHekCoord.name: Kappa Beacon

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/VoidTearDro.name: Void Traces
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/VoidTearDro.description:
A substance used to increase the power within Relics.

Location: Void Fissure Missions
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/VoidTearDro.zhDescription:
一种用来增加遗物内在能力的物质。

获取地点：虚空裂缝任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/WaterFightB.name: Nakak Pearls
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/WaterFightB.description: Nakak in Cetus would probably like these. Maybe she'll trade something special for them.
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/WaterFightB.zhDescription: 希图斯的娜卡可能会喜欢这个。她可能会拿些特别的东西来和你交易。

/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/WeaponAmpAr.name: AMP ARCANE ADAPTER
/Lotus/Types/Items/MiscItems/WeaponAmpAr.description: Fuses with an Amp to unlock an Arcane Slot.

/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Blast.name: Spring Popper
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Blast.description:
A volatile mushroom with an acrid odor similar to freshly detonated explosives. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Blast.zhDescription:
一种挥发性蘑菇，散发着类似刚引爆的炸药的刺鼻气味。把它带到气密舱夜帽那里以获取更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/ColdM.name: Winter Spear
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/ColdM.description:
This bizarre mushroom appears to be permanently frozen. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/ColdM.zhDescription:
这种古怪的蘑菇似乎被永久冻住了。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处来了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Corro.name: Borica
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Corro.description:
This mushroom appears to continually excrete a highly acidic mucus. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Corro.zhDescription:
这种蘑菇似乎会不断分泌强酸性的黏液。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Elect.name: Thunder-Button
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Elect.description:
This fungus appears to emit an electric charge. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Elect.zhDescription:
这种真菌似乎会释放电荷。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/GasMu.name: Reeking Puffball
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/GasMu.description:
This gaseous mushroom exhibits a terrible stench. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/GasMu.zhDescription:
这种气态蘑菇散发出难闻的恶臭。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/HeatM.name: Blister Stalk
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/HeatM.description:
This mushroom is always hot to the touch. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/HeatM.zhDescription:
这种蘑菇摸起来总是炽热的。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Impac.name: Ironwood
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Impac.description:
This mushroom is hard as an anvil and nearly as heavy. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Impac.zhDescription:
这种蘑菇坚硬如铁砧，重量也几乎相当。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Magne.name: Ferrofungus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Magne.description:
An oddly shaped fungus that will latch itself onto metallic objects. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Magne.zhDescription:
一种形状古怪的真菌，会附着在金属物体上。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽那里了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Plain.name: Dull Button
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Plain.description:
This mushroom is as plain as plain can be. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Plain.zhDescription:
这种蘑菇普通得不能再普通了。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Punct.name: Thorn Tooth
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Punct.description:
Avoid stepping on this sharp, spear-like mushroom cap. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Punct.zhDescription:
小心别踩到这种尖锐如长矛般的蘑菇伞盖。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Radia.name: Gamma Berry
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Radia.description:
A potentially radioactive mushroom. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Radia.zhDescription:
一种可能具有放射性的蘑菇。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Slash.name: Devil's Cap
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Slash.description:
The spines on this mushroom appear to be extremely sharp. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Slash.zhDescription:
这种蘑菇上的尖刺看起来极为锋利。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/TauMu.name: Vomval Trumpet
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/TauMu.description:
A peculiar looking mushroom that seems not of this world. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/TauMu.zhDescription:
一种外观奇特，仿佛不属于这个世界的蘑菇。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Toxin.name: Muck Bonnet
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Toxin.description:
A snake-like mushroom that should be handled with caution.  Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Toxin.zhDescription:
一种蛇形的蘑菇，处理时应格外小心。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Viral.name: Violet's Bane
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Viral.description:
This multi-capped mushroom should probably not be ingested. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/Viral.zhDescription:
这种多伞盖的蘑菇最好不要食用。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/VoidM.name: Nonono
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/VoidM.description:
A mushroom of unknown origin or effect. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Types/Items/MushroomJournal/VoidM.zhDescription:

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Comm.name: Sunlight Threshcone
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Comm.description:
This common plant can only be found during the day. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Sunlight Threshcone plants that grow on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Comm.zhDescription:
这种常见的植物只能在白天找到。

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的日光去壳毬果植物获得。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Comm.name: Moonlight Threshcone
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Comm.description:
This common plant can only be found at night. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Moonlight Threshcone plants that grow on Earth
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Comm.zhDescription:
这种常见的植物只能在黑夜找到。

获取地点：通过采集地球上生长的月光去壳毬果植物获得。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/GftP.name: Ruk's Claw
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/GftP.description:
This plant was introduced to arid regions across the Origin System, for its ability to collect moisture in harsh environments. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Ruk's Claw plants that grow on Mars
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/GftP.zhDescription:
这种植物被引进遍布于始源星系的干旱地带，储存水分的能力使其得以对抗严酷的环境。 

获取地点：通过采集生长在火星的 Ruk 之爪植物获得

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Ires.name: Skateweed Extract
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Ires.zhDescription: 从鳐鱼草中萃取出的精华物。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Moss.name: Vestan Moss
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Moss.description:
One of the few known plant species able to thrive on asteroids in deep space. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Vestan Moss plants that grow on Mercury, Saturn, and Sedna
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Moss.zhDescription:
为数不多的能够在外太空小行星上繁衍生息的已知植物物种之一。 

获取地点：通过采集生长在水星、土星和赛德娜上的灶神藓植物获得

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/OroF.name: Cerulean Fungus Extract
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/OroF.description: Extracted from a Cerulean Fungus colony.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/OroF.zhDescription: 从蔚蓝菌群中萃取出的精华物。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/OroP.name: Ghost Brush Extract
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/OroP.zhDescription: 从鬼影之拂中萃取出的精华物。
