/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Wild.name: Frostleaf
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Wild.description:
This resilient plant provides a natural food source in frigid areas of the Origin system. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Frostleaf plants that grow on Venus, Neptune, and Pluto
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/Wild.zhDescription:
这种坚韧不拔的植物为始源星系的寒冷地区提供了天然的食物来源。 

获取地点：通过扫采集生长在金星、海王星和冥王星上的霜叶植物获得

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/ZenC.name: Dusklight Sarracenia
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/ZenC.description:
This robust, carnivorous plant has adapted to conditions in polluted waters. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Dusklight Sarracenia plants growing in Grineer Shipyards found commonly on Ceres
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/ZenC.zhDescription:
这种强壮的食虫植物已经适应了在污染水域下生存。 

获取地点：通过采集常见于谷神星，生长在 Grineer 造船厂的尘光瓶子草植物获取

/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/ZenP.name: Lunar Pitcher
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/ZenP.description:
This carnivorous plant can be found growing in the wilderness on Lua. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Lunar Pitcher plants that grow on Lua
/Lotus/Types/Items/Plants/MiscItems/ZenP.zhDescription:
这种食虫植物可以在月球的荒野之中找到。 

获取地点：通过采集生长在月球的月之猪笼草植物获得

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Ast.name: Asterite
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Ast.description:
Formed over billions of years, these crystals are most often found embedded in space rock.

Location: Railjack Missions
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Ast.zhDescription:
这些晶体形成了数十亿年，最常被发现嵌入太空岩石中。

获取地点：航道星舰任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Auc.name: Aucrux Capacitors
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Auc.description:
Once installed, these delicate power systems fuse with a Corpus Obelisk's engines. Unused capacitors are therefore, highly prized.

Location: Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Auc.zhDescription:
安装后，这些精致的电源系统将与 Corpus 方尖碑引起融为一体。因此，未被使用的电容器非常珍贵。 

获取地点：比邻星域（金星、海王星、冥王星）中的航道星舰任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Bra.name: Bracoid
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Bra.description: A rare bacterial entity that increases the spread of Infestation found on Infested Ships.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Bra.zhDescription: 一种罕见的细菌实体，可以促进感染战舰上发现的感染的扩散传播

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Car.name: Carbides
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Car.description:
Resilient components used to reinforce the plated sheets of metal strapped to Grineer Ships.

Location: Eximus units in the Grineer Shipyard Tileset, and Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Car.zhDescription:
用于加固绑在 Grineer 战舰上的镀金板的弹性部件。

获取地点：Grineer 船坞场景中的卓越者单位、比邻星域（地球、土星、面纱）中的航道星舰任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Cop.name: Copernics
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Cop.description:
A cell of encapsulated Void energy.

Location: Lua
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Cop.zhDescription:
一个封装着虚空能量的单元。

获取地点：月球

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Cub.name: Cubic Diodes
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Cub.description:
Vital components used in the creation of Corpus photon-networks.

Location: Eximus units in the Corpus Ice Planet Tileset, and Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Cub.zhDescription:
用于创建 Corpus 光子网络的重要部件。

获取地点：Corpus 冰原星球场景中的卓越者单位、比邻星域（金星、海王星、冥王星）中的航道星舰任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Fre.name: Fresnels
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Fre.description: A rare Orokin material used to create a tear in space and allow safe passage through the Void.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Fre.zhDescription: 一种稀有的奥罗金材料，用于撕裂空间以安全通过虚空。

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Gal.name: Gallos Rods
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Gal.description:
Antimatter fuel cell that powers the Grineer Ships.

Location: Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Gal.zhDescription:
为 Grineer 战舰提供动力的反物质燃料电池。

获取地点：比邻星域（地球、土星、面纱）中的航道星舰任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Iso.name: Isos
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Iso.description:
A self-replicating fluid comprised of nanoproxies capable of independently repairing worn and damaged systems.

Location: Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Iso.zhDescription:
一种由纳米机器人组成并且能自我复制的液体，能够独立修复磨损和损坏的系统。

获取地点：比邻星域（金星、海王星、冥王星）中的航道星舰任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Kes.name: Kesslers
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Kes.description: Orokin devices used for navigating the solar winds.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Kes.zhDescription: 用于应对太阳风的奥罗金设备。

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Kom.name: Komms
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Kom.description:
A component used in secure Grineer communication networks.

Location: Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Kom.zhDescription:
一块用于确保 Grineer 通信网络安全的组件。

获取地点：比邻星域（地球、土星、面纱）中的航道星舰任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Nul.name: Nullstones
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Nul.description:
Nullstones do not conform to several laws of physics, making them highly prized for optimizing sensitive components.

Location: Railjack Missions
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Nul.zhDescription:
虚无碎片并不符合几条重要的物理定律，因其可用于高灵敏度部件的优化而非常珍贵。

获取地点：航道星舰任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Pus.name: Pustrels
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Pus.description:
A parasitic growth that often infects Eximus units operating in Infested environs.

Location: Eris
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Pus.zhDescription:
在感染者环境中的卓越者单位经常受到的一种寄生物感染。

获取地点：阋神星

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Scr.name: Ticor Plate
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Scr.description:
High-density alloy armor plating used in the construction of offensive spacecraft.

Location: Railjack Missions
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Scr.zhDescription:
用于建造攻击性战舰的高致密合金装甲板。

获取地点：航道星舰任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Tit.name: Titanium
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Tit.description:
This highly malleable metal was exploited in great quantities by the Orokin and can now only be found within space rock.

Location: Railjack Missions
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Tit.zhDescription:
这种柔软的金属曾被奥罗金过度开采，现在只能在太空陨石里找到。

获取地点：航道星舰任务

/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Tra.name: Trachons
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Tra.description: An organ found on Infested Ships believed to facilitate communication within the Infested Hivemind.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RailjackMiscItems/Tra.zhDescription: 一种在感染者飞船上发现的器官，被认为能促进感染者蜂巢群体思维的交流。

/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseOne.name: Relay Strut Component
/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseOne.description: An integral building block in the construction of Tenno relays.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseOne.zhDescription: Tenno 中继站构造中的一个组成部分。

/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseOne.name: Pyrus Essence
/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseOne.description: With a blazing orange hue and rigid material strength, this compound is prized by ship and station architects.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseOne.zhDescription: 这种化合物具有炽热的橙色色调和坚硬的材料强度，受到船舰及中继站建筑师的青睐。

/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseThr.name: Trembera Essence
/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseThr.description: A highly purified mineral compound prized for its strength, resiliency, and resistance to heat. Widely used in the construction of Tenno relays.
/Lotus/Types/Items/RelayRebuild/PhaseThr.zhDescription: 高纯度矿物质化合物，因其强度，弹性和耐热性而备受推崇。广泛用于 Tenno 中继站的建造。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/BioComponent.name: Mutagen Mass
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/BioComponent.description:
This living mass can produce weaponized toxins for weaponry.

Location: Clan Research (Bio Lab in the Dojo) and Infested Outbreak Invasion Rewards
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/BioComponent.zhDescription:
此生体聚合物可以制造出可供武器使用的毒素。 

获取地点：生物实验室（氏族道场）和 Infested 爆发奖励

/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/BioFragment.name: Mutagen Sample
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/BioFragment.description:
These samples could advance our knowledge of biological research.

Location: Eris and Deimos
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/BioFragment.zhDescription:
这些样本有助于使我们的生物研究水平更进一步。

获取地点：阋神星和火卫二。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/ChemComponen.name: Detonite Injector
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/ChemComponen.description:
Detonite injectors are the basis for explosive and incendiary weapons.

Location: Clan Research (Chem Lab in the Dojo) and Grineer Invasion Rewards
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/ChemComponen.zhDescription:
爆燃喷射器是爆炸和燃烧类武器的基础。

获取地点：化学实验室（氏族道场）和 Grineer 入侵任务奖励

/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/ChemFragment.name: Detonite Ampule
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/ChemFragment.description:
Researching the Detonite traces within could advance our weapon technology.

Location: Venus, Earth, Lua, Ceres, Saturn, Sedna, and the Kuva Fortress
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/ChemFragment.zhDescription:
对爆燃安瓿内的残留物进行研究，可推动我们的武器技术。

获取地点：金星，地球，月球，谷神星，土星，赛德娜和赤毒要塞。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/CipherPlus.name: Corpus Cipher
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/CipherPlus.description: A cipher used to decode Corpus intel. Crafting component required to create a CORPUS VOID KEY
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/CipherPlus.zhDescription: 一种用来破解Corpus 电脑密码的解码器。制造CORPUS 虚空钥匙组件所必要的组件。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/DataMassPlus.name: Corpus Datamass
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/DataMassPlus.description: A Corpus datamass containing encrypted intel. Crafting component required to create a CORPUS VOID KEY
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/DataMassPlus.zhDescription: 一个内含加密情报的 Corpus 数据块。制造CORPUS 虚空钥匙组件所必要的组件。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/EnergyCompon.name: Fieldron
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/EnergyCompon.description:
ClanTech weaponized containment field to contain superheated substances.

Location: Clan Research (Energy Lab in the Dojo) and Corpus Invasion Rewards
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/EnergyCompon.zhDescription:
氏族技术人员利用能量包围力场控制高热能物质以利于武器化。

获取地点：（道场中）能源实验室的氏族研究和 Corpus 入侵任务奖励

/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/EnergyFragme.name: Fieldron Sample
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/EnergyFragme.description:
This destroyed Fieldron could further research into super-heated containment fields.

Location: Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Europa, Neptune, and Pluto
/Lotus/Types/Items/Research/EnergyFragme.zhDescription:
借由损坏的电磁力场装置可促进有关高热能物质能量包围力场方面的研究。

获取地点：金星，火星，木星，欧罗巴，海王星和冥王星。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/AmazingEter.name: Centurion Commando Toy
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/AmazingEter.description: Decorate the Orbiter with this figurine of an ancient warrior, made from the very finest green polyethylene. Circa 1999.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/AmazingEter.zhDescription: 用这尊古代武士雕像来装饰你的轨道飞行器，雕像由最优质的绿色聚乙烯制成。时刻梦回《1999》。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/AmazingEter.name: Astro Fella Toy
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/AmazingEter.description: Your own Stuffie Buddy astronaut, ready for adventures in outer space!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/AmazingEter.zhDescription: 属于你的毛绒小伙伴宇航员，随时准备好去外太空冒险！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/AmazingEter.name: Rocketship Lua Toy
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/AmazingEter.description: Commemorate the Lua landings with this fun, robust rocketship. Batteries not included.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/AmazingEter.zhDescription: 用这艘有趣、坚固的火箭来纪念月球登陆。不含电池。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.name: On-lyne: The Classic Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.description: The first ever poster of the world smash hit sensation On-lyne. Show off your love of the boys with this original poster.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhDescription: 全球热门组合线上时代的首张海报。用这张原版海报来炫耀你对男孩们的喜爱吧。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.name: On-lyne: Jump Party Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhName: 线上时代：跳跃派对海报
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.description: When your excitement for the party can’t be contained, celebrate it with this wide On-lyne banner! Show off your love of the boys with this original poster.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhDescription: 当你无法抑制对派对的兴奋时，用这张宽幅线上时代横幅来庆祝吧！通过这张原版海报来展示你对男孩们的爱。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.name: On-lyne: The Great Despair Album Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhName: 线上时代：《绝望至极》专辑海报
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.description: The release of The Great Despair was the beginning of a tumultuous time for the band. This original poster is quite the collectors item.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhDescription: 《绝望至极》的发行标志着乐队动荡时期的开始。这张原版海报值得收藏。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.name: On-lyne: The Heartthrobs Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.description: Traditionally displayed pinned to a ceiling. Show off your love of the boys with this original poster.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhDescription: 按照传统，这张海报应挂在天花板上。用这张原版海报来表达你对男孩们的爱。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.name: On-lyne: Friends 4 Eva Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhName: 线上时代：友谊长存海报
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.description: The On-lyne boys were always there for each other. Show off your love of the boys with this original poster, circa 1999.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhDescription: 线上时代男孩们总是互相支持。用这张 1999 年的原版海报来炫耀你对男孩们的爱。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.name: On-lyne: Hearts Take Flight Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.description: When your heart is so full of love for On-lyne it just needs to take off! Show off your love of the boys with this original poster.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhDescription: 当你心中充满对线上时代的爱时，它就需要飞翔！用这张原版海报来炫耀你对男孩们的爱。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.name: On-lyne: Rolling Out Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhName: 线上时代：炫酷登场海报
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.description: Sales of the ZeViLa Stretch Elegance Extreme Deluxe Limo soared after being featured on the cover of this original poster.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhDescription: 自从泽威拉极致优雅豪华的加长版礼车亮相这张原版海报封面后，其销量一路飙升。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.name: On-lyne: Only Looking Up Poster, Day
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhName: 线上时代：仰望天空海报·白昼版
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.description: When you’re on the bottom, things can only look up from here. Especially when the sun is out. Show off your love of the boys with this original 1999 poster.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhDescription: 当你身处底层时，一切只能从这里向上看。尤其是当太阳出来的时候。用这张 1999 年的原版海报来炫耀你对男孩们的爱。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.name: On-lyne: Only Looking Up Poster, Night
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhName: 线上时代：仰望天空海报·黑夜版
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.description: When you’re on the bottom, things can only look up from here. Show off your love of the boys with this original poster.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhDescription: 当你身处底层时，一切只能从这里向上看。用这张原版海报来炫耀你对男孩们的爱。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.name: On-lyne: Reunion Tour Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhName: 线上时代：重组巡演海报
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.description: After their notorious fallout, the reunion tour was a record-breaking success. Show off your love of the boys with this original 1999 poster celebrating that time.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhDescription: 在他们臭名昭著的闹剧结束后，重组巡演取得了创纪录的成功。用这张 1999 年的原版海报来庆祝那段时光，炫耀你对男孩们的爱。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.name: On-lyne: Feeling Blue Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhName: 线上时代：忧郁心情海报
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.description: A poster as cool as the On-lyne boys themselves. From their Yeah Yeah Baby tour. Show off your love of the boys with this original poster.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhDescription: 这张海报和线上时代男孩一样酷。出自他们的《来吧，宝贝》巡回演唱会。用这张原版海报来炫耀你对男孩们的爱。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.name: On-lyne: Yeah Yeah Baby Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhName: 线上时代：《来吧，宝贝》海报
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.description: A poster commemorating the Yeah Yeah Baby On-lyne tour. Show off your love of the boys with this original poster.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/BoybandPost.zhDescription: 纪念《来吧，宝贝》线上时代巡演的海报。用这张原版海报来炫耀你对男孩们的爱。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusShip/.name: Zenith Granum Crown Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusShip/.description: A Zenith Granum Crown replica for your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusShip/.zhDescription: 一个给轨道飞行器的顶级格拉努硬币复制品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusShip/.name: Granum Crown Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusShip/.description: A Granum Crown replica for your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusShip/.zhDescription: 一个给轨道飞行器的格拉努硬币复制品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusShip/.name: Exemplar Granum Crown Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusShip/.description: An Exemplar Granum Crown replica for your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusShip/.zhDescription: 一个给轨道飞行器的范本格拉努硬币复制品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusShip/.name: Golden Hand Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusShip/.description: A miniature of a Corpus shrine said to represent the hand of their Founder.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusShip/.zhDescription: 微型 Corpus 神龛，据说代表着他们创始人的手。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Daug.name: Daughter Token Ornament
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Daug.description: A decorative replica of an Entrati family token.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Daug.zhDescription: 一件英择谛家族石印的装饰性复制品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Deim.name: Whispering Naberus Mobile
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Deim.description: Handcrafted by Grandmother, this macabre ornament tells a special story for Naberus Night. Get comfortable and listen...
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Deim.zhDescription: 由'祖母'亲手制作，这款令人毛骨悚然的饰物讲述了一个有关纳贝流士之夜的特殊故事。找个舒服的姿势，然后听它慢慢道来……

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Fath.name: Father Token Ornament
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Fath.description: A decorative replica of an Entrati family token.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Fath.zhDescription: 一件英择谛家族石印的装饰性复制品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Gran.description: A decorative replica of an Entrati family token.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Gran.zhDescription: 一件英择谛家族石印的装饰性复制品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Hall.name: Wild Hunt Totem
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Hall.description: You can almost feel the beast growling, beckoning you closer. Place it in a spot of honor, settle in, and listen to the story its gaze seems ready to tell.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Hall.zhDescription: 你几乎能感觉到那野兽在咆哮，在召唤你走近。把它放在一个荣誉之地，静坐下来，聆听它目光中准备诉说的故事。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Lychnus
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: This delicate Entrati design's slender metal arm holds a subtle blue flame in a state of perfect equipoise.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.zhDescription: 这件英择谛精巧设计的细长金属臂，以一种完美平衡的状态，托举着一团微妙的蓝色火焰。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Rolizor
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: Natural infested forms combine in an eye-catching piece that recalls the singular landscape of Deimos.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.zhDescription: 感染的自然形态融合在一件夺目的作品内，让人联想到火卫二的独特景观。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Glynort
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: Add the perfect infested highlight to any room with this expertly cast decorative piece.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.zhDescription: 通过这件专业铸造的装饰品来为任意房间增添完美的感染特色。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Sprongi
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: Sneak in this stand-out accent piece to give your ship’s interior a unique flair.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.zhDescription: 悄然拿出这件杰出的装饰品，来为你的飞船内部带来一丝独特的风格。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Spilosect
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: This insectoid plant’s hardy disposition makes it a great, low-maintenance addition to any space.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.zhDescription: 这种类昆虫植物的顽强性格，使其对任意空间来说都是一种绝佳的易养护的装饰品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Groptic
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: Beauty and strangeness blend in this distinctive tendrilled houseplant.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.zhDescription: 集美丽与珍奇为一身的独特卷须室内植物。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Veforg
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: This bioluminescent plant is sure to brighten up any dark corner in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.zhDescription: 这种生物发光植物一定会照亮你轨道飞行器中的任何黑暗角落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Ansophys
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: The functional elegance of Orokin design makes this a versatile piece for storage or display.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.zhDescription: 源自奥罗金设计的优雅实用性，使其成为可用作储存或展示的多功能工艺品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Kybus
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: Evoking the timeless classicism of the Orokin era, the Kybus makes a great base or table.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.zhDescription: 唤起奥罗金时代永恒的古典主义，绘玉台是一个很不错的底座或桌子。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Auroron
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: With its antiqued metal and delicate gold accents, this Orokin floor piece adds grace and style to any room.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.zhDescription: 通过使用古式金属和精致的金色装饰，这件奥罗金地面装饰可以为任意房间增添典雅和格调。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Moth.name: Mother Token Ornament
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Moth.description: A decorative replica of an Entrati family token.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Moth.zhDescription: 一件英择谛家族石印的装饰性复制品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Otak.name: Otak Token Ornament
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Otak.description: A decorative replica of an Entrati family token.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Otak.zhDescription: 一件英择谛家族石印的装饰性复制品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/SonT.name: Son Token Ornament
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/SonT.description: A decorative replica of an Entrati family token.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/SonT.zhDescription: 一件英择谛家族石印的装饰性复制品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Calculum
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: An ingenious device for arithmetic. Used to keep track of a shopkeeper’s sales, a kingdom’s wealth, or the seemingly endless spiral of time.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.zhDescription: 一个精巧的算术装置。用来记录店主的销售、王境的财富，或者看似无穷无尽的时间螺旋。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Hand Spa
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: Duviri citizens are expected to keep clean at all times, in case Thrax’s gaze should fall upon them.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.zhDescription: 双衍王境的公民必须时刻保持干净，以防士魂大帝的目光落在他们身上。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Mortis Stela
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: A replica of the cryptic monument that overshadows the many graves of Duviri.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.zhDescription: 掩盖双衍王境众多坟墓的神秘墓碑复制品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Theater Seat
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: Ideal for appreciating Bombastine's performances. Cushioned to avoid uncomfortable posterior numbness.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.zhDescription: 非常适合欣赏蓬蓬士君的表演。有缓冲，以避免久坐的麻木不适。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Senate Seat
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: The style of chair that would be occupied by Duviri’s elected government, if it had one.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.zhDescription: 如果双衍王境的民选政府真实存在，那么一定用的是这种风格的座椅。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Hay Bale
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: Standard fodder for the Kaithes of Duviri, doubling as a humble bed for the weary laborer.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.zhDescription: 双衍王境里绝灵骥的标准饲料，同时也是疲惫工人的简陋床铺。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Footstool
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: Even the lowest Duviri citizen may need to reach a high spot from time to time.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.zhDescription: 即使是最底层的双衍王境公民，时不时也需要到达一些高度。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Repast Table
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: A sturdy table on which to enjoy the nutritious dole of simple grains which Thrax’s generosity has blessed you with.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.zhDescription: 一张坚固的桌子，在上面你可以享受由士魂大帝慷慨赐予的营养丰富的简单谷物。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Lectern
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: Ideal for lecturing, preaching, or reading magnificent poetic compositions to a crowd who does not understand or appreciate them.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.zhDescription: 是向不理解或不懂得欣赏的凡夫俗子们演讲、布教或诵读宏伟的诗歌作品的理想选择。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Scales
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: Used to weigh out meager, everyday goods by meager, everyday merchants.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.zhDescription: 用来给普通商人称量微不足道的日常物品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Fainting Couch
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: For those times when turning into an Orowyrm is not an option.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.zhDescription: 适用于无法变成奥金魇龙的时候。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Modesty Screen
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: Thrax has, grudgingly, allowed his citizens the use of these screens for the preservation of personal modesty. There are some places where even his exalted eyes have no business peering.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.zhDescription: 士魂大帝勉强允许他的公民使用这些屏风来维护个人的隐私。有些地方即使是他那双尊贵的眼睛也无权窥视。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Clerical Desk
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: Draft and redraft endless bureaucratic scrolls with this fine Duviri desk.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.zhDescription: 用这张精美的双衍王境书桌，反复起草没完没了的官僚文书。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Mitw.name: Major Rusalka's Hat Memento
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Mitw.zhName: 鲁莎卡少校的帽子纪念品
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Mitw.description: Neci Rusalka’s distinctive Scaldra hat, received as part of a mysterious communication.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Mitw.zhDescription: 鲁莎卡少校独特的炽蛇军帽，在一次神秘通信中获得。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Mitw.name: Major Rusalka's Medals Memento
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Mitw.zhName: 鲁莎卡少校的勋章纪念品
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Mitw.description: Medals for valor awarded to Neci Rusalka, received as part of a mysterious communication.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Mitw.zhDescription: 内奇·鲁莎卡的英勇勋章，在一次神秘通信中获得。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.name: Long Artisan Barrel
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.description: A long barrel to fill with oil, water, and other materials artisans might find useful.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.zhDescription: 一个高桶，用来装油、水和其他工匠觉得可能有用的材料。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.name: Short Artisan Barrel
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.description: A short barrel to fill with oil, water, and other materials artisans might find useful.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.zhDescription: 一个矮桶，用来装油、水和其他工匠觉得可能有用的材料。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.name: Duviri Flask
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.description: A discreet way to have a sip while attending any formal event.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.zhDescription: 一个瓶子，灵感来自《双衍王境故事集》中描述的市民生活。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.name: Duviri Thermos
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.description: The ideal vessel for any Tammherd who enjoys a hot or cold drink on the job.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.zhDescription: 一个保温瓶，灵感来自《双衍王境故事集》中描述的市民生活。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.name: Duviri Mug
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.description: Sip from this mug as you assess what the morning sky has in store.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.zhDescription: 一个杯子，灵感来自《双衍王境故事集》中描述的市民生活。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.name: Duviri Fenn Planter
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.description: Brighten your space with sunny Duviri florals.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.zhDescription: 用阳光明媚的双衍王境花卉点亮你的居所。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.name: Duviri Hyssic Planter
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.description: Brighten your space with rosy Duviri florals.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.zhDescription: 用娇艳如玫瑰的双衍王境花卉点亮你的居所。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.name: Duviri Esphal Planter
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.description: Brighten your space with elegant Duviri florals.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.zhDescription: 用高雅的双衍王境花卉点亮你的居所。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.name: Short Green Artisan Pot
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.description: A short green pot of soil artisans might find useful.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.zhDescription: 工匠们可能会觉得有用的一个矮绿色工匠盆。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.name: Tall Green Artisan Pot
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.description: A tall green pot of soil artisans might find useful.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.zhDescription: 工匠们可能会觉得有用的一个高绿色工匠盆。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.name: Wide Green Artisan Pot
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.description: A wide green pot of soil artisans might find useful.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.zhDescription: 工匠们可能会觉得有用的一个宽绿色工匠盆。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.name: Tall White Artisan Pot
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.description: A tall white pot of soil artisans might find useful.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.zhDescription: 工匠们可能会觉得有用的一个高白色工匠盆。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.name: Wide White Artisan Pot
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.description: A wide white pot of soil artisans might find useful.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/DUVx.zhDescription: 工匠们可能会觉得有用的一个宽白色工匠盆。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Domi.name: Duviri Palace Throne
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Domi.description: A throne inspired by descriptions of the king's palace in Tales of Duviri.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Domi.zhDescription: 一个王座，灵感来自《双衍王境故事集》中对王宫的描述。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Orowyrm's Sanctum Display
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.zhName: 奥金魇龙的圣所展示图
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: An elegant depiction of the fabled Orowyrm.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.zhDescription: 优雅地描绘了传说中的奥金魇龙。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Nigh.name: Hero of Duviri Display
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Nigh.zhName: 双衍王境的英雄展示图
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Nigh.description: A hero on the back of a loyal Kaithe, as described in the storybook, Tales of Duviri.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Nigh.zhDescription: 一位英雄骑乘着忠诚的绝灵骥，就像《双衍王境故事集》中描绘的那样。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Puzz.name: Watchful Paragrimm
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Puzz.description: The Watchful Paragrimm chooses to watch over those with keen minds.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Puzz.zhDescription: 警惕的幽幽鹰选择守望那些思维敏锐的人。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.name: Entrati Study Chair
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.description: A gilded chair upholstered with the finest silk. The perfect spot to sit and contemplate the Universe and beyond.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.zhDescription: 一把镀金的椅子，上面铺着上好的丝绸。这是坐下来沉思宇宙和外宇宙的绝佳位置。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.name: Entrati Serpentine Chair
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.description: An unorthodox chair of Albrecht Entrati’s own design.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.zhDescription: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛自己设计的一把另类椅子。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.name: Entrati Chaise Lounge
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.description: Curl up on the same chaise lounge that Albrecht Entrati’s favorite pet, Kalymos, once did.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.zhDescription: 蜷缩在阿尔布雷希特·英择谛最喜欢的宠物卡利莫斯曾经呆过的躺椅上。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.name: Entrati Globe Chandelier
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.description: Cast an aura of sophistication with this Entrati Chandelier.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.zhDescription: 用这款英择谛吊灯营造出精致的氛围。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.name: Entrati Candelabra
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.description: An elegant Candelabra that once adorned the secret laboratories of Albrecht Entrati.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.zhDescription: 曾经装饰过阿尔布雷希特·英择谛秘密实验室的优雅烛台。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.name: Entrati Grand Candelabra
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.description: A grand, gilded Candelabra originally found in the depths of Albrecht Entrati’s labs.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.zhDescription: 最初在阿尔布雷希特·英择谛实验室深处发现的宏伟镀金烛台。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.name: Entrati Wall Sconce
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.description: Create a timeless look with this wall sconce, plucked from the depths of Albrecht Entrati’s Deimos laboratory.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.zhDescription: 这款壁灯取自阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的火卫二实验室深处，打造出永恒的外观。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.name: Entrati Settee
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.description: Relax and ponder the unknown with this Entrati Settee.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.zhDescription: 使用这款英择谛沙发椅放松并思考未知。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.name: Entrati Stratalizer
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.description: A deeply complex machine of unknown function.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.zhDescription: 功能未知、极其复杂的机器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.name: Entrati Congromulator
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.description: Designed and built by Albrecht Entrati, the precise purpose of this machine is as much of an enigma as the man himself.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.zhDescription: 这台机器由阿尔布雷希特·英择谛设计和制造，其确切用途与他本人一样是个谜。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.name: Entrati Temporal Cartograph
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.description: Used by Albrecht Entrati to chart a temporal path to eras unknown.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.zhDescription: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛用此绘制通向未知时代的时间路径。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.name: Entrati Ottoman
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.description: Relax, as Albrecht Entrati must have, with this timeless ottoman.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.zhDescription: 踏上这款经久不衰的脚凳放松身心，就像阿尔布雷希特·英择谛所做的一样。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.name: Entrati Stool
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.description: A sophisticated stool. Perfect for lab work and deep concentration.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.zhDescription: 一把精致的凳子。非常适合实验室工作和深度专注。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.name: Observant Vitreum

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.name: Noctua's Paragrimm

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/EntratiLabs.zhDescription: 一只幽幽鹰从夜枭的书页中升起，在轨道飞行器中陪伴你。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Events/Citr.name: Belric and Rania Reunited
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Events/Citr.description: A memory of the lovers, Belric and Rania, preserved in crystal.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.name: Jade Ophanim Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.description: Be not afraid with Jade's gaze in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.zhDescription: 不必害怕 Jade 在轨道飞行器中注视的目光。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.name: Jade's Promise Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.description: Feathers of memory, lovingly collected. The gift of self, immortalized in motes of steadfast light.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.zhDescription: 记忆之羽，悉心珍藏。献予自己的礼物，化作永恒的微光，永垂不朽。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.name: Heurodis Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.description: Invite the spirits of the Otherworld into your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.zhDescription: 邀请异世界的灵魂进入你的轨道飞行器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Leverian/Iv.name: Secret History Replica
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Leverian/Iv.description: A replica of the archive that held 'The Secret History of the Orokin Court,' by the historian Porvis. Notably containing the telling of Ivara and the Myrmidon.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Leverian/Iv.zhDescription: 保存着由历史学家珀维斯撰写的《奥罗金宫廷秘史》的档案副本。值得注意的是，其中包含了 Ivara 和密尔弥多的故事。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Leverian/Li.name: Lua's Pack Mural
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Leverian/Li.description: This mural cycles through four elegant portraits of the wolves that once guarded Lua: Dynar the shadowed, Raksh the defender, Lycath the stalwart, and Ulfrun the fierce.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Leverian/Li.zhDescription: 这幅壁画循环展示了四张曾经守护月球的狼群的优雅肖像：暗影者戴拿、防御者亚克什、顽强的莱卡斯，和凶猛的乌尔佛伦。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Leverian/Li.zhDescription: 凶猛强大——乌尔佛伦的优雅肖像。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/NewWar/Lise.name: Zariman Mattress
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/NewWar/Lise.description: Many troubled dreams were dreamed on this mattress.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/NewWar/Lise.zhDescription: 许多烦恼的梦都是在这床垫上做的。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/NewWar/Lise.name: Zariman Pillow
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/NewWar/Lise.description: A place for a Drifter to lay their head.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/NewWar/Lise.zhDescription: 一个可以让漂泊者稍作休息的地方。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/NewWar/Lise.name: Zariman Table
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/NewWar/Lise.description: You never know when an unexpected guest will drop by.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Bi.description: 'See, now your family is all together in your nest.' - Loid
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Bi.zhDescription: '看，你的家人现在都在你的小窝里团聚了。'——洛德

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/De.name: Tagfer Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/De.description: 'You will always have a home here, Tagfer. With us.' - Loid
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/De.zhDescription: '标弃，这里永远是你的家，和我们在一起。'——洛德

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Fi.name: Fibonacci Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Fi.description: 'Biped, you clearly crave the companionship of your intellectual superior. How laudable.' - Fibonacci
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Fi.zhDescription: '两脚兽，你显然渴望与智力高于你的人为伴。多么值得称赞啊。'——斐波那契

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Ga.name: Gauss Prime Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Ga.description: A cuddly floof of golden thread.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Ga.zhDescription: 用金色丝线钩织的软萌玩偶。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Conquera Kuaka Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: This Kuaka is so grateful you adopted it for charity!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 这只库阿卡非常感谢你为慈善事业收养了它！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Conquera Sawgaw Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: This Sawgaw is so grateful you adopted it for charity!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 这只梭歌非常感谢你为慈善事业收养了它！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Amir Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: Now you can give Amir the hugs he appreciates so much!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 现在你可以给阿米尔一个他非常期待的拥抱了！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Aoi Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: This Stuffie Buddy was approved by Aoi personally. Can be hugged without fear of crushing.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 这款毛绒小伙伴是由碧亲自认证的，可以抱在怀里，不用担心被压坏。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Arthur Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: 'My studies of the 1999 period have revealed a priceless relic known as the Stuffie Buddy. We must recreate the wonders of the past.' - Loid
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: '我对 1999 时期的研究发现了一个名叫‘毛绒小伙伴'的无价文物。我们必须重现过去的奇迹。'——洛德

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Neolyst Natah Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: Change of plans: leave nothing uncuddled with this adorable floof.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 计划有变：和这个可爱玩偶在一起好好拥抱吧。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Baro Ki'Teer Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: Baro returns from his latest foray into the Void in a softer, more huggable form.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: Baro 从虚空之旅中归来，现在他的样子更加柔软，更能惹人喜爱。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Eskhatos Ki'Teer Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: This unusual floof was likely the result of a manufacturing error. Will you accept it into your home, Tenno?
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 这个奇特的玩偶很可能是生产过程中的瑕疵。Tenno，你会把它带回家吗？

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Beach Kavat Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: A very special Floof commemorating your participation in Tactical Alert: Dog Days. FOR SQUISHY HONOR!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 一个非常特别的玩偶，以纪念你在战术警报：三伏天中的参与。为了湿漉漉的荣誉！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: DJ RoM Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: When DJ RoM speaks, the world tunes in! And this reporter was no exception. The whole crew from On-lyne nodded along as DJ said, 'We became a group because we share a love for music.' Talk about squad goals!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 当打碟王一开口，全世界都在倾听！这位记者也不例外。当打碟王说'我们之所以组成这个团体，是因为我们都热爱音乐'时，线上时代的所有成员都点头表示同意。这才是团队目标！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Technocyte DJ RoM Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: When DJ RoM speaks, the world tunes in! And this reporter was no exception. The whole crew from On-lyne nodded along as DJ said, 'We became a group because we - infect people.' Talk about squad goals!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 当打碟王一开口，全世界都在倾听！这位记者也不例外。当打碟王说'我们之所以组成这个团体，是因为我们都——感染人'时，线上时代的所有成员都点头表示同意。这才是团队目标！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Desert Skate Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: Avoid shifting sands with this squishy little fella!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 通过这湿漉漉的小家伙来避免流沙！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Drillbit Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: Drillbit keeps it 100% real, as always. No sugarcoating here. He told us straight up, 'Once you get a taste of fame, you're hooked.' Honesty like that is why we love him!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 钻头小子一如既往地保持百分百的真实。从不讲虚话。他直截了当地告诉我们，'一旦你尝到了名气的滋味，你就会上瘾。'正是这种坦率让我们如此喜爱他！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Technocyte Drillbit Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhName: 科技细胞钻头小子玩偶
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: Drillbit keeps it 100% real, as always. No sugarcoating here. He told us straight up, 'Once you get a taste of - hearts - you're hooked.' Honesty like that is why we love him!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 钻头小子一如既往地保持百分百的真实。从不讲虚话。他直截了当地告诉我们，'一旦你尝到了——心脏——的滋味，你就会上瘾。'正是这种坦率让我们如此喜爱他！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Drippy Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: In case of waterworks, this cuddly Drippy floof is here to help!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 如果想哭了，这只毛茸茸的滴答玩偶可以陪伴你！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Eleanor Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: Eleanor's cuddly replica, guaranteed not to get in your head or bare her fangs at you.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 埃莉诺的可爱复制品，保证不会钻入你的脑袋，也不会对你露出尖牙。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Harddrive Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: Harddrive is the ultimate hype machine! Right before hitting the stage, he was all about the team spirit, shouting, 'Let's get out there and show our fans how much we love them!'
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 硬盘是极致的气氛制造者！在登上舞台之前，他充满团队精神，高声呼喊'让我们走出去，向我们的粉丝们展示我们是怎么爱他们的！'

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Technocyte Harddrive Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: Harddrive is the ultimate hype machine! Right before hitting the stage, he was all about the team spirit, shouting, 'Let's get out there and show our fans how much we - destroy - them!'
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 硬盘是极致的气氛制造者！在登上舞台之前，他充满团队精神，高声呼喊'让我们走出去，向我们的粉丝们展示我们是怎么——摧毁——他们的！'

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.name: Packet Floof
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: Packet's dressing room is every gamer's dream! With a console fired up, he flashed the biggest grin and shouted 'Instagib!' as digital carnage exploded across the screen. Luckiest teen ever? Absolutely!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.zhDescription: 数据使者的更衣室是每个玩家的梦想！游戏主机全速运转，他露出灿烂的笑容，高呼'秒杀！'，屏幕里瞬间血花四溅。这是世界上最幸运的少年吗？绝对是！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: A 1m patch of Tau Xenoflora to decorate your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 1 米长的 Tau 异星花，用来装饰你的轨道飞行器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Xenoflora Patch (2m)
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: A 2m patch of Tau Xenoflora to decorate your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 2 米长的 Tau 异星花，用来装饰你的轨道飞行器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Xenoflora Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: Wrought in memory of the Xenoflora of Tau, its beauty can be preserved in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 为了纪念 Tau 的异星花而打造，它的美丽现在可以保存在你的轨道飞行器中。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Gilded Microscope
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: Orokin archimedean instruments were status symbols as well as tools of study.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 奥罗金哲士仪器既是身份象征，也是研究工具。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Gilded Alchemy Stand
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: Gold assists with conductivity in some areas of study, but here is purely decorative.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 黄金在某些研究领域有助于导电，但在这里纯属装饰用途。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Orokin Cask
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: While purported to house all manner of precious resources, in truth these containers primarily contained various strong drinks.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 这些容器虽然号称能存放各类珍贵资源，实际上主要盛装着各种烈性酒。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Orokin Conduit
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: Tubing used to protect the volatile energy sources the Orokin would often use.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 用于保护奥罗金人常用的易挥发能源的管道。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Orokin Sealed Storage
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: Used to house volatile and dangerous substances in Orokin installations.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 用于储存奥罗金设施中易挥发且危险的物质。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Orokin Arc Conduit
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: A gilded component used in the operation of Orokin infrastructure.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 奥罗金基础设施运作中使用的镀金组件。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Camp Bed
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: Better than the ground, but not by much.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 比睡在地上强，但也好不了多少。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Anarch Storage Crate
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: A container for all manner of Anarch war supplies.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 用来存放自由派战争物资的容器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Anarch Storage Drum
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: A cylindrical storage receptacle used by Anarch forces.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 自由派使用的圆柱形储存容器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Anarch Anti-tank trap
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: A simple trap designed to impede even the most advanced Orokin tank.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 一个简单的陷阱，足以阻挡最先进的奥罗金坦克。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Tauron Academy Desk
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: A desk used at Tauron Academy.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: Tauron 学院使用的书桌。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Tauron Academy Table
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: A double-leaf table used at Tauron Academy.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: Tauron 学院使用的双层折叠桌。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Gilded Plinth
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: A stand made for only the most precious of Orokin belongings.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 专为奥罗金最珍贵的物品打造的底座。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Gilded Feather Quill Set
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: An ornate writing implement used primarily to sign paperwork.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 一种主要用于签署文书的华丽书写工具。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Sentient Bone Effigy (Medium)
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: A staked figure used by Anarchs to demarcate an area claimed by a belligerent force.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 自由派用于标记交战势力所占领区域的桩状物。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Sentient Bone Effigy (Large)
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: A large staked figure used by Anarchs to demarcate an area claimed by a belligerent force.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 自由派用于标记交战势力所占领区域的大型桩状物。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.name: Somatic Bearer Memorial
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.description: Honor the memory of Old Tau and the Somatic Bearers who fought at your side with this interactive Xenoflora decoration.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Tau/LisetPr.zhDescription: 用这款互动式异星花装饰来缅怀远古 Tau 上和曾与你并肩作战的活体载体。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/ClemT.name: Dashing Through the Vallis Display
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/ClemT.description: A festive display of Clem and Popcorn. Art created by Ritens.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/ClemT.zhDescription: Clem 和小米花的节庆展示图。由 Ritens 创作的艺术作品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/Conqu.name: Conquera 2023 Community Display
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/Conqu.description: A community-made fanart Display for the Quest to Conquer Cancer. Art created by Maelibun.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/Conqu.zhDescription: 玩家社区为征服癌症活动制作的粉丝艺术展示图，由 Maelibun 创作。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUBoo.name: Rail Agent Manifest Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUBoo.zhName: 航道特工货物清单装饰
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUBoo.description: Logs of an unknown rail agent. A quaint addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUBoo.zhDescription: 一位无名航道特工的日志。给着陆器平添了一份古雅。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCon.name: Solaris Cargo Crate Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCon.zhName: 索拉里斯货物储存箱装饰
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCon.description: Conforms to standard retention bracket specs for all make of rail tractor. And, coincidentally, your lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCon.zhDescription: 符合标准的滞留支架，适用于各类航道牵引机。并且，巧合的是，也适用于你的着陆器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCoo.name: Fortuna-Model Coolant Pod Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCoo.zhName: 福尔图娜型冷却舱装饰
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCoo.description: For sample containment and transfer. Adds a rugged look to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCoo.zhDescription: 用于样本的储存和运输。给任何着陆器增加了粗犷的外观。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.name: Solaris Food Box Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.description: Those Solaris still utilizing traditional ingestion methods (often children) take sustenance from foods such as these energy bars. Place about your lander to give it that lived-in feel.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.zhDescription: 那些索拉里斯人仍然使用着传统的进食方式（主要是小孩），从比如能量棒这样的食物中获取养分。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以增加生活气息。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.name: Solaris Food Can Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.description: Those Solaris still utilizing traditional ingestion methods (often children) take sustenance from foods such as processed fish. Place about your lander to give it that lived-in feel.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.zhDescription: 那些索拉里斯人仍然使用着传统的进食方式（主要是小孩），从比如能量棒这样的食物中获取养分。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以增加生活气息。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.name: Solaris Canteen Tray Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.zhName: 索拉里斯餐厅托盘装饰
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.description: A meal tray for a Solaris citizen still utilizing traditional ingestion methods. Place about your lander to give it that lived-in feel.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.zhDescription: 仍以传统方式进食的索拉里斯市民所使用的食物托盘。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以增加生活气息。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.name: Solaris Supply Cart Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.zhName: 索拉里斯补给货车装饰
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.description: Favored by rig jockeys for efficient transportation of parts and supplies. Give your lander that seat-of-your-pants scoundrel feel.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.zhDescription: 受到技工的喜爱，可以有效地运输零件和补给。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以增加一种'老子的专属座驾'的感觉。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.name: Localized Air Purifier Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.description: Off-gassed coolant can be fatal to those with organic respiratory systems. Add this decoration to your lander to evoke the smells of Fortuna.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.zhDescription: 废气中的冷却液对于有机呼吸系统是致命的。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以唤起福尔图娜的气息。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.name: Solaris Supply Rack Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.description: A common sight on various decks and in the sumps, these racks allow much-needed tools and parts to remain within arm's reach. A tasteful addition to any engine room.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.zhDescription: 在多种甲板和污水池中常见，这种架子使得许多常用工具和零件触手可及。放置在引擎室中别有一番风味。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.name: Solaris Sawchain Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.description: Can be used as metal-cutter or filer. A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.zhDescription: 可以被用于金属切割或锉修。着陆器中的实用装备。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.name: Solaris Motherwrench Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.description: Primarily used in the opening and closing of coolant sluices. A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.zhDescription: 主要用于打开或关闭冷却液水闸。着陆器中的实用装备。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.name: Solaris Diagnostic Tool Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.zhName: 索拉里斯诊断工具装饰
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.description: Useful for taking atmospheric readings and measuring the thermal properties of coolant. A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.zhDescription: 测量大气读数和冷却液热性能时很有用。着陆器中的实用装备。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.name: Solaris Sampler Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.description: Used by geologists, technicians, plumbers, hydrologists, terraforming engineers, slurry monitors, sumpers, crud divers... A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.zhDescription: 被地质学家、技师、水管工、水文学家、地球化改造工程师、泥浆监视员、污水池操作工、污垢深潜员等等使用。着陆器中的实用装备。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUToo.name: Solaris Toolbox Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUToo.description: For when you really need that thermal prong within manipulator's reach. A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUToo.zhDescription: 当你非常需要操纵器可以抓取那个热能探针时很有用。着陆器中的实用装备。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUToo.name: Solaris Supplies Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUToo.description: Everything you need to refill nutrient canisters, recharge tools and protect what organics you have remaining. How you present it in your Lander is up to you.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUToo.zhDescription: 加满营养罐、工具充电、保护你剩下的有机部分，你需要的应有尽有。至于你如何将之展现在着陆器上就由你决定了。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTru.name: Widebody Ore Transport Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTru.description: Minature model of a commonly-used mining vehicle. The kids seem to like it. Why not add it to your lounge area?
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTru.zhDescription: 常用采矿车辆的缩小模型。小孩子们看上去很喜欢。为何不把它加入你的休息区域呢？

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/ContainerDe.name: Nanospore Culture Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/ContainerDe.description: A Nanospore Culture resource container to place in your Orbiter.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: Humble Beginnings
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Fear not poverty. Poverty is the bitter soil in which sweet desire blossoms.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.zhDescription: 不要惧怕贫穷。贫穷是能激起甜美欲望的痛苦土壤。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: To The City
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Fortune despises the idle man. Stasis is death. Always move forward.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.zhDescription: 财富不会眷顾懒惰的人。停滞等于死亡。要不断前行。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: What Right Do They Have?
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Be envious. Covet. Then take what you desire.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.zhDescription: 嫉妒吧。觊觎吧。然后拿走你想要的东西。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: The Taking
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Deception is the sword of wisdom. Be wise.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.zhDescription: 欺骗是智慧之剑。学聪明点。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: Crawling Back
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Beware the idle man who would lull you back to idleness.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.zhDescription: 当心那个懒惰的人，他会麻痹你，让你变得像以前一样懒惰。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: The Gemstone
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Contentment is idleness. Desire inspires action. Nurture all desires.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.zhDescription: 知足就意味着懒惰。欲望会激发实际行动。滋养所有的欲望。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: Giving Back
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Charity is power. More charity is more power.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.zhDescription: 给予是力量。更多的给予就是更大的力量。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: Bury The Past
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Shun sentimentality. It is a weakness that binds the idle man.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.zhDescription: 避免多愁善感。这是制约懒惰之人的弱点。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: A New Empire
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Fulfill desire and others will. Follow.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.zhDescription: 当你能满足欲望，他人会，蜂拥追随。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: We Are Corpus
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: We are Desire. Ours is the grasping golden hand. We. Are. Corpus.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.zhDescription: 我们是欲望的化身。我们的手是紧抓黄金的手。我们，是， Corpus。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Cyte09Exalt.name: Timelost Artifact
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Cyte09Exalt.description: Long before the Orokin Era, there was a sharpshooter who would become legend. This decoration honors Cyte-09's Protoframe, Quincy.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Cyte09Exalt.zhDescription: 早在奥罗金时代之前，就有一位日后成为传奇的神枪手。这个装饰是为了纪念 Cyte-09 的原型战甲——昆西。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/DomsFinalDr.zhName: 德纳斯的陈年红葡萄酒
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/DomsFinalDr.description: A claret with notes of golden sunlight. The Leverian’s history of the Warframe Ash brings into question whether blood runs thicker than fine wine.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/DomsFinalDr.zhDescription: 散发着金色阳光气息的红葡萄酒。Ash 在莱弗博物馆的历史不由让人质疑鲜血是否比红酒更加浓郁。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JS2HunhowSt.zhDescription: 在这个变图展示图中，现实仅仅是一种视角，它展现了现实与可能之间的冲突。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JS2MAshPost.name: Cloning 101 Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JS2MAshPost.description: Many problems can be solved by the ability to be in two places at once. Many other problems are created this way. Faint traces of Efervon imply the artist may have had a mechanical hand.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JS2MAshPost.zhDescription: 如果能同时身处两地，许多问题便迎刃而解。但这种能力同时也带来了许多其他问题。微弱的艾弗旺痕迹暗示，这位艺术家可能有一只机械手。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JS2MGarudaP.name: Relationship Goals Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JS2MGarudaP.description: For the expression of extremely normal and measured feelings toward the object of your affection. Faint traces of Efervon imply the artist may have had a mechanical hand.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JS2MGarudaP.zhDescription: 用于表达对心上人那种极其平常且克制的感情。微弱的艾弗旺痕迹暗示，这位艺术家可能有一只机械手。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.name: Stay Together Display
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.description: This display celebrates the best of both worlds, and the worst of each. United or divided, they are two sides of the same whole.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.zhDescription: 这个展示图既展现了两种文化的优点，也揭露了它们的缺点。无论团结还是分裂，它们都是同一个整体的两面。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.name: Orion Alone Display
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.description: This display honors Orion, the burning heart. Schooled in vengeance, the only love he knows is death.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.zhDescription: 这个展示图是为了纪念 Orion，他拥有一颗燃烧的心。他从小就被复仇所熏陶，他唯一懂得的爱就是死亡。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.name: Sirius Alone Display
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.description: This display honors Sirius, the lonely star. Raised in shadow. Trained with dignity.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.zhDescription: 这个展示图在致敬 Sirius，一颗孤独的星。他在阴影中成长，在尊严中成长。
