/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCl.zhName: 浪漪珊瑚盘古底内务无人机
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCl.description: Fight dirt and grime with this aquatic Domestik Drone inspired by Merulina Pandea.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCl.zhDescription: 使用这款受浪漪珊瑚盘古底启发的水系内务无人机来对抗污垢。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCl.name: Merulina Prime Domestik Drone
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCl.zhName: 浪漪珊瑚 Prime 内务无人机
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCl.description: Merulina’s tiny spawn are used to foraging on the sea bed, and adapt easily to nibbling up dirt from an Orbiter floor.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCl.zhDescription: 浪漪珊瑚的幼体习惯于在海床上觅食，很容易适应啃食轨道飞行器地板上的污垢。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCo.name: Sukshma Regulator
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCo.description: This exquisitely designed decoration adds luxury and class to any Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCo.zhDescription: 这款精心设计的装饰给轨道飞行器来去了奢华感和经典的气质。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCo.name: Basilisk Fighter Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCo.description: A stunningly detailed representation of the signature Corpus fighter craft.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCo.zhDescription: 以惊人的细节展示了标志性的 Corpus 战机。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCo.name: Harpi Fighter Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCo.description: A stunningly detailed representation of the signature Corpus fighter craft.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCo.zhDescription: 以惊人的细节展示了标志性的 Corpus 战机。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCo.name: Weaver Fighter Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCo.description: A stunningly detailed representation of the signature Corpus fighter craft.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropCo.zhDescription: 以惊人的细节展示了标志性的 Corpus 战机。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropDo.name: Day of the Dead Shawzin
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropDo.description: Embrace the fallen with this ghoulish Shawzin. Play this instrument by equipping and using the included Shawzin Emote.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropDo.zhDescription: 用这把令人毛骨悚然的三线琴拥抱亡者。装备并使用内含的三线琴表情动作来弹奏这把乐器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropEi.name: Eidolon Relic
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropEi.description: A still-living fragment torn free from one of the feared Eidolons that stalk the plains beyond Cetus.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropEi.zhDescription: 从徘徊在希图斯之外的可怕夜灵身上撕下，仍然活动的碎片。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropFi.name: Fishing Boot
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropFi.description: A single boot, possibly of Grineer design, pulled from one of the ponds that dot the Eidolon Plains. Smells of Gulper and pondscum.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropFi.zhDescription: 一只靴子，可能是 Grineer 设计，从遍布夜灵平野的某个池塘中钓出。闻起来有股囊咽鱼和绿藻的气味。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGl.name: Onkko's Coffer
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGl.description: It is believed that Onkko protected the coffer's contents with a glass shatter lock.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGl.zhDescription: 据信昂克用一把玻璃做的碎裂锁保护了保险箱中的东西。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGr.name: Dawn Shawzin
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGr.description: Like the morning’s first light, this Shawzin will wake the spirit within. Play this instrument by equipping and using the included Shawzin Emote.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGr.zhDescription: 如早上的第一道晨光，这把三线琴会唤醒内在的灵魂。装备并使用内含的三线琴表情符号来弹奏这把乐器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGr.name: Grineer Crewship Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGr.description: A stunningly detailed representation of the signature Grineer spacecraft.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGr.zhDescription: 以惊人的细节展示了标志性的 Grineer 航天器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGr.name: Cutter Fighter Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGr.description: A stunningly detailed representation of the signature Grineer fighter craft.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGr.zhDescription: 以惊人的细节展示了标志性的 Grineer 战机。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGr.name: Flak Fighter Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGr.description: A stunningly detailed representation of the signature Grineer fighter craft.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGr.zhDescription: 以惊人的细节展示了标志性的 Grineer 战机。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGr.name: Taktis Fighter Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGr.description: A stunningly detailed representation of the signature Grineer fighter craft.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGr.zhDescription: 以惊人的细节展示了标志性的 Grineer 战机。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGy.name: Gyratory Sphere Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGy.description: Gyre will feel right at home with this decoration on display.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropGy.zhDescription: Gyre 将在展示这款装饰时感到像在家一样自在。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropHa.name: Sukshma Casing
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropHa.description: This exquisitely designed decoration adds luxury and class to any Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropHa.zhDescription: 这款精心设计的装饰给轨道飞行器来去了奢华感和经典的气质。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropHo.name: Sukshma Lumino
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropHo.description: This exquisitely designed decoration adds luxury and class to any Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropHo.zhDescription: 这款精心设计的装饰给轨道飞行器来去了奢华感和经典的气质。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropLo.name: Nelumbo Shawzin
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropLo.description: A sound like no other. Strum an ode to the Lotus with this unique sounding gold and violet Shawzin. Play this instrument by equipping and using the included Shawzin Emote.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropLo.zhDescription: 一种与众不同的声音。使用这把独特音响的金紫色的三线琴弹拨一首颂歌给 Lotus。装备并使用内含的三线琴表情符号来弹奏这把乐器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropMa.name: Dax's Shawzin
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropMa.description: This antique Orokin string instrument once belonged to a great Dax. The ancient ballad, 'Smiles from Juran,' is one of the few known examples of music composed for this instrument. Play this instrument by equipping and using the included Shawzin Emote.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropMa.zhDescription: 这个古老的奥罗金弦乐器曾经属于一个伟大的禁卫。古老的民谣《朱兰笑》，是为这种乐器创作的为数不多的已知乐曲之一。装备并使用内含的三线琴表情符号来弹奏这把乐器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropMa.name: Corbu Shawzin
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropMa.description: Shape intricate melodies with this geometric shawzin.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropMa.zhDescription: 通过这款几何状的三线琴来编织复杂的旋律。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropMa.name: Tiamat Shawzin
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropMa.description: Compose ballads of old threats risen anew, with this shawzin.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropMa.zhDescription: 用这把三线琴谱写旧时威胁再次崛起的民谣。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropMu.name: Sukshma Array
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropMu.description: This exquisitely designed decoration adds luxury and class to any Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropMu.zhDescription: 这款精心设计的装饰给轨道飞行器来去了奢华感和经典的气质。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropNa.name: Narmer Shawzin
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropNa.description: The golden Shawzin used by Narmer adherents to sing the praises of Ballas.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropNa.zhDescription: 合一众信徒用来赞美 Ballas 的金色三线琴。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropNe.name: Necramite
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropNe.description: The cooperative nature of this Necramite can be attributed to its omission from security protocols, and to the (almost) total absence of the Indifference from the Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropNe.zhDescription: 这种殁世微灵的合作性质可以归因于它被排除在安全协议之外，以及轨道飞行器几乎完全没有虚空无情之物的存在。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropNo.name: Sprodling
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropNo.description: Adopt one of Nokko's adorable Sprodlings to bounce around the orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropNo.zhDescription: 领养 Nokko 的一只可爱菌宝，让它在轨道飞行器周围蹦蹦跳跳。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropNo.name: Nightwave Landing Craft Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropNo.description: Adorn your Orbiter with this decoration representing the Nightwave Landing Craft.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropNo.zhDescription: 用这个代表午夜电波登陆艇的装饰来点缀你的飞行器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOl.name: Vintage Corpus Locker
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOl.description: Decorate the Orbiter with this miniature replica of an old model Corpus locker.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOl.zhDescription: 用这个古老型号的 Corpus 储物柜的微型复制品来装饰轨道飞行器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOp.name: Hood Display Black Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOp.description: A wooden frame to display a red-and-black hood of Quill design.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOp.zhDescription: 用来展示红黑色夜羽兜帽的木框。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOp.name: Hood Display Teal Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOp.description: A wooden frame to display a teal-colored hood of Quill design.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOp.zhDescription: 用来展示墨绿色夜羽兜帽的木框。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOp.name: Hood Display Grey Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOp.description: A wooden frame to display a grey hood of Quill design.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOp.zhDescription: 用来展示灰色夜羽兜帽的木框。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOr.name: Operator Switch
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOr.description: A switch used by operators to control access to their network.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOr.zhDescription: 一个指挥官用来控制其网络权限的开关。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOr.name: Agkani Stone
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOr.description: A stone marker, miraculously preserved from the Orokin era, polished smooth by time and accented with tooled gold.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOr.zhDescription: 一个石头记号，奇迹般地从奥罗金时代保存下来，被时光打磨抛光，并被金子手工点缀。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOr.name: Spotlight (Ostron)
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOr.description: A spotlight constructed by the Ostron people.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOr.zhDescription: 一盏由 Ostron 人建造的聚光灯。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOr.name: Domestik Carrion Drone
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOr.description: An Infested stowaway from one of your Missions, now content to wander your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOr.zhDescription: 一个从你的任务中偷跑出来的感染者，现在正满足地在你的轨道飞行器上游荡。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.name: Gilded Illumination
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.description: Illumination, crafted by Ostron glassworkers, fashioned and gilded to aesthetic perfection.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.zhDescription: 照明物，由 Ostron 玻璃工人制作，工艺和镀金都体现了极致的审美。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.name: Caged Condroc
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.description: A bird of prey to accompany you aboard the Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.zhDescription: 轨道飞行器中的猛禽伴侣。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.name: Temple Flesh
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.description: A small sample of sacred Temple flesh, iconic export of Cetus.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.zhDescription: 一小块神殿肉的样本，希图斯的标志性出口品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.name: Reclamator Balloon
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.description: One of Cetus' signature sights, in miniature.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.zhDescription: 缩小的希图斯标志性景象之一。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.name: Xartaan Lamp
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.description: Turquoise glass suspended in a handmade gilded basket, filled with bioluminescence.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.zhDescription: 青绿色的玻璃悬挂在手工制作的镀金篮子中，注有生物冷光物质。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.name: Caged Kuaka
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.description: A small rodent of Earthly origin to keep you company aboard the Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.zhDescription: 一种来自地球的小型啮齿类，可以在轨道飞行器中伴随你。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.name: Tenno Kindred Rug
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.description: Personalize your quarters with this unique rug.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.zhDescription: 用这个独特的毯子来个性化你的个人房间。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.name: Ostron Blau Rug
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.description: An Ostron rug featuring blue bands.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.zhDescription: 一种有蓝色带装饰的 Ostron 毯子

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.name: Ostron Verru Rug
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.description: An Ostron rug featuring green bands.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.zhDescription: 一种有绿色带装饰的 Ostron 毯子

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.name: Ostron Oraggu Rug
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.description: An Ostron rug featuring orange bands.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.zhDescription: 一种有橙色带装饰的 Ostron 毯子

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.name: Ostron Rahd Rug
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.description: An Ostron rug featuring red bands.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.zhDescription: 一种有红色带装饰的 Ostron 毯子

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.name: Ostron Yollau Rug
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.description: An Ostron rug featuring yellow bands.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.zhDescription: 一种有黄色带装饰的 Ostron 毯子

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.name: Statuette - Thousand-Year Fish
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.description: A glass carving depicting the colossal Thousand-Year Fish of Ostron legend.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropOs.zhDescription: 一个描绘着 Ostron 传奇的巨大千年灵鱼的玻璃雕刻。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropPi.name: Sukshma Support
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropPi.description: This exquisitely designed decoration adds luxury and class to any Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropPi.zhDescription: 这款精心设计的装饰给轨道飞行器来去了奢华感和经典的气质。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropRe.name: Sukshma Centribrace
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropRe.description: This exquisitely designed decoration adds luxury and class to any Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropRe.zhDescription: 这款精心设计的装饰给轨道飞行器来去了奢华感和经典的气质。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSU.name: Solaris Industrial Strip
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSU.description: Corpus-produced posters and signboards reminding Solaris workers of rights and safety protocols. Report nonconformists! Life is Profit, Profit is Life!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSU.zhDescription: 由 Corpus 出产的海报及布告板，提醒 Solaris 工人的权利及安全措施。一律举报不遵奉者！人生是利益，利益就是人生！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSe.name: Glowing Sentient Core Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSe.zhName: 发光的 Sentient 核心装饰
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSe.description: A single, warm Sentient core decoration for your orbiter - still illuminated by a shred of the power it once commanded.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSe.zhDescription: 一颗温暖的 Sentient 核心装饰，借由过去所拥有的力量仍在发光。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.name: Courtly Shawzin
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.description: Elite audiences appreciate the Courtly Shawzin’s elegant ornamentation.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.zhDescription: 精英阶层观众普遍欣赏典雅三线琴那优雅的装饰。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.name: Lonesome Shawzin
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.description: A creative soul rings out with each strum of the Lonesome Shawzin.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.zhDescription: 孤寂三线琴的每一次弹奏都会响起一个创造性的灵魂。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.name: Aristei Prime Shawzin
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.description: Long ago this Shawzin was played to entertain the Orokin court. Now its enduring music shall celebrate your victories.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.zhDescription: 很久以前，这把三线琴是奥罗金宫廷的御用乐器。而现在，它那悠扬的曲调，将为你的胜利而奏响。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.name: Lizzie
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.description: For some favored Tenno, Flare's infested guitar has consented to be played like any other instrument. Handle with respect - and caution.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.zhDescription: 对于某些受青睐的 Tenno 来说，弗莱尔的感染吉他已同意像其他乐器一样被演奏。请怀着敬意——并小心使用。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.name: Iridos Shawzin
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.description: A familiar sound with a distinctive new look.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.zhDescription: 一个熟悉的声音配上一款与众不同的新外观。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.name: Kira's Shawzin
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.description: This instrument belonged to a much-loved member of the Holdfasts, who would often cheer up her companions with it.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.zhDescription: 这件乐器曾属于坚守者中一位深受喜爱的成员，她经常会弹奏它来鼓舞同伴。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.name: Void's Song Shawzin
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.description: Kira played her shawzin to uplift the spirits of Zariman crewmembers. Her song and her memory live on in the Void.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.zhDescription: 吉拉演奏她的三线琴来振奋扎里曼船员的精神。她的歌声和记忆永存于虚空之中。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSi.name: Simaris Offerings Replica Console
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSi.zhName: Simaris 声望奖励复刻控制台
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSi.description: Hunter, behold the rewards of your work in Synthesis. A non-functioning Simaris console decoration for your Orbiter.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/OstronHeadS.name: Telamon Dance of Death
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/OstronHeadS.description: A moment frozen in time, gruesomely magnificent. This harrowing piece was found among a debris field that made Drusus Leverian reconsider legends about the Warframe Atlas.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/OstronHeadS.zhDescription: 时光凝结在这一瞬间，美的令人毛骨悚然。这件惊世骇俗的作品是在一片碎石区发现的，这让德枢·莱弗重新考虑了关于 Atlas 的一些传说。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/OwlOrdisSta.name: Ordis Reified Statue
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/OwlOrdisSta.description: A decorative statue that recognizes steadfast loyalty in an ever-changing universe.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/OwlOrdisSta.zhDescription: 一个装饰性的雕像，代表着在千变万化的宇宙中矢志不渝的忠诚。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/ParazonPost.name: Parazon Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/ParazonPost.description: Mercy Or Convert? A poster for your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/ParazonPost.zhDescription: 怜悯之击还是感化？一张给轨道飞行器的海报。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/PedistalPri.name: Pedestal Prime
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/PedistalPri.description: Behold, the singular vision of a great artist and the life’s work of a master craftsmen. An artifact so refined, so imbued with the finest material that it has no equal in this system. This is the plinth that all others aspire to be. This is Pedestal Prime.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/PedistalPri.zhDescription: 看吶，来自伟大艺术家的卓越眼光和手艺大师的毕生杰作。这一款精心雕琢、使用最佳材质的工艺品，在这个星系都无可匹及。这就是基座中的王者，这就是基座 Prime。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotA.name: Gallixware Raku Vase
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotA.description: The grooves in this vase were shaped by the careful hands of artist Bren Terrasiam.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotA.zhDescription: 这个花瓶上的凹槽是由艺术家布伦·泰拉西姆精心塑造的。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotB.name: Gallixware Kaolin Bowl
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotB.description: The flowing pattern Bren Terrasiam painted onto this bowl is meant to promote serenity.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotB.zhDescription: 布伦·泰拉西姆在这个碗上所画的流线图案旨在宣扬静心之道。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotC.name: Gallixware Bisque Amphora
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotC.description: Bren Terrasiam fashioned custom amphorae for elite Orokin who stored and served fine wine with style.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotC.zhDescription: 布伦·泰拉西姆为奥罗金精英们定制的双耳瓶，他们以别具一格的方式储存和伺候美酒。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotD.name: Gallixware Coiled Vase
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotD.description: Bren Terrasiam lovingly fashioned and stacked clay coils to form this vase.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotD.zhDescription: 布伦·泰拉西姆用匠心和层叠的泥条盘筑成这个花瓶。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotE.name: Gallixware Studded Vase
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotE.description: Bren Terrasiam was renowned for his precision. The uniformity of this vase was typical in his fine ceramics.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotE.zhDescription: 布伦·泰拉西姆以精细着称。这个花瓶的均匀性是他精美陶瓷的典型特征。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotF.name: Gallixware Frit Plate
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotF.description: Orokin ceramic artist, Bren Terrasiam employed an old world glazing technique to give this plate a lustrous finish. Elites of the day admired his mastery of the ancient arts.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotF.zhDescription: 奥罗金陶瓷艺术家布伦·泰拉西姆采用旧世界的上釉技术为这个盘子赋予光泽。当时的精英们钦佩他对古代艺术的精通。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/ZephyrBobbl.description: A small wobbly statue of Zephyr.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/ZephyrBobbl.zhDescription: 一小座 Zephyr 摇头娃娃。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Arse.name: Arsenal Segment
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Arse.description: Install this segment in order to enable the Arsenal within your orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Arse.zhDescription: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器上以启用军械库功能。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Arse.name: MELEE UPGRADE SEGMENT
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Arse.description: Strengthen your Arsenal with Melee Arcanes. This segment unlocks Exilus Slots for your Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Arse.zhDescription: 通过近战武器赋能强化你的军械库。这个模块会为你的近战武器解锁特殊功能槽。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Foun.name: AUXILIARY FORMA CRUCIBLE
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Foun.description: A foundry upgrade that allows two Forma to be crafted at the same time.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Foun.zhDescription: 允许在同一时间制造两个 FORMA 的铸造厂升级。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Foun.name: Landing Craft Foundry Segment
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Foun.description:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Foundry with the following features:

- Allows construction of Landing Craft
- Allows construction of Air Support Charges

Equip Air Support Charges in your Loadout's Gear.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Foun.zhDescription:
将轨道飞行器的铸造厂升级，可获得下列功能：

－可以制造登陆艇
－可以制造空中支持呼叫道具

在「军械库」>「携带装备」中装备「空中支援呼叫器」。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.name: Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.description: Allows the Incubator to breed Kavats.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.zhDescription: 可以让孵化器繁殖库娃。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.name: Incubator Segment
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.description: Install this segment to enable the pet incubator within your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.zhDescription: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器上以启用宠物孵化器功能。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.name: Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.description:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Incubator with the following features:

- Regress genetic aging of mature companions
- Egg incubation reduced by a day
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Gene.zhDescription:
升级轨道飞行器的孵化器来获得以下功能：

- 回退受老化基因影响的成熟同伴
- 孵化时间减少一天

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.name: HELMINTH ARCHON SHARD SEGMENT
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.zhName: HELMINTH 执刑官源力石模块
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.description: Allows the Helminth to socket Archon Shards in the current Warframe. Archon Shards permanently enhance various stats.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.zhDescription: 该模块允许 Helminth 将执刑官源力石嵌入当前战甲。执刑官源力石可以永久增强多种属性。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.name: HELMINTH COALESCENT SEGMENT
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.description: Allows the Helminth to fuse Archon Shards into more powerful variants through Coalescent Fusion and Ascent Fusion.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.zhDescription: 通过联结融合和升华融合，可让 Helminth 融合执刑官源力石来获得更强大的源力石变体。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.name: HELMINTH SEGMENT
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.description: Empower the Helminth in your Orbiter and unlock the transfer of new abilities to your Warframes.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.zhDescription: 在轨道飞行器强化 Helminth，并解锁将新技能转移到战甲上的功能。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.name: HELMINTH INVIGORATION SEGMENT
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.description: Allows The Helminth to inject a Warframe with an Invigoration. Invigorations temporarily increase a Warframe's capabilities.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Infe.zhDescription: 允许 Helminth 为战甲注入活力。活化可以暂时增加战甲的能力。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Mods.name: Mod Fusion Segment
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Mods.description: Install this segment to enable the Mod Fusion function within the MODS terminal of your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Mods.zhDescription: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器的 Mod 终端机上以解锁 Mod 融铸功能。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Rail.name: Railjack Cephalon
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Rail.description: A Railjack Command Cephalon. Responsible for ships systems, mission completion and crew preservation.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Rail.zhDescription: 航道星舰指挥中枢。负责战舰系统、任务完成以及舰员保护。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Rail.name: RELIQUARY KEY
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Rail.description: Resembling a Void Key, this object appears to be a perfect match for the empty slot in the Railjack's reliquary.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Rail.zhDescription: 与虚空钥匙类似，这个物品明显与航道星舰里圣物装置的钥匙孔相匹配。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Void.name: VOID RELIC SEGMENT
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Void.description: Install this Void Relic Segment in your Orbiter to begin opening Void Relics. Void Relics contain valuables that are only determined when opened in Void Fissure missions. Void Relics can be obtained as mission rewards.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipFeatureItems/Void.zhDescription: 将此虚空遗物模块安装到你的轨道飞行器上，即可开启虚空遗物。虚空遗物内含的宝物只有在虚空裂缝任务中开启后才能确定。虚空遗物可以作为任务奖励获得。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/BlueSkyShip.name: Scimitar
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/BlueSkyShip.description: This blade-like landing craft is armed with Carpet Bomb air-support.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/BlueSkyShip.zhDescription: 这艘像刀刃一样的登陆艇装备了地毯式轰炸空中支援系统。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/DefaultShip.name: Liset
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/DefaultShip.description: The landing craft of choice utilised by the Tenno during their missions.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/DefaultShip.zhDescription: Tenno 执行任务期间会选择使用这艘登陆艇。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/GrineerShip.name: SKAUT
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/GrineerShip.description:
A Grineer Bolkor remodeled for Tenno reinforcement. Skaut's alert signal calls Kahl and his Grineer brothers for backup. When backup is active, use the alert signal to replenish your squad's health. Each squad member can call one additional Grineer brother to join the fight.

Also available in the Market after completing the Veilbreaker quest.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/GrineerShip.zhDescription:
一艘为了 Tenno 增援而重新改装的 Grineer 博寇。伺航的警报信号呼叫卡尔和他的 Grineer 兄弟们来支援。当支援起作用时，使用警报信号来补充你的小队生命值。每个小队成员可以额外呼叫一名 Grineer 兄弟加入战斗。

完成《破障者》系列任务后也可在商店内购得。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/GyroscopeShip.name: Xiphos
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/GyroscopeShip.description: Featuring Sentry Gun air-support, this stylish landing craft is an asset in any battle.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/GyroscopeShip.zhDescription: 装备有自动炮台的空中支援系统，这艘时尚的登陆艇在任何战斗中都是实用的座驾。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/InsectShip.name: Mantis
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/InsectShip.description: This insect-like landing craft features Med-Tower air-support.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/InsectShip.zhDescription: 这架虫型的登陆艇装置了治愈塔，可支援空中作战。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/NoraShip.name: Nightwave
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/NoraShip.description: A landing craft model that pays homage to the forever-wandering home of pirate DJ Nora Night. Stay deadly, Dreamers. Nightwave's air support releases powerful sound waves, destroying weaker enemies while stunning more powerful ones.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/NoraShip.zhDescription: 一款向海盗 DJ 诺拉·夜 的永恒漫游之家致敬的登陆艇型号。时刻保持强大与敏锐吧，梦回者。午夜电波的空中支援系统能够释放强力声波，它能摧毁弱小的敌人，同时也能让强大的敌人陷入眩晕。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/ZarimanShip.name: Parallax
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/ZarimanShip.description: The Parallax was designed for Zariman interplanetary research. It can deploy the advanced Orokin Eye air support, which would have allowed colonizers to study areas rich in rare resources before landing.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/ZarimanShip.zhDescription: （英文：PARALLAX）星察是为扎里曼的行星研究而设计的。它可部署先进的奥罗金之眼空中支援，可让殖民者在登陆前研究稀有资源丰富的地区。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenA.name: TRAINING DEBT-BOND
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenA.description:
The Taxmen call it an investment in our future, but loans to cover vocational and specialist training almost always cost more than you'll ever earn. Especially with the interest.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenA.zhDescription:
税务官将其称为对我们未来的投资，但是用来支付职业和专业培训的贷款几乎超过你的收入。尤其还有利息。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得

/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenB.name: SHELTER DEBT-BOND
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenB.description:
Covers everything from hab rent to insurance, docking permits and paying off that rail tractor. Big ticket items.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenB.zhDescription:
涵盖从栖所租金到保险，登陆许可和支付航道船舰的所有费用。高价物品。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得

/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenC.name: MEDICAL DEBT-BOND
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenC.description:
To get work you need mods. Then you need more work to pay for the mods, so you get more mods. And here we are.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenC.zhDescription:
要有更多工作，你需要改装。然后你需要更多的工作来支付改装，这样你才能得到更多的改装。所以我们现在才会这样。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得

/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenD.name: ADVANCES DEBT-BOND
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenD.description:
Sometimes a rig jockey needs a helping hand, so they get an advance on the next pay. Massive interest rates almost guarantee they'll be paying that off forever.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenD.zhDescription:
有时候一个技工需要一些帮助，所以他们可以预支下一次的工资。高额利率几乎可以保证他们将一辈子来偿还这笔费用。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得

/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenE.name: FAMILIAL DEBT-BOND
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenE.description:
Debts unpaid by one generation are passed to the next. Working to pay them off is seen as something to be proud of. What choice do they have?

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Items/Solaris/DebtTokenE.zhDescription:
上一代未付清的债务由下一代承接。努力付出偿还债务被视为一种值得的骄傲。他们有还能有什么选择？

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/Events/Isle.name: Invictus Signa
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/Events/Isle.description: This signa pays tribute to your steadfast dedication in the face of the mind-tormenting Murmur.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/Events/Isle.zhDescription: 这个头环致敬你在面对令人心神不宁的低语者时始终如一的坚定奉献。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/Events/Isle.name: Invictus Emergent Signa
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/Events/Isle.description: Though the influence of the Indifference grows stronger, this evolution of the Invictus signa proves that your defiance grows in equal measure.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/Events/Isle.zhDescription: 尽管虚空无情之物的影响日益增强，但不屈头环的进化证明了你的反抗精神也在以同样的力度增长。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/Events/Isle.name: Invictus Apex Signa
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/Events/Isle.description: The supreme version of this signa, signifying the denial of Neci Rusalka's false Duviri in Operation: Eight Claw.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/Events/Isle.zhDescription: 这个头环的最高版本，标志着在《行动代号：八爪》中对内奇·鲁莎卡那虚假双衍王境的否定。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/BaruukDelux.name: Liania Signa
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/BaruukDelux.description: The dignified drape of Baruuk Shaoshi's signature signa is the mark of a warrior committed to defending peace - by any means necessary.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/BaruukDelux.zhDescription: Baruuk 少室标志性头环的庄严图案，象征着一位不惜一切代价致力于捍卫和平的战士。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/ChoirFrameH.name: Motetique Signa
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/ChoirFrameH.description: Much as music enriches the atmosphere, the Motetique Signa enhances your appearance.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/ChoirFrameH.zhDescription: 正如音乐可以点缀氛围一般，圣歌头环亦可美化你的外表。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/CitrineDelu.name: Erato Signa
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/CitrineDelu.description: Citrine Aphrodita inspires epics of undying devotion with this graceful signature signa.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/CitrineDelu.zhDescription: Citrine 美神以这一优美的头环激发了人们对不朽献身精神的无限向往。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/Dex2026Lotu.name: Dex Signa
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/Dex2026Lotu.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the thirteenth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/Dex2026Lotu.zhDescription: 这是 Lotus 为第一位从低温催眠中醒来的 Tenno 所准备的一份十三周年纪念礼物。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/DexVinesCro.name: Envine Signa
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/DexVinesCro.description: Bring elegance to your look with this regal wreath.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/DuelistCrow.description: A circlet from ancient times, its ornamentation signifying wisdom and strength.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Crowns/GarudaBlood.name: Karotic Signa

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Dragon/SWThyrusSki.description: A unique skin for the Chroma Warframe, designed by Stenchfury.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Dragon/SWThyrusSki.zhDescription: Chroma 战甲的独特外观，由 Stenchfury 设计。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/DualAxe/DaggerAxe.name: Dual Zoren Dagger-Axe Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/DualAxe/DaggerAxe.zhName: 佐伦双斧 戈刃外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/DualAxe/DaggerAxe.description: Replaces the edges of the Dual Zoren with multiple Rubedo blades.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/DualAxe/DaggerAxe.zhDescription: 使用多个红化结晶刀片替换佐伦双斧的边缘。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Duelist/DuelistAgi.name: Narin Agile Animation Set
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Duelist/DuelistAgi.description: The Agile Animation Set for Narin.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Duelist/DuelistAlt.name: Narin Baridegi Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Duelist/DuelistAlt.description: This alternate helmet for Narin evokes an otherworldly flower of frost, accentuating her finesse and grace.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Duelist/DuelistAlt.zhDescription: Narin 的替换头盔让人联想到一朵超凡脱俗的霜花，突显了她的优雅与细致。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Duelist/DuelistHel.name: Narin Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Duelist/DuelistHel.description: The standard issue helmet for the Narin Warframe.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Duelist/DuelistNob.name: Narin Noble Animation Set
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Duelist/DuelistNob.description: The Noble Animation Set for Narin.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Duelist/DuelistSki.name: Narin Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Duelist/DuelistSki.description: The standard issue skin for the Narin Warframe.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Duviri/DuviriSword.name: Gaforn Sword and Shield Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Duviri/DuviriSword.description: Evoke the might of a giant.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaF.name: Vengeful Flame Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaF.description: A fiery ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaF.zhDescription: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的炽烈幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaI.name: Vengeful Chill Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaI.description: An icy ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaI.zhDescription: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的冰凉幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaI.name: Vengeful Shockwave Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaI.description: An ephemera that echoes punishing impacts, seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaI.zhDescription: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的惩戒性冲击回声幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaL.name: Vengeful Charge Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaL.description: A shocking ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaL.zhDescription: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的电击幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaM.name: Vengeful Pull Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaM.description: A magnetic ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaM.zhDescription: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的磁力幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaT.name: Vengeful Toxin Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaT.description: An ephemera of toxic miasma seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaT.zhDescription: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的毒性瘴气幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaT.name: Vengeful Trickster Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaT.description: The energy of the trickster Warframes is embodied in this colorful ephemera, seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaT.zhDescription: 战甲骗术的能量包含在这个多彩的幻纹里，从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ArchonShar.name: Shard Hex Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ArchonShar.description: Expose the power that courses through you. This Ephemera dynamically updates with your Warframe’s installed Archon Shards.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ArchonShar.zhDescription: 展现流淌全身的力量。这个幻纹会随着你战甲上安装的执刑官源力石进行动态更新。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ArchonShar.name: Shard Bane Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ArchonShar.description: Express the Archon's fury. This Ephemera dynamically updates with your Warframe's installed Archon Shards.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ArchonShar.zhDescription: 表现执刑官的怒火。这个幻纹会随着你战甲上安装的执刑官源力石进行动态更新。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AshGeminiE.name: Syndir Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AshGeminiE.description: Obscure the identity of the killer within with this translucent ephemera. The mark of a Scoria assassin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AshGeminiE.zhDescription: 用这种半透明的幻纹掩盖凶手的身份。这是火山石组织刺客的标志。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AvatarBloo.name: Bleeding Body Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AvatarBloo.zhDescription: 散发出令人毛骨悚然的血腥效果。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AvatarSmok.name: Smoking Body Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AvatarSmok.description: A hazy smoke trail emanates from your Warframe.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AvatarSmok.zhDescription: 让战甲散发出朦胧的烟雾轨迹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEpheme.name: Ki'Teer Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEpheme.description: Spread the influence of the System's greatest trader wherever you go!
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEpheme.zhDescription: 无论你身在何处，都扩散该星系最伟大商人的影响！

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEvilEp.name: Eskhatos Ki'Teer Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEvilEp.description: Those in the vicinity of this ephemera claim to hear baneful whispers, but surely these are fanciful tales.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEvilEp.zhDescription: 据说靠近幻纹的人们能听到邪恶的低语，但这显然是些虚幻的传闻。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEvilEp.name: Eskhatos Infinitas Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEvilEp.description: This ephemera is an endless source of sinister style.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEvilEp.zhDescription: This ephemera is an endless source of sinister style.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaruukDelu.name: Neviti Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaruukDelu.description: Encircled by harmonious energy, the shifting balance of conflict reveals itself in Baruuk Shaoshi's signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaruukDelu.zhDescription: 在和谐能量的环绕下，冲突的微妙平衡在 Baruuk 少室的标志性幻纹中显露出来。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaruukPrim.name: Vaaditum Prime Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaruukPrim.description: Honor your serenity and that of others as you display Baruuk's symbol. In relays, temporarily bestow the Vaaditum Prime Ephemera upon others.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaruukPrim.zhDescription: 展示 Baruuk 的象征，尊重你与他人的宁静。在中继站中，可暂时将惟喜 Prime 幻纹赠予他人。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BatWingsEp.name: Nyctalus Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BatWingsEp.description: Spread the membranous wings of night with this haunting Ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BatWingsEp.zhDescription: 用这款阴魂不散的幻纹来展开夜之翅膜。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BatsEpheme.name: Naberus Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BatsEpheme.description:
A warrior walks, alone in crowds
Companion to moon and mist and bat
With a vision grim the mind enshrouds
This fearsome, deathborne aristocrat.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BatsEpheme.zhDescription:
孤傲的战士，独行于族群
唯有月雾蝠，常伴其左右
眼神若冰霜，内心亦朦胧
化身为恐惧，死亡之贵族

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CalibanDel.name: Heurodis Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CalibanDel.description: Carry the spirits of the Otherworld with you.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CalibanDel.zhDescription: 与黄泉归来的灵魂作伴。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CitrineDel.name: Didyma Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CitrineDel.description: Leave lingering sparks in the hearts of all you encounter with Citrine Aphrodita’s signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CitrineDel.zhDescription: Citrine 美神的标志性幻纹将在你遇到的所有人心中留下挥之不去的火花。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Conquera20.name: Conquera II Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Conquera20.description: Wear this floral Ephemera as a symbol of support in the Quest to Conquer Cancer.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Conquera20.zhDescription: 佩戴此花艺幻纹作为支持「征服癌症活动」的象征。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Conquera20.name: Conquera III Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Conquera20.description: Wear this streaming ephemera as a symbol of support of the Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation Quest.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Conquera20.zhDescription: 佩戴这款流光幻纹，表达你对玛嘉烈公主癌症基金慈善活动的支持。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ConqueraEp.name: Conquera Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ConqueraEp.description: Wear this Ribbon Ephemera as a symbol of support in the Quest to Conquer Cancer.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ConqueraEp.zhDescription: 佩戴此缎带幻纹作为支持「征服癌症活动」的象征。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.name: Sybillina Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.description: Information flows like live current through this Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.zhDescription: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的、信息若电流般流淌的幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.name: Zarina Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.description: A blazingly regal Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.zhDescription: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的炽烈尊贵幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.name: Gloriana Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.description: An icily imperious Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.zhDescription: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的冰冷傲慢幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.name: Lucretia Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.description: Hatch venomous plots in this Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.zhDescription: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的、生出恶毒阴谋的幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.name: Solena Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.description: A magnetically compelling Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.zhDescription: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的磁性引力幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.name: Hypatia Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.description: A radiant Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.zhDescription: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的辐射幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.name: Kyruna Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.description: A striking Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.zhDescription: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的冲击幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CupidWings.name: Eros Wings Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CupidWings.description: Wings to lift your love starward.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CupidWings.zhDescription: 让你的爱展翅飞向星空。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DeimosEphe.name: Festering Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DeimosEphe.description: Pestilent sores and bubbles burst with your every move.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DeimosEphe.zhDescription: 致命的脓包随着你的一举一动而膨胀爆裂。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DexEphemer.name: Dex Laurus Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DexEphemer.description: Commemorate 12 cycles since the Tenno first awoke with this graceful ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DexEphemer.zhDescription: 通过这款优雅的幻纹纪念 Tenno 首次苏醒以来的 12 个周期。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DogDaysEph.name: Dog Days Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DogDaysEph.description: Soak off with this Dog Days Ephemera - Only for a limited time!
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DogDaysEph.zhDescription: 沉浸在这个三伏天幻纹中 — 仅在限定时间内可用！

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DuelistEph.name: Gangrim Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DuelistEph.description: May a chill descend upon you with the frozen embrace of Narin's signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DuelistEph.zhDescription: 愿 Narin 的标志性幻纹将寒意伴着冰冷的拥抱降临于你。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DuelistSpi.name: Seonang Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DuelistSpi.description: Call on a frosty spirit to swirl around you.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DuelistSpi.zhDescription: 召唤冰霜精灵环绕着你。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraGa.name: Catena Prime Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraGa.description: Levitating crystals weave a web of luminous connections. Gara Prime’s signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraGa.zhDescription: 轻盈的水晶编织出晶莹剔透的网。Gara Prime 的标志性幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraNe.name: Baurahn Prime Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraNe.description: Coiling, hissing, the spirits of flame ride with their kin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraNe.zhDescription: 盘旋缠绕、嘶嘶作响，烈焰之灵与其亲族同行。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraPr.name: Corposant Prime Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraPr.zhName: 圣艾尔摩之火 Prime 幻纹
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraPr.description: Luminous plasma leaps off surfaces in your presence.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraPr.zhDescription: 发光的等离子体会在你所经之处跃出地面。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.name: Spring Step Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.description: Mark the path to a new season with a trail of decorative eggs - only for a limited time!
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.zhDescription: 布置装饰性蛋来标记通往新季节的道路-只在限定的时间内！

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.name: Eidolon Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.description: Move as the Eidolons and burn the ground coldly with footsteps of shimmering Void energy.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.zhDescription: 像夜灵般移步，以闪烁的虚空能量，无情地践踏并焚烧地面。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.name: Shocking Step Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.description: Your Warframe leaves crackling footprints in its wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.zhDescription: 让战甲在身后留下劈啪作响的足迹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsH.name: Blazing Step Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsH.description: Your Warframe leaves flaming footprints in its wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsH.zhDescription: 让战甲在身后留下火焰般的足迹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsI.name: Freezing Step Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsI.description: Your Warframe leaves icy footprints in its wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsI.zhDescription: 让战甲在身后留下结冰的足迹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsM.name: Fae Path Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsM.description: Leave a trail of fireflies and forest leaves in your wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsM.zhDescription: 在你身后留下一道萤火虫和树叶的足迹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsP.name: Seeding Step Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsP.description: Your Warframe leaves grassy footprints in its wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsP.zhDescription: 让战甲在身后留下绿意盎然的足迹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GarudaBloo.name: Viserakta Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GarudaBloo.description: Bathe in the life essence of your enemies.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GarudaBloo.zhDescription: 在敌人的生命精华中徜徉。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GarudaPrim.name: Sanguinax Prime Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GarudaPrim.description: Spread Garuda Prime's wings of slaughter with this flowing Ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GarudaPrim.zhDescription: 用这款流动的幻纹展开 Garuda Prime 的杀戮之翼。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GrendelDel.name: Fraktur Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GrendelDel.description: The ground trembles to herald your arrival. Grendel Turbis' signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GrendelDel.zhDescription: 大地震颤，宣告你的到来。Grendel 暴坦的标志性幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GrendelPri.name: Oni Prime Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GrendelPri.description: Take on the look of a monster that can devour an enemy in a single bite.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GrendelPri.zhDescription: 呈现出一个能一口吞噬敌人的怪物形象。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.name: Heart-Throb Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.description:
'Time will show the way, And I'll mend the heart you've broken'

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.zhDescription:
'年华流逝，我将愈合你心上的伤口'

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.name: Tail Feather Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.description:
'Please stay
Don't put out the flame and run away'

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.zhDescription:
'请留在我身边
留下情热的火焰'

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.name: Heart-Beat Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.description:
'In this heart break
I'll be here fighting for you'

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.zhDescription:
'遍体鳞伤
依然为你而战'

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.name: Luv-Byte Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.description:
'With a flicker of hope on the darkest of days
Now it feels like the end is near'

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.zhDescription:
'在最黑暗的日子里，仍怀揣着一丝希望
现在感觉结局已经临近'

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.name: Pins-N-Needles Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.description:
'I thought I could take
More than I really can'

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.zhDescription:
'我以为我可以承受
比实际的更多'

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.name: Embracer Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.description:
'Baby 'til you come back with something
I know I'll never let it go'

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.zhDescription:
'宝贝，除非你带点什么回来
我知道我永远不会放手'

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.name: Lovestruck Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.description:
'I'm getting stronger but I still feel the pain'

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.zhDescription:
'纵然身强体壮，心痛却无处隐藏'

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.name: Soul-Eye Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.description:
'I keep thinking I see you
And there's nobody there'

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.zhDescription:
'总幻想和你重逢
到头来只是一场空'

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.name: Primatura Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.description: A fresh coating of ink marks the first step taken on the road to understanding the truth of the Shadowgrapher.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.zhDescription: 新的墨水涂层标志着我们踏上了揭开绘影者真相的第一步。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.name: Pareidola Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.description: To see truth in the shapes created by this ephemera is a mark of increased understanding.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.zhDescription: 能从幻纹所构成的形态中洞察真相，正是理解力日益深厚的标志。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.name: Liftbalon Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.description: Celebrate the completion of Follie's Shadowgraph during Operation: Atramentum with a festive collection of balloons.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.zhDescription: 通过这套节日气球的幻纹，在《行动代号：墨痕》中庆祝 Follie 的绘影图的完成。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.name: Aspirus Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.description: Pay tribute to Jade and mark the battle of Operation Belly of the Beast with this transcendent Ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.zhDescription: 用个超凡的幻纹来向 Jade 致敬，并纪念《行动代号：兽之腹》的战斗。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.name: Aspirus Emergent Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.description: An even more radiant evolution of the Aspirus Ephemera, created with vestiges over Jade's volatile motes.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.zhDescription: 由 Jade 不稳定微粒留下的痕迹所形成，是追梦幻纹更加耀眼的进化版本。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.name: Aspirus Apex Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.description: The pinnacle version of this ephemera, signifying victory over Parvos Granum’s forces in Operation Belly of the Beast.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.zhDescription: 这是此幻纹的巅峰版本，象征着在《行动代号：兽之腹》中战胜帕尔沃斯·格拉努的军队。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYDragonE.name: Xianglong Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYDragonE.description: A dragon’s spirit graces your path.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYDragonE.zhDescription: 祥龙之气为你的道路增光添彩。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYKaitheD.name: Malaen Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYKaitheD.description: Bring forth the fiery steeds of Dagath Yfari’s signature ephemera to follow in your footsteps.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYKaitheD.zhDescription: 让 Dagath 伊法里的标志性幻纹中那些炽热的骏马追随你的脚步。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYStonesE.name: Heaven Stones Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYStonesE.description: Step lightly with stones that could mend the very fabric of the heavens.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYStonesE.zhDescription: 随着轻盈的脚步踏出能够修补天空的五色石。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LavosDelux.name: Ophodryx Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LavosDelux.description: Ethereal serpents slither in your caustic wake with Lavos Khymia’s signature Ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LavosDelux.zhDescription: 通过 Lavos 点金标志性的幻纹，空灵的蛇影将在你留下的腐蚀性尾迹中蜿蜒爬行。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LotusFlowe.name: Lotus Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LotusFlowe.description: Leave a trail of fragrant petals in your wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LotusFlowe.zhDescription: 在你身后留下一道芬芳花瓣的足迹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LunarEphem.name: Purified Bloom Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LunarEphem.description: Flourish out of the muddiness of war.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LunarEphem.zhDescription: 在战争的泥沼中繁茂生长。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.name: Protovyre Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.description: An evolving Ephemera that draws upon Sentient technology. Earn Focus with this Ephemera equipped to unlock two additional looks.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.zhDescription: 一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化幻纹。装备这款幻纹获取专精点数时会额外解锁两个外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.name: Protovyre Emergent Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.description: An evolving Ephemera that draws upon Sentient technology. Earn Focus with this Ephemera equipped to unlock an additional look.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.zhDescription: 一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化幻纹。装备这款幻纹获取专精点数时会额外解锁一个外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.name: Protovyre Apex Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.description: An evolving Ephemera that draws upon Sentient technology.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.zhDescription: 一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NightwaveD.name: Wirematrix Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NightwaveD.description: Embrace the look of 1999's most cutting-edge video game technology with this wireframe-themed Ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NightwaveD.zhDescription: 通过这款以数字线战甲为主题的幻纹，你将领略到 1999 年最前沿电子游戏技术的风采。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NightwaveI.name: Waveform Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NightwaveI.description: Sweet frequencies ripple through this Nightwave themed ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NightwaveI.zhDescription: 甜蜜频率回荡于这个以午夜电波为主题的幻纹中。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NokkoEphem.name: Sprodling Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NokkoEphem.description: Baby sprods just love to have fun! Three bounce around your feet with Nokko’s signature ephemera, a playful reminder of the future of the Deepmines.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NokkoEphem.zhDescription: 菌宝就是喜欢玩耍！Nokko 的标志性幻纹会在你脚边蹦蹦跳跳，调皮地提醒你深矿的未来。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NokkoFoots.name: Rizoma Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NokkoFoots.description: Everything is connected. Spores linger in your footsteps with this ephemera, evoking the underground web of life.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NokkoFoots.zhDescription: 万物皆有联系。孢子会随着这些幻纹萦绕在你的脚印，唤起地下的生命之网。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NovaDeluxe.name: Maru Obi Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NovaDeluxe.description: The perfect flourish for a graceful Tenno.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NovaDeluxe.zhDescription: 优雅 Tenno 的完美修饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OpulaEphem.name: Opula Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OpulaEphem.description: Surround yourself with the dancing light of full spectrum flames.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OpulaEphem.zhDescription: 让自己沉浸在全光谱火焰的舞动光芒之中。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OraxiaEphe.name: Zygiella Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OraxiaEphe.description: Surround yourself with the growing dread of Oraxia's presence.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OraxiaEphe.zhDescription: 让自己沉浸在因 Oraxia 的存在而产生的日益增长的恐惧之中。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OrbsEpheme.name: Trio Orbit Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OrbsEpheme.description: Surround yourself with a trio of orbiting energy -  earned on the Steel Path.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OrbsEpheme.zhDescription: 三道绕轨能量在你身上环绕 — 在钢铁之路上获取。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/PeachBloss.name: Peach Blossom Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/PeachBloss.description: Surround your Warframe with softly falling peach blossoms, to celebrate the Lunar Renewal.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/PeachBloss.zhDescription: 用轻柔的桃花包围你的战甲，用以庆贺新春佳节。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/PrimeVorun.name: Okuri Tails Prime Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/PrimeVorun.description: The beast may be adorned, but never tamed. Voruna Prime's signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/PrimeVorun.zhDescription: 野兽或许可以穿着华服，但永远不会被驯服。Voruna Prime 的标志性幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ProteaDelu.name: Tealtrian Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ProteaDelu.description: Distinguish yourself with the essence of nobility.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/QorvexDelu.name: Belfri Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/QorvexDelu.description: Beckon Qorvex Basilica's fluttering fellows to your side with his signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/QorvexDelu.zhDescription: 通过他的标志性幻纹，将 Qorvex 圣殿里那些翩翩起舞的伙伴们召唤到你身边。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SandmanEph.name: Sands of Mars Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SandmanEph.description: Let the familiar sands of Mars accompany you.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SandmanEph.zhDescription: 让熟悉的火星之沙陪伴着你。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SentientDe.name: Tenebrous Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SentientDe.zhDescription: 行走在 Sentient 阴影的缭绕下。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SmokeEphem.name: Fog of War Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SmokeEphem.description: Emerge from the fog of war unscathed.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SmokeEphem.zhDescription: 毫发无伤地从战争迷雾中现身。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SnowEpheme.name: Frostfall Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SnowEpheme.description: Become the heart of the winter, beneath a cloud of falling snow.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SnowEpheme.zhDescription: 在一片雪花飘落的云朵下化作冬日之心。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TatsuSkull.name: Crania Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TatsuSkull.description: Surround yourself with the echoes of the fallen - earned on the Steel Path.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TatsuSkull.zhDescription: 亡者的余音在你身上环绕 — 在钢铁之路上获取。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TennoCon20.name: TennoCon 2021 Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TennoCon20.description: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2021.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TennoCon20.zhDescription: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2021 的玩家。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TennoCon20.name: Hunhullus Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TennoCon20.description: Emulating the colossus of Hull, this ephemera is a reminder of the Tenno's past conflicts.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TennoCon20.zhDescription: 效仿舰体的宏观之形，这个幻纹唤起了 Tenno 对昔日冲突的追忆。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Twitch2023.name: Raya Aurora Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Twitch2023.description: Evoke the awe and beauty of solar winds with this delicate ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Twitch2023.zhDescription: 通过这款精致的幻纹，唤起太阳风暴的浩瀚与美丽。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TwitchEphe.name: Verv Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TwitchEphe.description: Broadcast your presence with every move.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TwitchEphe.zhDescription: 通过一举一动来宣告你的存在。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/VoidAngelE.name: Raptwing Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/VoidAngelE.description: Take on the majesty of an angel’s wings.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/VoidAngelE.zhDescription: 展现了天使之翼的威严。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/VoidAngelE.name: Seraphayre Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/VoidAngelE.description: Walk in the echo of an ethereal song.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/VoidAngelE.zhDescription: 走进空灵歌曲的回声中。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/VorunaDelu.name: Manegarmr Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/VorunaDelu.description: The wolf-tail plume of Voruna Medeina’s signature ephemera displays the refined nature of an inner beast.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/VorunaDelu.zhDescription: Voruna 梅迪娜的标志性幻纹中的狼尾羽展现了内在野兽的精致本性。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/WebEphemer.name: Spinneret Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/WebEphemer.description:
A rogue slinks, along a line
Deadly patience its tactic
In sparkling moonlight eyes shine
Ruthless, skulking arachnid
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/WebEphemer.zhDescription:
离群恶棍线上渡
夺命只需耐心足
晶莹眼眸月光下
网上蛛影祟祟伏

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/WerewolfEp.name: Okuri Tails Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/WerewolfEp.description: Share the path with your inner beast.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/WerewolfEp.zhDescription: 带上你心中的野兽一起上路。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/XakuDeluxe.name: Lohk's Embrace Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/XakuDeluxe.description: Feel the whisper of the Void.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/YareliPrim.name: Thalassa Prime Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/YareliPrim.description: Creatures of the deep circle and play in your wake. Yareli Prime’s signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/YareliPrim.zhDescription: 深海生物在你身后盘旋嬉戏。Yareli Prime 的标志性幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/EliteAlerts/EliteA.name: Amprex Telos Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/EliteAlerts/EliteA.zhName: 安培克斯 终极外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/EliteAlerts/EliteA.description: This unique skin was paid for with blood in the merciless crucible of Arbitration.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/EliteAlerts/EliteA.zhDescription: 这种独特的外观是在仲裁的无情试炼中，付以鲜血而得到的。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/EliteAlerts/EliteA.name: Atomos Telos Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/EliteAlerts/EliteA.zhName: 原子矿融炮 终极外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/EliteAlerts/EliteA.description: This unique skin was paid for with blood in the merciless crucible of Arbitration.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/EliteAlerts/EliteA.zhDescription: 这种独特的外观是在仲裁的无情试炼中，付以鲜血而得到的。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/EliteAlerts/EliteA.name: Atterax Telos Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/EliteAlerts/EliteA.zhName: 阿特拉克斯 终极外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/EliteAlerts/EliteA.description: This unique skin was paid for with blood in the merciless crucible of Arbitration.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/EliteAlerts/EliteA.zhDescription: 这种独特的外观是在仲裁的无情试炼中，付以鲜血而得到的。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberAgileAn.name: Ember Agile Animation Set
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberAgileAn.description: The Agile Animation Set for Ember.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberAlterna.name: Ember Immortal Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberAlterna.description: The Immortal skin for the Ember Warframe.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeD.name: Nusku Dual Pistol Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeD.description: The signature pistol skin of Ember Vermillion.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeD.zhDescription: Ember 朱红的标志性手枪外观

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeH.name: Ember Vermillion Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeH.zhDescription: Ember 朱红的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeI.name: Flamethrower Plazm Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeI.description: A flamethrower skin that's twice as hot as the carnage it contains.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeI.zhDescription: 一件能发射其内在杀戮双倍热量的火焰喷射器外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeI.name: Ember Pyraxis Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeI.zhDescription: Ember 燃烬的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeI.name: Ember Pyraxis Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeI.description: Ember refined to her most searing elemental form, the primordial flame.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeI.zhDescription: Ember 精炼成了她最灼热的元素形态，原初之火。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeP.name: Nusku Pistol Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeP.description: The signature pistol skin of Ember Vermillion.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeP.zhDescription: Ember 朱红的标志性手枪外观

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeS.name: Ember Vermillion Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeS.description: From the ashes of battle a flamboyant new Ember rises.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberDeluxeS.zhDescription: 在战斗的烟尘中冉冉升起的全新 Ember。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberHeirloo.name: Ember Heirloom Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberHeirloo.zhDescription: Ember 传家宝的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberHeirloo.name: Ember Heirloom Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberHeirloo.description: Heirloom skins signify the passage of time and the dedication of the Tenno. Ember's legacy is immortalized in the beauty of molten rock and volcanic fire.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberHeirloo.zhDescription: 传家宝外观象征着时间的流逝和 Tenno 的付出。Ember 的传承在熔岩和火焰中永垂不朽。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberHelmet.name: Ember Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberHelmet.description: The standard issue helmet for the Ember Warframe.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberHelmetA.name: Arcane Phoenix Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberHelmetA.description: This helmet is worn by Ember, and reduces Shields in order to boost Energy Capacity.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberHelmetA.zhDescription: 这顶头盔是由 Ember 所装备，可增加能量上限，但会减少护盾。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberHelmetA.name: Arcane Backdraft Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberHelmetA.description: This helmet is worn by Ember, and adds Health, with a reduction to Speed.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberHelmetA.zhDescription: 这顶头盔是由 Ember 所装备，可增加生命值，但会减少移动速度。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberHelmetA.name: Ember Backdraft Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberHelmetA.description: Backdraft Helmet for the Ember Warframe.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Ember/EmberHelmetA.name: Ember Phoenix Helmet

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Hoplite/StyanaxDel.description: The warrior spirit reincarnates in the image of a god.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Hoplite/StyanaxDel.zhDescription: 战士精神以神明的形象转世。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Hoplite/StyanaxPri.name: Styanax Prime Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Hoplite/StyanaxPri.description: The standard issue helmet for the Styanax Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Hoplite/StyanaxPri.zhDescription: Styanax Prime 战甲的标准头盔。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Hoplite/StyanaxPri.name: Styanax Prime Bare Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Hoplite/StyanaxPri.description: Styanax Prime's helmet, stripped down and ready to enter the melee.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Hoplite/StyanaxPri.zhDescription: Styanax Prime 的头盔，已卸去多余装饰，准备投身近战。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Hoplite/StyanaxPri.name: Styanax Prime Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Hoplite/StyanaxPri.description: The standard issue skin for the Styanax Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Hoplite/StyanaxPri.zhDescription: Styanax Prime 战甲的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Hoplite/StyanaxVoi.name: Styanax Voidshell Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Hoplite/StyanaxVoi.description: Don the morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Hoplite/StyanaxVoi.zhDescription: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Hoplite/StyanaxVoi.name: Styanax Voidshell Skin

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.name: Vexage Coronet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.description: Forewarn that fury awaits anyone who challenges your Kaithe and its rider.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.zhDescription: 事先警告，对于任何挑战你的绝灵骥和它的骑手的人，愤怒在等待着他们。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.name: Dauntair Coronet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.description: A skilled rider repurposes the Void’s mark for their Kaithe.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.zhDescription: 一位熟练的骑手将虚空的印记重新应用在他的绝灵骥上。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.name: Myrthen Coronet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.description: Joy blossoms in the Myrthen Coronet.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.zhDescription: 欢乐在欢馨马冠中开花。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.name: Enverve Coronet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.description: The Enverve Coronet elegantly expresses a bitter emotion.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.zhDescription: 激妒马冠优雅地传达了一种苦涩的情感。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.name: Wistfall Coronet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.description: The Wistfall Coronet depicts melancholy’s beauty.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.zhDescription: 忧泣马冠展示了忧郁之美。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/DagathDeluxe.name: Gynfas Kaithe
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/DagathDeluxe.description: The Tales of Duviri tell of the Gynfas Kaithe visiting homes on a moonless night. To deny it entry is to invite dire misfortune. A fitting steed for Dagath Yfari.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/DagathDeluxe.zhDescription: 《双衍王境故事集》讲述了画布绝灵骥会在无月之夜造访各家各户。将它拒之门外会招致可怕的厄运。它是 Dagath 伊法里的最佳坐骑。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/DagathDeluxe.name: Gynfas Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/DagathDeluxe.description: The macabre light of the Gynfas Kaithe’s tail has haunted many a moor and battlefield.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/DagathDeluxe.zhDescription: 画布绝灵骥尾巴上那阴森的光芒，曾萦绕许多荒野和战场。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.name: Aetigo Kaithe
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.description: Aetigo Kaithes are a native species of Duviri's southernmost island. Their emerald eyes once reflected the verdant plains they roamed, but when the island was reduced to ash, their eyes faded to nothing.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.zhDescription: 因理绝灵骥是双衍王境最南端岛屿的本地物种。它们祖母绿色的眼眸曾经映照着它们踏过的青翠平原，但当岛屿化为灰烬之时，它们的眼睛也随之消逝。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.name: Psyacus Kaithe
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.description: Psyacus Kaithes inspire fear in the faint of heart. Common wisdom among Duviri citizens holds that those who mount the Psyacus Kaithe must be either courageous or heartless.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.zhDescription: 心道绝灵骥会在懦夫的心中唤起恐惧。双衍王境的民众普遍认为，那些骑上心道绝灵骥的人要么勇敢，要么无情。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.name: Histornam Kaithe
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.description: It is said that the great Dominus Thrax prefers Histornam Kaithes above all other breeds. It was on the back of a Histornam Kaithe that Thrax himself learned to ride.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.zhDescription: 有言说伟大的士魂大帝最喜史源绝灵骥，胜于其他的所有品种。正是在一匹史源的背上，士魂大帝本人学会了骑乘。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.name: Sviari Chamfron
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.description: The might of the Kaithe rider is expressed through the Sviari Chamfron's sharp horns.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.zhDescription: 绝灵骥骑手的力量表现在瑞豚马盔的锋利之角上。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.name: Dyrncaul Chamfron
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.description: The Dyrncaul Chamfron’s curved horns are reminiscent of the Tamm, a creature whose happiness is said to bring good fortune.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.zhDescription: 勇角马盔的弯角让人想起塔牧羊，据说它的快乐会带来好运。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.name: Irdeni Chamfron
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.description: The Irdeni Chamfron is reminiscent of the ever-changing hues in Duviri’s sky.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.zhDescription: 复斓马盔让人想起双衍王境中千变万化的色调。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.name: Kheyur Chamfron
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.description: The Kheyur Chamfron befits any formal occasion.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.zhDescription: 华金马盔适合任何正式场合。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.name: Dovin Saddle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.description: The Dovin Saddle's deep curve and lightweight structure make for strong balance and gentle communication with the Kaithe.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.zhDescription: 迹语石马鞍深沉的曲线和轻巧的结构使得绝灵骥兼具良好的平衡性和易于与骑手交流。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.name: Vaidurian Saddle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.description: The Vaidurian Saddle’s comfortable and sturdy design is ideal for those long hours riding Kaithes.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.zhDescription: 猫睛石马鞍舒适坚固的设计非常适合长时间骑乘绝灵骥。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.name: Sohseki Saddle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.description: Style and comfort meet in the Sohseki Saddle. Its padding provides stability and protection during jumps.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.zhDescription: 杀生石马鞍兼具酷炫与舒适的特性。它的填充物在跳跃过程中具备很好的稳定性和保护性。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.name: Caersid Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.description: The Caersid Tail bespeaks the spirit of the vengeful warrior.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.zhDescription: 战坞马尾彰显着复仇战士的精神。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.name: Heoro Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.description: A Kaithe with the Heoro Tail evokes glory.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.zhDescription: 拥有荣英马尾的绝灵骥召唤出荣耀。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.name: Velific Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.description: Adorn the movements of an elegant Kaithe with the Velific Tail.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.zhDescription: 用灵现马尾装饰优雅的绝灵骥的动作。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.name: Aebolg Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.description: Bones laid bare in the Aebolg Tail are a reminder to appreciate the gift of life.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.zhDescription: 骨棘马尾上裸露的骨头提醒着人们珍惜生命的馈赠。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.name: Histornam Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.description: The Histornam Kaithe came into being with this regal tail.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.zhDescription: 史源绝灵骥诞生之时就有着这条华丽的尾巴。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.name: Aetigo Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.description: The Aetigo Kaithe came into being with this dignified tail.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.zhDescription: 因理绝灵骥诞生之时就有着这条气派的尾巴。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.name: Psyacus Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.description: The Psyacus Kaithe came into being with this tapered tail.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.zhDescription: 心道绝灵骥诞生之时就有着这条锥形尾巴。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseW.name: Exorion Wings
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseW.description: Outstretched wings reveal the path to celestial planes.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseW.zhDescription: 展开的双翼揭示了通往天外位面之径。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.name: Aethon Chamfron
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.description: Fan the flames of fortitude with the Aethon Chamfron.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.zhDescription: 用神驱马盔扇起坚韧的火焰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.name: Aethon Saddle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.description: The Aethon Saddle's flames don't burn the skilled rider.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.zhDescription: 神驱马鞍上的火焰并不会灼伤熟练的骑手。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.name: Aethon Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.description: The Aethon Tail is a good companion piece to the rider of fleet-footed fire.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.zhDescription: 神驱马尾是迅猛骑手的好搭档配件。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/FireM.name: Pyra Sugatra
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/FireM.description: During the height of the Old War, Tenno raiders used these flaming sugatras to intimidate and distract enemies.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/Razor.name: Uru Sugatra

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/Saryn.name: Melia Sugatra

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/Scrol.name: Naviga Prime Sugatra
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/Scrol.description: With a form that echos the sails of ancient sea ships, this sugatra creates a commanding silhouette on any weapon.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/SentS.name: Sporavyre Sugatra

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/Sugat.name: Opal Marteddu Sugatra

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/Sugot.name: Tammpet Sugatra
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/Sugot.description: Outfit your weapons with 1999’s hottest toy.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/Tenno.description: This sugatra is favoured by Tenno participating in the Conclave, as it is a symbol of unity and conviction.
