/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 一件指挥官套装的套服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Drifter Zariman Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: The Drifter's Zariman suit. Still intact after all these years.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 漂泊者的扎里曼套服。饱经岁月洗礼却仍旧完好。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Drifter Feldune Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Ready yourself for the heat of battle. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 为激烈的战斗做好准备。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Athletic Shirt
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Get your game on with this exclusive line of sportswear-inspired garments and accessories.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 穿上这一系列以运动风为灵感的服饰，来展现你的最佳状态。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Koppra Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: A suit of a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 一件漂泊者套装的套服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Drifter Vest
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: A ragged old cloth and leather vest worn by The Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 漂泊者所穿的破旧布皮拼接背心。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Drifter Escuchon Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Venture boldly forth, clad in the auspices of one who shows courage in the face of death.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 穿上无畏死亡的勇气之士的铠甲，英勇向前。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Drifter Voidshell Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Don the morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Manduka Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: A suit of a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 一件漂泊者套装的套服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Hawk Bishamo Cuirass
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 身披军神护甲套装来秉承 Teshin 和禁卫精锐的传统。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Lark Bishamo Cuirass
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 身披军神护甲套装来秉承 Teshin 和禁卫精锐的传统。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Harrier Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: The suit of a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 一件漂泊者套装的套服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Drifter Dex Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the tenth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻睡眠中醒来 10 周年。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Drifter Keeler Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Nora Night recovered this suit from Saturn’s Keeler Gap. The durable material lined with rebreather tubing shows it was designed with depressurization in mind.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 诺拉·夜从土星的凯勒环缝取回了这件套服。耐用的材质配上内衬的循环呼吸导管表明它在设计时考量了减压能力。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Drifter Grineer Vest
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Sneak behind enemy lines with this scavenged Grineer Lancer breast plate. Fitted for The Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 使用这套 Grineer 枪兵胸甲深入敌后。为漂泊者量身定制。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Ceno Cuirass
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: An armor design honoring the monastic legacy of the Quills. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 一款充满设计感的护甲，尊崇着夜羽的修士传统。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Vahd Cuirass
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Crafted with surety of purpose, and clarity of vision. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 以坚定的目标和清晰的愿景而打造。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Zauba Cuirass
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Inspired by the seers of old; constructed to withstand ravages to both body and mind. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 受到年迈预言家的启发；被制作用来抵御对身体和精神的摧残。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Grunge Jacket
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Keep it real on the streets with thrifty, downbeat clothing inspired by the grunge scene.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 穿上灵感来源于颓废风格的简约低调街头服饰，保持街头风的真实感。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Outrider Cuirass
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Drifter armor modeled on enviro-gear worn by the surveyors and scouts of the Orb Vallis. Protected by an all-weather cloak they catalogue the wildlife, seek out resources and chart safe routes for patrols and miners.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 依奥布山谷的调查员或侦查员穿戴的装备所仿制的漂泊者护甲。在对应全天候的大衣保护之下，他们编录野生动物，寻找资源，以及为巡逻员与矿工绘制安全路线。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Emissary Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: The suit of a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 一件漂泊者套装的套服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Haztech Cuirass
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: When coolant offgasses or a fusion-gen gets cracked it's everybody out. Everybody except the haztechs. Drifter armor modeled on the daredevils of Fortuna's maintenance crews.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 当冷却液废气或是合成液破裂时，这时所有人都得停工，除了危难技术人员必须留下。依福尔图娜敢死维修工所仿制。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Smelter Cuirass
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Drifter armor inspired by those Solaris who must work in searing heat.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 灵感来自那些必须在灼热环境下工作的索拉里斯人。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Vent Rat Cuirass
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Living in Fortuna a lot of repairs need to happen in the vents. Lightweight and practical Drifter armor designed for flexibility and tight squeezes.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 居住在福尔图娜，通风管道经常需要维修。轻便实用的漂泊者护甲专为灵活机动和狭窄空间而设计。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: TennoCon 2022 Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2022.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2022 的玩家。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Vent Pobber Ventkid Cuirass
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhName: 通风泡博通风小子胸甲
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Drifter Armor modeled on the workshop gear favored by Roky, leader of the industrious Vent Pobbers.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 依勤劳的通风泡博领导人小洛最喜爱的工坊装备所仿制的漂泊者护甲。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Varida Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: A suit of a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 一件漂泊者套装的套服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Nightwave Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: A suit for all of you Dreamers out there.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 适合你们所有梦回者的套服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Masker's Theodolite Crewsuit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhName: 「蒙面者的经纬仪号」船员套服
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Historian Drusus Leverian recalls that the hostage crew of the passenger vessel, Masker's Theodolite, wore this very crewsuit when they were rescued by Nova.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 据历史学家德枢·莱弗回忆说，客轮「蒙面者的经纬仪号」的人质船员在被 Nova 营救时就穿着这套船员制服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Kubrodon Ventkid Cuirass
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Drifter Armor modeled on the workshop gear favored by Roky, leader of the industrious Vent Pobbers.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 依勤劳的通风泡博领导人小洛最喜爱的工坊装备所仿制的漂泊者护甲。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Grand Carnus Cuirass
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: A suit for the Drifter embodying the ultimate in Orokin style and luxury.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 一套专为漂泊者设计的套服，完美体现了极致的奥罗金风格和奢华。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Goth Jacket
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Watch from the shadows or dance with the dead, with these Gothic-inspired garments.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 穿上这些哥特风格的服饰，在暗处观察或与亡者共舞。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Stormfall Jacket
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Embody Scaldra's intimidating military style in the uniform of their elusive elite commanders.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 穿上那些神秘精英指挥官的军服，体现炽蛇军令人生畏的军队风格。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Chymerist Uniform
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: The mysterious technicians who staff Scaldra's secret Efervon distilleries have a style all their own.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 炽蛇军的秘密艾弗旺蒸馏厂的神秘技师们拥有他们自己的风格。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Drifter Loneryder Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Look sharp after miles on the dusty trail. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 在尘土飞扬中穿行许久依旧锐不可当。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Drifter Orizu Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Invite longevity and protection with a look inspired by the origami crane. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 这款以千纸鹤为灵感的外观会带来长寿与保护。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Saita Prime Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: The suit of a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 一件漂泊者套装的套服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Commodore Prime Cuirass
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhName: 海军准将 Prime 胸甲
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Take command with this regal Drifter suit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 穿上这套庄严的漂泊者服饰来发布号令。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Templar Prime Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhName: 圣殿骑士 Prime 套服
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: The dress uniform worn with pride by Harrow's faithful legions.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: Harrow 那忠诚的军团自豪地穿戴这套制服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Clearvoy Prime Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: A look worthy of one who has the power to straddle realities. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 唯有掌控现实之力，方能得此绣罗衣裳。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Necra Prime Cuirass
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Necrotic accents define this testament to the Entrati family’s aesthetic. Perhaps there’s a lesson in how those who gaze into the Void find beauty in the fusion of luxury and oblivion.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 腐生的特质是英择谛家族美学的见证。也许这是一个教训，告诉那些凝视虚空的人如何在奢华与虚无的融合中发现美。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Tauron Prime Regalia
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: The Tauron Academy uniform blends Tenno functionality with Sentient design.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 将 Tenno 的特能与 Sentient 设计融为一体的 Tauron 学院制服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Operator Feldune Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Ready yourself for the heat of battle. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Have the Operator embody Scaldra's intimidating military style in the uniform of their elusive elite commanders.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 让指挥官穿上那些神秘精英指挥官的军服，体现炽蛇军令人生畏的军队风格。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Chymerist Uniform
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: The mysterious technicians who staff Scaldra's secret Efervon distilleries have a style all their own. Now it can be the Operator's too.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 炽蛇军的秘密艾弗旺蒸馏厂的神秘技师们拥有自身的风格。现在，指挥官也可以拥有同样的风采。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Operator Loneryder Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Look sharp after miles on the dusty trail. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 在尘土飞扬中穿行许久依旧锐不可当。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Operator Keeler Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Nora Night recovered this suit from Saturn’s Keeler Gap. The durable material lined with rebreather tubing shows it was designed with depressurization in mind.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 诺拉·夜从土星的凯勒环缝取回了这件套服。耐用的材质配上内衬的循环呼吸导管表明它在设计时考量了减压能力。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Operator Orizu Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Invite longevity and protection with a look inspired by the origami crane. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 这款以千纸鹤为灵感的外观会带来长寿与保护。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Saita Prime Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: A suit of an Operator outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 一件指挥官套装的套服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Templar Prime Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhName: 圣殿骑士 Prime 套服
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: The dress uniform worn with pride by Harrow's faithful legions.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: Harrow 那忠诚的军团自豪地穿戴这套制服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Clearvoy Prime Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: A look worthy of one who has the power to straddle realities. Fitted for the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 唯有掌控现实之力，方能得此绣罗衣裳。适用于指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Necra Prime Cuirass
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Necrotic accents define this testament to the Entrati family’s aesthetic. Perhaps there’s a lesson in how those who gaze into the Void find beauty in the fusion of luxury and oblivion.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 腐生的特质是英择谛家族美学的见证。也许这是一个教训，告诉那些凝视虚空的人如何在奢华与虚无的融合中发现美。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Tauron Prime Regalia
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: The Tauron Academy uniform blends Tenno functionality with Sentient design.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 将 Tenno 的特能与 Sentient 设计融为一体的 Tauron 学院制服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Harrier Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: The suit of an Operator outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 一件指挥官套装的套服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Kaneshell Atomicycle Jacket
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhName: 凯恩壳原子摩托车夹克
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Slide into this biker outfit of the new millenium. Fitted for the Drifter and Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 穿上这套新千年风格的机车服。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Kaneshell Atomicycle Jacket
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhName: 凯恩壳原子摩托车夹克
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Slide into this biker outfit of the new millenium. Fitted for the Drifter and Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.zhDescription: 穿上这套新千年风格的机车服。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.name: Arthur's Hairstyle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.description: Floppy locks, for a classic 90s Emo look.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.zhDescription: 随性飘逸的发型，呈现经典的 90 年代 Emo 风格。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.name: Velimir's Hairstyle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.description: Casual. Cool. Velimir's signature hairstyle is no muss, no fuss.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.zhDescription: 维利米尔的标志性发型简洁利落。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.name: Lyon's Hairstyle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.description: Hair is vanity. Lyon’s signature style is the ultimate in low maintenance.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.zhDescription: 头发不过是虚荣的象征。里昂的标志性发型堪称极致的免打理之选。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.name: Loid's Hairstyle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.description: The elegant, well-maintained tresses of a gentleman's gentleman.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.zhDescription: 优雅且精心打理，尽显绅士风范的秀发。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.name: Aoi's Hairstyle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.description: Aoi's daring, angular cut, the apex of street style.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.zhDescription: 碧的大胆、棱角分明的发型，是街头风格的巅峰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.name: Kaya's Hairstyle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.description: The messy bun of a genius with far more important things to worry about.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.zhDescription: 天才的凌乱丸子头，因为有更重要的事要操心。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.name: Eleanor's Hairstyle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.description: Eleanor's signature flowing locks, tightly bound up.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.zhDescription: 埃莉诺的标志性飘逸长发，紧紧束起。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.name: Quincy's Hairstyle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.description: Braids and beads embody the marksman's pride.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.zhDescription: 发辫和珠饰彰显射手的骄傲。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.name: Rusalka's Hairstyle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.description: Major Rusalka's splendid hair, carefully plaited to keep it from entangling in her mechanical arm.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.zhDescription: 鲁莎卡少校的美丽秀发，被精心编织起来，以免缠住她的机械臂。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.name: Minerva's Hairstyle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.description: Stay stylish even during the worst of international incidents.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.zhDescription: 即使在最严重的国际事件中，也要保持时尚。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.name: Minerva's Hairstyle (No Shades)
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.description: Stay stylish even during the worst of international incidents.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.zhDescription: 即使在最严重的国际事件中，也要保持时尚。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.name: Flare's Hairstyle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.description: Blow their minds with Flare’s signature hairstyle.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.zhDescription: 用弗莱尔的标志性发型让他们大吃一惊。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.name: Lettie's Hairstyle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.zhDescription: 莱蒂的经典复古庞巴杜发型。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.name: Roathe's Hairstyle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.description: Only the most elite of Orokin could afford the time, and expense, of this intricate beaded style.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.zhDescription: 只有奥罗金最精英阶层才能负担起得起这种复杂串珠风格所需的时间和费用。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.name: Amir's Hairstyle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.description: For that 'couldn't sleep, too wired' look.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.zhDescription: 打造'睡不着，太亢奋'的造型。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.name: Marie's Hairstyle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.description: The wispy tresses of Marie’s signature style are rarely seen, but no less intricate for it.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hair/Hair.zhDescription: 玛丽标志性的飘逸长发很少见，但即便如此，其精致程度也毫不逊色。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Adu.name: Umbra Hooded Scarf
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Adu.description: A fashionable accessory fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Adu.zhDescription: 给漂泊者使用的时尚配件

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Dri.name: Kaneshell Atomicycle Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Dri.zhName: 凯恩壳原子摩托车头盔
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Dri.description: Slide into this biker outfit of the new millenium. Fitted for the Drifter and Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Dri.zhDescription: 穿上这套新千年风格的机车服。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Zariman Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A hood belonging to an Operator outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 一顶属于指挥官套装的头套。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Zariman Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: The Drifter's Zariman hood. Still intact after all these years.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 漂泊者的扎里曼头罩。饱经岁月洗礼却仍旧完好。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Feldune Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Ready yourself for the heat of battle. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 为激烈的战斗做好准备。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Koppra Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A ragged old cloth hood and leather mask worn by The Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 漂泊者所穿的破旧布制头罩和皮制面具。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Escuchon Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Venture boldly forth, clad in the auspices of one who shows courage in the face of death.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 穿上无畏死亡的勇气之士的铠甲，英勇向前。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Voidshell Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Don the morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Manduka Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Hawk Bishamo Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 身披军神护甲套装来秉承 Teshin 和禁卫精锐的传统。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Lark Bishamo Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 身披军神护甲套装来秉承 Teshin 和禁卫精锐的传统。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Harrier Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Dex Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the tenth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻睡眠中醒来 10 周年。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Keeler Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Nora Night recovered this suit from Saturn’s Keeler Gap. The durable material lined with rebreather tubing shows it was designed with depressurization in mind.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 诺拉·夜从土星的凯勒环缝取回了这件套服。耐用的材质配上内衬的循环呼吸导管表明它在设计时考量了减压能力。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Grineer Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Sneak behind enemy lines with this scavenged Grineer Lancer face shield and hood. Fitted for The Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 通过这些搜集来的 Grineer 枪兵面罩和兜帽深入敌后。已为漂泊者量身修改。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Ceno Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: An armor design honoring the monastic legacy of the Quills. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 一款充满设计感的护甲，尊崇着夜羽的修士传统。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Vahd Mask
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Crafted with surety of purpose, and clarity of vision. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 以坚定的目标和清晰的愿景而打造。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Zauba Mask
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Inspired by the seers of old; constructed to withstand ravages to both body and mind. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 受到年迈预言家的启发；被制作用来抵御对身体和精神的摧残。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Grunge Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Keep it real on the streets with thrifty, downbeat clothing inspired by the grunge scene.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 穿上灵感来源于颓废风格的简约低调街头服饰，保持街头风的真实感。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Outrider Mask
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Drifter armor modeled on enviro-gear worn by the surveyors and scouts of the Orb Vallis. Protected by an all-weather cloak they catalogue the wildlife, seek out resources and chart safe routes for patrols and miners.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 依奥布山谷的调查员或侦查员穿戴的装备所仿制的漂泊者护甲。在对应全天候的大衣保护之下，他们编录野生动物，寻找资源，以及为巡逻员与矿工绘制安全路线。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Emissary Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Haztech Mask
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: When coolant offgasses or a fusion-gen gets cracked it's everybody out. Everybody except the haztechs. Drifter armor modeled on the daredevils of Fortuna's maintenance crews.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 当冷却液废气或是合成液破裂时，这时所有人都得停工，除了危难技术人员必须留下。依福尔图娜敢死维修工所仿制。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Smelter Mask
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Drifter armor inspired by those Solaris who must work in searing heat.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 灵感来自那些必须在灼热环境下工作的索拉里斯人。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Vent Rat Mask
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Living in Fortuna a lot of repairs need to happen in the vents. Lightweight and practical Drifter armor designed for flexibility and tight squeezes.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 居住在福尔图娜，通风管道经常需要维修。轻便实用的漂泊者护甲专为灵活机动和狭窄空间而设计。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: TennoCon 2022 Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2022.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2022 的玩家。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Vent Pobber Ventkid Mask
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhName: 通风泡博通风小子面罩
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Drifter Armor modeled on the workshop gear favored by Roky, leader of the industrious Vent Pobbers.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 依勤劳的通风泡博领导人小洛最喜爱的工坊装备所仿制的漂泊者护甲。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Varida Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Masker's Theodolite Crewsuit Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhName: 「蒙面者的经纬仪号」船员套服头套
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Historian Drusus Leverian recalls that the hostage crew of the passenger vessel, Masker's Theodolite, wore this very crewsuit when they were rescued by Nova.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 据历史学家德枢·莱弗回忆说，客轮「蒙面者的经纬仪号」的人质船员在被 Nova 营救时就穿着这套船员制服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Kubrodon Ventkid Mask
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Drifter Armor modeled on the workshop gear favored by Roky, leader of the industrious Vent Pobbers.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 依勤劳的通风泡博领导人小洛最喜爱的工坊装备所仿制的漂泊者护甲。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Grand Carnus Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A suit for the Drifter embodying the ultimate in Orokin style and luxury.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 一套专为漂泊者设计的套服，完美体现了极致的奥罗金风格和奢华。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Goth Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Watch from the shadows or dance with the dead, with these Gothic-inspired garments.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 穿上这些哥特风格的服饰，在暗处观察或与亡者共舞。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Stormfall Mask
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Embody Scaldra's intimidating military style in the uniform of their elusive elite commanders.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 穿上那些神秘精英指挥官的军服，体现炽蛇军令人生畏的军队风格。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Chymerist Mask
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: The mysterious technicians who staff Scaldra's secret Efervon distilleries have a style all their own.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 炽蛇军的秘密艾弗旺蒸馏厂的神秘技师们拥有他们自己的风格。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Loneryder Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Look sharp after miles on the dusty trail. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 在尘土飞扬中穿行许久依旧锐不可当。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Orizu Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Invite longevity and protection with a look inspired by the origami crane. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 这款以千纸鹤为灵感的外观会带来长寿与保护。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Saita Prime Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Commodore Prime Mask
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhName: 海军准将 Prime 面罩
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Take command with this regal Drifter suit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 穿上这套庄严的漂泊者服饰来发布号令。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Templar Prime Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhName: 圣殿骑士 Prime 头罩
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: The dress uniform worn with pride by Harrow's faithful legions.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: Harrow 那忠诚的军团自豪地穿戴这套制服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Clearvoy Prime Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A look worthy of one who has the power to straddle realities. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 唯有掌控现实之力，方能得此绣罗衣裳。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Necra Prime Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Necrotic accents define this testament to the Entrati family’s aesthetic. Perhaps there’s a lesson in how those who gaze into the Void find beauty in the fusion of luxury and oblivion.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Vent Pobber Ventkid Mask
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhName: 通风泡博通风小子面罩
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Armor modeled on the workshop gear favored by Roky, leader of the industrious Vent Pobbers.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 依勤劳的通风泡博领导人小洛最喜爱的工坊装备所仿制的护甲。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Norg Mask
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A masterwork of the crafter's art, this exquisite headpiece captures the grace and noble bearing of the majestic Norg. Truly, the prince of fish.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 工匠艺术中的杰作，这款精致的头饰展现了雄伟诺格上优雅和高贵的风采。真正的鱼之王子。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Masker's Theodolite Crewsuit Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhName: 「蒙面者的经纬仪号」船员套服头套
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Historian Drusus Leverian recalls that the hostage crew of the passenger vessel, Masker's Theodolite, wore this very crewsuit when they were rescued by Nova.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.zhDescription: 据历史学家德枢·莱弗回忆说，客轮「蒙面者的经纬仪号」的人质船员在被 Nova 营救时就穿着这套船员制服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 身披军神护甲套装来秉承 Teshin 和禁卫精锐的传统。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Harrier Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Sleeves for a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 漂泊者套装的袖件。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Drifter Dex Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the tenth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻睡眠中醒来 10 周年。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Drifter Keeler Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Nora Night recovered this suit from Saturn’s Keeler Gap. The durable material lined with rebreather tubing shows it was designed with depressurization in mind.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 诺拉·夜从土星的凯勒环缝取回了这件套服。耐用的材质配上内衬的循环呼吸导管表明它在设计时考量了减压能力。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Drifter Grineer Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Sneak behind enemy lines with this scavenged Grineer Lancer shoulder armor and gloves. Fitted for The Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 通过这些搜集来的 Grineer 枪兵肩甲和手套深入敌后。已为漂泊者量身修改。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Ceno Pauldrons
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: An armor design honoring the monastic legacy of the Quills. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 一款充满设计感的护甲，尊崇着夜羽的修士传统。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Vahd Pauldrons
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Crafted with surety of purpose, and clarity of vision. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 以坚定的目标和清晰的愿景而打造。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Zauba Pauldrons
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Inspired by the seers of old; constructed to withstand ravages to both body and mind. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 受到年迈预言家的启发；被制作用来抵御对身体和精神的摧残。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Grunge Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Keep it real on the streets with thrifty, downbeat clothing inspired by the grunge scene.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 穿上灵感来源于颓废风格的简约低调街头服饰，保持街头风的真实感。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Outrider Pauldrons
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Drifter armor modeled on enviro-gear worn by the surveyors and scouts of the Orb Vallis. Protected by an all-weather cloak they catalogue the wildlife, seek out resources and chart safe routes for patrols and miners.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 依奥布山谷的调查员或侦查员穿戴的装备所仿制的漂泊者护甲。在对应全天候的大衣保护之下，他们编录野生动物，寻找资源，以及为巡逻员与矿工绘制安全路线。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Emissary Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Sleeves for a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 漂泊者套装的袖件。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Haztech Pauldrons
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: When coolant offgasses or a fusion-gen gets cracked it's everybody out. Everybody except the haztechs. Drifter armor modeled on the daredevils of Fortuna's maintenance crews.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 当冷却液废气或是合成液破裂时，这时所有人都得停工，除了危难技术人员必须留下。依福尔图娜敢死维修工所仿制。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Smelter Pauldrons
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Drifter armor inspired by those Solaris who must work in searing heat.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 灵感来自那些必须在灼热环境下工作的索拉里斯人。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Vent Rat Pauldrons
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Living in Fortuna a lot of repairs need to happen in the vents. Lightweight and practical Drifter armor designed for flexibility and tight squeezes.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 居住在福尔图娜，通风管道经常需要维修。轻便实用的漂泊者护甲专为灵活机动和狭窄空间而设计。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: TennoCon 2022 Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2022.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2022 的玩家。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Vent Pobber Ventkid Pauldrons
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhName: 通风泡博通风小子护肩
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Drifter Armor modeled on the workshop gear favored by Roky, leader of the industrious Vent Pobbers.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 依勤劳的通风泡博领导人小洛最喜爱的工坊装备所仿制的漂泊者护甲。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Varida Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Sleeves for a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 漂泊者套装的袖件。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Nightwave Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Sleeves and gloves for all of you Dreamers out there.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 适合你们所有梦回者的袖件和手套。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Masker's Theodolite Crewsuit Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhName: 「蒙面者的经纬仪号」船员套服袖件
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Historian Drusus Leverian recalls that the hostage crew of the passenger vessel, Masker's Theodolite, wore this very crewsuit when they were rescued by Nova.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 据历史学家德枢·莱弗回忆说，客轮「蒙面者的经纬仪号」的人质船员在被 Nova 营救时就穿着这套船员制服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Kubrodon Ventkid Pauldrons
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Drifter Armor modeled on the workshop gear favored by Roky, leader of the industrious Vent Pobbers.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 依勤劳的通风泡博领导人小洛最喜爱的工坊装备所仿制的漂泊者护甲。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Grand Carnus Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: A suit for the Drifter embodying the ultimate in Orokin style and luxury.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 一套专为漂泊者设计的套服，完美体现了极致的奥罗金风格和奢华。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Goth Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Watch from the shadows or dance with the dead, with these Gothic-inspired garments.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 穿上这些哥特风格的服饰，在暗处观察或与亡者共舞。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Stormfall Gloves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Embody Scaldra's intimidating military style in the uniform of their elusive elite commanders.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 穿上那些神秘精英指挥官的军服，体现炽蛇军令人生畏的军队风格。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Chymerist Gloves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: The mysterious technicians who staff Scaldra's secret Efervon distilleries have a style all their own.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 炽蛇军的秘密艾弗旺蒸馏厂的神秘技师们拥有他们自己的风格。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Drifter Loneryder Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Look sharp after miles on the dusty trail. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 在尘土飞扬中穿行许久依旧锐不可当。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Drifter Orizu Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Invite longevity and protection with a look inspired by the origami crane. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 这款以千纸鹤为灵感的外观会带来长寿与保护。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Saita Prime Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Sleeves for a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 漂泊者套装的袖件。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Commodore Prime Pauldrons
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhName: 海军准将 Prime 护肩
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Take command with this regal Drifter suit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 穿上这套庄严的漂泊者服饰来发布号令。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Templar Prime Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhName: 圣殿骑士 Prime 袖件
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: The dress uniform worn with pride by Harrow's faithful legions.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: Harrow 那忠诚的军团自豪地穿戴这套制服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Clearvoy Prime Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: A look worthy of one who has the power to straddle realities. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 唯有掌控现实之力，方能得此绣罗衣裳。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Necra Prime Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Necrotic accents define this testament to the Entrati family’s aesthetic. Perhaps there’s a lesson in how those who gaze into the Void find beauty in the fusion of luxury and oblivion.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 腐生的特质是英择谛家族美学的见证。也许这是一个教训，告诉那些凝视虚空的人如何在奢华与虚无的融合中发现美。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Tauron Prime Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: The Tauron Academy uniform blends Tenno functionality with Sentient design.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 将 Tenno 的特能与 Sentient 设计融为一体的 Tauron 学院制服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Operator Feldune Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Ready yourself for the heat of battle. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 为激烈的战斗做好准备。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Athletic Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Get your game on with this exclusive line of sportswear-inspired garments and accessories.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.zhDescription: 穿上这一系列以运动风为灵感的服饰，来展现你的最佳状态。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.name: Koppra Sleeves
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Sleeves/S.description: Sleeves for an Operator outfit.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SWVelenosaHe.description: A helmet for the Saryn Warframe, designed by Hitsu San.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SWVelenosaSk.name: Saryn Velenosa Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SWVelenosaSk.description: A unique skin for the Saryn Warframe, designed by Hitsu San.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SWVelenosaSk.zhDescription: Saryn 战甲的独特外观，由 Hitsu San 设计。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynChamele.name: Saryn Voidshell Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynChamele.description: Don the morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynChamele.zhDescription: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynChamele.name: Saryn Voidshell Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynChamele.description: Don the morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynChamele.zhDescription: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynDeluxeH.name: Saryn Orphid Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynDeluxeH.zhDescription: Saryn 兰花的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynDeluxeS.name: Saryn Orphid Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynDeluxeS.description: Bloom into a beautiful yet deadly agent of the Lotus.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynDeluxeS.zhDescription: 绽放为美丽而致命的 Lotus 特工。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynLunarNe.name: Saryn Yuheng Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynLunarNe.zhDescription: Saryn 玉恒的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynLunarNe.name: Saryn Yuheng Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynLunarNe.description: Take on the look of a moon goddess to celebrate Lunar Renewal.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynLunarNe.zhDescription: 装扮成月亮女神来庆祝农历新年。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynPrimeHe.name: Saryn Prime Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynPrimeHe.description: The standard issue helmet for the Saryn Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynPrimeSk.name: Saryn Prime Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynPrimeSk.description: The standard issue skin for the Saryn Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynPrimeSk.zhDescription: Saryn Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynSkin.name: Saryn Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/SarynSkin.description: The standard issue skin for the Saryn Warframe.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynA.name: Minerva's Shades (Up)
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynA.zhDescription: 米尼娃的标志性太阳镜。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynA.name: Minerva's Shades (Down)
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynA.zhDescription: 米尼娃的标志性太阳镜。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynH.name: Saryn Prime Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynH.description: The standard issue helmet for the Saryn Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynS.name: Minerva Gemini Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynS.description:
Minerva Hendricks, former Libertatian military agent, brings a human face to the Saryn Warframe.

Switch between Saryn and Minerva's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Minerva Gemini Emote, even during missions.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynS.zhDescription:
米尼娃·亨德里克斯是前自由军特工，她为 Saryn 战甲带来了人性化的一面。

使用内含的米尼娃双子表情动作，在 Saryn 和米尼娃的全配音、可自定义的双子外观之间切换，即使是在任务期间。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/AmazonOniS.name: Stezia Sumbha Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/AmazonOniS.description: Like a carnivorous flower, this alluring Syandana conceals a dangerous predator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/AmazonOniS.zhDescription: 就像一朵肉食性的花一样，这件披饰的诱人外表下潜藏着一个危险的捕食者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/April2015S.name: Kyroptera Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/April2015S.description: A Tenno Syandana evocative of winged night creatures.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/April2015S.zhDescription: 一件 Tenno 披饰，令人联想到有翅膀的夜之生物。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ArmScarf.name: Yomo Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ArmScarf.description: A traditional garment, popular with high ranking Tenno.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ArmScarf.zhDescription: 一件传统服装，在高等 Tenno 中很受欢迎。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/AtlasDelux.name: Stratum Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/AtlasDelux.description: Austere crystalline beauty, formed over time, deceptively delicate, lethally sharp. The Stratum Syandana perfectly compliments Karst, Atlas' deluxe skin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/AtlasDelux.zhDescription: 随着时间的推移形成了简朴的结晶美，看似脆弱却又尖锐致命。地层披饰完美地装点了岩溶， Atlas 的华丽外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape.name: Ki'Teer Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape.description: Walk the cutting edge of fashion with this exclusive Ki'Teer original.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape.zhDescription: 搭配 Ki'teer 原创的独占披饰，行于时尚的锐利锋缘。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape2R.name: Ki'Teer Razza Elixis Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape2R.description: The refined Razza Syandana, enriched further by the sheen of this bronzed Elixis skin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape2R.zhDescription: 精致的类种披饰在古铜色的皮革映衬下更显光彩夺目。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape2S.name: Ki'Teer Razza Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape2S.description: Exude style and poise with this refined accessory.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape2S.zhDescription: 用这款精致的配饰来彰显出格调与风度。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape3S.name: Ki'Teer Straed Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape3S.description: Flaunt your impeccable taste in a Ki'Teer original syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape3S.zhDescription: 身着 Ki'Teer 的原创披饰炫耀你无可挑剔的品味。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaruukDelu.name: Khinn Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaruukDelu.description: The glow of the Khinn Syandana inspires inward reflection.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaruukDelu.zhDescription: 经行披饰的光芒激发着内心的沉思。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BillowingC.name: Cumulus Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BillowingC.description: Roiling and swirling with the promise and threat of a thunderhead, the Cumulus Syandana is for those Tenno who dwell among the clouds.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BillowingC.zhDescription: 在雷霆的允诺和威力下飘摇吧，这个积云披饰是为那些住在云间的 Tenno 们所设计的。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BrassAndGo.name: Kyroptera Ormolu Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BrassAndGo.description: Custom edition of the Kyroptera Syandana forged by Tenno artisans.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BrassAndGo.zhDescription: 经由 Tenno 工匠所打造的订制版蝙蝠披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CenturionC.name: Centuria Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CenturionC.description: Take command with this imposing cloak.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CenturionC.zhDescription: 带着这壮丽的斗篷来发出指令。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CephSyanda.name: Boolean Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CephSyanda.description: A procedurally-designed Syandana possessed of proportions pleasing to 87.8% of Cephalons.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CephSyanda.zhDescription: 一件由程序设计的披饰，可以取悦 87.8% 的中枢。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CitrineDel.name: Corazon Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CitrineDel.description: Delicate blooms framed by vicious thorns warn: beauty can still be deadly. Citrine Aphrodita’s signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CitrineDel.zhDescription: 娇艳的花朵被恶毒的荆棘衬托，警示着：美丽也可能致命。Citrine 美神的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ConclaveCa.name: Celestia Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ConclaveCa.description: Displays Daily and Weekly Conclave Challenge and Mission progress, with a beam of light for each completed challenge or mission.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ConclaveCa.zhDescription: 能够在每天和每周显示武形秘仪挑战和任务进程，每完成一项挑战或任务便会点亮一道光。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpAladSca.name: Opulas Robe
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpAladSca.description: An opulent display of privilege for the Corpus elite becomes a trophy for the Tenno who fight them.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpAladSca.zhDescription: 一组特別赐给 Corpus 精英华贵展示品，如今成为与之对抗的 Tenno 的战利品。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpCubinat.name: Flox Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpCubinat.description: A Corpus-inspired Syandana that responds to the wearer's well-being, unfolding in response to damage. As you endure the Flox unfolds.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpCubinat.zhDescription: 一款受 Corpus 所启发的披饰，反映穿着者的状态，受到伤害时披饰展开。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpMBundle.name: Quaro Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpMBundle.description: Extol the virtues of Profit with this Corpus-styled Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpMBundle.zhDescription: 以这件 Corpus 风格的披饰来赞扬利润的美德。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpModular.name: Vexillus Cloak
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpModular.description: March through the battlefield with this Corpus cloak.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpModular.zhDescription: 身着这件 Corpus 斗篷于战场上行军。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DOTD2025Mo.name: Monarcierro Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DOTD2025Mo.description: Embody the festive spirit with this brightly painted syandana that evokes a magnificent bird.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DOTD2025Mo.zhDescription: 这款色彩鲜艳、犹如尊贵飞鸟的披饰体现了节日风采。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DOTDWolfBa.name: Saturn Six Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DOTDWolfBa.description: Pay tribute to the fallen with this festive syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DOTDWolfBa.zhDescription: 以这款节日披饰向逝者致敬。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DaxSquareC.name: Lustratus Conquest Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DaxSquareC.description: Reclaimed from the battlefields of Tau, this battle-worn syandana reflects the cost of war.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DaxSquareC.zhDescription: 这件从 Tau 的战场上缴获的披饰，饱经战火洗礼，它反映了战争的代价。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DaxTwoTail.name: Lustratus Warbanner Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DaxTwoTail.description: A syandana once worn to distinguish Dax commanders on Tau; wear it now as a mark of pride.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DaxTwoTail.zhDescription: 这是曾经用来在 Tau 上区分禁卫指挥官的披饰；现在佩戴它是一种荣耀的象征。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DeimosSupp.name: Khrusos Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DeimosSupp.description: Resembling a butterfly's wings emerging from their chrysalis, this Syandana seems infused with mystical power.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DeimosSupp.zhDescription: 宛如蝴蝶的翅膀破蛹而出，这款披饰似乎被注入了神秘的力量。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DexScarf.name: Dex Nouchali Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DexScarf.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the fourth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DexScarf.zhDescription: 这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻催眠中醒来 4 周年。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DinoSpikeS.name: Yamako Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DinoSpikeS.description: Once worn exclusively by Orokin Judiciary, the Yamako Syandana is a symbol of wisdom and authority.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DinoSpikeS.zhDescription: 山越披饰是一种传统的 Tenno 服饰。曾经只有奥罗金的法官才能穿戴，山越披饰是智慧和权威的象征。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DraculaCap.name: Dhampyre Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DraculaCap.description: Own the night with this sinister syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DraculaCap.zhDescription: 通过这件诡异披饰来主宰黑夜。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DuelistSya.name: Durumi Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DuelistSya.description: The wish for a long life is carried upon the noble wings of Narin's signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DuelistSya.zhDescription: 长寿的愿望承载在 Narin 标志性披饰的高贵羽翼之上。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EmberDelux.name: Volca Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EmberDelux.description: Ember's Fourth Law of Thermodynamics: look good doing it.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EmberDelux.zhDescription: Ember 的热力学第四定律：做起来要好看点。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EmberDelux.name: Bennu Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EmberDelux.description: The signature syandana of Ember Vermillion.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EmberDelux.zhDescription: Ember 朱红的标志性披饰

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EnergyScar.name: Asa Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EnergyScar.description: A traditional Tenno garment, this Syandana is woven from ancient, Orokin synthetic thread.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EnergyScar.zhDescription: 传统 Tenno 服装，这条披饰源自远古时期，由奥罗金合成纤维所编织而成。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EnergyScar.name: Asa Phased Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EnergyScar.description: The Void's corrupting energy has scarred this syandana, leaving it permanently out of phase with conventional space.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EnergyScar.zhDescription: 虚空的堕落能量让这件披饰伤痕累累，使它拥有完全迥异的外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EquinoxDel.name: Circadian Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EquinoxDel.description: Rise and fall, ebb and flow, peace and war. A signature Syandana for Equinox.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EquinoxDel.zhDescription: 盛衰兴废，潮起潮落，玉帛干戈。Equinox 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ErosionCap.name: Abrasys Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ErosionCap.description: Evokes stone scarred but not destroyed by the sea's tireless onslaught.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ErosionCap.zhDescription: 让人联想起那被不休海潮冲刷得伤痕累累却又没有破裂的巨石。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FireFlySca.name: Igaro Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FireFlySca.description: This wing-like syandana invokes the beauty and agility of the Ceresean Butterfly Sparrow.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FireFlySca.zhDescription: 这件翼状般的披饰呼应着自谷神蝶雀的美丽与轻灵。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FlameScarf.name: Pyra Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FlameScarf.description: During the Orokin Era, only the most fierce warriors were permitted to wear this flaming Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FlameScarf.zhDescription: 在奥罗金时代，只有最凶猛的战士们才被准许穿戴这件火焰般的披饰

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FlameScarf.name: Pyra Opula Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FlameScarf.description: Full spectrum flames dance around this evolved Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FlameScarf.zhDescription: 全光谱的火焰在这个进化后的披饰上舞动。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GarudaCape.name: Suparna Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GarudaCape.description: Flows like grace. Flows like blood. An asymmetrical, stain-resistant Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GarudaCape.zhDescription: 飘姿秀逸、淌若鲜血。一款可防渍的非对称披饰

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GaussDelux.name: Bolide Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GaussDelux.description: Gauss Kresnik’s signature Syandana proves he can stand the heat.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GaussDelux.zhDescription: Gauss 火神的标志性披饰证明他可以承受住高温的考验。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GaussDelux.name: Tailfin Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GaussDelux.description: Sleekly aerodynamic, Gauss Moto's signature syandana is made for speed.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GaussDelux.zhDescription: Gauss 摩托的标志性流线型空气动力学披饰，专为极速而生。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GlassDelux.name: Glistor Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GlassDelux.description: Panes of polished glass complete this elegant Syandana. Like Gara herself, it is less fragile than it looks.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GlassDelux.zhDescription: 抛光的玻璃让这件优雅的披饰更加完美。就像 Gara 她本人一样，它并不像看上去的那样脆弱。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrendelDel.name: Lumbox Tactical Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrendelDel.description: Be prepared for anything from a firefight to a midnight snack with Grendel Turbis' signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrendelDel.zhDescription: 佩戴 Grendel 暴坦的标志性披饰，无论是战场交锋还是午夜加餐，都要随时做好准备。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrineerTur.name: Harkonar Cloak
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrineerTur.description: A syandana of Grineer design. Matches the Harkonar Armor Set.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrineerTur.zhDescription: 由 Grineer 设计的披饰。与哈库那护甲套装配套。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnAmphisS.name: Amphor Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnAmphisS.description: A syandana assembled from the scavenged internals of some unidentified mechanism, it is still dusty from the desert where it was found.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnAmphisS.zhDescription: 这是一个由一些未被识别的机械内部残骸组装而成的披饰，它依然沾染着从它被发现之地带来的沙砾。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnHoodedC.name: Kuva Cloak
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnHoodedC.description: Once worn by an elegant Elder Queen, before time and disease left her body mangled and disfigured.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnHoodedC.zhDescription: 在身体被时间与疾病给折磨到残破不堪以前，优雅的大女皇曾穿着这件斗篷。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnQueenSc.name: Kuva Braid
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnQueenSc.description: Symbolizing the corrupting power of the Grineer Queens.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnQueenSc.zhDescription: 象征了 Grineer 双子女皇的腐化力量。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnStrapsS.name: Laddak Cloak
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnStrapsS.description: Fashioned with spare field components this cloak is an example of rarely seen creativity within the Grineer ranks.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnStrapsS.zhDescription: 这件由备用的战备零件打造而成的斗篷可是 Grinneer 兵队中罕见的创造性的例证之一。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnTubeSca.name: Rath Kittag Cloak
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnTubeSca.description: A prototype destined for one of Tyl Regor’s experiments, this syandana has been repurposed for Tenno Agents.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnTubeSca.zhDescription: 原为泰尔·雷工众多实验之一的预定原型，这件披饰现已易主为 Tenno 特工所使用。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnVhCape.name: Maggor Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnVhCape.description: Victory over the Grineer, draped across your shoulders.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnVhCape.zhDescription: 战胜 Grineer 的象征，披挂在你的肩膀。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/Halloween2.name: Izvara Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/Halloween2.description: Celebrate the departed with this colorful Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/Halloween2.zhDescription: 通过这件色彩缤纷的披饰来纪念逝者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenE.name: Abrasys Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenE.zhDescription: 一件令人毛骨悚然的节庆风格披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenF.name: Igaro Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenF.zhName: 伊卡洛 亡灵节披饰
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenF.description: An Igaro Syandana adorned with a morbidly festive design.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenF.zhDescription: 令人毛骨悚然的伊卡洛披饰节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenG.name: Vanquished Banner Day of the Dead
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenG.zhName: 战败旗帜 亡灵节披饰
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenG.description: A Vanquished Banner that has been adorned with a morbidly festive design.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenG.zhDescription: 以令人毛骨悚然的节庆风格所装饰的战败旗帜。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenK.name: Kyroptera Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenK.zhDescription: 一件令人毛骨悚然的节庆风格披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HildrynDel.name: Brising Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HildrynDel.description: The sun rises on the victor and sets upon the vanquished. This is how your legend is made. Adorn yourself with this exquisite syandana, worthy of the sun herself.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HildrynDel.zhDescription: 太阳在胜利者上升起，在被征服者身上落下。这就是你传说的诞生之处。用这个精致的披饰装点自己，无愧于太阳本身。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HolidayTur.name: Imperator Festive Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HolidayTur.description: A festive variation of the Imperator Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HolidayTur.zhDescription: 一条改款节庆版的凯旋将军披饰

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HornSkullS.name: Rakta Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HornSkullS.description: The Rakta Syandana is awarded by the Red Veil for exemplary valor. This honor is rarely given to outsiders.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HornSkullS.zhDescription: 绯红披饰是来自血色面纱象征英勇典范的奖赏，这项荣誉鲜少给予外来者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HornSkullS.name: Hecate Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HornSkullS.description: Used for festive ceremonies, this Syandana was often worn during social gatherings.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HornSkullS.zhDescription: 这件披饰经常在节日庆典时的社交场合中穿戴。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HydroidDel.name: Burangara Longcoat
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HydroidDel.description: Get decked out in this coat inspired by the surf and sand.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HydroidDel.zhDescription: 用这件灵感来自海浪和沙滩的长衣进行一番打扮。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IceSpikeCa.name: Glacia Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IceSpikeCa.description: Jagged, crystalline spikes crown a shroud of snowy mist in this ice themed syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IceSpikeCa.zhDescription: 在这款以冰为主题的披饰中，参差不齐的冰晶尖刺外笼罩着一层雪雾。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InarosDlxC.name: Scarab Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InarosDlxC.description: The signature syandana of Inaros Ramses.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InarosDlxC.zhDescription: Inaros 拉美西斯的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfBatCape.name: Awlspan Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfBatCape.description: Bring forth the look of your inner beast.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfCoralSy.name: Sordario Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfCoralSy.description: Pulsing with a bioluminescent glow, this syandana is eye-catchingly contagious.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfCoralSy.zhDescription: 散发着律动般的生物冷光，这款披饰有着引人注目的感染力。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfGrnWolf.name: Lycanblight Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfGrnWolf.description: Pursue your prey with a look that combines beast and Infestation.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfGrnWolf.zhDescription: 用一种融合了野兽与感染者的外表追击你的猎物。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfMembran.name: Apis Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfMembran.description: Chitin, cartilage and nectar. This Infested Syandana once twitched with unsettling life.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfMembran.zhDescription: 几丁质、软骨组织，以及花蜜。这件感染披饰曾经发出让人不安的抖动。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfScarfRi.name: Thorac Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfScarfRi.description: A sinuous spine of Infested anatomy.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfScarfRi.zhDescription: 感染者解剖后的弯曲脊椎。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfTentacl.name: Mucusk Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfTentacl.description: A crown of bone spawns a mass of writhing, meaty, Infested tentacles.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfTentacl.zhDescription: 一件骨盔上恣意生长着扭曲、多肉的感染触手。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfestedFi.name: Iliac Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfestedFi.description: An infested syandana made from living tissue. Matches the Iliac Armor Set.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfestedFi.zhDescription: 一个用活体组织制造出的感染披饰。与髂骨护甲组合配套。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IvaraDelux.name: Thiazi Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IvaraDelux.description: The signature syandana of Ivara Skathi.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IvaraDelux.zhDescription: Ivara 冬之女神的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IvaraPrime.name: Apavada Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IvaraPrime.zhName: 阿帕瓦哒 Prime 披饰
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IvaraPrime.zhDescription: Ivara Prime 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/JadeTurtle.name: Imperator Jade Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/JadeTurtle.zhName: 凯旋将军 翡翠披饰

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KazBaroCap.name: Ki'Teer Diax Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KazBaroCap.description: Define style with this crystalline cape.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KazBaroCap.zhDescription: 用这款水晶般的披风定义你的风格。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KazInfeste.name: Apoxys Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KazInfeste.description: This malignant growth hangs elegantly on the shoulders of any Tenno.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KazInfeste.zhDescription: 这恶性生长之物可以优雅地披挂于任何 Tenno 的肩膀。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KhoraPrime.name: Kerata Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KhoraPrime.description: Flowing lines meet sharpened spikes in Khora Prime's signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KhoraPrime.zhDescription: 流畅的线条与尖锐的钉刺在 Khora Prime 的标志性披饰中相逢。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KulervoDel.name: Culpa Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KulervoDel.description: Once chains of binding guilt, now twisted into a defiant ornament. The signature Syandana of Kullervo Apostate.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KulervoDel.zhDescription: 曾是束缚罪孽的锁链，如今扭曲成一个象征反抗的装饰物。这是 Kullervo 叛徒的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LasBackpac.name: K.O.L. Drippy-Assisted Tactical Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LasBackpac.zhName: 即时网滴答助攻战术披饰
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LasBackpac.description: Be prepared no matter where with everything you need for the long haul, including Drippy, the K.O.L. virtual assistant. 'No need for waterworks, Drippy is here to help!'
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LasBackpac.zhDescription: 无论身在何处，都要准备好应对长期发展所需的一切，包括即时网虚拟助手滴答。'无需费力，滴答助你一臂之力！'

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LasNightwa.name: Globakk Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LasNightwa.description: Only the most highly trained - or highly reckless - Scaldra dare to wear this portable Efervon container.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LasNightwa.zhDescription: 只有训练有素——或者极其鲁莽——的炽蛇军才敢佩戴这种便携式艾弗旺容器。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LavosDelux.name: Aculea Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LavosDelux.description: Many a specimen has felt the sting of this wearable apparatus. Lavos Khymia’s signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LavosDelux.zhDescription: 许多实验对象都曾感受到这件可穿戴设备的刺痛。Lavos 点金的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LimboDelux.name: Sidereal Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LimboDelux.description: A Syandana that dances upon the eddies of battle and void-currents alike.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LimboDelux.zhDescription: 一款在战场及虚空流电的旋涡上舞动的披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LisetScarf.name: Domus Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LisetScarf.description: Take to the stars with this sleek Syandana. Strapping in feels just like home.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LisetScarf.zhDescription: 带着这款柔滑的披饰前往各种行星。戴着它会有种如家的感觉。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/MagDeluxeS.name: Vasa Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/MagDeluxeS.zhDescription: Mag 元气的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/MesaDeluxe.name: Constella Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/MesaDeluxe.description: Venture into uncharted territory with Mesa Presidio’s signature Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/MesaDeluxe.zhDescription: 佩戴 Mesa 边塞的标志性披饰前去未知的领域冒险。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/MixerKyrop.name: Kyroptera Panoply Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/MixerKyrop.description: An elite version of the Kyroptera Syandana.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.name: Protovyre Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.description: An evolving Syandana that draws upon Sentient technology. Collect Relics or Aya with this Syandana equipped to unlock two additional looks.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.zhDescription: 一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化披饰。装备这款披饰收集遗物或阿耶精华时，会额外解锁两个外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.name: Protovyre Emergent Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.description: An evolving Syandana that draws upon Sentient technology. Collect Relics and Aya with this Syandana equipped to unlock an additional look.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.zhDescription: 一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化披饰。装备这款披饰收集遗物和阿耶精华时，会额外解锁一个外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.name: Protovyre Apex Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.description: An evolving Syandana that draws upon Sentient technology.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.zhDescription: 一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NefSyandan.name: Lucra Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NefSyandan.description: Flaunt wealth and prosperity with a constant stream of financial data.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NefSyandan.zhDescription: 用这股持续不断的财政数据流来炫耀财富与昌盛。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NeurovyreP.name: Neurovyre Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NeurovyreP.description: Painstakingly embellished with scavenged gold as a treaty gift for the Orokin, this Sentient spinal symbiote serves as Caliban Prime’s signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NeurovyreP.zhDescription: 作为与奥罗金签订的条约礼物，这个 Sentient 脊椎异融者由搜集而来的黄金精心装饰，是 Caliban Prime 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NezhaDelux.name: Buzhou Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NezhaDelux.description: The strength of the mountain; the grace of flowing water.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NezhaLever.name: Reshantur Cult Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NezhaLever.description: This humble Syandana is modeled on those worn by the Children of Reshantur, who formed into a clan devoted to Nezha in defense of their home.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NezhaLever.zhDescription: 这件朴素的披饰是根据瑞圣途的孩子们曾穿戴过的样式设计而来的，那些孩子们组成了一支信奉 Nezha 的小型氏族来保卫他们的家园。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NidusDelux.name: Nosos Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NidusDelux.description: The signature Syandana of Nidus Phryke.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NidusDelux.zhDescription: Nidus 恐惧神的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NidusPrime.name: Crinoid Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NidusPrime.description: Beauty and dread combine in this unique Infested Syandana, alive with swaying gilded tentacles.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NidusPrime.zhDescription: 美丽与恐惧在这件独特的感染者披饰中融为一体，镀金的触须摇曳生姿。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NokkoSyand.name: Caranthele Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NokkoSyand.description: Nokko’s trusty pack carries everything needed for a long day of caring for the fruits n’ roots. Nokko’s signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NokkoSyand.zhDescription: Nokko 的可靠背包里装着一整天照料果子和根所需的一切。Nokko 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NoruPrimeS.name: Noru Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NoruPrimeS.description: A relic from another time, this syandana is a highly ornamental and prized garment.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NoruPrimeS.zhDescription: 来自于其他时代的遗物，这条披饰是一种极具观赏性的珍贵服装。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NovaDeluxe.name: Danavi Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NovaDeluxe.zhDescription: Nova 阿修罗的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NovaIIDelu.name: Radia Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NovaIIDelu.description: The signature syandana of Nova Atomica.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NovaIIDelu.zhDescription: Nova 原子姬的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NyxDeluxeS.name: Enthra Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NyxDeluxeS.description: Strike a cutting figure with Nyx’s mesmerizing signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NyxDeluxeS.zhDescription: 用 Nyx 迷人的标志性披饰为打造出一个凛冽的仪表。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PS5Syandan.name: Obsidian Sedai Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PS5Syandan.description: Next-generation Tenno design, enviable and cutting-edge.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PS5Syandan.zhDescription: Tenno 的次世代设计，令人艳羡且走在时尚前沿。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PacifistSy.name: Akrabu Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PacifistSy.description: This Syandana of corded-knots wrapped in linen is used by Baruuk for meditation and contemplation.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PacifistSy.zhDescription: 亚麻布包裹的绳状披饰，被 Baruuk 使用于冥想和沉思。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PaxDuviric.name: Ahlto Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PaxDuviric.description: The Void makes its mark on Kullervo's signature Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PaxDuviric.zhDescription: 虚空在 Kullervo 的标志性披饰上留下了自己的印记。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAkrab.name: Asila Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAkrab.description: The ornate charms on this Syandana represent the ideal of serenity.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAkrab.zhDescription: 这件披饰上的华丽坠饰代表了宁静的理想。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAltra.name: Altra Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAltra.zhName: 阿尔特拉 Prime 披饰
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAltra.description: A shining garment befitting the Saint of Altra.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAltra.zhDescription: 适合阿尔特拉圣者的闪亮服装。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeArtif.name: Artifex Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeArtif.description: A techno-organic Syandana, reimagined with regal flair worthy of the Orokin elite.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeArtif.zhDescription: 一款科技有机披饰，重塑奥罗金精英的高贵气质。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAviaS.name: Avia Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAviaS.description: The bold, wing-like arcs of this Syandana have been crafted to complement the Avia Prime armor.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAviaS.zhDescription: 这件不羁的、像翅膀一样的弧形披饰，是为了搭配飞空 Prime 护甲而精心打造的。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeCapeE.name: Isabeau Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeCapeE.description: A flowing river of light and grace, a Syandana fit for royalty.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeCapeE.zhDescription: 充盈着光与优雅的流动之河，此乃适合高贵之人的披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeChrom.name: Impetus Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeChrom.description: A blade-like cut in regal red-and-gold, reminiscent of the elite honor guards of ancient Mars.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeChrom.zhDescription: 庄严的红色与金色构成的利刃，令人回想起旧日火星上的精英御卫。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeCitri.name: Sphatika Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeCitri.description: Citrine Prime's signature Syandana sparkles with a brilliant luster.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeCitri.zhDescription: Citrine Prime 的标志性披饰闪耀着璀璨的光芒。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeFlame.name: Pyra Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeFlame.description: A ceremonial version of the Pyra that drapes the entire back in a cape of flames.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeFlame.zhDescription: 庆典版的珮菈，一条披挂在背部的火焰披风。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeGrend.name: Sumbha Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeGrend.description: The signature Syandana of the gilded gourmand, Grendel Prime.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeGrend.zhDescription: 镀金美食家 Grendel Prime 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeGyreS.name: Triodic Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeGyreS.description: Enchant onlookers with the crystalline adornments of Gyre Prime's signature syandana.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeInaro.name: Kahtuss Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeInaro.description: A regal Syandana and a record of Inaros' legacy.
