/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeLimbo.name: Oblivia Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeLimbo.description: Step into oblivion with the signature syandana of Limbo Prime.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeLimbo.zhDescription: 用 Limbo Prime 的标志性披饰步入遗忘边境。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeMerul.name: Merulina Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeMerul.zhName: 浪漪珊瑚 Prime 披饰
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeMerul.description: Yareli Prime’s faithful water-glider is happy to adorn her body as an additional ornament.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeMerul.zhDescription: Yareli Prime 忠实的水上滑行者很乐意成为她身上额外的装饰品。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeNaveS.name: Nave Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeNaveS.description: Invest Harrow Prime with this golden Syandana of holy office.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeNaveS.zhDescription: 授予 Harrow Prime 这件圣职用的金色披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeObero.name: Sukira Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeObero.description: This long, powerful ribbon symbolizes the Tenno path toward balance.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeObero.zhDescription: 这条长而有力的缎带标志着 Tenno 的平衡之道。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeOctav.name: Serenidine Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeOctav.description: Awe the crowds with this majestic flourish of a Syandana, fit for the mistress of the Mandachord.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeOctav.zhDescription: 这款华丽曼妙的披饰，不仅能让听众折服，与那位演奏曼达和弦琴的女音乐家更是绝配。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeReven.name: Aurimus Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeReven.description: A spectral glow emanates from this ornate syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeReven.zhDescription: 这件华丽的披饰散发着鬼魅的幽光。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeRhopt.name: Rhoptron Prime Syandana

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeScarf.name: Misa Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeScarf.description: Discovered in the vaults of a drifting derelict, this Syandana was worn by Temple Guardians before the fall of the Orokin Empire
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeScarf.zhDescription: 这件披饰是在漂流的遗迹宝库中被发现，在奥罗金帝国灭亡之前是由神庙守卫所穿戴。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeScarf.name: Massif Prime Syandana

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SapientCap.name: Altra Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SapientCap.description: Found deep in the rubble at Altra, this Syandana is thought to have been worn by Gauss on the day he broke through enemy lines, decisively ending that bloody siege.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SapientCap.zhDescription: 这件在阿尔特拉废墟深处发现的披饰，被认为是 Gauss 在突破敌人防线，果断结束那场血腥围攻时所穿过的。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SentSyanda.name: Neurovyre Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SentSyanda.description: A Sentient spinal symbiote that functions as Caliban’s signature Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SentSyanda.zhDescription: 一个 Sentient 的脊椎共生体，现在成为了 Caliban 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ShieldFram.name: Surator Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ShieldFram.description: A Syandana with kick, as robust as Hildryn herself.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ShieldFram.zhDescription: 够带劲的披饰，像 Hildryn 一样强壮。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SiriusOrio.name: Jade's Victory Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SiriusOrio.description: Fury tempered. Pride soothed. This unity was hard-won, and all the more precious for it.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SiriusOrio.zhDescription: 怒火平息，骄傲抚平。这份团结来之不易，也因此更加珍贵。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SiriusOrio.name: Orion's Swaddle Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SiriusOrio.description: Swaddling cloth of the infant Orion, torn in ecstatic fury.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SiriusOrio.zhDescription: 包裹着幼年 Orion 的襁褓布，在狂喜的愤怒中被撕碎。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SiriusOrio.name: Sirius' Swaddle Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SiriusOrio.description: Swaddling cloth of the infant Sirius, worn as a ragged badge of honor.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SiriusOrio.zhDescription: 包裹着幼年 Sirius 的襁褓布，被当作一枚破旧的荣誉勋章佩戴着。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SyndicateN.name: Sancti Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SyndicateN.description: The Sancti Syandana pulses every time the Tenno uses an ability and continues to strengthen with each ability used.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SyndicateN.zhDescription: 圣洁披饰会在 Tenno 每次使用技能的时候发出脉冲，并在每次使用技能时继续加强效果。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SyndicateP.name: Secura Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SyndicateP.description: This Secura Syandana pulses every time a Tenno picks up credits and glows brighter as their wealth increases.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SyndicateP.zhDescription: 保障披饰会在 Tenno 每次捡取现金时候发出脉冲，并在每次财富增加时发出更亮的光芒。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SyndicateR.name: Asita Rakta Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SyndicateR.description: This Asita Rakta Syandana ignites a jet of flames that burns brighter with each stealth takedown.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SyndicateR.zhDescription: 隐士绯红披饰会在每次的暗杀燃起火焰，并且愈燃愈亮。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SyndicateS.name: Vaykor Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SyndicateS.description: The Vaykor Syandana flares up whenever the Tenno takes damage.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/SyndicateS.zhDescription: 勇气披饰会在 Tenno 受到伤害时燃烧起来。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TC2025Evol.name: Nulwarden Syandana (Void-swept)
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TC2025Evol.zhName: 虚空防御者披饰（虚空侵蚀）
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TC2025Evol.description: This tattered variant syandana displays the wearer's ability to manipulate the Void.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TC2025Evol.zhDescription: 这块破旧的变体披饰，彰显了佩戴者操纵虚空的能力。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TC2025Evol.name: TennoCon Riftguard Syandana (Void-swept)
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TC2025Evol.zhName: TennoCon 裂隙护卫披饰（虚空侵蚀）
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TC2025Evol.description: This Void-swept cape transitions into its normal form when the TennoCon Riftguard Emote is used. Created to celebrate the tenth anniversary of Tennocon.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TC2025Evol.zhDescription: 使用 TennoCon 裂隙护卫表情动作时，这件被虚空侵蚀的斗篷会化为正常形态。为庆祝 TennoCon 十周年而创作。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TC2025Orok.name: Nulwarden Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TC2025Orok.description: Stand guard against the allure of the Void with this opulent syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TC2025Orok.zhDescription: 用这件华丽的披饰抵御虚空的诱惑。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TC2025Scar.name: TennoCon Riftguard Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TC2025Scar.description: This flowing cape transitions into its tattered Void-swept form when the TennoCon Riftguard Emote is used. Created to celebrate ten years of TennoCon in 2025.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TC2025Scar.zhDescription: 使用 TennoCon 裂隙护卫表情动作时，这件飘逸的斗篷会化为残破的虚空侵蚀形态。为庆祝 2025 年 TennoCon 十周年而创作。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoAngle.name: Bombyx Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoAngle.description: Envelop yourself in this silky nature-inspired syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoAngle.zhDescription: 将自己裹入这款由天然丝绸所启发联想到的披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoCon20.name: TennoCon 2017 Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoCon20.description: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2017.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoCon20.zhDescription: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2017 的玩家。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoCon20.name: TennoCon 2020 Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoCon20.description: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2020.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoCon20.zhDescription: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2020 的玩家。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoCon20.name: TennoCon 2023 Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoCon20.description: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2023.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoCon20.zhDescription: 赐予那些参与 TennoCon 2023 欢庆的玩家。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoCon20.name: TennoCon 2024 Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoCon20.description: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2024.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoCon20.zhDescription: 授予那些参与 TennoCon 2024 欢庆的玩家。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoConSc.name: TennoCon 2016 Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoConSc.description: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2016.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoConSc.zhDescription: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2016 的玩家。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoFeath.name: Foxglove Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoFeath.description: Envelop yourself in this silky nature-inspired syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoFeath.zhDescription: 将自己裹入这款由天然丝绸所启发联想到的披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoLeafD.name: Samia Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoLeafD.description: Envelop yourself in this silky nature-inspired syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoLeafD.zhDescription: 将自己裹入这款由天然丝绸所启发联想到的披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoWolfB.name: Saturn Six Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoWolfB.description: A syandana inspired by the brutality of life inside the Saturn Six Max-Pen.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TennoWolfB.zhDescription: 一件灵感源自于土星六号最高戒备监狱里残酷生命的披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TitaniaDel.name: Raylta Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TitaniaDel.description: A glowing syandana of the deadly night.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TitaniaDel.zhDescription: 一件致命之夜的发光披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TitaniaPri.name: Gigelor Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TitaniaPri.description: A miniature twist on Titania Prime's signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TitaniaPri.zhDescription: 迷你版的 Titania Prime 标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TitaniaPri.name: Gigelorum Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TitaniaPri.zhDescription: Titania Prime 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnAlchemis.name: Vitam Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnAlchemis.description: Lavos' signature Syandana has been engineered for life in the lab and the battlefield.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnAlchemis.zhDescription: Lavos 的标志性披饰经过精心设计，适用于实验室和战场的日常使用。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnAshDelux.name: Cremata Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnAshDelux.description: With time and fire the truth of bone is revealed. The signature Syandana of Ash Shroud.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnAshDelux.zhDescription: 伴随着时间与烈火，骨头的真面目被揭示。Ash 裹尸布的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnBrokenFr.name: Artifex Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnBrokenFr.description: This techno-organic syandana fits over the shoulder, producing a unique, spiked silhouette.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnBrokenFr.zhDescription: 这件有机科技披饰与肩部贴合，勾勒出独特且又突出的轮廓。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnCharityR.name: Conquera Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnCharityR.description: Wear this ribbon Syandana as a symbol of support in the Quest to Conquer Cancer.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnCharityR.zhDescription: 佩戴此缎带披饰作为支持「征服癌症活动」的象征。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnConcrete.name: Portcull Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnConcrete.description: Qorvex's signature Syandana looks like stone but remains as light as it is stylish.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnConcrete.zhDescription: Qorvex 的标志性披饰看起来像石头，但却轻巧时尚。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnGuandaoS.name: Mozi Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnGuandaoS.description: Windswept ribbons of crimson evoke the war-kites of ancient earth.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnGuandaoS.zhDescription: 迎风飘扬的绯红缎带唤起了对古老地球的战争风筝的记忆。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnGyreCape.name: Triodic Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnGyreCape.description: Amplify your look with Gyre’s signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnGyreCape.zhDescription: 用 Gyre 的标志性披饰来强化你的造型。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnKorahSya.name: Pulchranopsis Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnKorahSya.description: The beauty of the orchid paired with the elegance of Tenno design. A signature Syandana for Khora.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnKorahSya.zhDescription: 兰花的美丽与 Tenno 设计的典雅相辅相成。Khora 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnLargeCap.name: Broca Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnLargeCap.description: This flowing Tenno cape is supported by an intricately sculpted brooch.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnLargeCap.zhDescription: 这款流畅的 Tenno 披饰由雕刻复杂的饰针支撑着。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnLargeCap.name: Broca Prominence Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnLargeCap.description: Draw attention with the bold geometric patterns in this exclusive Broca Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnLargeCap.zhDescription: 用这件专属的布洛卡披饰上大块的几何图案来吸引注意力。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnLargeCap.name: Broca Solstice Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnLargeCap.description: This winter rendering is a perfect fit for the geometric patterns of the Broca syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnLargeCap.zhDescription: 这款冬季外观与布洛卡披饰的几何图案完美契合。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnLefauche.name: Palla Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnLefauche.description: Tenno design at its finest. This classic syandana was inspired by the elegant drapery of the Orokin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnLefauche.zhDescription: Tenno 设计的杰出代表。这款经典披饰的灵感来自于奥罗金的优雅帷幔。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnNewPlaye.name: Oscira Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnNewPlaye.description: An arcing syandana with refined highlights and distinctive technical elements.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnNewPlaye.zhDescription: 一款具有精致亮点与独特科技元素的弧形披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnOctaviaD.name: Verismo Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnOctaviaD.description: Make a breathtaking entrance with the syncopated design of the Verismo Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnOctaviaD.zhDescription: 佩戴这款切分音设计的写实歌剧披饰来进行一次惊心动魄的登场。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnOdaliskS.name: Rhoptron Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnOdaliskS.description: A confident warrior strides into battle, but the truly brazen announce their presence with an ostentatious flourish. The Rhoptron is Protea's signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnOdaliskS.zhDescription: 一位自信的勇士会大踏步迈入战斗，但真正的无耻之徒会以更浮夸的举动来宣告他们的存在。铃鼓是 Protea 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnOniSyand.name: Sumbha Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnOniSyand.description: A most curious syandana, and one favored by the gallant gourmand, Grendel.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnOniSyand.zhDescription: 一款造型别致的披饰，深受豪爽美食家 Grendel 的青睐。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnPagemast.name: Rencowl Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnPagemast.zhDescription: 一件让人联想到抄写室的披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnPyraV2Sy.name: Stelflare Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnPyraV2Sy.description: Advance into the heat of battle.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnRailjack.name: Raya Sigma Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnRailjack.description: Flash across the battlefield with this syandana that elevates the original design of House Sigma.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnRailjack.zhDescription: 穿上这款升级自西格玛系列原版设计的披饰，在战场上闪耀。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnRailjack.name: Sigma Series Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnRailjack.description: This Syandana was a mark of honor, and part of the battle dress of Warframe Railjack crews.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnRailjack.zhDescription: 这款披饰是荣誉的标记，是 Warframe 航道星舰舰员战斗服的一部分。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnSmallBat.name: Synkra Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnSmallBat.description: A satisfyingly coordinated Syandana that is more than the sum of its parts.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnSmallBat.zhDescription: 一件整体协调到令人满意的披饰，而不仅是它的各个部分的简单相加。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnSparrowC.name: Parotia Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnSparrowC.description: Put on a striking display with this fanciful syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnSparrowC.zhDescription: 将这款奇特的披饰摆在醒目位置。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnSundialC.name: Lodestar Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnSundialC.description: Stay on the true path with this compass inspired Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnSundialC.zhDescription: 戴着这基于罗盘构想的披饰在正道上继续前行。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnVoltDelu.name: Cathode Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnVoltDelu.zhDescription: Volt 原型的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnWispDelu.name: Subvolv Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnWispDelu.description: Wisp Somnium's signature Syandana evokes the light and shadow of a solar eclipse.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnWispDelu.zhDescription: Wisp 星梦的标志性披饰唤出日食的光影。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnWraitheS.name: Vithil Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnWraitheS.description: A flowing, contoured Syandana for Sevagoth, the dark Helmsman.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TnWraitheS.zhDescription: 一款为黑暗舵手 Sevagoth 设计的流动且轮廓分明的披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TurtleNeck.name: Imperator Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TurtleNeck.description: Before the fall, the Imperator Syandana was bestowed upon only the highest-ranking Orokin commanders.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TurtleNeck.zhDescription: 在奥罗金帝国衰败之前，只有最高阶的奥罗金将领才能被授予凯旋将军披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/Twitch2021.name: Verv Atelia Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/Twitch2021.description: Dazzle the crowds with this stylish high-concept Syandana, modelled for elegance.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/Twitch2021.zhDescription: 这款时尚且拥有尖端概念的披饰让人眼花缭乱，造型异常优雅。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TwitchPrim.name: Spektaka Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TwitchPrim.zhName: 华丽演出 Prime 披饰
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TwitchPrim.description: See and be seen with this captivating Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/TwitchPrim.zhDescription: 以这件迷人的披饰成为时尚新宠儿。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/UmbraDaxDa.name: Dax Daybreak Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/UmbraDaxDa.description: Bring the early light of Sol to this late-Orokin Dax Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/UmbraDaxDa.zhDescription: 让太阳神初晓的光辉，照耀这件奥罗金晚期的禁卫披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/UmbraDaxSy.name: Dax Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/UmbraDaxSy.description: Worn in battle and ceremony by late-Orokin Dax, this Syandana was seen as a symbol of power to all in the empire.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/UmbraDaxSy.zhDescription: 前任奥罗金禁卫将这件披饰穿在战场和典礼中，它被全帝国视为是权力的象征。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/UruPrimeSc.name: Uru Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/UruPrimeSc.description: Let these massive segments of interlinked gold and silver ripple down a Warframe’s back.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/UruPrimeSc.zhDescription: 令那无数交织的金色与银色如水波般飘洒在战甲的背部。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/VTDinoSpik.name: Prisma Yamako Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/VTDinoSpik.description: Forged by Orokin era artisans, this exquisite syandana is finished by bathing its prisma crystal in pure Void energy.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/VTDinoSpik.zhDescription: 由奥罗金时代的工匠所制造，这条精致的披饰是浸泡在充满虚空能量的棱晶中才完成的。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/VTHornSkul.name: Prisma Hecate Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/VTHornSkul.zhName: 棱晶 朔月女神披饰
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/VTHornSkul.description: This Hecate Syandana has been threaded with filaments of prisma crystals.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/VTHornSkul.zhDescription: 这件朔月女神披饰被镶嵌上棱水晶细丝。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ValdurBack.name: Valdur's Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ValdurBack.description: Honor a great commander by wearing his distinctive syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ValdurBack.zhDescription: 佩戴这位伟大统帅的标志性披肩，以示敬意。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/VitamPrime.name: Vitam Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/VitamPrime.description: Transmute the chaos of battle into golden triumph.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/VitamPrime.zhDescription: 将战斗的混乱转化为金子般的胜利。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/WraithTurb.name: Harkonar Wraith Cloak
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/WraithTurb.description: A blood-red variant of this symbolic Grineer cloak.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/WraithTurb.zhDescription: 具有象征性的血红版 Grineer 斗篷

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/WukongDelu.name: Subhuti Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/WukongDelu.zhDescription: Wukong 三摩提的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/YamakoPrim.name: Yamako Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/YamakoPrim.description: An ancient and golden syandana, worn only by those chosen to lead the Orokin High Court.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/YamakoPrim.zhDescription: 一款古老的金色披饰，只有那些被挑选出来带领奥罗金高阶枢密院的勇士才能佩戴。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/YareliCape.name: Merulina Syandana

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Volt/VoltTwitchHel.zhDescription: 用这独占的 Volt 头盔上刚劲的几何图案来吸引注意力。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Volt/VoltTwitchSki.name: Volt Prominence Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Volt/VoltTwitchSki.description: Draw attention with the bold geometric patterns in this exclusive Volt skin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Volt/VoltTwitchSki.zhDescription: 用这独占的 Volt 外观上刚劲的几何图案来吸引注意力。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Volt/WF1999VoltAux.name: Amir's Shades
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Volt/WF1999VoltAux.zhDescription: 阿米尔的标志性玫瑰色太阳镜。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Volt/WF1999VoltSki.name: Amir Gemini Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Volt/WF1999VoltSki.description:
Amir Beckett, the Hex's quirky, upbeat technician, brings a human face to the Volt Warframe.

Switch between Volt and Amir's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Amir Gemini Emote, even during missions.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Volt/WF1999VoltSki.zhDescription:
阿米尔·贝克特是六人组中的古怪而乐观的技术员，他为 Volt 战甲带来了人性化的一面。

使用内含的阿米尔双子表情动作，在 Volt 和阿米尔的全配音、可自定义的双子外观之间切换，即使是在任务期间。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Claws/Garu.name: Bloodfrenzy Venka Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Claws/Garu.description: Send a gruesome message about the fate of all who encounter these claws with this skin for the Venka.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Claws/Garu.zhDescription: 使用这款凯旋之爪外观，向所有遭遇这些利爪的人传达一个可怕的命运信息。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DSPistols/.name: Protokol Spectre Pistol Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DSPistols/.description: In the distant past, pistols of this kind packed a mean punch.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DSPistols/.zhDescription: 在遥远的过去，这种手枪杀伤力巨大。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DSPistols/.name: Protokol Vekesk Pistol Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DSPistols/.zhName: 协议维克斯克手枪外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DSPistols/.description: Give your pistol some primeval kick.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DSPistols/.zhDescription: 给你的手枪带来一丝原始的感觉。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DSPistols/.name: Protokol Tekna Pistol Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DSPistols/.description: An ancient look for a reliable pistol.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DSPistols/.zhDescription: 一把可靠手枪的古老外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DSPistols/.name: Protokol 95 Pistol Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DSPistols/.description: A real beauty from a former age.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Daggers/Ar.name: Niveus Nepheri Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Daggers/Ar.zhName: 赤炎流星 冰魄外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Daggers/Ar.description: The dual fang-blades of the Archon Amar, now frozen solid with chilling wrath.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Daggers/Ar.zhDescription: 执刑官欺谋狼主的双刃，如今已被刺骨的愤怒彻底冻结。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Daggers/As.name: Bladeswarm Karyst Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Daggers/As.description: This Karyst skin bears the markings of a long forgotten assassin's order, the Scoria.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Daggers/As.zhDescription: 这款凯洛斯特外观上印有早已被世人遗忘的刺客组织火山石的标志。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DualDagger.name: Zastra Dual Dagger Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DualDagger.description: Artistry meets lethality with this elegant dual dagger skin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DualDagger.zhDescription: 在这款优雅的双持匕首外观，精美手工艺与致命杀伤力双剑合壁。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DualSword/.name: Dual Sword Lemnas Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DualSword/.description: An enchanted skin for any Dual Sword combination.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/DualSword/.zhDescription: 适用于任意双剑组合的迷人外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Glaives/Te.name: Niveus Orvius Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Glaives/Te.description: The icy glint of this Orvius skin stops enemies in their tracks.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Glaives/Te.zhDescription: 这一灵枢外观散发出的冰冷光芒足以让敌人止步不前。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Glaives/Xo.name: Xoris Elixis Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Glaives/Xo.zhName: 驱魔之刃 镀铜外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Glaives/Xo.description: Give the Xoris a dose of old world class with this bronzed Elixis skin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Glaives/Xo.zhDescription: 这款古铜色的外观为驱魔之刃赋予了浓浓的怀旧风格。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.name: Niveus Paracesis Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.zhName: 心智之殁 冰魄外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.description: The Sentient slayer, veiled in glittering ice.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.zhDescription: Sentient 猎杀者，被耀眼的冰层笼罩。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.name: Paracesis Obsidian Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.zhName: 心智之殁 黑曜石外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.description: A next-generation skin for the Paracesis.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.zhDescription: 心智之殁的次世代外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.name: Heavy Blade Grimstone Cleaver Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.description: A unique heavy blade skin, designed by Vulbjorn, the graphical walrus.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.zhDescription: 独特的巨刃外观，由 Vulbjorn, the graphical walrus 设计。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.name: Paracesis Opal Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.zhName: 心智之殁 蛋白石外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.description: A next-generation skin for the Paracesis.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.zhDescription: 心智之殁的次世代外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.name: Heavy Blade Obanakk Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.description: A unique heavy blade skin, designed by VoidPunch.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.zhDescription: 独特的巨刃外观，由 VoidPunch 设计。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.name: Paracesis Jade Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.zhName: 心智之殁 翡翠外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.description: A next-generation skin for the Paracesis.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/GreatSword.zhDescription: 心智之殁的次世代外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Grimoire/G.name: Eskhatos Grimoire Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Grimoire/G.description: The seething cover of this skin for the Grimoire does all it can to disinvite touch.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Grimoire/G.zhDescription: 这个魔典外观的封面沸腾翻滚，极尽所能地阻止任何人的触碰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Grimoire/G.name: Vitreum Tome Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Grimoire/G.description: Set watchful eyes upon the battle.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Grimoire/G.name: Necratech Tome Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Grimoire/G.description: Give your tome a high-tech appearance.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Grimoire/G.zhDescription: 为你的典籍赋予高科技外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Grimoire/H.name: Grimoire Day of the Dead Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Grimoire/H.description: Celebrate the departed with this festive skin for the Grimoire.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Grimoire/H.zhDescription: 使用魔典的这款节日外观来纪念逝者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Grimoire/P.name: Noctua Lophos
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Grimoire/P.description: The dark feathers of Dante Tytonis' Exalted Tome lift arcane secrets to the skies.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Grimoire/P.zhDescription: Dante 夜鹰的显赫典籍夜枭上那深色羽毛，将玄奥的秘密高高托举入云霄。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Hammers/Ni.name: Fragor Opal Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Hammers/Ni.zhName: 重击巨锤 蛋白石外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Hammers/Ni.description: A next-generation skin for the Fragor.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Hammers/Ni.zhDescription: 重击巨锤的次世代外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Hammers/So.name: Motherwrench Hammer Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Hammers/So.description: Leave the Corpus in no doubt as to where your allegiance lies with this iconic Solaris utility item. Lift together, smack 'em down together.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Hammers/So.zhDescription: 让 Corpus 毫不怀疑你对这个标志性的索拉里斯体系的忠诚度。共度时艰，一起击败他们。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/A.name: Bladeswarm Vectis Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/A.description: This Vectis skin's camouflage is designed for long stakeouts, an essential part of any assassin's toolkit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/A.zhDescription: 这款守望者外观的迷彩设计专为长时间的蹲点而打造，是每位刺客必备的装备之一。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/C.name: Ascension Speargun Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/C.description: Adopt your Corpus enemy’s aesthetic. Show them whose vision of the future will prevail.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/C.zhDescription: 采用你的 Corpus 敌人的审美。让他们看看谁的未来愿景将得胜。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/C.name: Niveus Glaxion Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/C.zhName: 冷冻光束步枪 冰魄外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/C.description: The glacial cold of the Glaxion freeze ray is now reflected on its exterior.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/C.zhDescription: 冷冻光束步枪冰冻射线的刺骨寒意如今已映照在其表面上。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/G.name: Bloodfrenzy Nagantaka Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/G.description: A bloodthirsty Nagantaka skin for those who prefer to use a crossbow at close range.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/G.zhDescription: 一款嗜血的噬蛇弩外观，适合喜欢近距离使用弩的玩家。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/H.name: Renuntio Speargun Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/H.description: Renounce heresy with this signature speargun skin for Harrow Reliquary.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/H.zhDescription: 使用 Harrow 圣骨匣的标志性标枪外观来宣布摒弃异端邪说！

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/R.name: Niveus Quellor Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/R.description: The Quellor's reliable cryo-blasts wrapped in a new frigid package.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/R.zhDescription: 压制者可靠的冰冻爆裂如今包裹在崭新的冰冷外壳中。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/S.name: Burston Solstice Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/S.description: A festive skin for the Burston.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Machete/Gr.name: Kludgekil Machete Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Machete/Gr.description: Bludgeon, hack, and maim with this improvised machete skin fashioned out of broken Grineer weapons.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Machete/Gr.zhDescription: 用这款由 Grineer 武器残骸所随兴打造出来的砍刀外观去棒打、劈砍、残害敌人。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Bi.name: Stratus Pistol Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Bi.description: A skin to provide a billowing, ethereal look for your pistol.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Bi.zhDescription: 一款为你的手枪带来滚滚云烟般的飘渺外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Ce.name: Pandero Ceramica Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Ce.description: A bold red and white glaze glisten across the surface of this hardened ceramic Pandero skin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Ce.zhDescription: 鲜明的红色和白色釉彩闪亮在坚硬的陶瓷手鼓外观表面。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Ga.name: Bloodfrenzy Ballistica Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Ga.description: This skin for the Ballistica embodies the philosophy that if your weapon is clean, you're not using it properly.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Ga.zhDescription: 这款布里斯提卡外观体现了'如果你的武器很干净，说明你没有正确使用它'的理念。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Tn.name: Zundi Dual Pistol Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Tn.description: As no Zundi weapons survive from the Old War this formidable pistol skin was created to honor them. Stout, distinctive and intimidating it is a reminder of times past.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Tn.zhDescription: 由于没有尊谛武器从远古之战留存下来，这种令人敬畏的手枪外观被制作出来以作纪念。强力、与众不同，且又使人望而生畏，令人回想起过去的时代。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Tn.name: Zundi Pistol Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Tn.description: As no Zundi weapons survive from the Old War this formidable pistol skin was created to honor them. Stout, distinctive and intimidating it is a reminder of times past.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Tn.zhDescription: 由于没有尊谛武器从远古之战留存下来，这种令人敬畏的手枪外观被制作出来以作纪念。强力、与众不同，且又使人望而生畏，令人回想起过去的时代。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Zy.name: Zylok Elixis Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Zy.zhName: 席尔火枪 镀铜外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Zy.description: This bronzed Elixis skin for the Zylok is a heavy hitter of style.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Zy.zhDescription: 这款古铜色的外观让席尔火枪极具风格冲击力。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Rapier/Crp.name: Rapier Tributaker Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Rapier/Crp.description: Appropriate the Corpus aesthetic for your blade.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Rapier/Crp.zhDescription: 将 Corpus 风格融入你的刀剑中。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Rapier/Ice.name: Neote Rapier Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Rapier/Ice.description: Narin's frozen rapier skin, bestowed upon only those whom she deems worthy.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Rapier/Ice.zhDescription: Narin 的冰霜细剑外观，只赐予她认为配得上的人。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Rapier/Las.name: Viktor's Rapier Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Rapier/Las.description: Commissioned by Lieutenant Viktor Vodyanoi for his personal use, this elegant officer's weapon incorporates Sol and Lua motifs.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Rapier/Las.zhDescription: 这款优雅的军官武器由维克多·维德诺伊中尉委托制造供其个人使用，融合了太阳神和月神的图案。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Rapier/TnL.name: Nefertym Rapier Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Rapier/TnL.description: Unsheath your sword like a lotus in bloom.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Rapier/TnL.zhDescription: 如莲花绽放般抽出你的剑。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Redeemer/R.name: Redeemer Pyrus Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Redeemer/R.description: A blazing skin for the Redeemer gunblade.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Redeemer/R.zhDescription: 救赎者枪刃的炽热外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Redeemer/R.name: Redeemer Abysso Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Redeemer/R.description: A skin for the Redeemer drawn from the crushing depths.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Redeemer/R.zhDescription: 来自于破碎深渊的一款救赎者外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Redeemer/R.name: Ravurex Gunblade Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Redeemer/R.description: A gunblade skin inspired by the mighty Sentient Murex.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Redeemer/R.zhDescription: 一款灵感来自于强大的 Sentient 骨螺战舰的枪刃外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Redeemer/R.name: Verv Redeemer Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Redeemer/R.description: Slice and blast in supreme style with this exclusive skin for the Redeemer gunblade.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Redeemer/R.zhDescription: 装备这款救赎者枪刃的专属外观来以极致的方式进行切割和射击。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Redeemer/T.name: Kyndryn Gunblade Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Redeemer/T.description: Show off this skin as you remember the Tenno who have fought beside you for ten years.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Redeemer/T.zhDescription: 展示这个外观，纪念那个陪你并肩作战了十年的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Rifle/Soak.name: Soaktron Rifle Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Rifle/Soak.description: Celebrate Dog Days all year round with this refreshing Rifle Skin. WARNING: Not a toy.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Rifle/Soak.zhDescription: 通过这件令人耳目一新的步枪外观来在一整年里庆祝三伏天。警告：这不是玩具。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Staff/TnRi.name: Lemnas Staff Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Staff/TnRi.description: An elegant staff of ancient Tenno design, the Lemnas dangles with a ribbon that distracts as you attack.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Staff/TnRi.zhDescription: 一款由远古 Tenno 设计的优雅长棍，浮萍上挂着一条丝带，可以在你攻击时分散对手的注意力。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Staff/Trin.name: Staves Volu Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Staff/Trin.description: Enchant any staff with this skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Staff/Trin.zhDescription: 用这个外观来给任何杖类武器增加魔力。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Swords/Dar.name: Niveus Dark Dagger Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Swords/Dar.zhName: 暗影匕首 冰魄外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Swords/Dar.description: This icy look for the Dark Dagger conceals its irradiated nature.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Swords/Dar.zhDescription: 暗黑匕首冰冷的外观掩盖了它辐射的本质。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Swords/Dar.name: Niveus Dark Split-Sword Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Swords/Dar.zhName: 暗黑分合剑 冰魄外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Swords/Dar.description: The frozen elegance of this skin for the Dark Split-Sword belies its irradiated nature.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Swords/Dar.zhDescription: 暗黑分合剑冰冷优雅的外观，与其辐射的本质形成了鲜明对比。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Swords/Dar.name: Niveus Dark Sword Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Swords/Dar.zhName: 暗影长剑 冰魄外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Swords/Dar.description: This skin for the Dark Sword lends a glacial hue to its irradiated metal.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Swords/Dar.zhDescription: 这款暗黑长剑的外观皮肤为其辐射金属表面赋予了冰川般的色调。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Swords/Las.name: Protokol Longsword Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Swords/Las.description: Take the fight to a new era with Arthur Nightingale’s signature Skana skin for longswords.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wraith/SevagothDel.zhName: Sevagoth 格劳克斯幽影外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wraith/SevagothDel.description: Rail agents told of the legendary battle between Sevagoth Glaukus and Hydroid Rakkam. Agents looked on as the pair disappeared into the Void, locked in combat. Nobody knows how much of the old railer's tale is true.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wraith/SevagothDel.zhDescription: 航道特工讲述了 Sevagoth 格劳克斯和 Hydroid 逐波之间的传说战斗。特工们眼睁睁地看着两人在战斗中消失在虚空中。没人知道老航道特工的故事有多少是真的。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wraith/SevagothDel.name: Sevagoth Glaukus Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wraith/SevagothDel.description:
Rail agents told of the legendary battle between Sevagoth Glaukus and Hydroid Rakkam. Agents looked on as the pair disappeared into the Void, locked in combat. Nobody knows how much of the old railer's tale is true.

This skin features a custom Tombstone and Sevagoth's Lullaby, a custom song that plays for Sevagoth's Shadow.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wraith/SevagothDel.zhDescription:
航道特工讲述了 Sevagoth 格劳克斯和 Hydroid 逐波之间的传说战斗。特工们眼睁睁地看着两人在战斗中消失在虚空中。没人知道老航道特工的故事有多少是真的。

该外观包含一个可自定义的墓碑，以及一首为 Sevagoth 的幽影播放的自定义歌曲——Sevagoth 的安眠曲。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/TnReve.name: Orison Two-Handed Nikana Skin

/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Twi.description: The heart of Deimos, twined around with the twin wyrms Vome and Fass. Who can say for how long their bitter, murderous rivalry will last?
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Twi.zhDescription: 火卫二，被双蛟龙'秩序'和'混乱'所缠绕。又有谁知道它们的激烈、凶残之争会持续多久呢？

/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Twi.name: Necraloid Glyph
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Twi.description: Are you as wormed as the others?
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Twi.zhDescription: 你是否像其他人一样虫化了？

/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Ves.name: Arturos Vessel Glyph

/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.name: Daughter Tennobaum Glyph
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.description: Exocrine Nog experiments were a catastrophic failure...for now.
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.zhDescription: 就目前而已，外分泌液蛋奶酒实验是一场灾难性的失败……

/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.name: Father Tennobaum Glyph
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.description: Chief toymaker of the Entrati, Father has embraced the holidays with a joyous fervor.
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.zhDescription: 作为英择谛的首席玩具制造者，'父亲'以一种喜悦的激情来拥抱假日。

/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.name: Grandmother Tennobaum Glyph
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.description: A storyteller at heart, Grandmother's holiday spirit has infested the whole family!
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.zhDescription: '祖母'在内心深处是个喜欢讲故事的人，她的假日精神已经感染了整个家族！

/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.name: Mother Tennobaum Glyph
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.description: She’s making a list of Bounties and checking it twice.
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.zhDescription: 她正在列出一张赏金任务的清单，并反复对其检查。

/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.name: Necraloid Tennobaum Glyph
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.zhName: 殁世械灵 Tennobaum 浮印
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.description: Unfortunately, the Island of Misfit Cephalons was full this cycle.
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.zhDescription: 很遗憾，本季度的错位中枢岛已经满员了。

/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.name: Son Tennobaum Glyph
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.description: All through the Drift, not a creature was stirring, not even a Predasite.
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/XMa.zhDescription: 在整个魔胎之境，没有一个生物在萌动，甚至连一只扑猎达赛都没有。

/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.name: Kahl-175 Tennobaum Glyph
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.description: Not Queens. Not Vay Hek. Only Tenno and Blue Girl celebrate TennoBaum with Kahl.
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.zhDescription: 没有女皇。没有韦·海克。只有 Tenno 和蓝女孩与卡尔一起庆祝 TennoBaum。

/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.name: Maggot Prime Tennobaum Glyph
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.zhName: 蛆虫 Prime Tennobaum 浮印
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.description: Maggot's little mouth was drawn up like a bow, and his infested charm even spread through the snow.
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.zhDescription: 蛆虫的小嘴像弓一样张开，他的魅力在雪中蔓延开来。

/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.name: MOA Tennobaum Glyph
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.description: All through the system, the MOAs appear. They bring their masters some holiday cheer.
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.zhDescription: 恐鸟们出现在始源星系的每个角落。他们给主人带来了节日的欢乐。

/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.name: Veso-R Tennobaum Glyph
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.description: The look of a Nutcracker for a skilled Corpus Tech hacker.
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.zhDescription: 拥有胡桃夹子外观的老练 Corpus 技师黑客。

/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.name: Bombastine Tennobaum Glyph
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.zhName: 蓬蓬士君 Tennobaum 浮印
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.description: Bombastine is green with holiday spirit.
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.zhDescription: 充满节日气氛的绿色蓬蓬士君。

/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.name: Thrax Tennobaum Glyph
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.description: By royal order of his majesty Dominus Thrax, all shall have a merry Tennobaum.
/Lotus/Types/StoreItems/AvatarImages/Xma.zhDescription: 奉陛下士魂大帝之圣令，所有人都将会度过一个快乐的 Tennobaum。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/GrineerShip/.name: Skaut Day of the Dead Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/GrineerShip/.description: Decorate the Skaut’s functional Grineer design with colorful paint and festive designs.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/GrineerShip/.zhDescription: 通过彩色的涂装和节庆图案来装饰伺航的功能性 Grineer 外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/GrineerShip/.name: Skaut Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/GrineerShip/.description:
A Grineer Bolkor remodeled for Tenno reinforcement. Skaut's alert signal calls Kahl and his Grineer brothers for backup. When backup is active, use the alert signal to replenish your squad's health. Each squad member can call one additional Grineer brother to join the fight.

Also available in the Market after completing the Veilbreaker quest.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/GrineerShip/.zhDescription:
一艘为了 Tenno 增援而重新改装的 Grineer 博寇。伺航的警报信号呼叫卡尔和他的 Grineer 兄弟们来支援。当支援起作用时，使用警报信号来补充你的小队生命值。每个小队成员可以额外呼叫一名 Grineer 兄弟加入战斗。

完成《破障者》系列任务后也可在商店内购得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/Gyroscope/Li.name: Xiphos Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/Gyroscope/Li.description: Featuring Sentry Gun air-support, this stylish landing craft is an asset in any battle.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/Gyroscope/Li.zhDescription: 装备有自动炮台的空中支援系统，这艘时尚的登陆艇在任何战斗中都是实用的座驾。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.name: Parallax Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.description: The Parallax was designed for Zariman interplanetary research. It can deploy the advanced Orokin Eye air support, which would have allowed colonizers to study areas rich in rare resources before landing.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.zhDescription: （英文：PARALLAX）星察是为扎里曼的行星研究而设计的。它可部署先进的奥罗金之眼空中支援，可让殖民者在登陆前研究稀有资源丰富的地区。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.name: Parallax Dorsat Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.description: The Parallax would have been adorned with the Dorsat skin when its passengers left the Zariman to study Tau regions with rocky or barren terrain.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.zhDescription: 当乘客搭乘星察离开「扎里曼号」前去研究 Tau 星系岩石或荒地的地形时，星察就会被装备上脊岩外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.name: Parallax Mesaen Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.description: The Parallax would have been adorned with the Mesaen skin when its passengers left the Zariman to study hot and volcanic regions of Tau.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.zhDescription: 当乘客搭乘星察离开「扎里曼号」前去研究 Tau 星系的炎热火山区域时，星察就会被装备上狱火外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.name: Parallax Fremutar Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.description: The Parallax would have been adorned with the Fremutar skin when its passengers left the Zariman to study Tau regions with water and other resources that support life.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.zhDescription: 当乘客搭乘星察离开「扎里曼号」前去研究 Tau 星系中可维持生命的水资源或其他资源时，星察就会被装备上水道外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.name: Parallax Raya Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.description: The light and dark of the cosmos are etched into this skin for the Parallax Landing Craft.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.zhDescription: 宇宙间的光与暗蚀刻在了这款星察登陆艇外观上。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.name: Parallax Albodix Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.description: The Parallax would have been adorned with the Albodix skin when its passengers left the Zariman to study cold or dark regions of Tau.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.zhDescription: 当乘客搭乘星察离开「扎里曼号」前去研究 Tau 星系的低温区和黑暗区时，星察就会被装备上反照外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/1999TankHood.name: H-09 Apex Turret Sumdali
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/1999TankHood.description: The smoldering turret of an H-09 Apex Scaldra tank shall adorn your Landing Craft.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/1999TankHood.zhDescription: 这座冒着烟的 H-09 炽蛇军王者坦克炮台将装饰你的登陆艇。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ConquestHood.name: Archimedean Eye Sumdali
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ConquestHood.description: An ornament awarded only to the most dedicated of researchers. Said by some to be representative of the eye of an ancient deity, sacrificed in return for wisdom.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ConquestHood.zhDescription: 只有最敬业的研究者才能获得的饰物。有人说，它代表了古代神灵的眼睛，为换取智慧而牺牲。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/CryobellHood.name: Cryobell Sumdali
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/CryobellHood.description: A mysterious glacial bell, awarded to commemorate defiance in the face of adversity.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/CryobellHood.zhDescription: 一只神秘的冰霜之铃，为了纪念身处逆境仍不屈抗争的意志。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/DexLisetSkin.name: Liset Dex Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/DexLisetSkin.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo statis.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/DexLisetSkin.zhDescription: 这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻催眠中醒来。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/DuelistHoodO.name: Niveus Sumdali

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Trinity/UnlockTrin.description: This item lets you use Trinity's noble animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Trinity/UnlockTrin.zhDescription: 能让任意战甲使用 Trinity 的尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Volt/UnlockVoltAgi.name: Volt Agile Animation Set
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Volt/UnlockVoltAgi.description: This item lets you use Volt's agile animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Volt/UnlockVoltAgi.zhDescription: 能让任意战甲使用 Volt 的迅捷站姿。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Volt/UnlockVoltNob.name: Volt Noble Animation Set

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Volt/UnlockVoltNob.zhDescription: 能让任意战甲使用 Volt 的尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Werewolf/UnlockWer.name: Voruna Agile Animation Set
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Werewolf/UnlockWer.description: This item lets you use Voruna's agile animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Werewolf/UnlockWer.zhDescription: 能让任意战甲使用 Voruna 的迅捷站姿。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Werewolf/UnlockWer.name: Voruna Noble Animation Set
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Werewolf/UnlockWer.description: This item lets you use Voruna's noble animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Werewolf/UnlockWer.zhDescription: 能让任意战甲使用 Voruna 的尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wisp/UnlockWispAgi.name: Wisp Agile Animation Set
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wisp/UnlockWispAgi.description: This item lets you use Wisp's agile animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wisp/UnlockWispAgi.zhDescription: 能让任意战甲使用 Wisp 的迅捷站姿。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wisp/UnlockWispNob.name: Wisp Noble Animation Set
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wisp/UnlockWispNob.description: This item lets you use Wisp's noble animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wisp/UnlockWispNob.zhDescription: 能让任意战甲使用 Wisp 的尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wraith/UnlockWrait.name: Sevagoth Agile Animation Set
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wraith/UnlockWrait.description: This item lets you use Sevagoth's agile animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wraith/UnlockWrait.zhDescription: 能让任意战甲使用 Sevagoth 的迅捷站姿。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wraith/UnlockWrait.name: Sevagoth Noble Animation Set
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wraith/UnlockWrait.description: This item lets you use Sevagoth's noble animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Wraith/UnlockWrait.zhDescription: 能让任意战甲使用 Sevagoth 的尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Yareli/UnlockYarel.name: Yareli Agile Animation Set
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Yareli/UnlockYarel.description: This item lets you use Yareli's agile animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Yareli/UnlockYarel.zhDescription: 能让任意战甲使用 Yareli 的迅捷站姿。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Yareli/UnlockYarel.name: Yareli Noble Animation Set
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Yareli/UnlockYarel.description: This item lets you use Yareli's noble animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Yareli/UnlockYarel.zhDescription: 能让任意战甲使用 Yareli 的尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Types/Game/ShipScenes/NidusPrimeS.name: Infested Orbiter Decorations
/Lotus/Types/Game/ShipScenes/NidusPrimeS.zhName: 感染者轨道飞行器装饰

/Lotus/Types/Game/ShipScenes/PrimeLisetF.name: Filigree Prime Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Game/ShipScenes/PrimeLisetF.zhName: 精工掐丝 Prime 装饰

/Lotus/Types/Keys/1999PrologueQuest/1999.name: The Lotus Eaters
/Lotus/Types/Keys/1999PrologueQuest/1999.description: A strange call comes from beyond and must not go unanswered.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/1999PrologueQuest/1999.zhDescription: 奇异的呼唤从远方传来，不能置之不理。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/1999Quest/1999QuestGoo.name: The Hex Finale
/Lotus/Types/Keys/1999Quest/1999QuestGoo.description: A chance to rewrite history and avert disaster.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/1999Quest/1999QuestGoo.zhDescription: 一个改写历史、避免灾难的机会。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/1999Quest/1999QuestKey.name: The Hex
/Lotus/Types/Keys/1999Quest/1999QuestKey.description: The desperate hunt for Albrecht Entrati has led the Drifter to the city of Höllvania on December 31st, 1999. Despite the Scaldra lockdown in the face of the Techrot menace, the citizens do their best to celebrate. But this has all happened before... and ended in disaster.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/1999Quest/1999QuestKey.zhDescription: 1999 年 12 月 31 日，为了找到阿尔布雷希特·英择谛，漂泊者来到了霍瓦尼亚。尽管面对科腐者的威胁，炽蛇军实施的封锁，但市民们仍努力庆祝。但这一切曾经发生过……并以灾难告终。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/ApostasyQuest/Apostasy.name: Apostasy Prologue
/Lotus/Types/Keys/ApostasyQuest/Apostasy.description: Inspect your personal quarters upon finishing the Chains of Harrow quest.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/ApostasyQuest/Apostasy.zhDescription: 完成 Harrow 系列任务后前去检查你的个人房间。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/ArchwingQuest/Archwing.name: The Archwing
/Lotus/Types/Keys/ArchwingQuest/Archwing.description: The Balor Fomorians are coming but we are ready. Through your efforts we finally have a working Archwing prototype and I am sending you the blueprint. However, your task is not yet complete. You still must discover the component parts.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/ArchwingQuest/Archwing.zhDescription: 巴罗尔巨人战舰即将来袭，但我们已做好准备。通过你努力的成果，我们总算有了能实际运作的曲翼原型机，我将蓝图寄给你了。不过你的任务并未结束，你仍得搜索其他的组成部件。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/BardQuest/BardQuestKey.name: Octavia's Anthem
/Lotus/Types/Keys/BardQuest/BardQuestKey.description: Build the Mandachord and find the cause of Cephalon Suda’s erratic behavior.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/BardQuest/BardQuestKey.zhDescription: 建造曼达和弦琴并查明中枢苏达异常行为的原因。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/ChimeraQuest/ChimeraKe.name: Chimera Prologue
/Lotus/Types/Keys/ChimeraQuest/ChimeraKe.description: Investigate your personal quarters upon completion of The Sacrifice.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/ChimeraQuest/ChimeraKe.zhDescription: 完成《牺牲》系列任务后调查个人房间

/Lotus/Types/Keys/DragonQuest/DragonQues.name: The New Strange
/Lotus/Types/Keys/DragonQuest/DragonQues.description: Work with Cephalon Simaris to find the source of a mysterious voice.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/DragonQuest/DragonQues.zhDescription: 和中枢 Simaris 合作找出一个神秘声音的源头。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/EntratiLab/EntratiQues.name: Whispers in the Walls
/Lotus/Types/Keys/EntratiLab/EntratiQues.description: Loid has had strange dreams and desperately needs to show you something.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/EntratiLab/EntratiQues.zhDescription: 洛德做了一些奇怪的梦，急需给你看一些东西。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/FairyQuest/FairyQuestK.name: The Silver Grove
/Lotus/Types/Keys/FairyQuest/FairyQuestK.description: New Loka seeks help protecting a sacred forest from Grineer incursions, but are they ready to face the forest's true nature?
/Lotus/Types/Keys/FairyQuest/FairyQuestK.zhDescription: 新世间为保护一片神圣的森林不被 Grineer 入侵正寻求帮助，但是他们准备好面对这片森林真正的本性了吗？

/Lotus/Types/Keys/GetClemQuest/GetClemQu.name: A Man of Few Words
/Lotus/Types/Keys/GetClemQuest/GetClemQu.description: Darvo needs your help again. Save one of his best contractors from Grineer execution.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/GetClemQuest/GetClemQu.zhDescription: Darvo 再次需要你的协助，从 Grineer 的刑罚中拯救出他最好的承包商。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/GlassQuest/GlassQuestK.name: Saya's Vigil
/Lotus/Types/Keys/GlassQuest/GlassQuestK.description: On the Plains of Eidolon a mystery has lain buried for years: one that will mend or destroy a heart, and open the door to a hidden past.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/GlassQuest/GlassQuestK.zhDescription: 在夜灵平野中，一个秘密埋藏了许久：这个秘密可以治愈或毁灭人心，并将打开一道通往隐秘过去的大门。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/GolemQuest/GolemQuestK.name: The Jordas Precept
/Lotus/Types/Keys/GolemQuest/GolemQuestK.description: Ordis is determined to help a fellow Cephalon overcome a ship wide infestation.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/GolemQuest/GolemQuestK.zhDescription: Ordis 决意帮助一具中枢同伴压制一艘遭到广域性感染的船舰。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/IndexQuest/IndexQuestK.name: The Glast Gambit
/Lotus/Types/Keys/IndexQuest/IndexQuestK.description: Nef Anyo has stolen the children of the Mycona Colony and it is up to you to get them back. You must challenge Nef on The Index and beat him at his own game. But Tenno, beware, not all is as it seems.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/IndexQuest/IndexQuestK.zhDescription: 奈富·安尤偷走了 Mycona 殖民地的孩子们，全靠你去解救他们了。你需要在指数之场中挑战 奈富，在他自己的游戏中击败他。但是注意了，Tenno，并不是一切都如看起来那么单纯。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/InfestedAladVQuest/Ass.name: Mutalist Alad V Assassinate
/Lotus/Types/Keys/InfestedAladVQuest/Ass.zhName: 异融阿拉德 V 刺杀
/Lotus/Types/Keys/InfestedAladVQuest/Ass.description: Put an end to Alad V and his Mutalist experiments
/Lotus/Types/Keys/InfestedAladVQuest/Ass.zhDescription: 突袭阿拉德 V 的研究船，终结他的异融者实验。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/InfestedAladVQuest/Inf.name: Patient Zero
/Lotus/Types/Keys/InfestedAladVQuest/Inf.description: Find Alad V's laboratory and put a stop to his madness.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/InfestedAladVQuest/Inf.zhDescription: 找到阿拉德 V 的实验室并制止他的疯狂行径。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/InfestedIntroQuest/Inf.name: Once Awake
/Lotus/Types/Keys/InfestedIntroQuest/Inf.description: Intercepted Grineer communications reveal that Grineer have been experimenting with some sort of bio weapon. You must investigate.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/InfestedIntroQuest/Inf.zhDescription: 拦截到的 Grineer 通讯显示，Grineer一直在试验某种生化武器，你必须调查清楚。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/InfestedMicroplanetQue.name: Heart of Deimos
/Lotus/Types/Keys/InfestedMicroplanetQue.description: Deimos emerges in Martian orbit, completely overrun by the Infestation... yet among the writhing mass, a distress call comes over a most ancient carrier wave...
/Lotus/Types/Keys/InfestedMicroplanetQue.zhDescription: 火卫二出现在了火星轨道上，被大量感染者占领……然而在这些蠕动的生物体中，伴随着一道极古老的载波，传来了一个求救信号……

/Lotus/Types/Keys/JadeShadows/JadeShadow.name: Jade Shadows
/Lotus/Types/Keys/JadeShadows/JadeShadow.description: Struggling to understand the oldest and deepest secret from his past, Stalker finds himself allied with sworn enemies on the troubling road toward uncovering the truth… and averting an incalculable loss.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/JadeShadows/JadeShadow.zhDescription: 为了了解他过去的陈年秘辛，追猎者发现自己在揭露真相的艰难道路上与死敌结盟……并避免了不可估量的损失。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/JadeShadowsPart2Conste.name: Jade Shadows: Constellations
/Lotus/Types/Keys/JadeShadowsPart2Conste.description: When Hunhow summons the Stalker to a bizarre conflict unfolding in the Orb Vallis, he must confront the shocking consequences of his own actions. The shadows of his future have come calling, and they are not alone.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/JadeShadowsPart2Conste.zhDescription: 当 Hunhow 召唤追猎者前往奥布山谷参与一场正在展开的离奇冲突时，他必须面对自己行为所带来的令人震惊的后果。他未来的阴影正在召唤，而这些阴影并不孤单。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/KahlQuest/KahlQuestKey.name: Veilbreaker
/Lotus/Types/Keys/KahlQuest/KahlQuestKey.description: Daughter Entrati gets more than she bargained for when she enlists the Tenno to investigate a call for reinforcements aboard a Narmer Murex.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/KahlQuest/KahlQuestKey.zhDescription: 当英择谛“女儿”号召 Tenno 去调查合一众骨螺战舰上的一个增援请求时，她所收获的要比预想中的更多。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/KubrowQuest/KubrowQues.name: Howl of the Kubrow
/Lotus/Types/Keys/KubrowQuest/KubrowQues.description: You are Tenno, you deserve a Kubrow by your side.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/KubrowQuest/KubrowQues.zhDescription: 你是 Tenno，你应要有一只库狛伴随。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/LimboQuest/LimboQuestK.name: The Limbo Theorem
/Lotus/Types/Keys/LimboQuest/LimboQuestK.description:
The Limbo Theorem quest cannot be completed without an Archwing

Piece together the Limbo Theorem to uncover its source
/Lotus/Types/Keys/LimboQuest/LimboQuestK.zhDescription:
Limbo 定理任务必须具备曲翼才能完成

通过拼凑 Limbo 定理来揭露其起源

/Lotus/Types/Keys/ModQuest/ModQuestKeyCh.name: The Teacher
/Lotus/Types/Keys/ModQuest/ModQuestKeyCh.description: Corpus incursions into Grineer territory lead to showdown with a forgotten rival.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/ModQuest/ModQuestKeyCh.zhDescription: Corpus 入侵 Grineer 领土，却引发与一位被遗忘的劲敌的对决。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/MummyQuest/MummyQuestK.name: Sands of Inaros
/Lotus/Types/Keys/MummyQuest/MummyQuestK.description: Help Baro Ki'Teer raid an ancient Martian tomb for a mysterious treasure.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/MummyQuest/MummyQuestK.zhDescription: 帮 Baro Ki'Teer 突袭一座古老的火星古墓并偷盗一件神秘的宝物。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/NewPlayerQuest/NewPlay.name: AWAKENING
/Lotus/Types/Keys/NewPlayerQuest/NewPlay.description:
The Tenno: monuments of an ancient warrior caste.

For generations you've slept, with no call to wake you.

Until now.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/NewPlayerQuest/NewPlay.zhDescription:
Tenno：代表远古战士的不朽精锐。

世世代代，你长眠于此，无人唤醒你。

直到如今。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/NewWarQuest/NewWarQues.name: The New War
/Lotus/Types/Keys/NewWarQuest/NewWarQues.description:
The Sentient armada has emerged from the Veil Proxima in shocking numbers.

At their head, Natah, once the trusted guide 'Lotus', now seemingly in thrall to Ballas and her brother Erra.

Across worlds and space, the Tenno and their unlikely alliance launch a final assault to take the Sentient mothership... where Natah awaits.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/NewWarQuest/NewWarQues.zhDescription:
Sentient 舰队正以惊人的数量从面纱比邻星域中涌现。

领军的 Natah，曾是我们倍受信赖的向导 "Lotus"。而她现在似乎已被其亲弟 Erra，以及 Ballas 奴役。

横跨整个星系，Tenno 与他们意想不到的盟友，发动了最终强袭以攻占 Sentient 母舰。而 Natah……亦在舰中严阵以待。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/OrokinMoonQuest/Orokin.name: The Second Dream
/Lotus/Types/Keys/OrokinMoonQuest/Orokin.description: The Sentient Hunhow seeks to destroy the Tenno by exploiting long forgotten secrets.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/OrokinMoonQuest/Orokin.zhDescription: Sentient Hunhow 企图发掘一些被长久遗忘的秘密来毁灭 Tenno。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/PriestFrameQuest/Pries.name: Chains of Harrow
/Lotus/Types/Keys/PriestFrameQuest/Pries.description: A strange transmission leads deep into the dark world of Red Veil mysticism. What evils will be found there and what do they want?
/Lotus/Types/Keys/PriestFrameQuest/Pries.zhDescription: 一条奇怪的通信引向黑暗世界深处血色面纱的神秘。在那里会找到何种邪恶之物，而他们的目的又是什么呢？

/Lotus/Types/Keys/ProteaQuest/ProteaQues.name: The Deadlock Protocol
/Lotus/Types/Keys/ProteaQuest/ProteaQues.description: A power struggle within the Corpus elite has erupted. Seeking control, Nef Anyo looks to the past... to the very origins of the Corpus itself.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/ProteaQuest/ProteaQues.zhDescription: Corpus 内部爆发了一场始于 Corpus 精英之间的权力斗争。为了夺取控制权的奈富·安尤着眼于过去……追溯到了 Corpus 自身的起源。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/RailJackBuildQuest/Rai.name: Rising Tide
/Lotus/Types/Keys/RailJackBuildQuest/Rai.description: To face a growing threat, a long dormant Cephalon calls on you to reconstruct an Orokin-era interceptor craft: the Railjack.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/RailJackBuildQuest/Rai.zhDescription: 为了应对日益增长的威胁，一位长期处于休眠状态的中枢要求你重建一艘奥罗金时代的拦截战舰：航道星舰。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/RevenantQuest/Revenant.name: Mask of the Revenant
/Lotus/Types/Keys/RevenantQuest/Revenant.description: The Unum chooses Nakak to receive a strange mask. A mask that leads to even stranger visions. What lost story does the Unum want to tell?
/Lotus/Types/Keys/RevenantQuest/Revenant.zhDescription: 娜卡被乌努母神选中收到了一个奇怪的面具。这个面具引她看到了更奇怪的影像。究竟乌努母神想要诉说什么遗失的故事呢？

/Lotus/Types/Keys/SacrificeQuest/Sacrifi.name: The Sacrifice
/Lotus/Types/Keys/SacrificeQuest/Sacrifi.description: A tortured vision sends the Operator on the hunt for a Warframe unlike any other.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/SacrificeQuest/Sacrifi.zhDescription: 一个受折磨的景像使得指挥官开始寻找着一架不同于其他的战甲。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/SentientQuest/Sentient.name: Natah
/Lotus/Types/Keys/SentientQuest/Sentient.description: Strange drones have appeared in the Origin System, help the Lotus find out what they are and who sent them.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/SentientQuest/Sentient.zhDescription: 行迹诡异的无人机出没于始源星系，协助 Lotus 追查出它们究竟是什么，又是谁派它们来的。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/SolarisQuest/SolarisQu.name: Vox Solaris
/Lotus/Types/Keys/SolarisQuest/SolarisQu.description: Eudico would do anything to keep her people safe, but will she stand up to Nef Anyo?
/Lotus/Types/Keys/SolarisQuest/SolarisQu.zhDescription: Eudico 为了她的人民的安全可以做出任何事情，但她会起身对抗奈富·安尤吗？

/Lotus/Types/Keys/SpyQuestKeyChain/SpyQu.name: Stolen Dreams
/Lotus/Types/Keys/SpyQuestKeyChain/SpyQu.description: Find the thief Maroo and uncover the secrets of the Arcane Codices.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/SpyQuestKeyChain/SpyQu.zhDescription: 找到小偷 Maroo 揭开那些秘奧法典的秘密

/Lotus/Types/Keys/TauPrequel/TauPrequelQ.name: The Old Peace
/Lotus/Types/Keys/TauPrequel/TauPrequelQ.description: Albrecht Entrati's trail leads beyond the Origin System. Only by delving into the past can the path ahead be made clear - but buried secrets can be deadly.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/TauPrequel/TauPrequelQ.zhDescription: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的踪迹指向始源星系之外。唯有深入探究过去，才能厘清前路——但埋藏的秘密可能致命。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/TauPrologue/TauPrologu.name: Lua
/Lotus/Types/Keys/TauPrologue/TauPrologu.description: Find the Lotus in the Dark Refractory and seek her out within her memories.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/TauPrologue/TauPrologu.zhDescription: 在深溯池找到 Lotus，并在她的记忆中寻找她。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/TauPrologue/TauPrologu.name: Vessel
/Lotus/Types/Keys/TauPrologue/TauPrologu.description: The Vessel has awoken. Praghasa has returned. Deploy to the surface of Eris... fuel is required.
/Lotus/Types/Keys/TauPrologue/TauPrologu.zhDescription: 承载体已经苏醒。「布拉喀萨」已回归。部署至阋神星表面……需要燃料。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/VorsPrize/VorsPrizeQue.name: Vor's Prize
/Lotus/Types/Keys/VorsPrize/VorsPrizeQue.description:
My Queens, you were right, the Tenno threat is real. We found one drifting near Earth but the Lotus knew we were coming. She purged the Cryo moments before we had them and sent a squad of Tenno to break our assault.

They escaped. We are working on tracing them. Separate this Tenno from the flock and it should be easy to kill. We shattered its Warframe and expect such an abrupt Cryo purge will have damaged its memories.

We anxiously await punishment for failing this task.

- VOR
/Lotus/Types/Keys/VorsPrize/VorsPrizeQue.zhDescription:
我尊敬的女皇们，你们是正确的，Tenno 的威胁千真万确。我们找到一个 Tenno 漂浮在地球附近，但莲（Lotus）事先料到了我们的行动。就在我们要抓住 Tenno 之前，莲（Lotus）解除了冷冻睡眠，并派来一支 Tenno 小队破坏了我们的攻势。

他们逃跑了。我们正在追踪。只要将这个 Tenno 与大部队分开，就应该很容易干掉。我们已经击碎了其战甲外甲，并且如此突然地解除冷冻将对其记忆力造成损伤。

由于未能完成任务，我们不胜惶恐地等待应得的惩罚。

——沃尔

/Lotus/Types/Keys/WarWithinQuest/WarWith.name: The War Within
/Lotus/Types/Keys/WarWithinQuest/WarWith.description: A disturbance in the Somatic Link prompts the Lotus to send operatives back to the Tenno Reservoir.

/Lotus/Types/Keys/ZarimanQuest/ZarimanQu.description: From depths beyond reason a Voice had spoken, and its echoes would not be denied. No longer fully concealed by the ever-shifting Void, the Zariman now rests between worlds. A haunting song resounds across the System. It is time for an overdue confrontation with the past...
/Lotus/Types/Keys/ZarimanQuest/ZarimanQu.zhDescription: 一道声音从感知以外的幽深之处响起，其回响不容忽视。不再完全被变幻万千的虚空所掩盖，「扎里曼号」现在停泊于两界之间。荧惑的歌声在星系中回荡，是时候与过去开始一场早该进行的斗争了……

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Infe.name: Fass Residue
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Infe.description:
A chunk of the wyrm Fass, collected after his explosive death in the Cambion Drift. Used to attract Glutinox on the surface during Vome, Ostimyr at surface hotspots during Fass, and Vitreospina in caves during Fass/Vome.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos while Vome is active
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Infe.zhDescription:
属于蛟龙'混乱'的一大块东西，是在他爆炸死亡后收集的。可以用来吸引'秩序'期间地面中的狍鸮胶蛳、'混乱'期间地面鱼点中的奥斯蒂剑鱼，以及'秩序'/'混乱'期间洞穴中的璃化脊鳎。

获取地点：'秩序'活跃时的火卫二魔胎之境

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Infe.name: Processed Fass Residue
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Infe.description:
Matter from the body of the Wyrm Fass, purged of toxins, and rendered usefully. Used to attract Aquapulmo and Flagellocanth in Cambion Drift surface hotspots, Aquapulmo only during Vome.

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Infe.zhDescription:
来自于蛟龙'混乱'身上的物质，清除了毒素后变得有用了。可以用来吸引魔胎之境地面鱼点中的水肺和须腔棘鱼、'秩序'期间的水肺。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Orok.name: Vome Residue
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Orok.description:
A gobbet of raw flesh, fallen from the wyrm Vome in her death spasm. Used to attract Chondricord and Duriod in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos while Fass is active
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Orok.zhDescription:
在蛟龙'秩序'的死亡痉挛时，从她身上掉下来的一块生肉。可以用来吸引'秩序'/'混乱'期间魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中的骨锥琼鲷和韧铠灵鲷。

获取地点：'混乱'活跃时的火卫二魔胎之境

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Orok.name: Processed Vome Residue
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Orok.description:
The flesh of Vome, refined, and ready for use. Used to attract Myxostomata in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Vome.

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Infested/Orok.zhDescription:
'秩序'的肉，经过提炼且随时可用。可以用来吸引'秩序'期间魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中的独角米索鳎。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）的'女儿'处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.name: Mirewinder Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.description:
This bait is composed of aromatic tetraxin that is known to attract Mirewinders, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.zhDescription:
这种鱼饵由芳香性的四氢素组成，能够吸引污泥绕环者，一种出没于山洞鱼点中的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.name: Charamote Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.description:
This bait is synthesized from complex hexophenol that is known to attract Charamotes, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.zhDescription:
这种鱼饵由复杂的己苯酚合成，能够吸引重筑虾，一种可于山洞鱼点中找到的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.name: Synathid Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.description:
This bait is synthesized from specialized A-disulphex-A compounds that are known to attract Synathid, a legendarily rare Servofish found only in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/CaveCon.zhDescription:
这种鱼饵由特制的A－二硫科斯－A化合物合成，能够吸引海龙，一种可于山洞鱼点中找到的传奇稀有伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/Generic.name: Broad-Spectrum Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/Generic.description:
A simple cocktail of short-chain polymers and contaminants. Easily detected by rudimentary Servofish in the Orb Vallis under all conditions, but ignored by more specialized models. Good for Sapcaddies (found in the lake), and Tinks and Brickies (found in ponds).

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/Generic.zhDescription:
一种短链聚合物及污染物的简单混合。在所有情况下都能轻易被奥布山谷中基本的伺服鱼侦测到，但是被更特殊型的伺服鱼所忽略。适用于液集者（可在湖泊找到）、修补机和砖瓦匠（可在池塘找到）。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/LakeCon.name: Kriller Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/LakeCon.description:
This bait is synthesized from Methacalcene-1 that is known to attract Krillers, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis lakes during warm weather.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/LakeCon.zhDescription:
这种鱼饵由甲烷活性钙-1合成，可以吸引磷虾杀手，一种可在温暖天气中于湖泊中找到的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/LakeCon.name: Longwinder Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/LakeCon.description:
This bait is synthesized from beryzene that is known to attract Longwinders, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis lake hotspots during warm weather.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/LakeCon.zhDescription:
这种鱼饵由铍苯合成，用于吸引长型环绕者，一种可在温暖天气的湖泊中找到的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/PondCon.name: Narrow-Spectrum Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/PondCon.description:
This endochlor/dionium melange attracts both Recasters and Eye-Eyes, Servofish found in Orb Vallis ponds. The Eye-Eye shows up during warm weather and Recasters shows up at Hot Spots during cool weather.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/PondCon.zhDescription:
这种内型联氯 / 釱元素的混合物可以吸引续播机和目－目这类可以在池塘内找到的伺服鱼。目－目会在温暖天气时出现，续播机则在天气寒冷时出现在鱼点中。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/PondCon.name: Tromyzon Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/PondCon.description:
This bait is synthesized from long-chain LS-74 compounds that are known to attract Tromyzon, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis pond hotspots during cool weather.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/Venus/PondCon.zhDescription:
这种鱼饵由长链的 LS-74 化合物所合成，可以吸引多目鳗，一种可以在寒冷天气中池塘鱼点中找到的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/BothRareFishB.name: Murkray Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/BothRareFishB.description:
This bait is composed of materials that are known to attract Murkrays, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon ocean hotspots during both day and night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/BothRareFishB.zhDescription:
这种鱼饵是由已知能吸引阴暗鳐的材料所组成。这种鱼无论日夜皆只能在海洋鱼点中寻获。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/BothUncommonF.name: Twilight Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/BothUncommonF.description:
This bait attracts predatory fish that are active in the Plains of Eidolon during either day or night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Attracts Sharrac and Karkina in the ocean.
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/BothUncommonF.zhDescription:
这种鱼饵可以吸引白天或晚上活跃的捕食者鱼类。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。吸引海洋中的鲨客和卡其那。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/GenericFishBa.name: Peppered Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/GenericFishBa.description:
This bait attracts fish that are active in the Plains of Eidolon during the day.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Attracts Mawfish and Charc Eels in the lake; Khut-Khut, Yogwun, and Mortus Lungfish in ponds; and Goopolla and Tralok in the ocean.
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/GenericFishBa.zhDescription:
这种诱饵可以吸引白天在夜灵平野活动的鱼类。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。吸引湖中的喉鱼和查克鳗；池塘中的库特-库特、约格温和摩图斯肺鱼；以及海洋中的古泊拉和塔洛。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightLegendar.name: Glappid Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightLegendar.description:
This bait is composed of exotic materials that are known to attract the elusive Glappid, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon ocean hotspots during the night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightLegendar.zhDescription:
这种鱼饵是由已知能吸引神出鬼没的盖拉佩德的奇特材料所组成，这种鱼只能在夜间夜灵平野的海洋鱼点中寻获。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightRareFish.name: Norg Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightRareFish.description:

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightRareFish.zhDescription:
这种鱼饵是由已知能吸引诺格的材料所组成。这种鱼只能在夜间夜灵平野中的湖泊鱼点中寻获。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightRareFish.name: Cuthol Bait
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightRareFish.description:

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Types/Game/FishBait/NightRareFish.zhDescription:
这种鱼饵是由已知能吸引克苏尔的材料所组成。这种鱼只能在夜间夜灵平野中的池塘鱼点中寻获。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Keys/MummyQuest/MummyArtifa.zhDescription: 来自 Inaros 古墓中的奇怪文物。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Conservation/L.description: Entice and attract nearby Kubrodon with life-like animal calls. The Kubrodon is most often found around the Craters in Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Conservation/L.zhDescription: 以拟真的动物叫声来诱惑、吸引附近的库狛顿。库狛顿最常在奥布山谷的陨石坑周围被发现。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Conservation/T.name: Tranq Rifle
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Conservation/T.description: Tranquilizes animals for the purpose of safe relocation.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Conservation/T.zhDescription: 以安全重新安置为目的镇静动物。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Conservation/U.name: Echo-Lure

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Conservation/V.description: Entice and attract nearby Vasca Kavat with life-like animal calls. Vasca Kavat roam the Plains of Eidolon at night.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Conservation/V.zhDescription: 以拟真的动物叫声来诱惑、吸引附近的噬血型库娃。噬血型库娃徘徊在晚上的夜灵平野。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Eid.name: Beckonsnare
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Eid.description: Field-and-forget, the Beckonsnare emits an ultrasonic frequency enticing to targeted lifeforms. Upon entering they are comfortably contained within a one-way photon fence for easy collection at your convenience.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Eid.zhDescription: 一种采田忘野的装备，引诱陷阱可发出对目标生命体具有吸引力的超声波频率。目标进入后，它们轻松地被圈在一个单向光子围栏内，以便您轻松采收。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fis.name: Luminous Dye
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fis.description:
Dyes the waters with a compound that sticks to fish passing through it, making them easier to see from the shore.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fis.zhDescription:
用一种混合物给水域染色，这种混合物会附着在经过的鱼身上，使它们从岸边更容易被看到。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fis.name: Pharoma
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fis.description:
A compound that relaxes nearby fish.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fis.zhDescription:
一种可以让附近的鱼放松的混合物。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Npc.name: Calcifin Stim
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Npc.description: Hardens skin, fortifying against damage while restricting movement.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Npc.zhDescription: 硬化皮肤，对伤害产生抵抗，但限制移动力

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Npc.name: Refract Stim
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Npc.description: Coats the target in a film that refracts light, allowing undetected movement.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Npc.zhDescription: 将目标包覆在一层折射光线的薄膜中，使移动变得无法被侦测。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Npc.name: Clotra Stim
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Npc.description: Revives a target that is bleeding out, and provides a bonus revive to any allies in range.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Npc.zhDescription: 复活一名倒地出血的目标，并为范围内的友军提供一次额外的复活。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Npc.name: Adrenal Stim
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Npc.description: Elevates adrenaline levels to enable faster movement while increasing sensitivity to damage.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Npc.zhDescription: 提升肾上腺素水平以加快移动，但对伤害更加敏感。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Syn.name: Fosfor Blau
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Syn.description: Launch a bright blue flare that significantly increases Affinity Range while active.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Syn.zhDescription: 发射一只亮蓝色的信号弹，有效期内大幅增加经验范围。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Syn.name: Fosfor Rahd
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Syn.description: Launch a bright red flare that significantly increases Affinity Range while active.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Syn.zhDescription: 发射一只亮红色的信号弹，有效期内大幅增加经验范围。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Syn.name: Fosfor Rahd
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Syn.description: Launch a bright red flare that significantly increases Affinity Range while active.

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Tox.name: Beryl Antitoxin
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Tox.description: This is a mildly effective antitoxin.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Tox.zhDescription: 这是一个轻度有效的解毒剂。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Tox.name: Citrine Antitoxin
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Tox.description: This is a moderately effective antitoxin.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Tox.zhDescription: 这是一个比较有效的解毒剂。
