/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Tox.name: Topaz Antitoxin
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Tox.description: This is a moderately effective antitoxin.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Tox.zhDescription: 这是一个比较有效的解毒剂。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Tox.name: Lapis Antitoxin
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Tox.description: This is an extremely effective antitoxin.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Tox.zhDescription: 这是一个非常有效的解毒剂。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Tox.name: Vermillion Antitoxin
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Tox.description: This is an extremely effective antitoxin.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Tox.zhDescription: 这是一个非常有效的解毒剂。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Alp.name: Alpha Corruptor
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Alp.description: Inert on its own this corruptor is highly effective if mixed with its Beta counterpart. Properly mixed, these will destabilize Fomorian Reactors much faster than their Stable counterparts. This volatile item cannot be simultaneously equipped with Beta Corruptors. Recommended for Tenno operating as a team.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Alp.zhDescription: 这污染物单独时属于惰性，当与 BETA 污染物混合时会产生极高的效果，适当的混合会破坏巨人战舰反应堆的平衡，比 STABLE 污染物来的迅速，这个不稳定的物品不能同时间与 BETA 污染物一起携带，推荐给 Tenno 合作团队。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Anc.name: Ancient Protector Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Anc.description: Deploys an ANCIENT PROTECTOR EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Anc.zhDescription: 设置一个为你战斗的远古守护卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ass.name: Stalker Beacon
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ass.description: Lures the Stalker out of hiding. One-time use gear item that can only be used in locations where the assassin would normally appear.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ass.zhDescription: 吸引「追猎者」现身的物品。为一次性道具，仅能使用在刺客一般会出没的场景中。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ass.name: Zanuka Hunter Beacon
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ass.description: Lures the Zanuka Hunter out of hiding. One-time use gear item that can only be used in locations where the assassin would normally appear.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ass.zhDescription: 吸引「Zanuka 猎犬」现身的物品。为一次性道具，仅能使用在刺客一般会出没的场景中。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ass.name: Grustrag Three Beacon
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ass.description: Lures the Grustrag Three out of hiding. One-time use gear item that can only be used in locations where the assassins would normally appear.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ass.zhDescription: 吸引「Grustrag 三霸」现身的物品。为一次性道具，仅能使用在刺客一般会出没的场景中。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ass.name: Wolf Beacon
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ass.description: Lures the Wolf out of hiding. One-time use gear item that can only be used in locations where the assassin would normally appear.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ass.zhDescription: 吸引「恶狼」现身的物品。为一次性道具，仅能使用在刺客一般会出没的场景中。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bar.name: Ki'Teer Fireworks
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bar.zhDescription: 一场由色彩奏出的浮夸交响乐。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bas.name: A Fishing Spear
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bas.description:
The barbed prongs on this fishing spear make it easier to catch fish with smooth skin. 

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish:
Charc Eel
Cuthol
Goopolla
Murkray
Sharrac
Yogwun
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bas.zhDescription:
这把鱼叉有着带倒刺的叉齿，便于抓住表皮光滑的鱼类。 

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。这根鱼叉对以下夜灵平野的鱼类最有效：
查克鳗
克苏尔
古泊拉
阴暗鳐
鲨客
约格温

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bet.name: Beta Corruptor
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bet.description: Inert on its own this corruptor is highly effective if mixed with its Alpha counterpart. Properly mixed, these will destabilize Fomorian Reactors much faster than their Stable counterparts. This volatile item cannot be simultaneously equipped with Alpha Corruptors. Recommended for Tenno operating as a team.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bet.zhDescription: 这污染物单独时属于惰性，当与 ALPHA 污染物混合时会产生极高的效果，适当的混合会破坏巨人战舰反应堆的平衡，比 STABLE 污染物来的迅速，这个不稳定的物品不能同时间与 ALPHA 污染物一起携带，推荐给 Tenno 合作团队。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bro.name: Vapor Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bro.description: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Bro.zhDescription: 一个战甲的克隆复制品，可以部署来协助 Tenno 执行任务。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cam.name: Remote Observer
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cam.description: Deploys a short-lived remote camera that overrides your Warframe optics
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cam.zhDescription: 设置一个短暂存在的遥控镜头，取代战甲的视角

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cha.name: Charger Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cha.description: Deploys a CHARGER EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cha.zhDescription: 设置一个为你战斗的疾冲卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cle.name: Clem Clone
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cle.description: Deploys a clone of Clem to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cle.zhDescription: 部署一名 Clem 克隆人为你作战。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cor.name: Corrupted Bombard Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cor.description: Deploys a CORRUPTED BOMBARD unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cor.zhDescription: 部置一名堕落轰击者单位为你战斗。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cor.name: Corrupted Heavy Gunner Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cor.description: Deploys a CORRUPTED HEAVY GUNNER unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cor.zhDescription: 部署一名堕落重型机枪手单位为你战斗。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cor.name: Corrupted Lancer Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cor.description: Deploys a CORRUPTED LANCER EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cor.zhDescription: 设置一个为你战斗的堕落枪兵卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.name: Passionate Void Offering
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.description: Give unto The Void a generous 100,000 credits.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.zhDescription: 献给虚空的一大笔 100，000 元现金。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.name: Faithful Void Offering
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.zhDescription: 献给虚空的 10，000 元现金。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.name: Humble Void Offering
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.zhDescription: 献给虚空的 1,000 元现金。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.name: On Call Crew
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.description: Call in a designated crew member for backup in non-Railjack missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Cre.zhDescription: 在非航道星舰任务中，召唤一名指定的舰员作为后备支援。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fir.name: Grand Finale
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fir.description: Want a more spectacular fireworks display to show your patriotism? Celebrate in style with this single use consumable item.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fir.zhDescription: 想要以更壮观的烟火表演来展现你的爱国精神吗？以这个仅限一次使用的道具来庆祝吧。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fir.name: Starburst
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fir.description: Celebrate the holiday with fireworks! Light up the sky with this single use consumable item.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fir.zhDescription: 用烟火来欢庆假日！以这个仅限一次使用的道具来点亮整片天空吧。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fom.name: Fomorian Disruptor
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fom.description: When activated, it disrupts a Fomorian core's Omega energy field, making it vulnerable. Also shields Tenno from Omega radiation.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Fom.zhDescription: 启动时它会破坏巨人战舰核心的奥米伽能量力场，使其变得脆弱易损。并为暴露在奥米伽辐射中的 Tenno 提供庇护。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Gly.name: Glyph Prism
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Gly.description: Launches a magnetic prism to display your chosen Glyph. Only one may be deployed at a time, and charges are consumed on use.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Gly.zhDescription: 发射一道电磁光谱来展示你所选取的浮印。同一时间只能部署一个，并且一旦使用将消耗道具。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Gly.name: Glyph Prism
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Gly.description: Launches a magnetic prism to display your chosen Glyph. Only one may be deployed at a time, and charges are unlimited.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Gly.zhDescription: 发射一道电磁光谱来展示你所选取的浮印。同一时间只能部署一个，并且可以无限次地使用。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Gol.name: Force Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Gol.description: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Gol.zhDescription: 一个战甲的克隆复制品，可以部署来协助 Tenno 执行任务。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Hun.name: Kinetic Siphon Trap
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Hun.description: Specialized trap for attracting and slowing the movement of synthesis targets.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Hun.zhDescription: 用以吸引或减缓结合目标移动速度的特制陷阱。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.name: Pherliac Pods
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.description: Creates 50x Pherliac Pods that releases powerful pheromones to attract the Infested.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.zhDescription: 制造 50个 费洛髂荚囊，能释出强烈的费洛蒙吸引感染者。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.name: Spari Spear
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.description:
Plumb the depths with this crafty fishing spear that's barely detectable to Infested and hybrid/Orokin fish. Due to its Infested aspect, it's one of the only known things that can pass through exocrine. 

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk. This spear is most effective on fish found in the Cambion Drift (Deimos).
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.zhDescription:
用这把狡黠的鱼叉来探索深渊，感染者和感染者/奥罗金混种鱼类几乎无法察觉它。由于它的感染属性，它是已知的少数几种可以穿过外分泌液的鱼叉。 

从殁世幽都的'女儿'处获得。这根鱼叉对魔胎之境的鱼类最有效。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.name: Ebisu Spear
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.description:
Plumb the depths with this crafty fishing spear that's barely detectable to Infested and hybrid/Orokin fish. Due to its Infested aspect, it's one of the only known things that can pass through exocrine. 

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk. This spear is most effective on fish found in the Cambion Drift (Deimos).
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.zhDescription:
用这把狡黠的鱼叉来探索深渊，感染者和感染者/奥罗金混种鱼类几乎无法察觉它。由于它的感染属性，它是已知的少数几种可以穿过外分泌液的鱼叉。 

从殁世幽都的'女儿'处获得。这根鱼叉对魔胎之境的鱼类最有效。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.name: Potent Pherliac Pods
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.description: Creates 50x Potent Pherliac Pods that releases powerful pheromones to attract the Infested.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.zhDescription: 制造 50 个强效费洛髂荚囊，能释出强烈的费洛蒙吸引感染者。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.name: Antiserum Injector
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.description: Injects antiserum into Vaporizers or the user to prevent armor degradation.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Inf.zhDescription: 将抗血清注入雾化器或是使用者本身，可防止护甲被侵蚀。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Lib.name: Synthesis Scanner
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Lib.description: Synthesize a genetic data of the target and uploads it to the Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Lib.zhDescription: 结合目标的基因数据并将其上传至圣殿。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Mac.name: Scorpion Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Mac.description: Deploys a SCORPION EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Mac.zhDescription: 设置一个为你战斗的毒蝎卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Map.name: Loc-Pin
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Map.description: A persistent waypoint marker for use with the world map. Coordinate your squad and track places of importance!
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Map.zhDescription: 一种使用在世界地图中的持久性标记点。协调你的队伍并追踪一些重要的位置！

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.name: Nosam Cutter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.description:
Standard tool for cutting ore and gems out of stone.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.zhDescription:
从石头中切割矿石和宝石的标准的工具。

远离城镇中心，将有更高几率开采出稀有矿物。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.name: Focused Nosam Cutter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.description:
A more accurate variation of the Nosam Cutter.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.zhDescription:
一款更精准的诺萨姆切割器变体。

远离城镇中心，将有更高几率开采出稀有矿物。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.name: Advanced Nosam Cutter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.description:
Enhanced with cybernetics, this tool is able to locate nearby gems and ore veins and has chance to retrieve Rare Gems on any Landscape.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.zhDescription:
经过控制理论的升级，这把工具能够定位附近的宝石和矿脉，并有几率在任何地形中获取稀有宝石。

远离城镇中心，将有更高几率开采出稀有矿物。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.name: Sunpoint Plasma Drill
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.description:
Fast-ignition, high-intensity mining tool capable of extracting the rarest of materials with surgical precision.

Can be used to retrieve Rare Gems on any Landscape. Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Min.zhDescription:
这是一把快速点火、高强度的采矿工具，能够以外科手术般的精确度开采最稀有的矿物。

可在任何地形中获取稀有宝石。远离城镇中心，将有更高几率开采出稀有矿物。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Moa.name: Moa Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Moa.description: Deploys a MOA EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Moa.zhDescription: 设置一个为你战斗的恐鸟卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Nem.name: Requiem Ultimatum
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Nem.description: Provokes an immediate confrontation with your Kuva Lich or Sister of Parvos: an insult which cannot be ignored.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Nem.zhDescription: 引发与你的赤毒玄骸或帕尔沃斯姐妹的直接对抗：这是一种不容忽视的侮辱。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Pla.name: Cosmic Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Pla.description: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Pla.zhDescription: 一个战甲的克隆复制品，可以部署来协助 Tenno 执行任务。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Raz.name: Razorback Cipher
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Raz.description: Used to bypass security systems that protect the Razorback's holding cell.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Raz.zhDescription: 用来绕开保护利刃豺狼收容室的安保系统。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rep.name: Omni
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rep.description: An Omni is a multi-use Railjack tool for extinguishing fires, grounding electrical hazards, and repairing hull ruptures. Use outside the Railjack to instantly recall back to the ship.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rep.zhDescription: 万用工具是一种多功能的航道星舰工具，用于扑灭火灾、抢救电力事故，以及修复舰体破裂。在航道星舰外使用可立即被召回舰上。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rob.name: Shockprod Fishing Spear
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rob.description:
Purpose built to recover Servofish without damage. Delivers a disabling electromagnetic pulse after a successful hit if timed correctly.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna. This spear is most effective on Servofish found in the Orb Vallis (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rob.zhDescription:
一种能够捕获伺服鱼，同时避免对其造成伤害的工具。若在恰当的时机命中目标，它就会释放出带有失能效果的电磁脉冲波。

从福尔图娜的操盘手处获得。这根鱼叉对奥布山谷（金星）的伺服鱼最有效。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rob.name: Stunna Fishing Spear
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rob.description:
Successful electromagnetic pulses radiate outward also disabling any nearby Servofish.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna. This spear is most effective on Servofish found in the Orb Vallis (Venus).
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rob.zhDescription:
成功发射的电磁脉冲往外散发同时瘫痪任何附近的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜的操盘手处获得。这根鱼叉对奥布山谷（金星）的伺服鱼最有效。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rol.name: Roller Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rol.description: Deploys a ROLLER EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Rol.zhDescription: 设置一个为你战斗的滚子卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sca.name: Codex Scanner
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sca.description: Samples a target of interest for later analysis in your Codex (25 charges).
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sca.zhDescription: 抽样扫描感兴趣的目标到资料库，用于日后分析。（25个装）

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Shi.name: Shield Osprey Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Shi.description: Deploys a SHIELD OSPREY EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Shi.zhDescription: 设置一个为你战斗的护盾鱼鹰卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sil.name: Phase Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sil.description: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sil.zhDescription: 一个战甲的克隆复制品，可以部署来协助 Tenno 执行任务。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ska.name: Desert Skate Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ska.description: Deploys a DESERT SKATE unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Ska.zhDescription: 设置一个为你战斗的沙漠鳐鱼魅影。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.name: Lanzo Fishing Spear
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.description:
The barbed prongs on this fishing spear make it easier to catch fish with smooth skin. 

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish:
Charc Eel
Cuthol
Goopolla
Murkray
Sharrac
Yogwun
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.zhDescription:
这把鱼叉有着带倒刺的叉齿，便于抓住表皮光滑的鱼类。 

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。这根鱼叉对以下夜灵平野的鱼类最有效：
查克鳗
克苏尔
古泊拉
阴暗鳐
鲨客
约格温

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.name: Tulok Fishing Spear
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.description:
This fishing spear features a slender blade to puncture armored plates and carapaces. 

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish:
Tralok
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.zhDescription:
这把鱼叉有着细长的刃，可以穿透护甲板和外壳。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。这根鱼叉对以下夜灵平野的鱼类最有效：
塔洛

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.name: Peram Fishing Spear
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.description:
This fishing spear has multiple blades that allow it to pierce the hides of scaly fish. 

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish:
Glappid
Khut-Khut
Mawfish
Mortus Lungfish
Norg
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Spe.zhDescription:
这把鱼叉有着多道刀刃，可以穿透有鳞鱼的外皮。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。这根鱼叉对以下夜灵平野的鱼类最有效：
盖拉佩德
库特-库特
喉鱼
摩图斯肺鱼
诺格

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sta.name: Stable Corruptor
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sta.description: Injected into a Fomorian Reactor this corruptor will imbalance the fuels. Critically imbalanced reactors will eventually implode, destroy the ship. Slow but effective, recommended for Solo Tenno.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sta.zhDescription: 对巨人战舰反应堆注射这个污染物会造成燃料失调，失调的精密反应堆最后会发生聚爆，并摧毁船只，缓慢但是有效，推荐给独行 Tenno。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sta.name: Stalker Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sta.description: Deploys a clone of the Stalker to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sta.zhDescription: 部署一名追猎者分身为你作战。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sur.name: Surge Eximus Specter
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sur.description: Deploys a clone of the Surge Eximus to fight for you.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Sur.zhDescription: 部署一名电涌卓越者分身为你作战。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Val.name: Eros Arrow Skin
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Val.description: Show the enemy how much you care with the adorable Eros Arrow skin.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Consumable/Val.zhDescription: 借由可爱的爱神之箭外观来对你的敌人诉说他们在你心目中的地位。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.name: Sunrise Apothic
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.description: Creates an organic compound composed of rare plant species. Effects unknown.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.zhDescription: 制作一种由稀有植物合成的有机混合物。效果未知。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.name: Nightfall Apothic
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.description: Creates an organic compound composed of rare plant species. Effects unknown.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.zhDescription: 制作一种由稀有植物合成的有机混合物。效果未知。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.name: Twilight Apothic
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.description: Creates an organic compound composed of rare plant species. Effects unknown.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TitaniaQuest/S.zhDescription: 制作一种由稀有植物合成的有机混合物。效果未知。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Damag.name: Extinguished Dragon Key
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Damag.description:
Damage is greatly reduced while key is equipped.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Damag.zhDescription:
装备该钥匙，伤害会极大的降低。

蓝图可以通过氏族道场中的奥罗金实验室获得。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Healt.name: Bleeding Dragon Key
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Healt.description:
Health is greatly reduced while key is equipped.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Healt.zhDescription:
装备该钥匙，生命会极大的降低。

蓝图可以通过氏族道场中的奥罗金实验室获得。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Shiel.name: Decaying Dragon Key
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Shiel.description:
Shields are greatly reduced while key is equipped. Full Shield Gate duration is capped at 0.33s.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Shiel.zhDescription:
在装备钥匙时，护盾会大幅减少。满护盾保险持续时间的上限会限定在 0.33 秒。

蓝图可以通过氏族道场中的奥罗金实验室获得。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Speed.name: Hobbled Dragon Key
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Speed.description:
Speed is greatly reduced while key is equipped.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Upgraded/Speed.zhDescription:
装备该钥匙，速度会极大的降低。

蓝图可以通过氏族道场中的奥罗金实验室获得。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/CatbrowVampire.name: Vasca Curative
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/CatbrowVampire.description: Known as 'lisau heisah' by the Ostrons, this is a traditionally-brewed remedy for the Vasca virus. Once applied any infected Kavats within a short radius are cured.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/CatbrowVampire.zhDescription: 这是一种用传统方式调制而成的噬血病毒治疗剂，Ostron 人称之为'lisau heisah'。一旦使用，小范围内所有被感染的库娃都会得到治愈。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Cipher.name: Cipher
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Cipher.description: Single-use device used for auto-hacking the lockdown control panels.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/Cipher.zhDescription: 自动入侵被锁定控制面板的一次性道具。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamAmmoTo.name: Squad Ammo Restore (Medium)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamAmmoTo.description: Restores 2x Primary and Secondary Ammo Pick Up Amount every 15s for 60s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamAmmoTo.zhDescription: 每 15 秒恢复 2 倍主要和次要弹药拾取量，持续 60 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamEnergy.name: Squad Energy Restore (Medium)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamEnergy.description: Restores Energy to all squad members. Pulses 50 Energy every 5s for 20s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamEnergy.zhDescription: 恢复全团队的能量。每次脉冲恢复 50 点能量。脉冲间隔 5 秒，共计 20 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamHealTo.name: Squad Health Restore (Medium)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamHealTo.description: Restores Health to all squad members. Pulses 100 Health every 5s for 20s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamHealTo.zhDescription: 恢复全团队的生命值。每次脉冲恢复 100 点生命。脉冲间隔 5 秒，共计 20 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamShield.name: Squad Shield Restore (Medium)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamShield.description: Restores Shields to all squad members. Pulses 100 Shield every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ClanTeamShield.zhDescription: 恢复全团队的护盾值。每次脉冲恢复 100 点护盾。脉冲间隔 7.5 秒，共计 30 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ErsatzSummon.name: Kaithe Summon
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ErsatzSummon.description: Summon and instantly mount a Kaithe while in free roam missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ErsatzSummon.zhDescription: 在自由漫游任务中召唤并立即骑上绝灵骥。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/HeavyWeaponSum.name: Archgun Deployer
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/HeavyWeaponSum.description: Deploy the selected archwing gun in any atmospheric environment using this gear item.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/HeavyWeaponSum.zhDescription: 使用此装备道具来在任何大气环境下使用选定的曲翼枪械。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/HoverboardSumm.name: K-Drive Launcher
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/HoverboardSumm.description: Summons a K-Drive for use during free roam missions
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/HoverboardSumm.zhDescription: 在自由漫游任务中召唤 K 式悬浮板使用

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAirSuppor.name: Air Support Charges
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAirSuppor.description: Charges consumed by Landing Craft Air Support.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAirSuppor.zhDescription: 登陆艇空中支援会消耗呼叫器。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAmmoDrop.name: Squad Ammo Restore (Medium)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAmmoDrop.description: Restores 2x Primary and Secondary Ammo Pick Up Amount every 15s for 60s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAmmoDrop.zhDescription: 每 15 秒恢复 2 倍主要和次要弹药拾取量，持续 60 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAutoHack.name: Override
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAutoHack.description: Ordis hacks into enemy systems and disrupts security protocols for a short period.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetAutoHack.zhDescription: Ordis 入侵敌方系统，暂时中断敌人的安保系统协议。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetBarrage.name: Carpet Bomb
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetBarrage.description: Ordis drops bombs in a line from your position to the beacon you placed.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetBarrage.zhDescription: Ordis 会从你的位置直线到信标的距离内投下炸弹。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetBlackHole.name: Vortex
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetBlackHole.description: Creates a whirling mass of energy that violently attracts nearby enemies, crushing their atoms into a tiny spec of matter.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetBlackHole.zhDescription: 创造一个大规模旋转的能量，猛烈牵引附近敌人，粉碎他们的原子成微小物质。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetGoldenIns.name: Orokin Eye
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetGoldenIns.description: Ordis scans the area for rare items.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetGoldenIns.zhDescription: Ordis 扫描该区域以寻找稀有物品。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetKahl.name: Kahl Beacon
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetKahl.description: Calls Kahl and a retinue of his Brothers to assist you for a limited time. Subsequent uses heal Kahl's squad and add an additional Brother.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetKahl.zhDescription: 召唤卡尔和他兄弟的随从们在限定的时间内协助你战斗。后续使用可以治疗卡尔的小队并为你增加一个额外的兄弟。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetMedStatio.name: Med-Tower
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetMedStatio.description: Ordis delivers a Med-Tower to restore health to nearby allies.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetMedStatio.zhDescription: Ordis 配送一座治疗塔，可恢复附近友军的生命值。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetShield.name: Snow Globe
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetShield.description: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetShield.zhDescription: 冻结周围所有水气与水分，制造出能用来防御的球形冰罩；冰罩生成时有短暂的无敌时间，此时敌人对冰罩造成的伤害能强化冰罩的耐久度；在相同位置重复施放冰罩可强化其耐久度。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetStun.name: Dreamers
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetStun.description: Nora sends enemies to dreamland with a calming tune.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetStun.zhDescription: 诺拉以平静的曲调将敌人送到梦境。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetTurret.name: Sentry Gun
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetTurret.description: Ordis delivers an automatic turret that will fire upon nearby visible enemies.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LisetTurret.zhDescription: Ordis 会投放一门全自动炮台来打击附近视野内的敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LoadoutTechSum.name: Necramech Summon
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LoadoutTechSum.description: Summon a Necramech to the battlefield.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/LoadoutTechSum.zhDescription: 召唤一架殁世机甲到战场上。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/MotorcycleSumm.name: Atomicycle Summon
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/MotorcycleSumm.description: Summons an Atomicycle for use in 1999 and free roam missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/MotorcycleSumm.zhDescription: 在《1999》和自由漫游任务中召唤一辆原子摩托车。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/OpenArchwingSu.name: Archwing Launcher
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/OpenArchwingSu.description: Summons an Archwing for use during free roam missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/OpenArchwingSu.zhDescription: 在自由漫游任务中召唤一架曲翼。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ScenarioBeacon.name: OpLink
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ScenarioBeacon.description: A device used to manage coordination and resources during Operation Link missions.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/ScenarioBeacon.zhDescription: 一个在联动作战任务期间用于协调管理及资源分配的设备。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SelfHealLarge.name: Health Restore (Large)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SelfHealLarge.description: Instantly restores your Health to full.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SelfHealLarge.zhDescription: 立即将你的生命恢复至全满

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SelfPistolAmmo.name: Pistol Ammo Box
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SelfPistolAmmo.description: Restores a bunch of pistol ammo.

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SelfRifleAmmo.name: Rifle Ammo Box
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SelfRifleAmmo.description: Restores a bunch of rifle ammo.

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SelfShotgunAmm.name: Shotgun Ammo Box
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SelfShotgunAmm.description: Restores a bunch of shotgun ammo.

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SelfSniperAmmo.name: Sniper Ammo Box
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SelfSniperAmmo.description: Restores a bunch of sniper ammo.

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SyndicateTeamA.name: Squad Ammo Restore (Large)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SyndicateTeamA.description: Restores 3x Primary and Secondary Ammo Pick Up Amount every 15s for 60s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SyndicateTeamA.zhDescription: 每 15 秒恢复 3 倍主要和次要弹药拾取量，持续 60 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SyndicateTeamE.name: Squad Energy Restore (Large)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SyndicateTeamE.description: Restores Energy to all squad members. Pulses 100 Energy every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SyndicateTeamE.zhDescription: 恢复全团队的能量。每次脉冲恢复 100 点能量。脉冲间隔 7.5 秒，共计 30 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SyndicateTeamH.name: Squad Health Restore (Large)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SyndicateTeamH.description: Restores Health to all squad members. Pulses 300 Health every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SyndicateTeamH.zhDescription: 恢复全团队的生命值。每次脉冲恢复 300 点生命。脉冲间隔 7.5 秒，共计 30 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SyndicateTeamS.name: Squad Shield Restore (Large)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SyndicateTeamS.description: Restores Shields to all squad members. Pulses 300 Shield every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/SyndicateTeamS.zhDescription: 恢复全团队的护盾值。每次脉冲恢复 300 点护盾。脉冲间隔 7.5 秒，共计 30 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TeamAmmoTotem.name: Squad Ammo Restore (Small)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TeamAmmoTotem.description: Restores 1x Primary and Secondary Ammo Pick Up Amount every 15s for 60s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TeamAmmoTotem.zhDescription: 每 15 秒恢复 1 倍主要和次要弹药拾取量，持续 60 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TeamEnergyTote.name: Squad Energy Restore (Small)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TeamEnergyTote.description: Restores Energy to all squad members. Pulses 25 Energy every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TeamEnergyTote.zhDescription: 恢复全团队的能量。每次脉冲恢复 25 点能量。脉冲间隔 7.5 秒，共计 30 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TeamHeal.name: Squad Health Restore (Small)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TeamHeal.description: Restores Health to all squad members. Pulses 30 Health every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TeamHeal.zhDescription: 恢复全团队的生命。每次脉冲恢复 30 点生命。脉冲间隔 7.5 秒，共计 30 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TeamHealTotem.name: Squad Health Restore (Small)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TeamHealTotem.description: Restores Health to all squad members. Pulses 30 Health every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TeamHealTotem.zhDescription: 恢复全团队的生命。每次脉冲恢复 30 点生命。脉冲间隔 7.5 秒，共计 30 秒。

/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TeamShieldTote.name: Squad Shield Restore (Small)
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TeamShieldTote.description: Restores Shields to all squad members. Pulses 35 Shield every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Types/Restoratives/TeamShieldTote.zhDescription: 恢复全团队的护盾。每次脉冲恢复 35 点护盾。脉冲间隔 7.5 秒，共计 30 秒。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Kavat/KhoraPrime.name: Venari Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Kavat/KhoraPrime.description: Khora's will, Venari's fangs and claws.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Kavat/KhoraPrime.zhDescription: Khora 的意志，薇娜丽的尖牙利爪。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Kavat/KhoraKavat.name: Venari
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Kavat/KhoraKavat.description: Khora's loyal Kavat. Her constant companion and protector.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Kavat/KhoraKavat.zhDescription: Khora 忠诚的库娃。她永远的同伴和守护者。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Wyrm
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Crowd Dispersion' as default Precepts, Wyrm is a highly offensive Sentinel. Wyrm also comes with a laser rifle.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: 以「突击模式」和「群体击散」为预设指令，是强力进攻型的守护，并同时具备激光步枪。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Taxon
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Molecular Conversion' as default Precepts, Taxon protects its owner with shield restoration. Equipped with the Artax ice-beam.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: 以「突击模式」和「分子转化」为预设指令，塔克桑利用护盾恢复来保护主人。它装备了阿塔克斯冰冷光束。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Shade
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Revenge' and 'Ghost' as default Precepts, Shade is well suited for stealth gameplay. Shade also comes with a burst laser pistol.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: 以「复仇」和「幽灵」为预设指令，非常适合隐匿型玩法，并同时具备点放式激光手枪。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Oxylus
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Scan Aquatic Lifeforms' and 'Scan Matter' as default Precepts, Oxylus was designed to assist in Search-and-Rescue operations through the harsh landscape around The Orb Vallis. Oxylus also comes with a Multron rifle.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: 以「扫描水生生命体」和「扫描物质」为默认指令，奥克绪罗斯被设计用于奥布山谷外围严酷环境的搜救行动。奥克绪罗斯拥有一把多连穿甲枪。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Prisma Shade
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: A rare jewel of the void. How could anything so beautiful be crafted for stealth?
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: 虚空中的一种稀有珍宝。怎有如此美丽宝物竟是为潜行锻造？

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Wyrm Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: Both bodyguard and status symbol, the Wyrm Prime Sentinel was the last line of defense for high ranking Tenno in the Orokin Era.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: 保镖与地位的象征，在奥罗金时代中，蛟龙守护 Prime 是高阶Tenno 的最后一道防线。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Shade Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: Shade Prime specializes in stealth and comes locked and loaded with the Burst Laser Prime. Together, you can dominate the shadows.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: 阴影 Prime 专长隐形，它装载了激光点发 Prime。和它一同主宰暗影吧。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Helios Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: This knowledge hungry protector defends its master with Deconstructor Prime.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: 这个充满求知欲的守护与分离 Prime 一同防卫着它们的主人。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Dethcube Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube Prime is the apex of lethal support. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle Prime weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: 以「突击模式」和「汽化」作为预设指令，死亡魔方 Prime 是致命支援的巅峰。其标配武器为死亡机枪 Prime。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Carrier Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: This ornate sentinel is an excellent example of late Orokin craftsmanship and styling.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: 这架华丽的守护是呈现奥罗金晚期工艺与风格极佳的范例。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Nautilus Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: This brave deckhand defends his crew with Verglas Prime.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: （英文：NAUTILUS PRIME）这位勇敢的水手使用冰凇 Prime 来保护他的船员。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Helios
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Investigator' as its unique Precept and 'Deconstructor' as its weapon, the versatile Helios Sentinel acts as both a lethal guardian and an automatic codex scanner. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: 赫利俄斯拥有独特的「侦查」指令并以「分离」作为武器，这位多功能的守护既是致命的守护者，又是资料库的自动扫描器。扫描功能须在身上携带扫描器，且扫描器有可使用的扫描次数才能触发。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Djinn
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Thumper' and 'Fatal Attraction' as default Precepts, Djinn is a combat Sentinel. Djinn also comes with a poison dart weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: 以「重击者」和「致命诱惑」为预设指令，引灵是一个战斗守护，还配备了毒镖武器。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Nautilus
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Auto Omni' and 'Cordon' as default Precepts, this Sentinel is the ideal companion for long voyages aboard a Railjack.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: 以「万用自修」和「防线封锁」为默认指令，这件守护是搭乘航道星舰远航的理想同伴。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Dethcube
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube acts exactly as advertised, as a badass cube of 'deth'. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: 以「突击模式」和「汽化」为预设指令，死亡魔方就像广告宣传的那样，是一个带来死亡的超棒魔方，内置死亡机枪。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Carrier
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Ammo Case' as default Precepts, Carrier is a seeker Sentinel. Carrier also comes with a shotgun weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: 以「突击模式」和「弹药储转箱」为预设指令，搬运者是一个前锋守护，并配备一把霰弹枪。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Diriga
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: Diriga shocks nearby enemies, and picks off distant threats, utilizing the Vulklok sniper rifle and the 'Calculated Shot', 'Arc Coil' and 'Electro Pulse' precepts.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.zhDescription: 电气浮囊会电击附近的敌人，并针对远处的威胁目标进行攻击。使用「金工火枪」狙击步枪与「精算射击」、「电弧线圈」与「电光脉冲」等独特技能。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/RetrieverKub.name: Chesa Kubrow
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/RetrieverKub.description: A clever accomplice, trained to relieve the enemy of both their weapons and their loot caches.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/RetrieverKub.zhDescription: 一个聪明的伙伴，经过训练可以从敌人手中夺取武器和战利品。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/HunterKubrow.name: Sunika Kubrow
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/HunterKubrow.description: Bred by the Orokin for combat. This martial beast lives to create chaos and bring down the most fierce opponents.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/HunterKubrow.zhDescription: 由奥罗金培育，用于战斗。这头武术野兽的使命是制造混乱，击倒最凶猛的对手。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/GuardKubrowP.name: Raksa Kubrow
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/GuardKubrowP.description: A strong guardian focused on protecting its master by bolstering their defense and by driving away attackers.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/GuardKubrowP.zhDescription: 强大的守护者，专注于通过加强防御和驱赶攻击者来保护其主人。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/FurtiveKubro.name: Huras Kubrow
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/FurtiveKubro.description: A stealthy ally, surprising enemies with impressive takedowns of explosive force.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/FurtiveKubro.zhDescription: 一个隐秘的伙伴，以惊人的爆炸力量出其不意地击倒敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/ChargerKubro.name: Helminth Charger
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/ChargerKubro.description: An experimental blending of Kubrow and Infestation. Uses maggots and other Infested abilities to inflict damage and control the battlefield.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/ChargerKubro.zhDescription: 库狛与感染者的实验性混合体。可使用蛆虫和其他感染者的能力造成伤害并控制战场。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/AdventurerKu.name: Sahasa Kubrow
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/AdventurerKu.description: A reliable partner that locates supplies for their Tenno master and while thinning enemy ranks.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/AdventurerKu.zhDescription: 一个可靠的伙伴，为他们的 Tenno 主人找到补给并削弱敌人的力量。

/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/VampireCatb.name: Vasca Kavat
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/VampireCatb.description: Now free of the Vasca virus, these Kavats can transfuse life to extend not only their own health but that of their master.
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/VampireCatb.zhDescription: 现在，这些库娃已经摆脱了噬血病毒，它们可以通过输送生命来延长自己的生命值，同时也可以延长主人的生命值。

/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/MirrorCatbr.name: Adarza Kavat
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/MirrorCatbr.description: A vicious and deadly Kavat prized for its combat prowess, offering increased critical chance and punishing those that dare attack it.
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/MirrorCatbr.zhDescription: 凶猛而致命的库娃因其战斗力而备受推崇，它能增加暴击几率并惩罚那些胆敢攻击它的人。

/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/CheshireCat.name: Smeeta Kavat
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/CheshireCat.description: This sly feline is playful yet devious.
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/CheshireCat.zhDescription: 这只狡猾的猫既好玩又诡诈。

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.name: Sly Vulpaphyla
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.description: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.zhDescription: 速度快且狡猾，让狐帕菲拉作为敏捷的友军，和你一起踏上下一次历险。

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.name: Vizier Predasite
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.description: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.zhDescription: 这些强悍的四足捕食者会成为你在战斗时的强大伙伴。

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.name: Pharaoh Predasite
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.description: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.zhDescription: 这些强悍的四足捕食者会成为你在战斗时的强大伙伴。

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.name: Medjay Predasite
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.description: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.zhDescription: 这些强悍的四足捕食者会成为你在战斗时的强大伙伴。

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.name: Crescent Vulpaphyla
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.description: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.zhDescription: 速度快且狡猾，让狐帕菲拉作为敏捷的友军，和你一起踏上下一次历险。

/Lotus/Types/Ship/AdvancedResourceDrone.name: Titan Extractor Prime
/Lotus/Types/Ship/AdvancedResourceDrone.description:
Deploy the Extractor on a planet to collect large amounts of resources.

Must be emptied regularly for maximum efficiency and monitored for damage.
/Lotus/Types/Ship/AdvancedResourceDrone.zhDescription:
在一个星球上部署采集机来收集大量资源。

必须定期清理，才能达到最高效率并防止损坏。

/Lotus/Types/Ship/AdvancedUcResourceDron.name: Distilling Extractor Prime
/Lotus/Types/Ship/AdvancedUcResourceDron.description:
The Distilling Extractor Prime has an increased chance of acquiring uncommon and rare resources.

Deploy this Extractor on a planet to collect large amounts of resources. It must be emptied regularly and monitored for damage.
/Lotus/Types/Ship/AdvancedUcResourceDron.zhDescription:
精粹采集机 PRIME 增加获得稀有资源的几率。

部署采集机在星球收集大量资源 ，它必须定期清理并检查是否有损坏。

/Lotus/Types/Ship/BasicResourceDrone.name: Titan Extractor
/Lotus/Types/Ship/BasicResourceDrone.description:
Deploy the Extractor on a planet to collect resources.

Must be emptied regularly for maximum efficiency and monitored for damage.
/Lotus/Types/Ship/BasicResourceDrone.zhDescription:
在一个星球上部署采集机来收集资源。

必须定期清理，才能达到最高效率并防止损坏。

/Lotus/Types/Ship/BasicUcResourceDrone.name: Distilling Extractor
/Lotus/Types/Ship/BasicUcResourceDrone.description:

Deploy this Extractor on a planet to collect resources. It must be emptied regularly and monitored for damage.
/Lotus/Types/Ship/BasicUcResourceDrone.zhDescription:
精粹采集机增加获得稀有资源的几率。

将采集机部署到一个星球上收集资源。采集机必须定期清理和检查以防止损坏。

/Lotus/Types/Ship/LandscapeTrapLight.name: Titan Extractor
/Lotus/Types/Ship/LandscapeTrapLight.description:

/Lotus/Types/Ship/VoidTraderResourceDron.name: Prisma Niroda Extractor
/Lotus/Types/Ship/VoidTraderResourceDron.description: Featuring unrivaled Orokin engineering, this advanced model was designed for peak volume extraction in the harshest of conditions.
/Lotus/Types/Ship/VoidTraderResourceDron.zhDescription: 拥有奥罗金最顶尖的技术，这款进阶采集机被设计为能在最恶劣的环境下取得最多数量的资源。
